title: Military and Family Life School Counselor
location: Fort Knox KY 40121 MFLC Fort Knox Central
description:
This position has the primary responsibility of providing the full breadth of Child and Youth Behavioral (CYB) counseling services to children of all ages of military service members and their families at military installations and off military installations. These services may include non-medical counseling, training/ health and wellness presentations, consultation with parents, personnel, schools, and consultation to installation command regarding behavioral health issues affecting children and youth. CYB School counselors will be assigned to Department of Defense (DoDEA) schools and community schools and will need to have experience working in a school setting to qualify for a school position. CYB School counselors will also be assigned to youth programs, summer camps, and on demand assignments. The counselors work closely with the installation and military branch Points of Contact (POC) to assure that the program is provided within scope and meets the needs of the installation and the schools.

  • Provides non-medical, short-term, solution focused, counseling directly to eligible children and youth of service members at assigned primary and secondary locations. Services include assessment, brief counseling and consultation, action planning, referral to resources (assuring linkage as appropriate), and follow-up as indicated.

  • CYB counselors will also have a focus on supporting the staff and personnel of DoDEA , community schools, summer camps (if available/assigned) as well as providing parent training and guidance.

  • Provides training and health and wellness presentations, participates in health fairs and other base/installation activities focused on children and youth.

  • Enters counselor activity data daily through smart phone, or web application, to assure that reporting is accurate from assigned installation while maintaining confidentiality and anonymity of service/family member.

  • Establishes and maintains working relationships with community resources focused on children and youth and provides appropriate linkages. Consistently visible within the school which allows MFLC services to be accessible when working with children, the counselor must abide by line of sight protocol (another adult with responsibility for the child must be able to see the counselor and child they are working with at all times).

  • Partners with POC to provide CYB services in a manner that addresses the needs of the installation/facility. Develops an effective and professional working relationship with the installation/facility POC.

  • Manages duty to warn and restricted reporting situations according to DoD protocol and staffs the cases with Regional Supervisor/Regional Director.

  • Communicates with Regional Supervisor and participates in regular individual and group supervision, sharing information regarding trends and issues on the installations and in facilities to which they are assigned. Responds to critical incidents and special requests as directed by the POC and approved by the Office of Secretary of Defense (OSD) program manager. The CYB will flex schedule to respond to urgent requests as needed or at the request of the Regional Supervisor/Regional Director.

  • Participates in regular in-services/training, Quality Improvement committees, initiatives, studies, pilot programs other contract activities as assigned/appropriate as directed by the customer and/or Magellan. This includes participation in pilot program certification and training processes, completion of activity documentation, integration of pilot activities in non-medical counseling work, and the utilization of applicable technology to complete required activities.

  • All other duties as assigned.

The job duties listed above are representative and not intended to be all-inclusive of what may be expected of an employee assigned to this job. A leader may assign additional or other duties which would align with the intent of this job, without revision to the job description.

Other Job Requirements

Responsibilities

Master’s Degree from an accredited Graduate Program in a Mental Health related field.

Valid unrestricted independent counseling license from a State, District of Columbia, US Territory or Commonwealth that grants authority to provide counseling services as an independent practitioner.

Less than 2 years of post-licensure clinical experience.

Demonstrate intermediate-level competencies in technology and software (i.e., Microsoft Suite, Internet navigation, Smartphone/Tablet and application navigation, video-conferencing platform navigation).

Requires ability to engage and communicate with military members or children as assigned, in order to accomplish job functions, and to respond quickly to emergent situations in any physical location on a military installation and/or within a school setting, which includes the need to traverse short and/or long distances within the base to both indoor and outdoor locations, to maneuver through rugged, outdoor or uneven locations (e.g., steep inclines, stairs, grass), and work in outdoor weather and other military base conditions. Due to the nature of working on military installations or related worksites, counselors may need to comply with various site-specific requirements to work at designated locations. For example, for some assignments, counselors will need to have certain current immunizations or vaccinations and provide record of receipt.

Ability to prove US Citizenship and must be fluent in English.

Understanding, sensitivity and empathy for service members and their families. Ability to develop trusting, helping relationships. Ability to work with individuals and families from diverse racial, ethnic and socioeconomic backgrounds.

Pass a National Agency Check and Inquiries (NACI) Clearance, and an Installation Records Check (IRC), Criminal Background Check, and FBI Fingerprints Check.

title: Senior Game Artist | New Games
description:
Craft:

Art

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Game Artist to help define, create, and implement visual content for an IP Centric brand new Mobile Game

This role is ideal for an experienced generalist with strong 2D art foundations who has successfully moved into 3D production and understands how game art lives inside the engine. You will help shape ideas visually, create production-ready assets, and make sure they are implemented correctly in Unity.

The right candidate combines strong artistic taste, stylized visual design, solid 3D skills, and practical engine knowledge. You should be comfortable moving from sketch and concept exploration into modeled, textured, optimized, and integrated game assets, while also helping raise the quality bar for the wider art team. You’ll be a founding generalist and backbone of a new art team - a self starting attitude is essential!

Your role within the Kingdom

  • Create high-quality visual concepts for characters, props, environments, features, events, and gameplay elements.

  • Produce stylized, production-ready assets

  • Work across the full asset pipeline, from idea exploration to engine implementation.

  • Model, texture, optimize, and prepare assets for Unity.

  • Implement and review assets in-engine to ensure they meet visual and technical requirements.

  • Support visual development

  • Maintain consistency across art style, scale, readability, materials, and lighting.

  • Collaborate with Art Direction to refine visual direction and solve creative challenges.

  • Provide clear visual feedback and support to other artists when needed.

  • Help improve asset workflows, documentation, and implementation standards.

Collaboration and Integration

  • Work closely with Art Direction to maintain the project’s visual quality and style.

  • Collaborate with Game Designers to create visuals that support gameplay clarity and player understanding.

  • Work with Technical Artists and Unity developers to ensure assets are correctly implemented and optimized.

  • Support the team by sharing best practices for asset creation, optimization, and Unity implementation.

  • Respond well to feedback and iterate quickly while maintaining quality.

Skills to create thrills

  • Strong portfolio showing excellent concept art, visual design, and 3D game art

  • Strong drawing, shape language, color, composition, and design skills.

  • Solid 3D production skills, including modeling, texturing, materials, and optimization.

  • Strong experience implementing art assets in Unity.

  • Good understanding of real-time game art constraints and mobile performance requirements.

  • Ability to take an asset from concept through final in-engine integration.

  • Strong understanding of stylized art pipelines.

  • Good knowledge of scale, readability, lighting, materials, and asset consistency in-engine.

  • Experience working with established art direction and maintaining visual consistency.

  • Ability to troubleshoot asset issues in Unity and collaborate with technical teams.

  • Ability to mentor, guide, or support other artists through feedback and best practices.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to give and receive constructive feedback.

  • Good sense of polish, quality control, and production readiness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on casual, mobile, or family-friendly games.

  • Experience with Blender.

  • Experience with Photoshop, Clip Studio Paint, or equivalent concept art tools.

  • Experience with Substance Painter, ZBrush, or equivalent 3D art tools.

  • Knowledge of basic shaders, materials, lighting, and prefab workflows in Unity.

  • Comfort supporting live game features, events, or seasonal content.

  • Experience working with basic animation and vfx

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help shape the visual quality of a major global IP on mobile.

  • A collaborative art team focused on craft, clarity, and polish.

  • The chance to work across concept, 3D production, and in-engine implementation.

  • A healthy work culture that values trust, ownership, and teamwork.


Success in this role means ideas are explored clearly, assets are built beautifully, and final art is integrated smoothly into the game.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. title: Senior Systems Engineer I
description:
Job Description Summary

Are you a seasoned Systems Engineer ready to take on a role where you can shape technology, solve complex problems, and make a meaningful impact? Join STEMCELL Technologies, Canada’s largest biotechnology company, and help us build modern, cloud-based systems that power our growing organization!

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of business-critical systems and infrastructure that enable STEMCELL’s employees and customers. In this role, you will bring strong experience with scalable, high-volume cloud environments to build secure, reliable, and self-service solutions that make it easier for our teams to access the best data, tools, and capabilities they need to do their best work.

If you’re a problem solver who thrives on complexity, takes ownership of your work, and approaches challenges with curiosity and pragmatism, this role could be the right fit for you!

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities


  • Design, develop and maintain cloud-based applications, tools and services on AWS supporting STEMCELL’s staff and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of your tools and services, including responding to and debugging production issues across different cloud services, and taking proactive action to prevent future problems
  • Embed into corporate technology and project teams as a subject matter expert to design, deliver and maintain new systems or applications
  • Partner with other technology teams to develop and improve design and operating best-practices; Explore and advocate for new methods and technologies
  • Respond to emergencies and system failures including after-hours problems; lead troubleshooting and resolution of escalated issues


Knowledge and Qualifications


  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent, plus 3+ years in DevOps/Systems Engineering building and running one or more large-scale web applications
  • AWS Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) certified with hands-on expertise in systems administration and operations, including fluency across a number of infrastructure technologies including AWS, GCP, Active Directory, and Entra
  • Exposure or experience to automation or infrastructure-as-code technologies (Terraform, Python, CloudFormation) and an understanding of fundamental networking concepts DNS, DHCP, AWS VPC foundations, AWS security and traffic control, AWS scaling and hybrid connectivity
  • Excellent full-stack problem-solving skills, utilizing metrics, monitoring, and reporting to drive root-cause resolution and service reliability



#NonBench #LI-Onsite #LI-KP1


STEMCELL Technologies is a privately owned, Vancouver-based biotechnology company that helps power leading-edge life science research around the world. title: Graphic Designer – Production
description:
Job Summary:

About the Role
XPEL is looking for a Graphic Designer - Production to join our creative team in support of sales and marketing initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for taking conceptual design ideas and creating visual representations of them, for traditional/print and digital mediums that help our sales channels tell the XPEL story, blending traditional design production skills with hands-on experience using AI-powered creative tools. This is a great opportunity for a design professional who enjoys fast-paced, high-volume production work and wants to be at the leading edge of AI-assisted visual content.
What We're Looking For
Someone who is equal parts designer and technologist — comfortable in traditional Adobe/Figma production workflows but excited to use AI tools to generate and refine vehicle imagery quickly and accurately. You take pride in clean, consistent, dealer-ready output and enjoy solving creative production challenges at scale.

Core Duties

  • Create and design various materials for print and digital collateral
  • Partner with the creative, sales, and marketing teams to translate requests into polished, on-brand deliverables.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects within design specifications and restrictions
  • Ensure projects are completed on schedule and to the highest degree of quality
  • Provides seamless transition of artistic vision from concept to realized product
  • Builds technically accurate files according to departmental standards and supplied specifications
  • Maintain existing brand guidelines across all creative and graphic materials and contribute to further development of a “best-in-class” organizational brand identity
  • Identifies inconsistencies between creative concept, production file and Company standards, then actively seeks out solutions to keep work moving forward without sacrificing quality or deliverability
  • Create and maintain artwork files and documentation for production on printed mediums, digital distribution, and cross-platform use
  • Develop graphics for use in product illustrations, promotional materials on social media, pre-production mockups, website content, and more
  • Plan and schedule multiple overlapping projects and deliver on time and on budget
  • Exercise excellent judgment and make recommendations that balance the needs of the company
  • Have the ability to manage multiple competing and important priorities quickly and effectively communicate back to other stakeholders.
  • Have a strong sense of urgency, integrity and impeccable professionalism.
  • Demonstrate knowledge and experience with graphic art software, applications, and utilization of digital resources
  • Generate AI renders of vehicles to support marketing and sales collateral.
  • Stay current on emerging AI design and generation tools, and recommend ways to improve production workflows.
  • Enthusiastically represent XPEL and present a professional appearance
  • Constantly be learning
  • Have a strong creative problem-solving ability


Job Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience performing production, graphic design functions with a strong demonstrative portfolio or body of work
  • Hands-on experience with AI creative tools, including Nano Banana, Artlist, Midjourney, and Claude.
  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s Degree in Graphic Design/ Digital Design, Visual Communication, Media, or equivalent experience
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite including but not limited to InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, etc.
  • Strong sense of trend spotting across all facets of visual communication on a global scale
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills – consider combining with next two
  • Ability to work well with others both in-person and across other locations via remote communications
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to effectively communicate and integrate with geographically dispersed leaders and teams
  • Automotive, aftermarket, or dealer-industry design experience is a plus.

XPEL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Trumf - Data Engineer
description:
Vil du være med på å utvikle løsningene som gjør data tilgjengelige for innsikt, analyse og rapportering i et av Norges største fordelsprogrammer? Trumf har over 3,1 millioner medlemmer og håndterer hver dag store mengder data fra et bredt spekter av kilder og systemer.


Som Data Engineer hos Trumf får du jobbe med Snowflake, dbt, SQL og Python for å utvikle gode datamodeller og fleksible dataprodukter. Du blir en viktig del av arbeidet med å gjøre data tilgjengelige, pålitelige og sikre for analyse og innsikt.


Din rolle i teamet

Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig analyse- og datateam med ti fagpersoner: dataanalytikere, data scientists og data engineers. Sammen utvikler vi robuste og moderne løsninger for personalisering, innsikt og beslutningsstøtte.


Som Data Engineer vil du samarbeide tett med kolleger på tvers av fagområdene for å forstå behov og utvikle effektive, skalerbare og sikre dataprodukter. Du får en sentral rolle i arbeidet med datamodellering, og vil bidra til at data blir tilgjengelige for Trumf, NorgesGruppen og samarbeidspartnerne våre.


Du vil blant annet:

  • Utvikle og forvalte effektive dataflyter og integrasjoner i skybaserte og eksisterende on-prem-miljøer.
  • Designe, implementere og optimalisere datamodeller for innsikt, analyse og rapportering.
  • Bidra til god datakvalitet, automatiser testing, dokumentasjon og overvåking av dataløsningene.
  • Samarbeide tett med beslutningstakere, analytikere og andre utviklere for å forstå databehov og levere målrettede løsninger.
  • Ivareta sikkerhet og personvern i utvikling og forvaltning av dataløsningene.


Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:


  • Bachelor- eller mastergrad i informatikk, ingeniørfag eller et relatert fagområde.
  • Erfaring med utvikling og forvaltning av dataløsninger og datapipelines.
  • God kompetanse i SQL og Python.
  • Erfaring med, eller interesse for, Snowflake og dbt.
  • Kunnskap om Microsoft Azure og infrastruktur som kode (IaC), gjerne med erfaring med Terraform.
  • Kjennskap til datamodellering, datakvalitet og automatisert testing.
  • Kjennskap til Git, CI/CD, DevOps-verktøy og tilhørende prinsipper.
  • Forståelse for informasjonssikkerhet og personvern knyttet til data.

Vi ser gjerne at du har relevant erfaring, men oppfordrer også nyutdannede med et godt faglig fundament og sterk interesse for data engineering til å søke.


Som person er du strukturert, nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert. Du setter deg raskt inn i nye problemstillinger og evner å omsette ny kunnskap til praktiske løsninger. Du har god gjennomføringsevne og egendriv, samtidig som du samarbeider godt med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kolleger.



Spennende rolle? Da håper vi å høre fra deg så snarlig som mulig og senest innen 11. oktober 2026.

Har du spørsmål er du velkommen til å kontakte analytiker Hilde Sletten på tlf. 922 48 428.

Trumf er Norges største lojalitetsprogram med mer enn 2,8 millioner medlemmer som sparer over en milliard kroner i bonus per år. Konseptet er et sentralt utgangspunkt for utviklingen av digitale tjenester og kundedialog for NorgesGruppen sine kjeder og samarbeidspartnere.

title: Electrophysiology Technologist I
description:
As one of the nation's Top 15 Health Systems, recognized by Premier and Modern Healthcare, Valley Health is a place where excellence, compassion, and purpose come together. This distinction reflects our commitment to exceptional patient care, clinical quality, and the caregivers who make it all possible.



Department

ELECTROPHYSIOLOGY - 206171

Worker Sub Type

Regular

Work Shift

Pay Range

$33.64 - $50.46

Job Description

The Electrophysiology Technologist provides support to physicians and other medical personnel in real time surgery by evaluating fluoroscopy options, performing radiologic imaging, and providing problem solving solutions to equipment issues during procedures in the Electrophysiology Lab in order to maximize efficiency and equipment usage.

Responsibilities and Duties

Creates accurate, high-quality images before, during, and after surgical procedures by operating imaging equipment and other Electrophysiology lab equipment/devices and adapts as necessary for procedures planned by physicians.

Provides input to physicians on fluoroscopy imaging during procedures and acts as a fluoroscopy equipment resource. Anticipates fluoroscopy needs, exposure factors, and contrast media for patients undergoing hybrid procedures.

Selects and handles instruments and supplies used for the procedure, monitors supplies as depleted and obtains additional supplies throughout surgical procedures and inventories all countable items pre- and post-surgery to ensure none remain in the patient post-operatively.

Notifies supervisor of malfunctioning equipment immediately.

Assists nursing in assuming care for physical and psychological needs of the patient during the procedures, e.g., monitoring vital signs (before, during and after cases), minimizes patient discomfort.

Anticipates needs of physician and other team members during electrophysiology procedures.

Assures that informed consent has been obtained on the patient and that all questions and concerns have been answered to the patient's satisfaction.

Safely operates and troubleshoots complex Electrophysiology Lab equipment.

Thoroughly documents procedure events and patient care into EMT and Imaging System to capture patient visit and charge information, including exam time and resource/supply usage, in adherence with hospital/regulatory requirements.

Annotates images, as needed, and sends all studies to Imaging Systems and the correct work list which limits the number of unnecessary, unspecified exams.

Adheres to radiation safety measures under the supervision of the Radiologist and further ensures safety of patients, hospital employees, and physicians by following all personnel, safety and infection control policies, National Patient Safety Goals, TJC standards, and proper universal infection control guidelines.

Supervises radiologic technology students during clinical rotations and orientation of new personnel.

Provides support and coverage for radiologic needs in the operating room and invasive areas.

Participates in continuing education and learning experiences to enhance and maintain current knowledge and skills for continued competence.

Education

High School Diploma or GED required

Completion of an accredited (2) year Allied Health training program preferred

Experience

Two years of full-time equivalent work experience in invasive cardiology, diagnostic and interventional cardiac electrophysiology, including Advanced Mapping and Device Implants (pacemaker, ICD, and CRT) preferred

Certification & Licensure

Registered Cardiac Electrophysiology Specialist certification required within two years of hire

A Registered Radiology Technologist may be hired into this position with ARRT(R) registry and satisfactory completion of an AMA accredited Radiologic Technology Program required

BLS Certification (Basic Life Support) - American Heart 'Healthcare Provider' (HCP) - AHA approved required. New hires must have American Heart Association (AHA) appropriate certification prior to completion of orientation.

ACLS Certification (Advanced Cardiac Life Support) required prior to the completion of orientation.

Qualifications

Demonstrates knowledge and skill of the moderate sedation process required

Demonstrated knowledge of human growth and development required

Competence in providing fluoroscopy services for patients of all ages including pediatric, adolescent, adult and geriatric required

Demonstrated progressive learning required

Excellent written and verbal communication required

Ability to relate to physicians, peers, and patients on a professional and technical level required

Ability to independently fulfill educational needs to pursue self-development opportunities required

Physical Demands

17 A Medical Technician/Other Technicians/Assistants

FLSA Classification

Non-exempt

Benefits

At Valley Health, we believe everyone is a caregiver, and our goal is to create an environment where our caregivers thrive physically, financially, and emotionally. In addition to a competitive salary, our most popular benefits for full-time employees include:

  • A Zero-Deductible Health Plan
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Retirement Savings Match
  • A Robust Employee Assistance Program to help with many aspects of emotional wellbeing
  • Membership to Healthy U: An Incentive-Based Wellness Program

Valley Health also offers a health savings account & flexible spending account for childcare, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, and professional development. In addition, several perks come with working for the largest employer in the region, such as discounts to on-campus dining, and more.

title: Vice President & Actuary
description:
This Vice President & Actuary position is responsible for leading and managing the actuarial staff for Westchester Digital/Middle Market and coordinating the Westchester Actuarial effort to improve system driven pricing, as well as the data and reporting strategy. The role is based in Philadelphia, PA and reports to the Lead Actuary for Westchester.

Duties and Responsibilities related to this position:

    • Work closely with WSG management to set priorities and coordinate the actuarial support

    • Manage a team of two actuaries, including setting the staff’s priorities/workloads and training/developing

    • Complete/Oversee annual pricing studies, as well as ad-hoc pricing study requests

    • Complete/Oversee monthly, quarterly and annual reporting requirements, including price monitoring and NvR, as well as the improvement of these reports as appropriate.

    • Assist in developing the annual financial plan

    • Work with the predictive analytics team as needed

  • Systems and Reporting:

    • Work closely with WSG management and IT to complete product enhancements in Fast Track and improve system driven rating

    • Oversee actuarial testing to confirm proper execution of system enhancements.

    • Ensure prioritization and execution of systems items needing actuarial support through involvement in ongoing meetings with IT

    • Create consistency in rating and reporting across WSG where possible, working with other NA actuarial groups where appropriate

    • Maintain appropriate documentation of pricing models and assumptions

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field.

  • Previous managerial or supervisory experience is strongly preferred but not required. We are open to individuals who have demonstrated leadership potential in other ways, such as leading projects or mentoring colleagues.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to provide clear and concise verbal and written communications to stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

title: Events and Engagement Officer (Saudi Arabia)
description:
The Events and Engagement Officer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing high-profile academic/nonacademic and institutional events. The role ensures exceptional attendee experience, seamless logistics, effective communication, and strong stakeholder engagement. This position works closely with leadership, Director Operations, external partners, and service providers to deliver events that align with the institution’s strategic objectives and reputation for excellence.

Scope of Work

· Coordinate the end-to-end planning and execution of academic conferences, workshops, symposiums, and visits.

· Develop detailed event timelines, floor plans, and run-of-show documents.

· Manage on-site operations including registration, venue setup, AV coordination, catering, and other requirements.

· Ensure compliance with campus policies, safety standards, and protocol guidelines for high-profile attendees.

· Coordinate cross-functional input and approvals required for high-impact events.

· Plan, coordinate, and execute end-to-end logistics for on-campus and off-campus events (campus-wide or external), including travel arrangements, accommodation, transportation, airport assistance, visas (if required), room bookings and setup, catering, formal meetings, cultural or social activities, and related services.

· Manage event-related procurement and financial processes, including raising purchase requisitions (PR), processing purchase orders (PO), completing service entry sheets (SES), handling invoice processing, supporting vendor onboarding and registration, tracking event budgets, and conducting post-event financial reconciliation.

· Serve as a liaison between internal departments and external vendors/service providers (e.g., catering, transport, event agencies) to coordinate event requirements and ensure successful execution.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Communications, or a related field.
  • At least two (2) years of experience in event planning, logistics coordination, or a similar role, preferably in an academic or research environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in coordinating events of varying sizes and complexities, with a track record of successful execution.
  • Experience in budget management and financial tracking for events.

description:

Division 70


Job Title: Advanced Tree Trimmer

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026


Job Summary:

The Advanced Tree Trimmer role is a qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer responsible for pruning and removing trees, limbs and shrubs away from power lines to reduce vegetation interference. This role utilizes various types of equipment, tools, and techniques to perform advanced tree care while addressing growth patterns and ensuring tree health, and appearance.


Essential Job Duties:

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.
  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.
  • Works aloft to cut branches or trunk sections and drop or lower them to the ground with rigging lines.
  • Uses appropriate tools on the ground to fell trees or spars and split them into manageable pieces.
  • Works around hazardous equipment and may work in close proximity to energized power lines while providing direct supervision of the activities of non-qualified employees working in close proximity to energized conductors.
  • Applies herbicide with growth regulators to brush and stumps. Maintains appropriate application records.
  • Adheres to and helps educate less experienced employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods and OSHA regulations.
  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.
  • Feeds brush and debris into woodchipper.
  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.
  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.
  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty for the duration of the disaster.
  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.
  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.
  • May assist with obtaining written permission from property owners. Helps promote and maintain good customer and public relations as well as with employees.

Supervisory Duties:


Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).
  • Ability to adhere and coach employees on company and industry safety requirements.
  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.
  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.
  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.
  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.
  • Must be able to comprehend and/or read and write both written and verbal job instructions and safety information.
  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.
  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.
  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.
  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.
  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 1 year of experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.
  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred, but not required.
  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.
  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.
  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.
  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.
  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Possesses the ability to lift, move, and maneuver up to 50 pounds on an infrequent basis and up to 30 pounds on a frequent basis.
  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.
  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.
  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.

Resumen del puesto:

El Advanced Tree Trimmer es un Qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer (podador calificado para el despeje de líneas) responsable de podar y retirar árboles, ramas y arbustos cerca de las líneas eléctricas para reducir la interferencia de la vegetación. La persona en esta función utiliza diversos equipos, herramientas y técnicas para realizar cuidados avanzados de los árboles, considerando patrones de crecimiento y asegurando la salud y apariencia del árbol.


Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.
  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.
  • Trabaja en altura para cortar ramas o secciones de tronco y bajarlas al suelo con cuerdas de aparejo.
  • Utiliza herramientas apropiadas en el suelo para talar árboles o troncos caídos y dividirlos en piezas fáciles de manipular.
  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y puede desempeñarse en proximidad a líneas energizadas mientras supervisa directamente las actividades de empleados no calificados que trabajan cerca de conductores energizados.
  • Aplica herbicidas con reguladores de crecimiento a la maleza (brush) y los troncos. Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.
  • Cumple y ayuda a capacitar a empleados con menos experiencia sobre las políticas de la empresa, los procedimientos, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de OSHA.
  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.
  • Introduce maleza (brush) y residuos en la astilladora.
  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.
  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson. sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.
  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio durante la duración del evento.
  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y de propiedad de empleados de Wright.
  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.
  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.
  • Puede asistir en la obtención de permisos escritos de los propietarios de las propiedades. Ayuda a promover y mantener buenas relaciones con clientes, público y empleados.

Funciones de supervisión:


Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con el público, los clientes y los empleados.
  • Conocimiento y comprensión de American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para Operaciones de Cuidado de Árboles - ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de American National Standards for Proper Pruning (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la Poda Adecuada - ANSI A300).
  • Capacidad para cumplir y capacitar a los empleados sobre los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.
  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.
  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.
  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.
  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.
  • Capacidad para comprender o leer y escribir tanto las instrucciones laborales como la información de seguridad, en forma escrita y verbal.
  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.
  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.
  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.
  • Conocimiento y capacitación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).
  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.
  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Department of Transportation (Departamento de Transporte, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de FMCSA.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

Responsible for leveraging advanced analytics and data science to drive pricing strategies, optimize revenue, and maximize performance across our product offering within North America Supply Chain. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and pricing experts to create impactful pricing solutions, refine discount logic, and support consistency across product categories and regions.

Essential Job Duties

  • Partner with pricing and business experts to maintain, refine, and scale price-setting logic across downstream systems, supporting pricing consistency across categories and regions.
  • Work alongside data professionals, including data engineers, IT, and Sr. Data Scientist to design robust data models and algorithms that support pricing systems, target discount logic, and other core data-driven solutions within the Supply Chain Org.
  • Analyze large, diverse datasets to test hypotheses, conduct predictive modeling, and inform pricing decisions across product lines.
  • Collaborates with Sr. Data Scientist pricing engines/algorithms for >1,000,000 individual SKUs across 5+ price levels.
  • Assists in shaping the Pricing Analytics roadmap by identifying emerging data science needs, recommending analytical tools, and proposing new methodologies to support the pricing function.
  • Alongside Sr. Data Scientist, assists with KPI tracking to assess the effectiveness of pricing initiatives, detect trends, and support proactive, data-driven decision-making.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses and reporting for real-time business needs, ensuring insights are accessible and relevant to key stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships with the Pricing leadership team and other cross-functional teams, establishing trust through consistent, high-quality insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Assumes other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Not responsible for supervising employees.

Basic Qualifications


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a professional data scientist or equivalent work experience, Ideally, within industrial goods, engineering products, distribution, or B2B sales environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data visualization and analytics tools, especially Power BI.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders across functions.
  • High fluency using analytics tools in a business setting, including Excel and report-building software (experience with Power BI or SQL a plus).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Applied Math, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and to draw and interpret graphs.
  • Demonstrate use of computer operations (programming, relational databases, and operating systems) and software packages.
  • Regularly uses moderately complex oral and written skills. May train others in functional areas, interact with colleagues, and deliver presentations to departmental or middle management.
  • Problems are varied and complex, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation. Problems are solved using knowledge and skills, general precedents, and practices.
  • Decisions impact the management and operations within a department or business unit. May contribute to business and operational decisions that affect the department.
  • Results are defined; sets personal own goals and determines how to achieve results with few or no guidelines to follow; supervisor/manager provides broad guidance and overall direction.
  • Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously with moderate complexity.

Essential Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Work is primarily sedentary: must be able to sit for extended periods and use a computer, keyboard, and mouse, frequently.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Travel may be required periodically, including overnight stays.

  • 401k with Generous Company Match

  • Short-Term Disability

title: Customer Supply Chain Representative - Nottingham
description:

Join a business built on trusted brands, great people and teamwork, where care and fresh ideas help keep things moving.

You’ll be encouraged to bring your strengths, supported to grow, and welcomed into a team where we make a meaningful difference together.

At Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, we're home to some of the world's most iconic brands, including Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, Monster and Costa Coffee. Behind every order delivered and every shelf stocked is a team committed to delivering an exceptional experience for our customers.

  • Managing customer queries, supply issues and complaints from initial investigation through to resolution.
  • Liaising with customers and internal stakeholders to proactively resolve delivery and service challenges.
  • Identifying trends and recurring issues, supporting continuous improvement activities and corrective actions.
  • Building strong, trusted relationships with customers to enhance their experience and strengthen partnerships.
  • Collaborating closely with Supply Chain, Logistics and Commercial teams to achieve service and operational goals.

Skills and essentials:

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of their work and is passionate about delivering excellent customer service.

  • A collaborative mindset and a willingness to work as part of a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Good PC skills, including experience using Microsoft Excel.

It would be advantageous if you also have:

  • Experience using SAP, Salesforce or similar business systems.
  • Experience working within a supply chain, logistics or FMCG environment.

Most importantly, we're looking for people who bring energy, curiosity and a commitment to delivering great outcomes for our customers. In return, we'll provide the support, development and opportunities to help you build a rewarding career with CCEP.

We are Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP), with 39,000 people serving 4 million customers across 31 markets. At CCEP, we welcome people from all backgrounds and value the experiences and perspectives they bring. title: Technical Lead - Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps - XLD
description:
Aspire Software is looking for a Technical Lead – Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps to join our team in Lebanon.

Here is a little window into our company: Aspire Software operates and manages wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

About the job:

We are seeking a hands-on Technical Lead to own cloud infrastructure and DevOps operations for the Health and Dental portfolio. This role combines technical delivery with team leadership, ensuring that the platform is reliable, secure, cost-effective and well supported.

The successful candidate will work directly with application teams to support service delivery, resolve production issues and make sound infrastructure decisions.

Team Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage two employees supporting the Health and Dental portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage two employees, providing technical direction, coaching, work prioritization and oversight of delivery.
  • Own AWS infrastructure, defined and managed through infrastructure as code.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines covering build, testing, security scanning and deployment.
  • Operate containerized production workloads, including health checks, rolling deployments and autoscaling.
  • Own backup and disaster recovery procedures, including regular restore testing.
  • Configure and maintain AWS load balancers and Nginx.
  • Manage access controls, IAM policies and secrets, and coordinate vulnerability remediation.
  • Maintain monitoring and alerting, and lead calm, methodical incident response and troubleshooting.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud spending, making clear, reasoned tradeoffs between cost, reliability, security and operational effort.
  • Work closely with application teams to troubleshoot services, coordinate releases and address infrastructure dependencies.
  • Document operational procedures, maintain technical standards and promote knowledge sharing.

Requirements

  • Hands-on AWS experience, including EC2, ECS, ECR, RDS, ACM, ALB/NLB, Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, CloudWatch and Cloud Map.
  • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Solid understanding of networking, including DNS, routing, firewalls, TLS and load balancing.
  • Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and/or OpenTofu.
  • Experience with Docker, including building, maintaining and troubleshooting container images.
  • Working knowledge of Git and CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or equivalent.
  • Experience with DNS management, preferably Cloudflare.
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting tools such as Zabbix.
  • Familiarity with Jira or equivalent ticketing and work-management systems.
  • Ability to read unfamiliar application code, particularly Java/Spring and Node.js, to support troubleshooting.
  • Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring team members.

Key Competencies

  • Operational judgment: Responds calmly to incidents, diagnoses issues systematically and communicates clearly.
  • Practical decision-making: Can explain infrastructure tradeoffs, including self-hosted versus managed services and when a temporary solution is appropriate or needs to be replaced.
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for service reliability, security, recovery readiness and ongoing costs.
  • Cross-team collaboration: Works effectively with the teams building and releasing each service.
  • People leadership: Sets clear priorities, supports team development and encourages shared knowledge.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Windows administration experience.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365, including email accounts.
  • Familiarity with employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including access provisioning and removal.

title: QA Requirements Tester - Activision
description:
Job Title:

R028182

Job Description:

Job Title: Quality Assurance Requirements Tester

Reporting To: QA Project Lead

Department: Quality Assurance

Location: El Segundo, CA

This role is based in our El Segundo, CA office and follows an onsite work schedule of five (5) days per week. Work arrangements may change at the company's discretion to meet business needs.

Your Mission

QA Testers are a support function within the Quality Assurance team. Under the supervision of the QA Project Leads and QA Management team, they are responsible for testing and generating bug reports for pre-release video games as well as verifying functionality, data content, performance, 1st Party Compliance, usability/playability, and hardware/software compatibility.

What you bring to the table

Priorities can often change in a fast-paced environment like ours, so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Assists in executing the QA project test plan by performing thorough testing on assigned software titles. This can include functionality, balance, stability, performance, interface, art, sound, text, documentation, and other types of testing.
  • Identifies and documents defects in a clear and concise manner using the assigned bug tracking database.
  • Assists the Production/Development team in tracking down issues and working out the steps to reproduce so that they are easier to locate and fix.
  • Completes regression/verification testing as needed.
  • Follows instructions and accomplishes tasks as directed by the QA Project Lead or QA Management.

Minimum Requirements

Technical

  • Experience and familiarity with multiple gaming platforms and genres.
  • Knowledge of most popular console platforms and related peripherals, PC Software/hardware, and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel).

Non-Technical

  • Excellent written/spoken English.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Strong interest in video games.
  • Must possess excellent communication skills.
  • Sharp attention to detail.
  • Team player.
  • Honesty and a strong work ethic.
  • Aptitude to learn quickly and effectively.
  • Ability to remain focused in a team-oriented environment.

Extra Points

  • Experience with Quality Assurance testing of software projects (desired).
  • Understanding of the software test cycle process (desired).

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do!     • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;

title: NPI Formulatie operator (Tijdelijk Assigment - 1,5j)
description:
NPI Operator Formulatie

Afdeling

De Small Scale Fill Finish (S2F2) afdeling maakt de lancering van nieuwe, innovatieve geneesmiddelen en vaccins mogelijk door het ontwikkelen en implementeren van nieuwe productie processen, het produceren van klinische stalen en het verwerven van product en proces kennis.

Het volledige productie proces wordt van A tot Z verzorgd door het team van de pilot plant: reinigen en steriliseren van equipment en cleanrooms, afwegen en dooien van grondstoffen, formulatie van oplossingen en suspensies, steriele filtratie, steriel afvullen van vials/spuiten en het vriesdrogen van het afgevulde product, …

In de pilot plant wordt gebruik gemaakt van divers farmaceutische equipment en processen en wordt gewerkt volgens dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden als in een commerciële farmaceutische productie plant.

Verantwoordelijkheden en opportuniteiten

Binnen clinical supply/S2F2 zijn we op zoek naar een tijdelijke versterking voor ons team gedurende 1,5 jaar. Een ideale opportuniteit om te ontdekken of de clinical supply/S2F2 wereld iets voor jou is.

Je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling van diverse nieuwe geneesmiddelen en vaccins, die elk een specifiek formulatie proces en equipment vereisen. Hierdoor krijg je de kans om met een brede waaier van processen en equipment te werken.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het formuleren van oplossingen en suspensies en mRNA producten:

· Je zorgt voor het afwegen van grondstoffen, dooien van actieve stoffen, bereiden van buffers, toevoegen van grondstoffen en actieve stoffen, aanpassen van pH, verdunningen, mengen, koelen/verwarmen, …

· Je bedient de Lipid Nano Particle (LNP) skid en de Tangential flow filtration (TFF) skid voor het formuleren van mRNA producten.

· Je voert een steriele filtratie of een bulksterilisatie uit om de bulk steriel te maken.

· Je test de integriteit van lucht- en productfilters

· Je neemt in-proces stalen zoals vereist voor de vrijgave maar ook voor de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe geneesmiddel of vaccin.

· Je assembleert tanken en assemblies volgens een product specifieke configuratie en zorgt voor de sterilisatie van deze diverse assemblies, tankenconfiguraties en klein materiaal en volgens gevalideerde procedures.

· Je reinigt het formulatie equipment en tanken en volgt hierbij strikt de quarantaine regels die verbonden zijn aan de lopende cleaning validatie voor het nieuwe geneesmiddelen of vaccin. Je reinigt ook de formulatiebooth, safety cabinet en cleanrooms.

· Je zorgt voor het dagelijks onderhoud van het uiteenlopende S2F2 formulatie equipment en lokalen.

· Je assisteert bij preventief onderhoud van het formulatie equipment.

· Je assisteert bij andere teams (filling of andere afdeling) indien nodig

· …

Functieprofiel

Must

  • Je werkt accuraat
  • Kwaliteit, orde en netheid zijn op je buik geschreven
  • Je volgt strikt procedures en documenteert nauwkeurig
  • Je werkt vlot in team
  • Goed proces en technisch inzicht
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken
  • Je communiceert goed en respectvol naar TL, shift PE, teamleden van zelfde en andere shift
  • Je kan goed tegen wisselende prioriteiten en planningswijzigingen (eigen aan clinical supply)

Nice to have

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie
  • Ervaring in een GMP omgeving
  • Ervaring in een aseptische werkomgeving



Work Location Assignment: On Premise

De Pfizer site in Puurs is één van de grootste productie- en verpakkingssites van Pfizer wereldwijd, gespecialiseerd in aseptische productie en verpakking. Jaarlijks worden in Puurs meer dan 400 miljoen doses injecteerbare vaccins en medicijnen geproduceerd. Deze zijn ter plaatse verpakt in ampullen, flacons, plastic flessen, spuiten en patronen voor pennen.

De medicijnen die in Puurs worden gemaakt, zijn bestemd voor patiënten in meer dan 170 landen wereldwijd. 30% van de productie uit Puurs is bestemd voor ontwikkelingslanden, in samenwerking met UNICEF, WHO, GAVI en ngo's.

Met het gebruik van twee windturbines, zonnepanelen en een warmtekrachtcentrale richten we ons op hernieuwbare energie.

Pfizer’s doel is om gelijke kansen te bieden in het wervingsproces door elke vorm van vooringenomenheid of mogelijke discriminatie te vermijden, ongeacht (maar niet beperkt tot) geslacht, leeftijd, ras, religie of overtuiging, seksuele geaardheid of handicap. We creëren een organisatie en bevorderen een cultuur die respect heeft voor ieders unieke karakter en levenservaringen en die de diversiteit van onze samenleving, klanten en markten weerspiegelt. Dit bereiken we door een omgeving te cultiveren en in stand te houden waarin elke collega zich gewaardeerd en ondersteund voelt.

Disability Inclusion:

Onze missie is om de kracht van al onze mensen te ontwikkelen en ruimte te geven. We zijn trots om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn, die aan alle kandidaten met een beperking gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen je aan om jezelf te zijn en dat met ons te delen, wetende dat wij ons best gaan doen om jouw sollicitatie en toekomstige carrière te ondersteunen. Jouw reis bij Pfizer begint hier!

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. description:
WHY PATIENTS NEED YOU
The Senior Manager, Site Logistics provides leadership for Kalamazoo site logistics operations supporting API and Drug Product manufacturing. The role is responsible for warehouse operations, inventory management, material flow, transportation, and distribution processes that enable reliable patient supply, operational excellence, and business performance.


WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE

The position partners across Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Procurement, Engineering, and Global Supply Chain organizations to ensure effective movement and storage of materials while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and compliance.


HOW YOU WILL ACHIEVE IT

  • Lead warehouse operations, transportation, material flow, and inventory management activities supporting site operations.
  • Ensure reliable material availability and supply chain execution to support production and customer commitments.
  • Drive inventory accuracy, warehouse optimization, and efficient movement of materials throughout the site.
  • Manage transportation operations, carrier performance, freight costs, and logistics service levels.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Quality, and Engineering to support site and network priorities.
  • Champion IMEx, Lean, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve safety, quality, service, and cost performance.
  • Manage departmental budgets, resources, and operating expenses while identifying productivity opportunities.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators to drive accountability and operational excellence.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing logistics organization while fostering an inclusive and engaged culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have

  • Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 6+ years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 5+ years of experience; OR a PhD with 1+ years of experience.
  • Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in logistics, warehousing, supply chain, manufacturing, or operations leadership.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in a complex manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with warehouse operations, inventory management, transportation, and supply chain execution.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, IMEx, APICS/CSCP, PMP, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience leading operational excellence and transformation initiatives.
  • Experience managing third-party logistics providers and transportation partners.
  • SAP and business intelligence tool experience.

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

Regular interaction with Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, Digital, Customer Service, Global Supply Chain, and external logistics service providers.


RESOURCES MANAGED

  • Site logistics organization including warehouse operations, transportation, inventory control, and material movement activities.
  • Department operating budget and logistics-related expenditures.
  • Third-party logistics and transportation service providers.

CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS

  • Patient-focused decision making.
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and compliance.
  • Data-driven leadership and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and talent development capabilities.
  • Enterprise mindset with a focus on site and network performance.


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to analyze complex operational and supply chain data.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to work in office, warehouse, and manufacturing environments.
