description:
Pike Engineering offers a wide variety of benefits including but not limited to Medical; Dental and Vision Insurance; Paid Time Off; 401(k); Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts; Employee and Dependent Basic Life Insurance; Employee and Dependent Basic Accidental Death & Dismemberment; Short Term Disability; Long Term Disability; Critical Illness; Accident and Whole Life Insurance; Legal Services, Identity Theft, and Cyber Security; Employee Discounts and Service Awards. All health care benefits are available upon election on day one (1) of your employment with Pike.

The compensation range for this position is $23/hr.

Position Overview: This is an intermediate level position which requires satisfactory performance of tasks assigned at the CAD Technician I level. Incumbents assigned to this level are required to exercise some independent responsibility in resolving problems, handling communications, and understanding department and work unit procedures. An incumbent at this level performs non-routine drafting assignments of moderate complexity from rough or general drawings, sketches, or layouts. This includes drawing irregular shapes, multiple functions, and precise positional relationships between components. Work is performed independently after initial assignment with advice provided by supervisor or engineering/designer personnel. Generally, this position requires coordination of own work details with other groups or sections within the department. The incumbent may be required to give technical advice to the Drafter 1.

Duties & Responsibilities

Under some supervision, will provide

  • Diagrams, schematics, layouts, multiview, and various drawings to scale in accordance with clients' requests.
  • Mathematical, geometrical, and minor engineering computations.
  • To scale engineering drawings using computer aided drafting system
  • Detailed design drawings and related specifications of civil/ electrical equipment according to engineering sketches, specifications, and related data and drawings to determine design factors such as size, shape, and arrangement of parts.
    • This would include structure, schematic, foundation, grounding, steel, layout, equipment, apparatus, wiring, panel, AC&DC, one lines, and other type drawings necessary to produce substation, relay, and line design job packages
  • File drawings, maintain catalogs of engineering data, and perform other routine drawing room functions as required

Requirements

  • Successful completion of high school diploma or equivalent
  • 1-2 years of training at a technical school or equivalent experience
  • 2-4 years of experience in the preparation of engineering drawings and diagrams as a Drafter 1
  • Proven AutoCad and/or Microstation skills
  • Strong PC/IT skills (i.e., Word, Excel, etc)
  • Ability to deal with a variety of individuals from various socio-economic, cultural and ethnic backgrounds.
  • Good written and oral communication skills
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills

Other Skills/Abilities

Self-Motivated

Work independently

Team-Oriented

Customer Oriented

Able to manage multiple tasks and provide leadership to other team members.

title: Product Engineering Supervisor (Pratt Valves)
description:
Who We Are:

Thank you for your interest in Mueller Water Products, Inc.

For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products, Inc. has been building the future of water infrastructure. From lifesaving fire protection to data intelligence, we are committed to developing products and solutions that help cities and utilities deliver clean, safe drinking water to hundreds of millions of people across North America.

Our purpose is to connect communities to water, life’s most essential resource, with exceptional, people solutions and products. Behind that purpose is a dedicated team, united by our shared values of respect, integrity, trust, inclusion and safety. With a vision to be the leader in water infrastructure solutions—solving challenges, enriching lives and safeguarding the future—we are making a positive impact that will last for generations.

By joining Mueller, you become part of a dynamic team dedicated to excellence and innovation, working collaboratively to achieve meaningful results. We champion our people because when they succeed, our communities thrive. We invite you to learn more about career opportunities with us and consider submitting your application.



Product Engineering Supervisor (Pratt Valves)

Mueller Water Products is the nation's leading manufacturer of flow control devices for the water and gas distribution industries and has an immediate opening for a Product Engineering Supervisor in our newest Kimball, TN facility. For over 160 years MWP’s manufacturing commitment has ensured one of the world’s most precious resources, clean drinking water, reaches millions of people daily. Come be a part of something that sustains and enriches the lives of every human being.


Job Description:

As a Product Engineering Supervisor, you will oversee the direction and assignment of work within your identified product group. You will be a first line leader for all product engineering needs for your group, maintaining relationships with direct reports as well as stakeholders within the manufacturing facility and externally. This is a working supervisory role, and the supervisor will be required to perform engineering work as necessary to achieve the goals of the department.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Directs the activities and provides guidance to Product Engineers and to meet project objectives.
  • Utilizes relevant industry standards and specifications to ensure compliant product development.
  • Facilitates communication between local plant staff and the Corporate NPD group to drive the development and diversification of product lines.
  • Maintains an updated understanding of the company's product offerings in the relevant areas to inform initial design decisions effectively.
  • Cultivates positive relationships with manufacturing personnel, addressing design-related issues, implementing cost-saving measures, and coordinating VAVE projects.
  • Establishes test requirements and procedures for new or modified products to ensure quality and functionality.
  • Nurtures productive partnerships with approved agencies such as UL, FM, and ISO to uphold regulatory compliance and product certifications.
  • Serves as a direct liaison between the sales team and product engineering to align strategies and address customer needs effectively.
  • Conducts regular one-on-one meetings with team members to provide feedback, support professional development, and ensure alignment with corporate objectives. Manages bi-annual talent management process for employees maintaining goals of the department.
  • Track engineering projects and metrics and provide regular updates of project and backlog status.
  • As needed, provide 2D and 3D working drawings according to requirements, ensuring timely schedule completion.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned to support the overall goals and objectives of the organization.

Required Skills:

  • Comfortable coaching and holding others accountable.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully achieve goals through influence.
  • Ability to assess and train others.
  • Must be able to communicate in an effective manner with all levels of employees.
  • Working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and Six Sigma tools.
  • Outstanding PC/Systems knowledge and skills including 2D and 3D CAD software and PLM databases.
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills with ability to interact with all levels of employees, customers, and outside professionals.
  • Knowledge dealing with manufacturing situations, quality standards, product development, CAD/CAM, technical specifications, and project management.
  • Travel may be required occasionally.

Required Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar technical degree.
  • 4 to 7 years of relevant external product engineering and leadership experience– or
  • 2 to 5 years of excelling relevant Mueller product experience, exhibiting strong leadership qualities.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in valves, controls, or similar applicable industrial products is desirable.
  • Knowledge of AWWA valve specifications.
  • Knowledge of third-party certifying agencies such as UL and FM are a plus.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt desired.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to remain in stationary position or standing position for prolonged periods and alternate between
  • Ability to repeat gross or fine manipulation that may include the use of wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Ability to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), including, but not limited to, safety glasses, steel-toed or metatarsal-guarded shoes, and/or ear plugs, while working in an industrial and/or manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to constantly communicate with others to exchange information in person, via phone, or via use of computer.
  • Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects up to 25 pounds in weight in all directions.
  • Ability to occasionally reach overhead or at or below shoulder level.
  • Ability to occasionally stoop, crouch, or kneel.




Other Compensation & Benefits:

Mueller offers an excellent salary and benefits package. Current benefit offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with 5% Company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), short-term and long-term disability benefits, vacation, 100% paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement program, student debt retirement matching, well-being program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-provided life insurance, supplemental insurance at group rates, and more.

title: Demand Planner
description:
Who We Are:

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.

JOB MISSION:

The EMEA Demand Planner plays a critical role in delivering business results through owning the creation, analysis, and execution of the regional demand plan. The Demand Planner will be responsible for providing a detailed forecast to the organization, at the model and item level for the EMEA region, for a designated category group. The role will also support the business by developing insights based on historical shipments, sales forecasts, sell through analytics and product plans and how this impacts the demand plan. The planner brings an analytical, data driven, and growth mindset, to their ownership of the demand plan and various forecasting activities, from both technical and overall business perspectives. This position is a key contributor within the Go-To Market process, supporting the Demand Planning Manager and Senior Demand Planner through engagement and participation in the regional S&OP process.

MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Develop the demand forecast for the region regarding specific product categories at item level, considering volume, value and stocking policy, as well as inputs from EMEA Merchandising, Sales, Marketing and Finance.

  • Responsible for forecast accuracy of owned category with the aim of continuous improvement towards MAPE targets.

  • Highlight risks and opportunities to the business and work collaboratively to implement resulting changes to the demand plan.

  • Work collaboratively with Inventory Planners to bring attention to risks and opportunities concerning the Demand Plan including signing off the DP/IP handshake.

  • Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Champion. Assist with regional S&OP activities, ensuring that S&OP process steps are aligned with the regional inventory strategy and S&OP guideline.

  • Participate in consensus meetings with key stakeholders, to align on monthly and/or seasonal item level forecasts, to be used for business planning across short, medium and long term horizons.

  • Actively manage and summarise scenario plans for potential challenges and advantages. Collaborate with Merchandising, Inventory Planning, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure communication and assumptions are accurate and aligned with business expectations.

  • Represent EMEA Demand Planning in the end to end Go-To-Market process.

  • Manage Product Lifecycles including ramp up/down logic, NII launch forecasts, style phaseout management, and sell through monitoring.

  • Work with the Sales Planning teams in the EMEA markets to understand the sales forecast and sales performance data impacts on the demand plan.

  • Support the business by developing insights that provide the organisation with high value information, with respect to their consumers, customers, product assortment and the financial health of the business.

  • Drive continuous improvement, particularly with regards to the overall demand planning and S&OP processes, through the definition and implementation of best practice, related tools and reporting capabilities whilst remaining aligned to the EMEA inventory strategy.

REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:

  • University degree and a relevant year of experience in Demand Planning, Sales Planning or Merchandising (does not have to be in a sport/fashion environment).

  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on analysis and planning, problem solving, collaboration, initiative, decision making and dealing with multiple varied partners.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and manage time, multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

  • Interest in developing strong cross functional partnerships, with a goal to strengthen forecast accuracy and improve business processes.

  • Experience in Microsoft Office: Excel (advanced level), Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, etc.

  • Demonstrate understanding of statistical forecasting and scenario modelling.

  • Experience with Microsoft D365, o9, and/or Spotfire would be an advantage.

  • APICS certification would be an advantage.

  • European language skills would be an advantage.

  • Ability to travel occasionally.

BENEFITS:

  • Discretionary Bonus Opportunity

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Dental Scheme

  • Pension Scheme

  • Flexible Working Hours

  • Hybrid working (3 days on-site)

  • 25 days Annual Leave per year

  • Life Insurance

  • Employee Discount

  • Flexibility to work 20 days from anywhere each year

  • Wellbeing and Mental Health Benefit (24/7 Employment Assistance Program & Support)

-

We are an equal opportunity employer and support a culture of diversity and inclusion.

title: FMS-ACES Senior Business / Functional Analyst (SETA Advisor)
description:
This position supports the Foreign Military Sales – Army Case Execution System (FMS-ACES) Product Office. FMS-ACES is the first Defense Business System (DBS) program in the DoDI 5000.87 Software Acquisition Pathway, within Capability Program Executive (CPE) Enterprise Software and Services (CPE ES2), located in the PMO Acquisition, Training & Readiness (AT&R) portfolio.

FMS-ACES is a cloud-based Platform as a Service (PaaS) providing a user-centric journey design that will modernize the Army’s FMS case execution and management processes from end to end. By stream-lining business processes, data standardization, integrated through state-of-the-art interface management, FMS-ACES will provide accurate case management and business analytics enabling real-time, accurate and informed data-drive decisions for Senior Leaders. FMS-ACES is in development and once fielded subsumes capabilities of a 50-year-old legacy system and consolidates two disparate systems into a single source of Army FMS data. The new system will exchange information with 26 distinct financial and logistic systems of record partners for end-to-end process execution. FMS-ACES will support 2000 users, incorporating 6,200 active FMS cases and 88,000 active requisitions.

Key Features and Capabilities:

Developed using Agile methodologies, FMS-ACES provides a unified environment for managing the full lifecycle of an FMS case:

· Case Management: Streamlines everything from initial case implementation to closeout.

· Real-Time Data: Connects to over 20 government data source systems to provide case officers with accurate, real-time information.

· Enhanced Reporting: Includes advanced automated workflows, data visualization, and comprehensive reporting capabilities.

· Transparency and Collaboration: Allows better end-to-end transparency and coordination between stakeholders like the Department of State and other military departments.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an accomplished, highly analytical Senior Business / Functional Analyst with at least 15 years of progressive experience to serve as a trusted Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) advisor to Department of the Army program leadership.

In this role, you will represent the government's best interests by providing objective technical oversight, quality evaluation, and strategic governance across contractor development teams. Rather than performing routine sprint-level backlog grooming, you will operate as an authoritative evaluator and coach—ensuring development vendors adhere to rigorous requirements engineering, SAFe execution, and deliverable quality standards. Additionally, you will directly lead targeted discovery and elicitation for complex, high-uncertainty capabilities situated far out on the multi-year solution roadmap.

The ideal candidate brings deep mastery of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles, extensive experience evaluating technical integration artifacts (APIs, schemas, data models), formal deliverable (CDRL) review discipline, advanced proficiency in Jira, and an operational mindset ensuring seamless transition to operations (O&M).

Core Responsibilities:

Contractor Evaluation, Assessment & Functional Oversight

· Artifact & Backlog Auditing: Audit contractor epics, stories, and acceptance criteria to enforce INVEST standards, DoR/DoD, and mission alignment.

· Demonstration & Acceptance Verification: Evaluate vendor sprint reviews, demos, and increments against contractual requirements prior to government sign-off.

· Non-Functional Verification: Partner with enterprise architects to verify stories incorporate throughput, data integrity, error-handling, and idempotency needs.

· Product Lead Support: Serve as primary functional evaluator supporting the Product Lead in reviewing formal contractor deliverables and CDRL items.

· Rigorous Document Analysis: Critically evaluate contract deliverables and provide constructive feedback to vendors and insights and observations to government leads.

Advanced & Far-Horizon Requirements Elicitation

· Long-Range Discovery: Lead targeted discovery and elicitation sessions for complex, ambiguous capabilities situated far out on the solution roadmap.

· Executive Stakeholder Alignment: Engage operational leads to translate policy mandates and CONOPS into structured functional baselines.

· Architectural Runway De-risking: Author functional white papers, roadmaps, and user journeys to de-risk future capabilities before engineering handoff.

SAFe Ceremony Guidance & Facilitation

· Ceremony Advisory: Mentor and guide contractor Scrum and Value Stream teams in the disciplined execution of SAFe ceremonies.

· PI Planning Oversight: Evaluate proposed team PI objectives, assess dependency management, and advise government leadership on delivery confidence.

· System Demos & I&A: Validate that system demos prove working software value; guide teams through structured root-cause analysis during I&A events.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

· Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in business/systems analysis or functional architecture on large enterprise software programs.

· Agile & SAFe Mastery: Proven track record guiding, mentoring, or assessing enterprise agile delivery and ceremonies within SAFe and Scrum frameworks.

· Far-Horizon Requirements Elicitation: Proven skill leading discovery, scoping, and roadmap elicitation for complex, ambiguous future-state capabilities.

· Story & Criteria Standards: Expert knowledge of user story conventions and structured acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then, Gherkin, BDD).

· Tooling Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence.

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Systems Engineering, or related analytical discipline.

· Clearance: Active U.S. Government security clearance (Secret or higher preferred)

Key Professional Competencies

· Technical Objectivity: Ability to provide candid, evidence-based assessments of contractor deliverables without bias.

· Advisory Influence: Strong executive presence to advise senior officials and guide contractor leads within non-personal services boundaries.

· Mission-to-Technical Translation: Ability to bridge communications seamlessly between software engineers, program leadership, and end users.

Place of Performance:

· The contractor will follow a hybrid work environment for the Place of Performance:

o On-site performance of services by the Contractor at Government facilities shall be accomplished primarily in northern Virginia, when required. Quarterly workshops at New Cumberland or northern Virginia.

Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za določen čas enega leta.


Ugodnosti in nagrajevanje:

V Novartisu smo predani soustvarjanju medicine in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo.

Pričakovani razpon plače za to delovno mesto:

27.510,00 EUR - 51.090,00 EUR

Osnovna plača se določa na podlagi vnaprej opredeljenih in transparentnih kriterijev, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje, ne glede na spol, ter v skladu z Novartisovo politiko določanja plač. Poleg osnovne plače ste lahko upravičeni tudi do kratkoročnega bonusa, ki je odvisen od določenih meril uspešnosti.

Ugodnosti zaposlitve v Novartisu vključujejo več kot le osnovno plačo in variabilno nagrajevanje. Kjer narava dela dopušča, omogočamo tudi prilagodljive in hibridne oblike dela ter najmanj 14 tednov plačanega starševskega dopusta.

Pravično plačilo je temeljno načelo naše zaposlitvene politike in odraža našo zavezanost ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava z dostojanstvom in spoštovanjem, kot je določeno v našem Etičnem kodeksu.

Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.

Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. Ste pripravljeni ustvariti svetlejšo prihodnost skupaj z nami?

title: Vendor Operations Lead - Global Clinical Operations (GCO)
description:

£67,900.00 - £126,100.00


Band

Level 5


Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid

Location: London, United Kingdom

Relocation Support: This role is based in London, United Kingdom. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis operates a Hybrid working arrangement with an expectation of 12 days per month onsite.

Home Worker/Remote contracts can be considered for candidates meeting eligibility criteria. This can be discussed at interview stage if applicable.

Strong vendor Quality and Compliance are critical to successful clinical development and inspection readiness. As Vendor Operations Lead - Global Clinical Operations (GCO), you will lead and strengthen the processes that prepare our vendor organization for regulatory inspections and audits. You will provide subject-matter expertise across inspection readiness, audit support, corrective and preventive actions, vendor compliance, and quality improvement, while helping colleagues respond effectively in demanding regulatory environments. Working across global functions and external partnerships, you will use compliance insights and performance trends to identify risks, improve processes, and ensure vendor activities meet Novartis standards and regulatory expectations.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the development and implementation of vendor operations standards, processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Lead inspection readiness and support regulatory inspection activities across vendor partnerships and operations.
  • Ensure consistent implementation of vendor risk assessment, selection, and compliance processes.
  • Oversee vendor quality and compliance metrics, identifying trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain templates, tools, and operational resources supporting vendor governance and compliance.
  • Support audit planning, preparation, and follow-up, including corrective and preventive action management.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert on vendor compliance, inspection readiness, and quality management practices.
  • Partner with global and local stakeholders to strengthen operational consistency and regulatory compliance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance vendor performance, quality outcomes, and inspection readiness.
  • Deliver training and communications supporting adoption of systems, processes, and compliance requirements.

Essential Requirements


  • University degree in business or a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Typically 8-10+ years’ experience in clinical operations, including systems, regulatory requirements, and third-party/vendor management.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice and regulations (GCP, GxP and ICH).
  • Demonstrated experience supporting and leading regulatory inspections and managing inspection back-room activities.
  • Experience with inspection readiness, storyboards, evidence collection, and regulatory document request management.
  • Experience supporting corporate or supplier audits and developing and managing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, vendor compliance, and third-party requirements across clinical operations.
  • Proven global matrix leadership, including independent ownership, analytical decision-making, and diplomatic stakeholder influence.

title: NBA POD Change Lead (AI Adoption & Enablement)
description:
Job Description:

Role Purpose

Mars Snacking’s vision is to create Better Snacks for Better Days, with a clear One Demand vision at the heart of it. At the service of the One Demand Vision, the Tech-Fueled Sales (TFS) ambition is to build a human-led, digitally-powered Sales Engine with the Associate at the center. This entails harnessing AI and data to help our associates sell smarter, serve customers better, and capture more value across every channel.

A successful Tech-Fueled Sales transformation is a human capability transformation first and a technology transformation second. The NBA Change Lead is accountable for ensuring that AI-powered solutions translate into sustained adoption, capability growth, and measurable business value across NBA/Perfect Store. Partnering with the NBA POD, commercial teams, and regional stakeholders, this role leads change management, communications, training, and business readiness efforts that enable associates to confidently adopt new tools, workflows, and ways of working. By combining strong change leadership with Digital Commerce and business transformation expertise, the NBA Change Lead helps accelerate user adoption, strengthen AI literacy, and ensure technology investments deliver lasting impact across the global NBA organization.

  • Reporting to: Global NBA POD Lead
  • Location: Chicago
  • Travel: 10-15%
  • Direct reports: 0
  • This is a transformation role with an expected end date at the end of 2029.


Key Responsibilities

  • Adoption & Change Management Strategy: Design and execute comprehensive, data-driven change management plans (leveraging frameworks like Prosci/ADKAR) specifically tailored for the iterative, agile rollout of AI agents and Next Best Actions (NBAs) to our global NBA teams.
  • Stakeholder Enablement & Business Readiness: Act as the direct engagement lead between the NBA POD and the global user base. Identify and support a network of change champions, assess business readiness, and proactively mitigate resistance to ensure smooth and successful AI tool adoption.
  • Capability Development & Training: Design and deliver a high-impact, scalable training program that builds both the confidence and competence of our commercial associates. Develop a suite of materials including quick-reference guides, interactive workshops, and digital upskilling pathways to boost AI literacy and tool proficiency.
  • Change Storytelling & Communications: Craft a compelling, value-driven narrative around the NBA transformation. Develop and execute a communications plan that moves beyond features and functions to tell "what's in it for me" success stories, celebrate wins, and drive sustained engagement and excitement.
  • Feedback Loops & Continuous Improvement: Establish and manage robust feedback loops (surveys, focus groups, user forums) to capture frontline feedback. Synthesize user insights and translate them back to the POD to drive the continuous improvement and evolution of our AI tools.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 6+ years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM), technology adoption, or business transformation, ideally gained while driving the adoption of SaaS, CRM, or AI technologies in a large, global organization.
  • Change Frameworks: Deep, practical knowledge of structured change methodologies is essential. Certification in Prosci, ADKAR, or a similar framework is highly preferred.
  • Storytelling & Communication: Elite written and verbal communication skills. Must have a demonstrated ability to demystify complex AI and technology topics into simple, practical, and value-focused stories that resonate with a commercial audience.
  • Business Acumen: A strong understanding of sales, Perfect Store/Next Best Action (NBA), or commercial ways of working is critical to building credibility and designing relevant change interventions. CPG experience is a strong asset.
  • Agile Alignment: Experience working within or alongside an Agile/Scrum team, with the ability to align change management campaigns with an iterative product release cycle.

Critical Skills & Leadership Capabilities

  • Instills Trust: Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity, which is critical when guiding people through change.
  • Influencing Without Authority: Can align and mobilize large, diverse groups of stakeholders and users across regions and functions through narrative, relationship-building, and demonstrating value.
  • Courage: Is not afraid to have difficult conversations, manage resistance, and champion a new way of working even when it's challenging.
  • Values Differences: Understands that different markets and cultures will adopt change differently and adapts strategies accordingly.
  • Being Resilient: Remains effective and positive when faced with setbacks and continues to drive progress in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.


Measures of Success

  • High adoption and sustained utilization rates for all AI agents and tools launched by the NBA POD.
  • High scores on user satisfaction, confidence, and readiness surveys.
  • Successful creation and engagement of a global network of change champions.
  • Positive feedback from regional leaders and commercial associates on the quality of communication, training, and support provided.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment.

title: Security Patrol
description:

Bilingual Overnight Driving Patrol Security Officer.
Location: Kendall, FL.
Position Type: Full-Time.
Schedule: Overnight Shift.
Hours: 40 hours per week.
Language: Bilingual English/Spanish preferred; Spanish-speaking candidates encouraged to apply.

About SMI Security:
SMI Security is seeking a professional, dependable, and experienced Security Officer to join our security team assigned to a large residential community in the Kendall area. This position requires an officer who is comfortable working independently overnight, conducting vehicle patrols, enforcing community parking regulations, and maintaining detailed documentation of daily activities.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, good judgment, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to professionally interact with residents, visitors, vendors, and community management.

Position Responsibilities:
The selected Security Officer will be responsible for maintaining a highly visible security presence throughout the community and ensuring established security and parking regulations are followed.

Primary duties include:
  • Conducting routine overnight driving patrols throughout the community.
  • Monitoring residential streets, parking areas, entrances, and other designated areas.
  • Enforcing the community's established parking rules and regulations.
  • Identifying vehicles that are illegally parked or in violation of community parking policies.
  • Documenting parking violations accurately and following established procedures for vehicle removal/towing.
  • Coordinating with authorized towing services when vehicles meet the community's established towing criteria.
  • Responding professionally to residents and visitors regarding parking and security-related concerns.
  • Maintaining a visible security presence throughout the property.
  • Monitoring for suspicious activity, property damage, safety concerns, and other incidents.
  • Conducting regular patrols using the assigned security vehicle.
  • Completing an hourly activity report documenting patrol activity, incidents, unusual occurrences, parking violations, and other relevant information.
  • Immediately reporting significant incidents or emergencies to the appropriate SMI Security supervisor and/or community management.
  • Maintaining accurate and professional written documentation.
  • Following all SMI Security policies, post orders, community rules, and client instructions.
  • Providing professional customer service while maintaining appropriate security procedures.
  • Maintaining confidentiality and professionalism when dealing with residents and community information.

Required Qualifications:
Applicants must meet the following requirements:
  • Valid Florida Security Class D License.
  • Valid Florida Driver's License.
  • Clean driving record with no points.
  • Ability to legally operate a security patrol vehicle.
  • Ability to work overnight shifts.
  • Ability to work independently with limited direct supervision.
  • Strong communication and observation skills.
  • Ability to complete detailed written and electronic reports.
  • Professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Reliable transportation to and from the assigned location.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to professionally enforce community rules and regulations.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred.
  • Previous residential community security experience.
  • Previous experience conducting vehicle patrols.
  • Experience with parking enforcement and towing procedures.

title: PAHO CONSULTANT - Fortalecimento da Resposta à Resistência aos Antimicrobianos, Vigilância Laboratorial e Prevenção e Controle de Infecções na Perspectiva de Uma Só Saúde
description:
OBJECTIVE OF THE OFFICE/DEPARTMENT

This is a requisition for employment at the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO)/Regional Office of the World Health Organization (WHO)

Contractual Agreement:

Non-Staff - National PAHO Consultant

Job Posting:

setembro 11, 2026

Closing Date:

outubro 7, 2026, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location:

Brasilia, Brazil

Organization:

BRA-01 Prevenção, controle, eliminação de doenças transmissíveis, e determinantes da saúde

Schedule:

Full time

PURPOSE OF CONSULTANCY

This requisition is for a consultancy at the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO)/Regional Office of the World Health Organization (WHO).
• Provide a short description of the objective of the office/department here.
• Provide a description of the purpose of the consultancy here.

DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES:

Objetivo/Contexto

Esta consultoria integra o Plano de Trabalho Bienal 2026–2027 da Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde no Brasil e tem como finalidade apoiar tecnicamente o fortalecimento da resposta nacional à resistência aos antimicrobianos, com ênfase na vigilância epidemiológica, laboratorial e genômica, no fortalecimento dos laboratórios de saúde pública, na prevenção e controle de infecções e na gestão de projetos de cooperação técnica conduzidos pela Coordenação de Eliminação, Prevenção e Controle de Doenças Transmissíveis e Determinantes da Saúde. A resistência aos antimicrobianos representa uma das principais ameaças à saúde pública e requer respostas integradas, coordenadas e sustentadas por evidências. Na perspectiva de Uma Só Saúde, seu enfrentamento pressupõe reconhecer a interdependência entre saúde humana, saúde animal e meio ambiente, considerando o uso de antimicrobianos, a produção de alimentos, a água e o saneamento, os resíduos e efluentes, a circulação de microrganismos resistentes e os determinantes ambientais que influenciam sua seleção e disseminação. Nesse contexto, a Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde apoia o Brasil na implementação do Plano de Ação Nacional de Prevenção e Controle da Resistência aos Antimicrobianos, fortalecendo a governança multissetorial, a integração de informações provenientes dos setores humano, animal e ambiental e a articulação entre vigilância em saúde, laboratórios, serviços de saúde, agricultura e pecuária, meio ambiente, saneamento, vigilância sanitária, instituições acadêmicas e demais parceiros estratégicos. A cooperação técnica inclui o fortalecimento da vigilância da resistência aos antimicrobianos, a participação do país em redes nacionais e internacionais, a vigilância de microrganismos e mecanismos de resistência prioritários, a vigilância em águas residuais e o aprimoramento da capacidade laboratorial. A consultoria também apoiará ações de prevenção e controle de infecções relacionadas à assistência à saúde, higiene das mãos, segurança do paciente, gestão do uso de antimicrobianos, comunicação, educação, capacitação, geração de evidências e iniciativas voltadas à resistência a medicamentos em doenças transmissíveis. A complexidade dessa agenda requer capacidade técnica e de gestão para planejar, implementar, monitorar e avaliar instrumentos e projetos de cooperação, articular contrapartes e parceiros e produzir análises e recomendações que contribuam para o fortalecimento sustentável das capacidades nacionais sob a perspectiva de Uma Só Saúde.


Resumo de Responsabilidades

Sob a coordenação técnica da Coordenação de Eliminação, Prevenção e Controle de Doenças Transmissíveis e Determinantes da Saúde, esta consultoria terá as seguintes responsabilidades: • Prestar assessoria técnica à Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde no planejamento, implementação, monitoramento e avaliação da cooperação técnica relacionada à prevenção, vigilância, controle e resposta à resistência aos antimicrobianos no Brasil, em consonância com o Plano de Ação Nacional de Prevenção e Controle da Resistência aos Antimicrobianos e com a abordagem de Uma Só Saúde. • Apoiar o fortalecimento e a integração da vigilância epidemiológica, laboratorial e genômica de microrganismos resistentes, promovendo o uso de dados para orientar a tomada de decisão em saúde pública. • Apoiar a participação do Brasil em sistemas e redes nacionais e internacionais de vigilância da resistência e do uso de antimicrobianos, favorecendo a integração de dados epidemiológicos, laboratoriais, genômicos e ambientais. • Prestar assistência técnica ao fortalecimento da rede de laboratórios de saúde pública, incluindo testes de sensibilidade aos antimicrobianos, caracterização molecular, vigilância de patógenos prioritários, identificação de mecanismos emergentes de resistência e incorporação de metodologias e tecnologias pertinentes. • Acompanhar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de vigilância de microrganismos resistentes, resistência a medicamentos em doenças transmissíveis e resistência antimicrobiana em águas residuais, bem como outras iniciativas priorizadas pelas autoridades nacionais. • Apoiar a implementação e o monitoramento de ações de prevenção e controle de infecções relacionadas à assistência à saúde, incluindo higiene das mãos, segurança do paciente e intervenções para reduzir a transmissão de microrganismos multirresistentes. • Apoiar estratégias de gestão e uso responsável de antimicrobianos, promovendo sua articulação com os setores de saúde humana e animal e com as prioridades nacionais de Uma Só Saúde. • Fortalecer a incorporação da dimensão ambiental na resposta à resistência aos antimicrobianos, considerando água, saneamento, efluentes, resíduos, vigilância ambiental e outros fatores relevantes para a seleção e disseminação da resistência. • Apoiar ações de comunicação, educação, capacitação e disseminação de evidências e boas práticas para gestores, profissionais de saúde, equipes laboratoriais, instituições acadêmicas e demais parceiros estratégicos. • Elaborar documentos técnicos, análises de situação, relatórios, apresentações, planos de trabalho, instrumentos de acompanhamento, recomendações e outros produtos necessários à execução e avaliação da cooperação técnica. Apoiar a implementação e o acompanhamento de Termos de Cooperação, projetos e iniciativas estratégicas vinculadas à resistência aos antimicrobianos, incluindo planejamento, execução técnica e orçamentária, definição de prioridades, metas, indicadores e mecanismos de acompanhamento. • Atuar de forma coordenada e interprogramática com as equipes da Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde no Brasil, com a sede regional, com a Organização Mundial da Saúde, contrapartes governamentais, instituições acadêmicas, laboratórios de referência e parceiros dos setores humano, animal e ambiental, incluindo participação em reuniões, oficinas e missões técnicas quando necessário.


Produtos esperados

1. Documento técnico contendo plano de trabalho da consultoria, cronograma de atividades, metodologia de acompanhamento e mapeamento dos Termos de Cooperação, projetos, iniciativas estratégicas, contrapartes e parceiros relacionados à implementação do Plano de Ação Nacional de Prevenção e Controle da Resistência aos Antimicrobianos e à abordagem de Uma Só Saúde.

16/11/2026 7,85% R$ 17.500,00

2. Relatório técnico de acompanhamento das ações de vigilância epidemiológica e laboratorial da resistência aos antimicrobianos, incluindo análise das atividades apoiadas pela Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde, avanços observados, lacunas identificadas e recomendações para o aprimoramento da vigilância nacional.

15/12/2026 8,12% R$ 18.120,00

3. Documento técnico contendo análise situacional das capacidades da rede de laboratórios de saúde pública para a vigilância da resistência aos antimicrobianos, incluindo testes de sensibilidade, caracterização de mecanismos de resistência, necessidades de fortalecimento, integração de informações e recomendações para qualificação da rede.

20/01/2027 8,34% R$ 18.600,00

4. Relatório técnico sobre o fortalecimento da vigilância genômica e da vigilância da resistência antimicrobiana em águas residuais, com análise das possibilidades de integração de informações humanas, animais e ambientais e recomendações para ampliar sua utilização na tomada de decisão sob a perspectiva de Uma Só Saúde.

19/02/2027 8,05% R$ 17.950,00

5. Documento técnico contendo sistematização do acompanhamento da participação do Brasil em redes nacionais e internacionais de vigilância da resistência e do uso de antimicrobianos, bem como das iniciativas de vigilância de patógenos e mecanismos de resistência prioritários, incluindo resistência a medicamentos em doenças transmissíveis.

15/03/2027 8,52% R$ 19.000,00

6. Relatório técnico sobre as ações de prevenção e controle de infecções relacionadas à assistência à saúde, incluindo higiene das mãos, segurança do paciente, prevenção da transmissão de microrganismos multirresistentes e apoio ao Programa Nacional de Prevenção e Controle de Infecções Relacionadas à Assistência à Saúde.

15/04/2027 8,27% R$ 18.450,00

7. Documento técnico contendo análise das estratégias para promover a gestão e o uso responsável de antimicrobianos, incluindo ações de qualificação da prescrição, monitoramento do consumo, fortalecimento de programas de gestão do uso de antimicrobianos e articulação entre saúde humana e saúde animal.

14/05/2027 8,61% R$ 19.200,00

8. Relatório técnico contendo análise das ações de governança e articulação multissetorial para o enfrentamento da resistência aos antimicrobianos na perspectiva de Uma Só Saúde, incluindo interfaces com saúde humana, saúde animal, meio ambiente, água, saneamento, resíduos e efluentes, com recomendações para fortalecer a coordenação intersetorial.

15/06/2027 8,09% R$ 18.044,00

9. Documento técnico contendo sistematização das ações de comunicação, educação, capacitação e disseminação de evidências relacionadas à resistência aos antimicrobianos, com identificação dos públicos prioritários, resultados alcançados, necessidades de fortalecimento e recomendações para a continuidade das ações.

15/07/2027 8,41% R$ 18.750,00

10. Relatório técnico de acompanhamento dos Termos de Cooperação e projetos relacionados à resistência aos antimicrobianos, contendo análise da execução técnica e orçamentária, situação dos produtos e indicadores, principais riscos, medidas de mitigação e recomendações para aprimorar a gestão da cooperação técnica.

10/08/2027 8,70% R$ 19.400,00

11. Documento técnico contendo avaliação dos avanços, resultados e desafios das iniciativas apoiadas durante o período da consultoria, incluindo análise de indicadores, boas práticas, lições aprendidas e recomendações para a sustentabilidade e o fortalecimento das capacidades nacionais.

09/09/2027 8,21% R$ 18.300,00

12. Relatório técnico final consolidado contendo a sistematização dos produtos, atividades, resultados e instrumentos de cooperação acompanhados, os principais avanços e desafios identificados e recomendações estratégicas para a continuidade e o fortalecimento sustentável da resposta nacional à resistência aos antimicrobianos sob a perspectiva de Uma Só Saúde.

11/10/2027 8,83% R$ 19.700,00


Habilidades/Conhecimentos Técnicos Especializados

Essenciais

• Conhecimento avançado da agenda nacional e internacional de resistência aos antimicrobianos, incluindo o Plano de Ação Nacional de Prevenção e Controle da Resistência aos Antimicrobianos e as estratégias da Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde, da Organização Mundial da Saúde e de parceiros internacionais. • Conhecimento sólido da abordagem de Uma Só Saúde aplicada à resistência aos antimicrobianos, incluindo as interfaces entre saúde humana, saúde animal e meio ambiente e os mecanismos de governança e coordenação multissetorial. • Conhecimento das estratégias de vigilância epidemiológica, laboratorial, genômica e ambiental da resistência aos antimicrobianos, incluindo a vigilância de patógenos prioritários, mecanismos emergentes de resistência e participação em redes internacionais. • Conhecimento sobre fortalecimento de redes de laboratórios de saúde pública, testes de sensibilidade aos antimicrobianos, caracterização molecular e integração de dados laboratoriais à vigilância em saúde pública. • Conhecimento sobre vigilância da resistência antimicrobiana em águas residuais e outras interfaces ambientais relevantes para a disseminação da resistência no contexto de Uma Só Saúde. • Conhecimento das estratégias de prevenção e controle de infecções relacionadas à assistência à saúde, segurança do paciente, higiene das mãos e gestão do uso de antimicrobianos. • Conhecimento dos mecanismos de cooperação técnica internacional e experiência no planejamento, gestão, monitoramento e avaliação de Termos de Cooperação e projetos de saúde. • Capacidade para elaborar documentos técnico-estratégicos, relatórios, pareceres, apresentações executivas, indicadores, matrizes e instrumentos de monitoramento e avaliação. • Capacidade para coordenar processos interinstitucionais, articular parcerias estratégicas e atuar com múltiplos atores dos setores humano, animal e ambiental em ambientes multidisciplinares e multiculturais. • Capacidade de análise crítica, planejamento, organização, negociação e acompanhamento de projetos complexos de saúde pública.

Desejáveis

• Experiência ou conhecimento aplicado na implementação do Plano de Ação Nacional de Prevenção e Controle da Resistência aos Antimicrobianos e da abordagem de Uma Só Saúde. • Experiência em iniciativas de vigilância epidemiológica, laboratorial, genômica ou ambiental da resistência aos antimicrobianos, prevenção e controle de infecções, gestão do uso de antimicrobianos ou fortalecimento de laboratórios de saúde pública. • Experiência em análise de dados, monitoramento de indicadores, elaboração de relatórios técnicos e sistematização de boas práticas e lições aprendidas. • Conhecimento ou experiência em tuberculose drogarresistente e outras doenças transmissíveis com desafios relacionados à resistência aos medicamentos. • Experiência em cooperação internacional e articulação com órgãos governamentais, laboratórios de referência, universidades, centros de pesquisa e organizações da sociedade civil.


Educação (Qualificação)

Essencial: Graduação em Ciências da Saúde. Essencial: Pós-graduação em Saúde Pública, Epidemiologia, Microbiologia, Infectologia, Vigilância em Saúde, Gestão em Saúde ou área afim.

Desejável: Formação complementar em resistência aos antimicrobianos, vigilância epidemiológica, vigilância laboratorial, vigilância genômica, prevenção e controle de infecções, gestão de projetos, cooperação técnica internacional ou abordagem de Uma Só Saúde. Será considerado diferencial o título de mestrado ou doutorado em área relacionada ao objeto da consultoria.


Experiência

Essencial: Mínimo de 07 anos de experiência profissional comprovada na área de resistência aos antimicrobianos (RAM), abrangendo o planejamento, implementação, monitoramento e/ou avaliação de projetos ou iniciativas de cooperação técnica, bem como a atuação em ações de vigilância epidemiológica, laboratorial e/ou genômica da RAM, preferencialmente no âmbito da abordagem de Uma Só Saúde.

Desejável: Experiência de trabalho com organismos internacionais, agências do Sistema das Nações Unidas, instituições governamentais, centros de pesquisa, universidades ou organizações da sociedade civil.


Idiomas

Essencial: Domínio do português, com excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita e de redação técnica.

Desejável: Conhecimento de trabalho em espanhol e/ou inglês, com capacidade para leitura, análise e elaboração de documentos técnicos.


Conhecimento de Sistemas

Essencial: Habilidade demonstrada para utilizar efetivamente computador e programas, tais como: • Microsoft Word; • Microsoft Excel; • Microsoft PowerPoint; • Microsoft Outlook; • Microsoft Teams; • SharePoint ou ferramenta equivalente de gestão documental; • plataformas virtuais de reunião e colaboração. Desejável: • sistemas de informação em saúde; • ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados; • sistemas de informação laboratorial e plataformas de vigilância epidemiológica e genômica; • painéis de monitoramento; • sistemas institucionais de acompanhamento de projetos e cooperação técnica

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Why you’ll love working here:

  • high-performance, people-focused culture

  • our commitment that equity, diversity, and inclusion are fundamental to our work environment and business success, which helps employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves

  • learning and development initiatives, including workshops, Speaker Series events and access to LinkedIn Learning, that support employees’ career growth

  • membership in HOOPP’s world class defined benefit pension plan, which can serve as an important part of your retirement security

  • competitive, 100% company-paid extended health and dental benefits for permanent employees, including coverage supporting our team's diversity and mental health (e.g., gender affirmation, fertility and drug treatment, psychological support benefits of $2,500 per year, parental leave top-up, and a health spending account).

  • optional post-retirement health and dental benefits subsidized at 50%

  • yoga classes, meditation workshops, nutritional consultations, and wellness seminars

  • the opportunity to make a difference and help take care of those who care for us, by providing a financially secure retirement for Ontario healthcare workers

Job Summary


HOOPP's Information Technology teams deliver innovative technology solutions to help build a stronger financial future for the healthcare community. As a Senior Cloud Security Engineer, you will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, challenge existing approaches, and help shape the future of cloud security at HOOPP.


Our Information Security Operations team plays a key role in securing HOOPP's cloud environments and supporting our cloud-first strategy. As a Senior Cloud Security Engineer, reporting to the Senior Manager, Information Security Operations, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and improving security controls, governance, monitoring, and security architecture across our multi cloud environment with a focus on AWS.


We cultivate a culture that emphasizes innovation, collaboration, practicality, and the courage to challenge the status quo. This role is well suited to someone who combines technical depth with curiosity, sound judgment, product thinking, systems thinking, and a willingness to test new ideas. You will look beyond immediate symptoms, identify underlying needs, and develop solutions that are secure, sustainable, and valuable in delivering the pension promise. Success in this role requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and turn emerging technologies into practical solutions that deliver measurable business impact.


What you will do:

  • Design, implement, and continuously enhance cloud security controls, standards, and guardrails across AWS and Azure environments to protect critical business services and data.

title: Regional Security Leader - Asia
description:
Job Posting Title

Regional Security Leader - Asia

Job Description Summary

Manages region-wide security responsibilities for access control, security systems, investigations, and all physical security programs.

Job Description:

Position Summary

Dauch is seeking an experienced and strategic Regional Security Manager, Asia to lead all security-related activities across our operations in Asia. This role is responsible for implementing Dauch's global, risk-driven security strategy to identify, assess, and mitigate threats that could impact our people, assets, facilities, operations, and reputation.

The Regional Security Manager will work closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure compliance with corporate security standards, maintain situational awareness of geopolitical and security developments, and proactively address emerging risks across the region. This position requires a strong understanding of enterprise security management, crisis response, intelligence analysis, investigations, and physical security operations.

Key Responsibilities

Security Leadership & Governance

  • Implement and oversee regional security procedures aligned with Dauch's Global Security policies and standards.
  • Assess business operations and establish appropriate security controls across all Asia locations.
  • Analyze security assessments, audits, and intelligence data to identify vulnerabilities affecting personnel, facilities, operations, and assets.
  • Serve as the primary security representative and trusted advisor for all security matters within the Asia region.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Legal, EHS, IT, Supply Chain, Operations, and plant leadership to support regional security objectives.
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with law enforcement agencies, government authorities, security organizations, and intelligence-sharing networks.
  • Support global security initiatives and lead assigned areas of expertise as directed by the Head of Global Security.

Physical Security

  • Lead regional security programs related to access control, guarding services, visitor management, intrusion detection, and security technologies.
  • Evaluate and enhance security systems, facility protection measures, and site security programs.
  • Ensure all regional locations comply with security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage contracted security providers and monitor service delivery against established performance expectations.
  • Oversee visitor management programs and ensure compliance with Dauch security requirements.

Investigations

  • Manage and coordinate security investigations throughout the Asia region under the direction of Global Security leadership.
  • Conduct or support interviews of witnesses and involved parties to identify causes of security incidents and policy violations.
  • Document investigative findings and support efforts to recover losses, pursue legal action, or implement corrective measures when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Human Resources on workplace concerns, involuntary terminations, threats, employee misconduct investigations, and behavioral risk assessments.
  • Partner with local law enforcement agencies as required during investigations and incident response activities.

Travel Security & Intelligence

  • Monitor regional geopolitical developments, security threats, and operational risks that could impact Dauch personnel or operations.
  • Assess threat levels and develop risk mitigation strategies based on intelligence provided by the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC).
  • Support and advise employees traveling within the region and coordinate risk mitigation plans for higher-risk destinations.
  • Collaborate with other Regional Security Managers when travel involves multiple geographic regions.
  • Collect, evaluate, and communicate relevant intelligence to the GSOC to support enterprise-wide awareness and response planning.
  • Determine the impact of security intelligence on regional operations and recommend appropriate actions.

Crisis Management & Emergency Response

  • Review and maintain crisis management and emergency response procedures across Asia operations.
  • Coordinate security responses during emergency incidents and business disruptions.
  • Partner with country and site leadership teams to manage security-related crises and recovery efforts.
  • Provide real-time situational updates and critical incident information to the GSOC for global coordination and communication.

Executive Protection & Event Security

  • Support regional leadership and special initiatives by planning and coordinating event security requirements.
  • Manage executive travel security programs in partnership with Global Security and approved security vendors.
  • Coordinate protective security measures for executive visits, business-critical events, and high-profile activities.
  • Liaise with law enforcement and government officials when required.
  • Ensure appropriate security support for international assignees and their families throughout the region.

Required Skills and Education

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant experience leading corporate security programs across multiple countries.
  • Proven experience in physical security, investigations, intelligence analysis, crisis management, and executive protection.
  • Strong understanding of geopolitical risk assessment and enterprise security management.
  • Experience working with law enforcement agencies, government organizations, and external security providers.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to travel throughout the Asia region as required.

Preferred

  • Professional security certifications such as CPP (Certified Protection Professional), PCI (Professional Certified Investigator), PSP (Physical Security Professional), or equivalent.
  • Prior experience supporting multinational manufacturing or industrial operations.
  • Experience working within a global security organization.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Strengthen security resilience across all Asia operations.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate emerging threats before they impact the business.
  • Build trusted partnerships with regional leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Drive consistent implementation of global security standards and best practices.
  • Enhance crisis preparedness and response capabilities across the region.
  • Help protect Dauch's people, assets, facilities, operations, and reputation.

Why Join Dauch?

At Dauch, security is a strategic business enabler. As Regional Security Manager, Asia, you will play a critical role in protecting our people and operations while helping shape the future of our global security program. This is an opportunity to influence security strategy at a regional level, collaborate with global leaders, and contribute to a safer and more resilient organization.

Dauch is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive.


About Dauch:

Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.

title: Military & Family Life Counselor - Child Development Center
description:
This position has the primary responsibility of providing the full breadth of Child and Youth Behavioral (CYB) counseling services to children of all ages of military service members and their families at military installations to include civilian expeditionary work force and their families (when activated). These services may include non-medical counseling, training/health and wellness presentations, consultation with parents, personnel at child development centers, and consultation to installation command regarding behavioral health issues affecting children and youth. CYB counselors will be assigned to child development centers, youth programs, summer camps, and on demand assignments. The counselors work closely with the installation and military branch Points of Contact (POC) to assure that the program is provided within scope and meets the needs of the installation.

  • Provides non-medical, short-term, solution focused counseling directly to eligible children and youth of service members at assigned primary and secondary locations. Services include assessment, brief counseling and consultation, action planning, referral to resources (assuring linkage as appropriate), and follow-up as indicated.

  • CYB counselors will also have a focus on supporting the staff and personnel of Child Development Centers (CDC), youth programs and summer camps (if available/assigned) as well as providing parent support, training, and guidance.

  • Provides training and health and wellness presentations, participate in health fairs and other base/installation activities focused on children and youth.

  • Enters counselor activity data daily through smart phone or web application to assure that reporting is accurate from assigned installation while maintaining confidentiality and anonymity of service/family member.

  • Establishes and maintains working relationships with community resources focused on children and youth and provides appropriate linkages. Consistently visible within the assigned location(s) which allows MFLC services to be accessible. When working with children, counselor must abide by line-of-sight protocol. (Another adult with responsibility for the child must be able to see the counselor and child they are working with at all times.)

  • Partners with POC to provide CYB services in a manner that addresses the needs of the installation/facility. Develops an effective and professional working relationship with the installation/facility POC.

  • Manages duty to warn and restricted reporting situations according to Department of Defense (DoD) protocol and staffs the cases with Regional Supervisor/Regional Director.

  • Communicates with Regional Supervisors and participates in regular individual and group supervision, sharing information regarding trends and issues on the installations and in facilities to which the counselor is assigned. Responds to critical incidents and special requests as directed by the POC and approved by the Office of Secretary of Defense (OSD) program manager. The CYB will flex schedule to respond to urgent requests as needed or at the request of the Regional Supervisor/Regional Director.

  • Participates in regular in-services/training, Quality Improvement committees, initiatives, studies, pilot programs other contract activities as assigned/appropriate as directed by the customer and/or Magellan. This includes participation in pilot program certification and training processes, completion of activity documentation, integration of pilot activities in non-medical counseling work, and the utilization of applicable technology to complete required activities.

  • All other duties as assigned.

The job duties listed above are representative and not intended to be all-inclusive of what may be expected of an employee assigned to this job. A leader may assign additional or other duties which would align with the intent of this job, without revision to the job description.

Other Job Requirements

Responsibilities

Master’s Degree from an accredited Graduate Program in a Mental Health related field.

Valid unrestricted independent counseling license from a State, District of Columbia, US Territory or Commonwealth that grants authority to provide counseling services as an independent practitioner.

Less than 2 years of post-licensure clinical experience.

Demonstrate intermediate-level competencies in technology and software (i.e., Microsoft Suite, Internet navigation, Smartphone/Tablet and application navigation, video-conferencing platform navigation).

Requires ability to engage and communicate with military members or children as assigned, in order to accomplish job functions, and to respond quickly to emergent situations in any physical location on a military installation and/or within a school setting, which includes the need to traverse short and/or long distances within the base to both indoor and outdoor locations, to maneuver through rugged, outdoor or uneven locations (e.g., steep inclines, stairs, grass), and work in outdoor weather and other military base conditions. Due to the nature of working on military installations or related worksites, counselors may need to comply with various site-specific requirements to work at designated locations. For example, for some assignments, counselors will need to have certain current immunizations or vaccinations and provide record of receipt.

Ability to prove US Citizenship and must be fluent in English.

Understanding, sensitivity and empathy for children, service members and their families. Ability to develop trusting, helping relationships. Ability to work effectively with individuals and families from diverse racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic backgrounds.

Pass a Child National Agency Check and Inquiries (CNACI) Clearance and an Installation Records Check (IRC), Criminal History Background Check and FBI Fingerprints Check.

Vehicle Operator's License Requirement: Unless specifically waived by the FEDSIM COR, all contractor personnel providing counseling support at Government locations shall possess a valid U.S. state vehicle operator’s license. As a condition for employment under this contract, contractor personnel may be required to pass all tests for and obtain a U.S. military vehicle operator’s permit for commercial sedans and similar, for use at Temporary Duty (TDY) locations, if required.

Must meet the Magellan MFLC CYB criteria for experience with children and youth and specialty in child and adolescent development/psychology. School assigned counselors must have past work experience in a school setting to qualify for assignment.

General Job Information

Military & Family Life Counselor - Child Development Center

Grade

MFLC Tier 2

Work Experience - Required

Clinical

Work Experience - Preferred

Master's - Behavioral Health

Education - Preferred

License and Certifications - Required

Current licensure required for this position that meets State, Commonwealth or customer-specific requirements - Care Mgmt, DL - Driver License, Valid In State - Other, Must be an independently licensed behavioral health clinician - Care Mgmt

License and Certifications - Preferred

Salary Range

Salary Minimum: $59,922

Salary Maximum: $100,280

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

This position may be eligible for short-term incentives as well as a comprehensive benefits package. Magellan offers a broad range of health, life, voluntary and other benefits and perks that enhance your physical, mental, emotional and financial wellbeing.

Magellan Health, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Tobacco-free workplace. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled.

title: Global Mobility Tax - Associate
description:

Whether someone is moving to a new country, working remotely, or traveling for business, we help ensure they have the right permits or visas, are paid and compensated according to local regulations, and remain compliant with cross-border tax requirements.


As a team member at Vialto, you’ll be part of a global network with real impact. We support 10,000+ clients in over 150 countries, and that reach gives you the room to grow, learn, and make a real difference.


We value collaboration, belonging, and innovation, and offer flexible career opportunities for people who want to shape the future of global work.

title: Studio Coordinator - Southie
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a Studio Coordinator (SC), you live your power by supporting the world class CorePower Yoga studio experience including coordinating studio operations and holding the studio to the highest health and safety standards. In alignment with our Core Values, you work alongside the Studio Manager to deliver results and sustained growth towards all current company and studio-level goals. In the SC role, you will learn the business and develop the skillset to operate a studio.

Studio Presence and Guiding the Student Experience

  • Act as an ambassador of the CorePower Yoga Core Values at all times and consistently inspire these values in others
  • Support the Studio Manager in achieving company and studio level goals, including membership growth, retail sales, community outreach, teacher and SET recruitment, and programming enrollment
  • Commit to flexible schedule of 18-29 hours per week in studio in support of operations coordination and teaching (if certified), include health and safety protocol execution, front desk guidance, and team support
  • Must be flexible with schedule availability within the hourly commitment in service of the studio and team
  • Responsibly run the studio, including by acting as the point of contact for students and staff when Studio Manager is not present, up to 20 hours per week
  • Support maintaining an appropriate level of studio supply inventory so that all provisions and amenities are available for students at all times including cleanliness inventory, locker room amenities, towels, programming materials, etc.
  • Engage and know your studio community consistently; greet students by name, serve as an ambassador of yoga both inside and outside of the studio, and spend quality time at the front desk fostering community
  • Support our teachers learning experience of working the POS and other pre/post class duties

Coordinate and Execute Health, Safety and Cleanliness Protocol in the Studio​

  • Uphold high standards for the studio and when on duty, ensure that the physical studio space meets the high CPY standards of cleanliness and functionality including a safe environment, optimum heat and humidity, inspiring music, and clean and clutter-free surroundings in all areas of the studio
  • Support communication around Smart Health Protocol to students upon entry and throughout their visit at CPY ​
  • Act as an extension of the Studio Experience Team (SET) including cleaning the studio, stocking amenities, and ensuring the CPY cleanliness protocol is always followed while on duty in the studio
  • Support the SET team by interviewing SET applicants, hiring SET employees, scheduling SET employee's shifts, stepping in for no call/no shows, training, and disciplining/terminating SET employees who have violated CPY's policies and standards
  • Lead Orientation for new Studio Experience Team members and train them on cleanliness protocol and role expectations

Coordinate Studio Systems

  • Act as a liaison between the Studio Manager and the teaching and SET teams in training, communicating, and coordinating studio operational systems including but not limited to:
  • Point of Sales System (POS); understand and efficiently navigate POS to sign students in, sell packages and memberships, and explore and correct problems with student accounts when at the desk
  • Online Reservation System; support administrative follow up of late cancel fees, waitlist, student support, etc
