title: Analyst, Land Services
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The Analyst reports to Manager, Land Services and is responsible for assisting with the land administration tasks, and maintaining land records, to ensure real estate and land-related activities are performed in a consistent, efficient manner, always in compliance with regulations and internal policies.

The Analyst is responsible for assisting departments corporate wide - supporting in land related activities - such as, but not limited to, land acquisitions/divestitures, refinancing real-estate collateral, obtaining flood-certificates, drainage studies, zoning requests, annexation agreements, surveys, plats, real property agreements (deeds, leases, easements, ingress/egress etc.), tax abatements, appraisals, etc.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Research land files to determine contractual obligations and rights concerning option and purchase/settlement agreements, contracts, deeds, easements, and lease agreements.
  • Review of title abstracts and perform curative and clearance activities required by company and/or lenders as needed.
  • Determine lease ownership interests and associated payment requirements.
  • Work with Land Department Team Members to create land-related reports and exhibits.
  • Prepare land agreements and conveyance instruments.
  • Collect and analyze data for quarterly reporting such as but not limited to, contract obligations and payments.
  • Responsible for analyzing, implementing, and maintaining contract obligations and payments for lease agreements in Quorum (land management system).
  • With supervision: assist with planning, controlling, and directing real estate activities such as site location and acquisition recommendations to management, contract negotiations, land acquisition and disposition, and land management of real property obligations – these activities are to support site/land development required for company’s projects/operations.
  • Research private and public records, determine surface ownership and associated encumbrances - analyze and interpret real-property related documents.
  • Analyze, review, interpret and set up surface agreements, right-of-ways, company owned property, and other legal documents in company land management system.
  • Analyze changes to existing surface agreements, company owned property, land contracts, and other legal documents in company land management system.
  • Maintain office space records in Company’s centralized real estate management system.
  • Assist with special projects and other assignments as required.
  • Follow company policies, plans, procedures and standards while executing tasks/projects.
  • Support departmental staff to ensure proper record administration.
  • The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

Knowledge:

Proven experience in land management, records management, and related tasks. In-depth understanding of land-related legal instruments and land title process (abstracts, opinions, policies, etc.). Working knowledge of land management systems (Quorum preferred), local, state and federal website navigation (County Clerks, Tax Assessors, Appraisal Districts, RRC, LDNR, FEMA, FERC, etc.). Working understanding of Oracle procurement and accounting systems is preferred.

Skills:

  • Acquisition and condemnation experience.
  • Strong analytical capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of real estate practices, procedures, and terminology.
  • Working knowledge of principles of real estate and right of way acquisition, including state and federal laws pertaining to real estate and/or right of way acquisition.
  • Broad knowledge of real estate appraisal principles and procedures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Broad knowledge of land department and organization procedures with frequent and varied use of business, legal and technical terminology relating to the industry.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team-based environment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines as assigned.
  • Ability to work on multiple long-term and short-term assignments concurrently.
  • Advanced knowledge with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint, automated document management applications, and the aptitude to continually learn new software or applications are required.
  • Knowledge of land development principles and practices.
  • Ability to explain highly complex issues to others in a manner easily understood by both associates in the industry and customers with limited knowledge of land development processes or terminology.
  • Excellent problem/conflict resolution skills, ability to handle and diffuse difficult situations and customer concerns in a positive manner.
  • Takes initiative; proactively identifies, reports, and assists with addressing problems while utilizing company’s process and procedures.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Education, Training and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree

Experience:

Three (3) years or more experience in land-related tasks.

DIRECT REPORTS

No direct reports.

FREEDOM TO ACT

The Analyst is capable of making daily decisions in conducting land related work and is expected to identify and communicate business issues and improvement opportunities.

WORK CONDITIONS

title: A Lineman - Transmission
description:
Position Summary

The Class A Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members in the absence of the Employee in Charge and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Train and mentor apprentices and ground workers.

  • Install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Willing and capable to obtain knowledge in bare hand work – 44kV and 500kV.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Associate
description:
We are seeking a motivated Junior Broker to support our commercial real estate brokerage team. The Junior Broker will assist with business development, market research, client service, and the coordination of lease, purchase, sale, and disposition transactions.
Working closely with senior brokers, clients, property owners, and service providers, the successful candidate will help move transactions from initial research and client tours through negotiation, execution, and closeout. This position offers hands-on training and a clear path toward managing client relationships and transactions independently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research local market conditions, available properties, comparable transactions, pricing, and prospective clients.
  • Generate new business opportunities through calls, emails, networking, referrals, and targeted market outreach.
  • Support senior brokers in developing and maintaining relationships with occupiers, owners, investors, landlords, and other industry professionals.
  • Assist with lease renewals, new leases, subleases, lease terminations, property purchases, and sales.
  • Coordinate transaction activities in accordance with client objectives, timelines, and internal procedures.
  • Serve as a point of contact for clients, landlords, local brokers, attorneys, and third-party service providers.
  • Prepare market surveys, client tour materials, requests for proposals, counterproposals, letters of intent, broker opinions of value, deal summaries, and presentation materials.
  • Assist senior brokers with lease and contract negotiations, including tracking proposals, amendments, critical dates, and outstanding items.
  • Prepare and review basic financial analyses, including cash-flow projections, net present value, internal rate of return, and comparisons of multiple transaction scenarios.
  • Maintain the transaction tracking system and monitor deadlines to support the timely completion of assignments.
  • Organize transaction documents, executed agreements, lease abstracts, contact lists, activity logs, and project closeout files.
  • Schedule client meetings and property tours and respond promptly to transaction-related inquiries.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Review deal and commission calculations, prepare deal sheets, and track commission payments.
  • Coordinate with internal departments and external professionals to help deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Participate in training, licensing, and professional-development activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, real estate, finance, economics, marketing, or a related field preferred.

  • Previous experience in commercial real estate, sales, customer service, financial analysis, or business development is preferred but not required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Professional approach to serving both internal and external clients.

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and transaction details.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Experience with CRM, transaction-management, or real estate research platforms is an advantage.

This position is a commission-only independent contractor commercial real estate broker position.

title: Programme & Policy Officer (IDM & CBT) | International Consultancy Level 1 | Gaza, Palestine
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

8 October 2026-23:59-GMT+02:00 Israel Time (Jerusalem)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

📌 Type of Contract: International Consultancy Level 1

➡️ Unit / Division: Programme

📍 Duty Station: Gaza

➡️ Duration: 11 months (renewable)


❗You are required to fill in all mandatory fields on Workday in English and upload your English CV as an attachment. Your application would be otherwise disqualified.


What will you do in this position?

The Gaza Strip presents a unique operating environment for WFP, characterized by large-scale population movements, extreme security and access constraints, unpredictability, and complex partner-led operations. WFP’s focus is currently on maintaining emergency operations and capacities in parallel to scaling diverse programmes and adapting relevant corporate processes, solutions, and capacities.


Since October 2023, WFP has rolled out custom digital IDM solutions such as the self-registration tool (SRA), the verification portal, data assurance tool (DAT), and payment instrument tracking tool (PIT), and adopted corporate solutions (SCOPE) for CBT. The office is currently planning the transition towards corporately endorsed systems such as MDP and SCOPE In-Kind.


WFP Gaza is implementing cash-based assistance as part of emergency and recovery activities, through digital/e-wallet payments, including Multi-Purpose Cash Assistance (MPCA), Cash for Prevention, and Cash for Work. As markets are progressively operating, cash assistance has become the most adequate transfer modality, and the office is scaling up its CBT assistance across all components.


The incumbent of this role will provide strategic and technical leadership to the CBT/IDM team, ensuring the effective and timely delivery of all CBT/IDM operations in Gaza.


Why work with WFP Palestine?

For decades, Palestine has been facing a protracted and complex protection and humanitarian crisis. The humanitarian situation worsened alarmingly after an upsurge in violence from October 2023.

WFP, through our dual mandate in humanitarian and development, provides life-saving food assistance to the most vulnerable and food insecure non-refugee Palestinians.

WFP provides logistics support to humanitarian and development partners, allowing them to reach more people faster, and at a lower cost to donors and the environment. By offering our cash-based transfer platform to the wider humanitarian and development community, coordinating logistics, and developing an inter-agency common feedback mechanism, WFP contributes to wider humanitarian efforts.

How can you make a difference?

Under the direct supervision of the Deputy Head of Programme, Gaza, in close technical coordination with the Identity Management and Cash-Based Transfer teams in Country Office (Jerusalem), and under the overall responsibility of the Gaza Head of Office, the job holder will have the following responsibilities:

1. Contribute to the Gaza CBT/IDM function, supervising a team of 4 staff.

2. Ensure effective planning, prioritization, delivery of identity management solutions and cash-based transfers.

3. Oversee the end-to-end CBT/IDM cycle across all programmes in Gaza, including MPCA, CfW, and CfP, and provide guidance to activity leads on process design, continuous improvement, and oversight of monthly operations.

4. Manage smooth and timely delivery of IDM operations in Gaza, including but not limited to registration, data update, verification, beneficiary selection, enrollment, distribution or payment list creation, assistance transfers and distribution, reconciliation, and anomaly detection.

5. Engage on CBT/IDM with other UN and NGOs that provide cash assistance in Gaza to strengthen coordination, identify operational challenges, and coordinate on Building Blocks list uploads.

6. Represent WFP in the Gaza Cash Working Group (CWG), ensuring effective information flow between national-level discussions and operational realities on the ground.

7. Provide regular updates, analysis, and recommendations on CBT/IDM to CO.

8. Drive the adaptation and improvement of cash programming in response to evolving operational conditions, including changes in the banking environment, regulations, and FSP arrangements, in coordination with activity leads and the Head of Programme.

9. Liaise with FSPs on KYC requirements and regulatory developments in Gaza that may affect beneficiary access to assistance.

10. Oversee use of all CBT/IDM technology solutions for the Gaza operation (SRA, Verification, DAT, NEST, PIT, SCOPE, MDP), effectively prioritizing new features and maintenance needs in close collaboration with CO colleagues.

11. In close coordination with the activity leads, ensure timely delivery of CBT/digital payments for MPCA, C4P and cash for work that are conducted through SCOPE; ensure coordination with the Financial Service Provider and relevant entities for timely delivery of cash assistance.

12. Ensure regular, timely, and in-depth analytics and reporting products are available to AO and CO stakeholders, including hands-on independent work when required.

13. Proactively identify challenges related to CBT/IDM processes and solutions, conduct root causes analysis and independently define potential solutions and mechanisms to resolve issues.

14. Coordinate effectively across activity and functional units in the AO, CO, and HQ, such as Programme, AAP, M&E, VAM, TEC, SCD.

15. Represent WFP in interagency collaboration and coordination on clearly defined CBT/IDM projects, such as assistance coordination (Building Blocks).

16. Support the AO transition to corporate solutions (MDP, SCOPE) as required, collaborating closely with CO and HQ colleagues.

17. Build local capacities in CBT/IDM areas, supporting sustainable long-term capacity strengthening of team members.

18. Act in an assigned emergency-response capacity as required, and undertake other, IDM, CBT, and programme-assurance responsibilities as needed.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

EDUCATION: First Degree / Advanced University degree in a relevant area, such as Economics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Technology, Statistics, etc.


EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant postgraduate progressively responsible professional experience in the public or private sector demonstrating high performance
  • Experience in CBT/IDM, in areas of operations, data analytics, design, and implementation
  • Experience in data analysis and visualization using SQL and Tableau.
  • Experience with WFP systems such as SRA, DAT, PIT, and SCOPE is considered a strong asset.
  • Experience in field operations is considered a strong asset.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong technical knowledge of CBT/IDM delivery cycle, including registration, data update, verification, enrollment, distribution list preparation, assistance tracking, and reconciliation –.
  • Demonstrated skills in using SQL and Tableau for data analysis.
  • Strong analytical communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, decision-oriented products.
  • Strong partnership and coordination skills, including experience engaging multi-TPM providers, humanitarian clusters/sectors, UN agencies, NGOs and other technical counterparts.
  • Proficiency in data management and analytical tools; experience with geospatial analysis, dashboards, automation and WFP corporate systems such as COMET, SCOPE, MDP and SugarCRM is desirable.
  • Sound understanding of humanitarian principles, data protection and responsible data management, particularly in relation to beneficiary data, targeting and digital identity management.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a volatile, high-pressure and access-constrained environment, adapting analytical and monitoring approaches to changing operational conditions.

LANGUAGES: Fluency in English is required. Working knowledge of Arabic will be considered a strong asset.

title: Taktični planer (m/ž/d) / Tactical Planner (m/f/d)
description:
Salary Range:

32.060,00 € - 59.540,00 €


Band

Level 4


Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid
Location: Ljubljana, Slovenia

Vas veseli načrtovanje, usklajevanje in iskanje rešitev v dinamičnem proizvodnem okolju? Kot Taktični planer (m/ž/d) boste skrbeli za pripravo in usklajevanje proizvodnih načrtov ter zagotavljali, da so zmogljivosti, materiali in viri pravočasno na voljo za nemoteno oskrbo trga z našimi izdelki.
Ker širimo našo ekipo, v ekipo vabimo tri Taktične planerje. Vsa delovna mesta bodo locirana v Ljubljani, pri čemer bosta dve osebi podpirali našo lokacijo v Schaftenau, ena pa lokacijo v Ljubljani.
V tej vlogi boste tesno sodelovali s sodelavci iz proizvodnje, oskrbovalne verige, kakovosti in drugih ključnih funkcij. S svojim delom boste pomagali zagotavljati zanesljivo oskrbo pacientov, pravočasno prepoznavati morebitna tveganja ter iskati rešitve za optimalno razpoložljivost izdelkov in učinkovito upravljanje zalog. Če vas motivira delo v mednarodnem okolju, je to lahko odlična priložnost za vas.

Are you passionate about turning demand signals into smart, executable production plans? As a Tactical Planner, you will drive and manage the Master Production Schedule across the tactical planning horizon, ensuring capacity and resources are in place to support demand and maintain reliable product availability. We are expanding our planning organization and are looking for three Tactical Planners to join our team in Ljubljana. While all positions will be based in Ljubljana, Slovenia, two roles will support our Schaftenau site and one role will support our Ljubljana site. Working closely with manufacturing, supply chain, and site leadership teams, you will translate plans into action, anticipate constraints, optimize inventory, and help ensure medicines reach patients in the right quantity and at the right time. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on supply continuity, operational performance, and customer service in a highly regulated environment.


Job Description

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:


  • Priprava in usklajevanje proizvodnih načrtov za srednje- in dolgoročno plansko obdobje.
  • Načrtovanje kapacitet ter zagotavljanje, da so materiali, viri in proizvodne zmogljivosti pravočasno na voljo.
  • Skrb za ustrezne zaloge in zanesljivo oskrbo ob hkratnem zmanjševanju izgub in odpisov.
  • Prepoznavanje morebitnih tveganj v oskrbi ali proizvodnji ter usklajevanje aktivnosti za njihovo obvladovanje.
  • Sodelovanje z ekipami s področij proizvodnje, kakovosti, inženiringa, oskrbovalne verige in podpore strankam.
  • Vodenje rednih planskih pregledov ter usklajevanje proizvodnih načrtov in načrtov zalog, z vsemi ključnimi deležniki.
  • Spremljanje kazalnikov uspešnosti planiranja in predlaganje izboljšav procesov.
  • Skrb za točnost podatkov v informacijskih sistemih ter podpora projektom digitalizacije in avtomatizacije.

Vaš doprinos k delovnem mestu:


  • Visokošolska izobrazba tehnične, ekonomske, logistične ali druge ustrezne smeri.
  • Izkušnje na področju oskrbovalne verige, planiranja proizvodnje ali / in upravljanja zalog.
  • Izkušnje z načrtovanjem proizvodnje, kapacitet in virov.
  • Dobro razumevanje proizvodnih procesov in delovanja oskrbovalne verige.
  • Poznavanje sistema SAP ter izkušnje z naprednimi orodji za planiranje.
  • Izrazite analitične sposobnosti in sistematičen pristop k reševanju izzivov.
  • Sposobnost učinkovitega sodelovanja z različnimi ekipami in usklajevanja več prioritet hkrati.
  • Aktivno znanje angleškega jezika.

Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas, s 6-mesečno poskusno dobo. Življenjepis priložite v angleškem in slovenskem jeziku.


Ugodnosti in nagrajevanje:

V Novartisu smo predani soustvarjanju medicine in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo.

Pričakovani razpon plače za to delovno mesto:

32.060,00 EUR - 59.540,00 EUR

Osnovna plača se določa na podlagi vnaprej opredeljenih in transparentnih kriterijev, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje, ne glede na spol, ter v skladu z Novartisovo politiko določanja plač. Po zaposlitvi v Novartisu se plača periodično pregleda v skladu z internimi akti in postopki.

Poleg osnovne plače ste lahko upravičeni tudi do kratkoročnega bonusa, ki je odvisen od določenih meril uspešnosti.

Ugodnosti zaposlitve v Novartisu vključujejo več kot le osnovno plačo in variabilno nagrajevanje. Zaposlenim nudimo nabor konkurenčnih ugodnosti, ki podpirajo strokovni in osebni razvoj, vključno s programi zavarovanj, pokojninsko shemo, aktivnostmi za dobro počutje ter programe za prepoznavanje dosežkov zaposlenih v skladu z internimi akti delodajalca. Kjer narava dela dopušča, omogočamo tudi prilagodljive in hibridne oblike dela ter najmanj 14 tednov plačanega starševskega dopusta.

Pravično plačilo je temeljno načelo naše zaposlitvene politike in odraža našo zavezanost ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava z dostojanstvom in spoštovanjem, kot je določeno v našem Etičnem kodeksu.

Za več informacij o nagrajevanju si oglejte našo globalno brošuro:

Opomba: Ugodnosti in nadomestila se lahko razlikujejo glede na državo in so predmet lokalnih zakonskih zahtev, vključno z določbami kolektivnih pogodb, kjer je to ustrezno. Celoten pregled vašega paketa ugodnosti, vključno z vsemi ustreznimi podrobnostmi kolektivnih pogodb, ki veljajo za vašo delovno mesto glede na lokacijo zaposlitve in pravno osebo Novartis, bo posredovano ločeno med postopkom prijave.

Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.

Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. Ste pripravljeni ustvariti svetlejšo prihodnost skupaj z nami?

___________________________________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage the Master Production Schedule across the tactical planning horizon of up to 24 months.
  • Lead capacity planning activities to ensure resources, materials, and capabilities support future demand requirements.
  • Balance inventory levels to ensure reliable product supply while minimizing waste and inventory write-offs.
  • Identify supply, capacity, and resource risks and coordinate mitigation plans with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Science and Technology, Quality, Engineering, Customer Service, and supply chain teams.
  • Drive monthly supply planning reviews and align stakeholders on updated production and inventory plans.
  • Monitor planning performance indicators and continuously improve planning processes, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate planning data in SAP and Kinaxis Maestro while supporting digitalization and automation initiatives.

Essential Requirements

  • University degree (BSc) in technical, economics, logistics, or another relevant field.
  • Experience in supply chain, production planning, inventory management, or logistics within a regulated environment.
  • Proven experience in master production scheduling, tactical planning, capacity planning, and resource management.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, planning processes, and end-to-end supply chain flows.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP and Kinaxis Maestro or similar planning systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and managing competing priorities.
  • Professional proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills.

We are offering a permanent contract, with 6-months probation period.


Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 32.060,00 EUR - 59.540,00 EUR

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.



Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

title: Bli MENY Holmlia sin nye tilkallingshelt i ferskvareavdelingen!
description:
I MENY elsker vi mat! For oss er god mat en lidenskap, og noe av det viktigste som finnes. Hos oss er alle MATarbeidere, uansett om du jobber i ferskvaredisken, kolonialen, i kassen eller på kontoret. Å være en MATarbeider i MENY betyr at du alltid gjør ditt beste for å veilede og inspirere kundene våre til matglede. Sammen skal vi hjelpe flere å spise bedre, og leve bedre.


Stillingsomfang: tilkallingshjelp
Arbeidstid: dag, kveld og helg - som tilkalling vil du ikke ha faste vakter, men bli kontaktet ved behov
Oppstart: snarest - eller etter avtale

Søknadsfrist: vi behandler søknader fortløpende

For å søke på denne stillingen må du være fylt 18 år, da du i denne stillingen håndterer maskiner med 18 års aldersgrense. Du må også kunne kommunisere godt med kunder og kolleger på norsk.

Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?
Som MATarbeider i vår ferskvareavdeling vil du ha en hektisk og spennende hverdag med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgavene. Du vil ekspedere kunder, skjære og tilberede ulike ferskvarer som kjøtt, fisk og ost, du vil fylle varer og naturlig nok ta oppvasken. Du vil også arbeide i bakeriavdelingen der oppgavene består i å steke brød, rydde, legge opp varer til neste dag og hjelpe kunder. For å trives må du være en som liker å prate med mennesker, takler utfordringer, tunge løft, hektisk tempo og ikke være redd for å smake på nye ting.


Våre kunder forventer at du har kunnskap om mat, men fortvil ikke selv om "Hellstrøm" ikke er ditt etternavn. Vi lærer deg alt vi kan om torsk, svinekjake, culotte og Kraftkar, men det er uten tvil en fordel om du har basiskunnskap og interesse for mat fra før av. Om du har relevant fagbrev er det selvfølgelig et pluss!


Hvordan er det å jobbe i MENY?
Hos oss vil du blant annet lære å ta ansvar, mestre stress, håndtere mennesker og ikke minst butikkdrift. Vi har en interaktiv kursplattform, ulike klasseromskurs som gir deg faglig påfyll og et traineeprogram med fokus på å gå fra ansatt til å bli leder, for å nevne noe. Satser du på MENY, satser MENY på deg!


Når det gjelder trivsel på jobb, vil vi trekke frem samholdet. Som en av våre matarbeidere blir du en del av et team som jobber mot felles mål, for din innsats vil påvirke butikken, kundene og kollegene dine. Vi verdsetter gjensidig omtanke og støtte, og det er rom for feil så lenge du lærer og utvikler deg – for er du trygg er du god.

Å søke jobb i MENY skal være enkelt

Du trenger ikke laste opp søknadsbrev. For at vi skal bli litt bedre kjent med deg, svarer du på spørsmålene om deg og din erfaring. Har du mye på hjertet må du gjerne skrive utfyllende, vi gleder oss til å lese! Og fordi vi synes det er spennende å se hvor du har vært tidligere, må du laste opp CV.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at alle søknader må sendes inn via søknadsskjema tilknyttet annonsen, dette er av hensyn til ditt personvern, samt at vi ønsker å være sikre på at vi klarer å følge opp alle kandidater på en god måte. Vi kan derfor ikke ta imot søknader på papir i butikken eller via e-post. Søknader behandles fortløpende.


Kontaktperson

Stephanie Brubak

Ferskvaresjef

22 75 05 00

ledigestillinger@meny.no

MENY er Norges største supermarkedkjede med nesten 200 butikker og en omsetning på over 20 milliarder kroner. Vi har 10 000 stolte matarbeidere som sørger for gode handleopplevelser hver eneste dag!

title: Project Manager
description:
About Us


At Aussie Broadband, things are done a little bit differently. Our goal is to be the telco people love – customers, team members, shareholders and all stakeholders. We do this by living and breathing our values in everything we do, that's the Aussie way. As a B Corp Certified company, we hold ourselves to the highest standards for social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability. We're proud to have been named one of Australia's Top Employers by HRD magazine.


Listed on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX: ABB), the Aussie Broadband Group collectively supplies more than 1 million telecommunications services, operates two Tier 1 voice providers in Australia and owns fibre infrastructure.


Our culture is built on five values that guide everything we do:


Don't be ordinary, be awesome | Think BIG | No bullsh*t | Be good to people | Have fun



About the Role


Ready to lead projects that make a real impact? We're looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our team in a permanent hybrid role based in Melbourne.

In this role, you'll lead complex business and technology projects, working across Product, Technology, Operations and Commercial teams to deliver successful outcomes, drive customer migrations and support key business initiatives.

We're looking for someone with a strong telco background who enjoys bringing people together, navigating complexity and turning strategy into action. If you're passionate about delivering great customer and business outcomes while working collaboratively across the organisation, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Do


  • Lead complex, technology-enabled telco programs end to end, coordinating Product, Technology, Operations, Commercial and external partners to deliver seamless customer migrations and service launches.
  • Bring strong telco domain knowledge and practical delivery leadership, with the ability to manage high-volume migrations, technical dependencies, operational readiness and transition into BAU.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to align project outcomes with strategic priorities.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, budgets and risks to keep delivery on track.
  • Provide clear project updates, insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making.
  • Support change, business readiness and smooth transitions into day-to-day operations.
  • Maintain key project documentation and governance requirements.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve project delivery, processes and ways of working.

What You'll Bring


  • Experience delivering projects and driving outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

title: Packing Operative

title: Care Partner
description:

title: Porter
description:
Kimpton de Witt and Super Lyan are only as good as the people it employs, that is why we picked you. You are outgoing and you love to meet new people. You are passionate, focused and driven about making every guest’s experience ‘ridiculously personal’, making their visit unforgettable, in all the right ways.

You will be working with a friendly, international, motivated team and will work together to develop our full potential and ensure we all provide genuine heartfelt care to our all guests.

At Kimpton De Witt Amsterdam, we believe the first few moments of a guest's stay can define their entire experience.

As a Porter, you are often the very first person guests meet when they arrive and one of the last people they see before they leave. Your smile after a long journey, your local recommendations before a day of exploring Amsterdam, and your willingness to go the extra mile all help create the kind of memorable experiences guests talk about long after they've returned home.

This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys people, and making them feel at home. Someone who thrives on variety, loves being active throughout the day, and understands that hospitality is often found in the smallest gestures.

A Day in the Life

No two days look the same. Really!

One moment you're welcoming a couple celebrating a special occasion, helping them settle into their room and sharing your favourite hidden spots in the city. The next, you're assisting a family arriving from overseas, arranging transportation for departing guests, or helping a colleague during a busy check in rush.

You start the day with fun, because that's the core value of the Porter team. Why ask you to smile, when we can offer you one?

Throughout the day, you'll be moving between the lobby, guest rooms, and the streets of Amsterdam, acting as a host, guide, problem solver, and ambassador for both Kimpton and the city itself.

While luggage assistance is naturally part of the role, being a Porter at Kimpton is about so much more. It's about reading people, anticipating needs, creating connections, and making guests feel genuinely cared for from the moment they arrive.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We're not necessarily looking for someone with years of hotel experience. We're looking for someone with the right personality.

You enjoy meeting new people and naturally make others feel comfortable. You're energetic, proactive, and happiest when you're helping someone. You don't wait to be asked twice and you take pride in finding solutions. Whether you're giving directions, arranging a taxi, carrying luggage, or simply sharing a warm conversation, you understand that every interaction matters.

Because you'll be welcoming guests from all over the world, confidence in English is important. Additional languages are always a bonus.

Why Join Kimpton De Witt?

Kimpton has always done hospitality a little differently.

We celebrate individuality, encourage personality, and believe that genuine service comes from genuine people. You'll be joining a team that works hard, supports one another, and genuinely enjoys creating memorable experiences together.

For many people, a Porter role is the perfect gateway into hospitality. It offers exposure to every corner of the hotel, endless opportunities to learn, and a chance to develop a career within one of the world's most recognised lifestyle hotel brands.

Most importantly, you'll be part of a culture where attitude matters more than hierarchy, where growth is encouraged, and where bringing your authentic self to work is not only welcomed but expected.

Whats in it for you?

  • Experience Stay at Kimpton De Witt as part of our introduction program (overnight stay with +1 including dinner, drinks & breakfast)
  • 6 complimentary nights per year at the Lore Group hotels worldwide
  • Employee and Friends & Family discount rates at the Lore Group hotels
  • Employee and Friends & Family discount rates at more than 5500 IHG Hotels and all Lore Group hotels
  • A yearly benefit budget of EUR180 that you can spend trough the benefits platform Alleo
  • Possibility to lease a bike
  • 50% discount in restaurants & bars at 19 partner hotels in Amsterdam
  • Free and unlimited appointments per year with a psychologist via OpenUp
  • A monthly contribution to a pension scheme
  • A monthly travel allowance
  • A monthly clothing allowance (if applicable to your position)
  • A yearly shoe allowance
  • Possibility to take part in a Dutch language course
  • Freshly prepared meals in the canteen
  • Discount on supplemental health insurances

Location: Amsterdam

title: Sr Director, Cyber Defense
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Our Cyber Defense team is the frontline of Pfizer’s cybersecurity operations, responsible for detecting, investigating, and responding to threats that could impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our systems and data. This team leads critical functions including Security Operations Center (SOC) monitoring, incident response, digital forensics, penetration testing, threat intelligence, host security, platform support, and security automation.

This leader will oversee enterprise-wide efforts in vulnerability management, threat intelligence, red teaming, SOC operations, incident response, insider risk, and secure network and cloud architecture. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in cyber operations, threat management, and security architecture, with a proven track record of driving large-scale, cross-functional cybersecurity programs. This role requires strong leadership, operational rigor, and the ability to translate technical risk into business-aligned strategies.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and execute a comprehensive strategy for the Cyber Security Posture Management, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Cyber Defense programs aligned with Pfizer’s cybersecurity vision and business priorities.
  • Develop and manage budgets, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and effective allocation of resources. Monitor expenditures, forecast future budget needs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Serve as a key advisor to the CISO and senior leadership on threat trends, operational readiness, and incident response posture.
  • Lead the transformation of legacy cybersecurity systems and drive the implementation of modern security practices across the organization.
  • Oversee the global cyber defense program, inclusive of the 24x7 SOC, ensuring proactive threat detection, effective monitoring, alert triage, and coordinated incident response.
  • Direct the strategy and execution of Pfizer’s cloud security program, ensuring robust controls across identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, and compliance.
  • Lead a proactive vulnerability management program, including scanning, prioritization, remediation, and executive reporting.
  • Partner with IT and business units to ensure timely resolution of critical vulnerabilities and alignment with enterprise risk tolerance.
  • Drive the strategy and implementation of network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention, and secure remote access.
  • Ensure continuous monitoring and protection of Pfizer’s global network infrastructure against emerging threats.
  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams across Cyber Posture Management, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Cyber Defense.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 12 - 15+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 8 years in leadership roles overseeing enterprise-wide cyber operations.
  • Proven expertise in multiple cybersecurity domains, including vulnerability management, threat intelligence, SOC operations, incident response, insider risk network security, and cloud security.
  • Strong understanding of security architecture and technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, WAF, DDoS mitigation, SIEM, SOAR, and cloud-native security tools.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, GIAC (e.g., GCIA, GCIH), CISM, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical risk into business-aligned strategies and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders.
  • Deep familiarity with threat modeling frameworks and adversary simulation methodologies (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, red/purple teaming).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Extensive understanding of the Crowdstrike suite, including its capabilities for SIEM, EDR and threat intelligence.
  • Experience with Wiz for cloud security management, including configuration, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Experience with Zscaler for secure network access, including implementation, configuration, and performance optimization.
  • Experience leading modernization initiatives and transforming legacy cybersecurity systems.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating multi-million dollar contracts with vendors and strategic partners.
  • Experience working abroad and leading global cybersecurity initiatives across multiple regions.

OTHER INFO

  • Periodic international and domestic travel may be required (less than 5%).
  • Work Location Assignment: Must be able to work in the assigned office 2-3 days per week, or as needed by the business.

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Workday Financials Consultants work in partnership with clients and internal teams to ensure maximum value out of a client's Workday investment. The role is responsible for providing Workday Post Production support across Workday Financials module(s), understanding the client's business and requirements, and configuring, designing and delivering solutions that best fit client needs.   • Use the company's methodology and processes to implement solutions successfully while remaining agile and flexible to clients' changing needs.

Seek opinions and feedback on alternative solutions from team members to solve client needs. Position Summary


Manages Owens & Minor’s leased and owned real estate portfolio and serves as the primary relationship manager for the company’s outsourced real estate brokerage partner. The role provides oversight of all real estate activities, including site options, lease and sublease negotiations, renewals, dispositions, portfolio optimization, and transaction management, ensuring alignment with the company’s operational, financial, and long-term network strategy.


Core Responsibilities


  • Partner with Operations, Engineering, Network Optimization, Finance, IT, Security, Legal, and other stakeholders to define facility requirements, business needs, geographic criteria, and project objectives for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and major facility modifications.
  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for the company's outsourced real estate brokerage partner, providing strategic direction, establishing priorities, monitoring performance, and overseeing site searches, market intelligence, transaction support, portfolio reporting, and real estate alternatives.

  • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning for rent, operating expenses, capital projects, tenant improvements, transaction costs, repairs, and other real estate-related expenditures.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to manage/coordinate multiple work assignments.
  • Strong organizational skills.

  • Ability to Ability to manage/coordinate multiple work assignments.

  • 30% travel.

title: Electrical Field Tech Service Field Service North Canton
description:
Powell Service Division is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Service Technician interested in joining one of the nation’s leading providers of medium and low voltage switchgear. Powell Service Technicians are responsible for ensuring the end-to-end safety, quality and performance of Powell equipment across the US and Canada. This includes performing installations, preventative maintenance, corrective maintenance, and periodic supervision of small crews. The ideal candidate thinks critically, can work well independently, and is a problem solver. Service technicians are expected to service the west coast, gulf coast south, offshore and east coast service regions. Qualified Service Technicians are provided safety and technical training with full office support. Once qualified, Technicians are assigned a company vehicle, standard tooling, testing equipment, a laptop, smart phone, and company expense card.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adhere to Powell’s current safety and quality standards
  • Complete all site documentation in in a timely manner; including but not limited to, weekly time sheets, signed service and repair order, materials used and report writing.
  • Provide regular and clear communication regarding work schedule to Field Operations Scheduler and District Service Manager
  • Maintain flexible work hours, which will include over time and periodic weekend support
  • Comply with Powell ‘s standard operating procedures, documentation processes, safety processes and protocols.
  • Coordinate with Powell Project management, customers, vendors, and labor support in a professional and customer-centric manner
  • Able to work in different roles from supporting the Manufacturing Department within house fabrication, to overseeing small crews on installation projects.
  • Switchgear and PCR installations
  • DC / AC Switchgear
  • Knowledge of Traction Power Systems
  • Troubleshooting mechanical repair issues.
  • Perform performance testing on Powell equipment and components, including but not limited to; insulation testing (megger testing), Ductor, Hi Potential testing, torque tests and mechanical / functional testing.
  • Perform regular inspections of any issued vehicle or calibrated equipment/tools.
  • Demonstrate ability to manage tasks, commitments, and deadlines as it pertains to assigned tasks, communications with customers, and internal customers

Job Requirements

  • The Service Technician must possess a high school diploma, as well as three or more years’ experience, as a shop and / or field electrical / technician.
  • Service Technicians must exhibit knowledge of Electrical Industry manufacturing standards.
  • Specific standards include sections of ANSI IEEE C37 applicable to the design and manufacture of breakers and switchgear.
  • Specific knowledge of the following: ANSI IEEE device function numbers; ampacities of electrical conductors in switchgear applications; electrical air and surface creepage clearance requirements.
  • Demonstrate knowledge in the design and manufacture of bus and structural modification projects.
  • Powell also requires that all Service Technicians undergo Factory Certified Technician training and maintain a passing grade.
  • The Service Technician must be experienced in the art of writing accurate and complete test reports, project summaries and has the ability to explain anomalies found on a given project.
  • Knowledge of basic electrical theory and control circuits i.e.: Ohm's Law; Basic AC and DC theory; contactor and circuit breaker schematics are a must.
  • The Service Technician must be able to perform of hi-pot testing and breaker function testing. i.e.: testing of over-current and motor protection relays with current injection; acceptance testing of dielectric apparatus using over voltage testing; mechanical and electrical functional testing of circuit breakers and electrical switchgear.
  • The Service Technician will also be expected to demonstrate proficiency with computer skills using Oracle, MS Outlook, Power DB, Word & Excel.
  • Additional requirements include but are not limited to:
  • Working knowledge with using the following test equipment: Hi potential, DLRO, Multi-meter, dial caliper.
  • Must demonstrate working knowledge with the use of various hand tools and mechanical adaptability.
  • Must have verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in problem solving is a preferred.
  • Willing to attend in-house and out-side training.
  • Willing to travel up 85% of the year.
  • Demonstrate ability to read and interpret plan sets and one-line diagrams.

Working Environment

The Service Technician typically performs duties in an industrial environment. This position requires services both locally and across the Continental US. It is the policy of Powell Service Division to promote safe working conditions for ALL employees, to make available where necessary special equipment to protect employees against specific hazards, to reduce accidents through prevention programs and to establish rules that are designed for the safety of all. It is the responsibility of each employee to adhere to this policy, as well as to observe all safety practices and exercise every precaution for the safety of accidents.

Physical Demands

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, feel, carry or operate objects, tools or controls and reach with hands and arms.
  • The employee frequently is required to stand; talk or hear; walk; sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Additional requirements are as follows:
    • Medium physical effort (lifting/moving up to 50 pounds)
    • Have full range of mobility in upper and lower body and be able to work in various positions, including, but not limited to, stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling and squatting for extended periods of time.
    • Work at heights greater than 10’.
    • Work on ladders of all types.
    • Work on scissor and bucket lifts (on occasion).

In addition, employees will be required to complete and pass Company and Customer required drug screening, background and employment verification checks, maintaining eligibility throughout employment.

  • Adheres to, trains and coaches employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods, and OSHA regulations.

Must understand Form I-9 process and proper interviewing techniques as well as exercise fair and reasonable judgment working through employee relations matters.
  • Obtains and interprets maps from the utility showing work orders to be completed for tree trimming, removals and chemical application. Responsible for understanding drawings and symbols representing types of power lines, voltages, and line equipment per industry standard and assigning daily work orders.
  • Responsible for maintaining records, and reports related to the production of the crew, such as timesheets, work orders, units of work, manhours, distribution of crew assignments and locations.
  • Responsible for controlling costs, including effective use of manpower, work methods, proper amount of trimming, and operation of equipment to meet organizational goals.
  • Works closely with internal departments to support accident investigations, property damage claims, truck breakdowns and workers compensation claims. May be a designated representative to settle minor claims.
  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools and request major repairs and replacements when necessary.
  • Maintains knowledge of new equipment specifications, standard practices and operating procedures.
  • Remains in contact with customers, property owners, general public, other contractors, and utility representatives and governmental agencies 20-30% of the time. Promotes and maintains good customer and public relations through courteous communication on behalf of Wright Tree Service.
  • Works around hazardous equipment and in close proximity to energized power lines.
  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster. Assists with contacting and coordinating the crew’s response to such work and responsible for determining proper steps necessary to eliminate hazards and trim/remove trees while onsite during emergency response.
  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.
  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:

  • Oversees crew employees.

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Possess excellent leadership skills and be able to handle stressful situations along with being able to multi-task.
  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with the general public, customers and employees at all levels.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).
  • Ability to adhere, educate, and enforce company and industry safety requirements.
  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.
  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office products.
  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.
  • Must be able to write, read, and comprehend written and verbal job instructions/information.
  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.
  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.
  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.
  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.
  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 4-5 years’ experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.
  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements). and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.
  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.
  • Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
