  • Imparte la capacitación en seguridad necesaria, las reuniones de concienciación y las reuniones informativas previas al trabajo (job briefings). Involucra al equipo de Safety Education Training (Capacitación en Educación sobre Seguridad) para coordinar iniciativas de capacitación adicionales para abordar áreas de oportunidad e inquietud.
  • Colabora con Human Resources (Recursos Humanos) en temas laborales relacionados con los miembros del equipo de trabajo, incluyendo, pero no limitándose a, contratación, medidas disciplinarias, terminación de empleo, permisos y ausencias (como la Ley de Licencia Familiar y Médica [FMLA]/Ley para Estadounidenses con Discapacidades [ADA]), así como la aplicación general de políticas. Debe comprender el proceso del Formulario I-9 y las técnicas adecuadas de entrevistas, así como ejercer un juicio justo y razonable al manejar asuntos de relaciones laborales.
  • Recibe e interpreta los mapas de la empresa de servicios públicos que muestran las órdenes de trabajo que deben completarse para la poda, la eliminación o la aplicación química. Es responsable de comprender los planos y símbolos que representan los tipos de líneas eléctricas, tensiones y equipos de línea según los estándares del sector, y en la asignación de las órdenes de trabajo diarias.
  • Es responsable de mantener registros e informes relacionados con la producción del equipo de trabajo, como hojas de horas, órdenes de trabajo, unidades de producción, horas-hombre, distribución de tareas y ubicaciones.
  • Responsable del control de costos, incluyendo el uso eficiente de la mano de obra, los métodos de trabajo, la cantidad adecuada de poda y la operación del equipo para cumplir con los objetivos de la organización.
  • Trabaja en colaboración con los departamentos internos para apoyar las investigaciones de accidentes, reclamaciones por daños a la propiedad, fallas de camiones y reclamaciones de compensación laboral. Puede ser un representante designado para resolver reclamaciones menores.
  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Realiza el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa, y solicita reparaciones mayores o reemplazos cuando sea necesario.
  • Mantiene conocimiento sobre las especificaciones de nuevos equipos, prácticas estándar y procedimientos operativos.
  • Se mantieneen contacto con clientes, propietarios, público en general, otros contratistas, representantes de servicios públicos y agencias gubernamentales entre el 20 y 30 % del tiempo. Promueve y mantiene buenas relaciones con clientes y público mediante una comunicación cortés en nombre de Wright Tree Service.
  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y en proximidad a líneas eléctricas energizadas.
  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento. Colabora en la comunicación y coordinación de la respuesta del equipo de trabajo ante dichas situaciones, y es responsable de determinar los pasos adecuados para eliminar peligros y podar o retirar árboles durante las labores de respuesta.
  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y de propiedad de empleados de Wright.
  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.
  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:

  • Supervisa a los empleados del equipo de trabajo.

Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo y capacidad para manejar situaciones de estrés, así como para realizar múltiples tareas simultáneamente.
  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse de manera profesional y efectiva con el público, los clientes y los empleados en todos los niveles.
  • Conocimiento y comprensión de American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para Operaciones de Cuidado de Árboles - ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de American National Standards for Proper Pruning (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la Poda Adecuada - ANSI A300).
  • Capacidad para cumplir, enseñar hacer que otros cumplan los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.
  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.
  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.
  • Competente en el uso de productos de Microsoft Office.
  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.
  • Capacidad para redactar, leer y comprender instrucciones o información laboral, tanto escritas como verbales.
  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.
  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.
  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.
  • Conocimiento y capacitación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).
  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.
  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Contar con un mínimo de 4 a 5 años de experiencia trabajando en equipos de poda o despeje de árboles, o haber completado con éxito las evaluaciones de habilidades correspondientes.
  • Se prefiere diploma de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.
  • Debe contar con credenciales de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR) válidas.
  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Departamento de Transporte (Department of Transportation, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de FMCSA.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.
  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.

Requisitos de idioma (leer, escribir, hablar):

Inglés: ☒ leer, ☒ escribir, ☒ hablar

Español: ☐ leer, ☐ escribir, ☐ hablar

Otro idioma _________________ - ☐ leer, ☐ escribir, ☐ hablar


Requisitos de viaje:

☐No, rara vez

☐Sí, ocasional (hasta el 5 %)

☐Sí, moderado (del 5 % al 25 %)

☒Sí, sustancial (del 25 % al 50 %)

☐Sí, extenso (más del 50 %)


Características físicas:

Este puesto puede requerir las siguientes exigencias y actividades físicas:

  • Flexionarse, estirarse, permanecer de pie, caminar, trepar, levantar, cargar, sujetar, hablar, oír y realizar movimientos repetitivos de manera efectiva. Ocasionalmente alcanzar hacia arriba o hacia abajo.
  • Ejercer hasta 50 libras (23 kg) de fuerza ocasionalmente o hasta 30 libras (14 kg) de fuerza con frecuencia, o hasta 10 libras (4.5 kg) de fuerza de manera constante para mover objetos.
  • Debe tener agudeza visual suficiente para determinar la precisión, pulcritud y exhaustividad del trabajo asignado o para hacer observaciones generales del entorno; agudeza visual cercana, como para leer una pantalla de computadora, materiales impresos, inspeccionar defectos pequeños o utilizar instrumentos de medición.
  • Poder entrar y salir de vehículos y equipos varias veces al día.

Factores ambientales:

Las personas en este puesto pueden estar expuestas a los siguientes factores:

  • Exposición habitual a condiciones de trabajo tanto interiores como exteriores.
  • Exposición habitual a las condiciones meteorológicas, climáticas y de temperatura, como lluvia, calor, sol, frío y nieve.
  • Exposición habitual a la naturaleza, como plantas irritantes, insectos que pican o muerden, polvo, etc.; el puesto se desarrolla al aire libre en terrenos irregulares.
  • Exposición habitual a ruido, vibraciones, peligros laborales como la proximidad a piezas móviles, equipos mecánicos, vehículos en movimiento, equipos con motor de gasolina, corriente eléctrica, alturas, calor, productos químicos, espacios reducidos, pasillos o conductos estrechos, enfermedades transmisibles, patógenos de transmisión sanguínea, productos de limpieza, polvo, olores y diversos tipos de plagas.



DECLARACIONES DE LA EMPRESA (solo EE. UU.):

Funciones del puesto: esta descripción del puesto no está diseñada para abarcar ni contener una lista exhaustiva de todas las actividades, tareas o responsabilidades requeridas del empleado. Las funciones, responsabilidades y actividades pueden modificarse en cualquier momento, con o sin previo aviso.


Igualdad de oportunidades de empleo: Wright Service Corp. respeta la diversidad y es un empleador inclusivo y con igualdad de oportunidades que no discrimina por motivos de raza, color, credo, religión, nacionalidad, ascendencia, ciudadanía, edad, sexo o género (incluidos embarazo, parto, condiciones médicas relacionadas y lactancia), identidad o expresión de género (incluido el estado de persona transgénero), orientación sexual, estado civil, servicio militar o condición de veterano, discapacidad física o mental, condición médica protegida, información genética o cualquier otra característica protegida por la legislación, norma o reglamento federal, estatal o local aplicable. Nos comprometemos a garantizar el cumplimiento de esta política en los procesos de reclutamiento, contratación, asignación, promoción, traslado, capacitación, compensación, beneficios, actividades laborales, acceso a instalaciones y programas, y en el trato general durante el empleo.


Adaptaciones razonables: Wright Service Corp. cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables sobre adaptaciones razonables para las personas, incluida Americans with Disabilities Act (a Ley de Estadounidenses con Discapacidades - ADA). En consecuencia, según lo exija la ley, ofreceremos adaptaciones razonables a los solicitantes y empleados que las soliciten o para quienes tengamos conocimiento de que las necesitan, independientemente de cualquier clasificación protegida, relacionadas con: (i) una discapacidad, entendida como una deficiencia física, médica, mental o psicológica, o el historial o registro de dicha deficiencia; (ii) creencias y prácticas religiosas sinceramente sostenidas; (iii) necesidades relacionadas con el embarazo, el parto o condiciones médicas asociadas; o (iv) cualquier otro motivo exigido por la ley aplicable, salvo que la adaptación suponga una carga indebida.


Empleo a voluntad: salvo disposición contraria en la legislación, norma o reglamento aplicable, el empleo en Wright Service Corp. es “a voluntad”. Esto significa que la relación laboral puede darse por terminada en cualquier momento por parte del empleado o de Wright Service Corp., por cualquier motivo o sin motivo alguno, con o sin causa o aviso previo. Ningún supervisor ni empleado de Wright Service Corp., salvo el Chief Executive Officer o su designado, tiene autoridad para celebrar un contrato de empleo, ya sea oral, escrito o implícito, que modifique o altere la relación laboral a voluntad. Todo acuerdo de este tipo debe constar por escrito y estar firmado por el Chief Executive Officer o su designado.


Lugar de trabajo sin drogas ni alcohol: con el fin de garantizar un entorno de trabajo seguro, saludable y productivo para nuestros empleados y demás personas, proteger la propiedad de Wright Service Corp. y asegurar la eficiencia operativa, Wright Service Corp. mantiene una política de mantener un lugar de trabajo libre de drogas y alcohol ilícitos o no autorizados.

Wright Tree Service employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Product Manager, Communications - Everyday Banking Transformation
description:
About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity to join BOQ Retail Bank's Transformation team and play a critical role in one of the bank's most significant customer-focused transformation programs.


As Product Manager, Communications – Everyday Banking Transformation, you will lead the design, development and delivery of customer communication strategies that support large-scale transformation and migration initiatives across our Everyday Banking products and services.


Working at the intersection of Product, Change, Digital, Marketing and Customer Experience, you will help ensure our customers and frontline teams are confidently guided through complex product, platform and service changes.


You will work closely with senior management, customer facing teams and stakeholders across the organisation to identify challenges, collaborate effectively, uncover opportunities and co-design practical communications that deliver meaningful transformation outcomes.


A core part of the role will involve leading end-to-end customer communication strategies and program delivery across a range of channels including email, SMS, direct mail, FAQs, web content, landing pages, in-app messaging and internal communications.


You will be responsible for translating complex banking, technical and regulatory information into clear, customer-friendly messaging that drives understanding, confidence and engagement.


You will play an instrumental role in supporting customer migration and transformation programs by coordinating communications across multiple customer cohorts, developing communication frameworks and reusable content templates, and ensuring messaging is delivered consistently across every customer touchpoint.


Success in this role will require strong stakeholder engagement skills. You will build trusted relationships across Product, Change, Marketing, Digital, Contact Centre, Program Delivery, Risk, Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all communications align with broader transformation objectives and customer support strategies. You will also identify, document, and help resolve risks and issues while ensuring communication activities meet governance, regulatory and compliance obligations.


This is a unique opportunity to influence the future of Everyday Banking at BOQ, helping deliver transformation initiatives that improve customer experiences, and support the bank's strategic direction.

About You

You are a collaborative, customer-focused and solutions-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys solving complex challenges.


You combine strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.


You have experience delivering customer communication strategies or change programs in complex environments and are confident managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and deliverables simultaneously.


You can take complex information and translate it into clear, engaging and customer-friendly communications that drive understanding and positive outcomes.


Your ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders enables you to work effectively across Product, Technology, Marketing, Change, Risk, Legal and Compliance teams.


You are comfortable working through ambiguity, adapting to changing priorities and taking ownership of challenges from identification through to resolution.


Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry will be highly regarded, particularly if you have supported customer migrations, transformation programs or large-scale business change initiatives.


Exposure to Jira, Confluence or similar project collaboration tools would also be advantageous.


Most importantly, you are highly organised, proactive and passionate about delivering customer-focused solutions.


You bring strong attention to detail, a commitment to continuous improvement and a genuine desire to make a meaningful impact on both customer experience and business outcomes.


If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.


About us

BOQ Group is a truly unique group of challenger brands with a purpose – to provide a genuine alternative to Australian financial services for customers and employees.

Our family of brands (Bank of Queensland (BOQ), ME Bank, Virgin Money Australia, BOQ Specialist), each come with their own defined customer audience and brand personality, but share one goal – to build social capital through banking. That’s creating trust with customers, exploring staff potential and believing that tiny gestures and big ideas can change the world for communities.

BOQ Group’s inclusive vision is to foster a workspace that values and leverages difference and creates new possibilities, a place where our people feel confident to bring their best selves to work every day. We embrace difference and believe that our workforce should reflect the customers and communities that we serve.

In 2023, we successfully implemented an innovative Reconciliation Plan, driving positive change and promoting inclusivity across BOQ Group.

Our perks

At BOQ Group, we are passionate about creating an exceptional work environment that nurtures both your professional and personal growth.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance your well-being, provide financial security, and foster a sense of community and inclusion. Here are just some of the fantastic perks you can enjoy as part of our team:

  • Flexible working arrangement - Balance your work and personal life with ease.

  • Discounted financial products - Enjoy exclusive rates on our financial services across the Group.

  • Salary sacrificing options - Maximise your take-home pay with our salary packaging options.

  • Paid parental leave with no minimum requirements - Spend quality time with your new family member without any worries.

  • Purchase additional annual leave - Need more time off? You can buy extra leave days.

  • Discounted private health insurance plan - Take care of your health with our special rates.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access confidential support for personal and professional challenges for you and your family

  • Access to employee network groups - Connect with peers through our First Nations Reconciliation, LGBTQIA+, Multicultural, Gender, Early Careers, and accessibility groups.

  • Pride in Diversity membership: We are proud members of Pride in Diversity and actively participate in the Australian Workplace Equality Index.

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Join us and be part of a company that truly cares about its people and community!

How to apply

To apply for this role, follow the links.

BOQ Group is committed to diversity and an inclusive workforce. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander People are encouraged to apply.

We celebrate, value and include people of all backgrounds, gender and expressions, sexualities, cultures, bodies and abilities. When you apply, you are welcome to tell us the pronouns you use and please let us know any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

If you are successful for a role with BOQ Group, it is a condition of employment that background screening is completed to ensure that the Bank complies with its obligations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing Act. These checks may include, but are not limited to identity, verification, reference checks, criminal background checks, immigration checks, verification of academic qualifications, bankruptcy checks.

Please no agency applications.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
About this role

Join a team at the forefront of protecting and shaping the future of technology. As our Cybersecurity Analyst, you’ll sit at the point where new technology meets risk, advising project teams, reviewing solution designs, and making sure security is designed in rather than retrofitted.

This is a second line role. You won’t be building or operating controls. Your job is to review the work of delivery and engineering teams, form your own view of the risk, and say so. That independence is what makes the role useful, and it’s also what makes it demanding. You’ll be influencing teams you don’t control and holding a position when a program is under pressure to move.

A core part of the role is working out what assurance each project needs, from architecture review and penetration testing through to supplier assurance and control review. You’ll arrange the internal teams and vendors who carry that work out, review the quality of what they produce, and track findings through to closure. Where risk remains, you’ll put it in front of the people accountable for accepting it.

You’ll be part of a collaborative Cybersecurity Assurance team that helps guide secure decision-making, provides oversight of technology and cyber risk, and supports the adoption of new technologies in a way that balances innovation with strong security practices. It’s a highly visible role, with reporting that reaches delivery teams, management and Board risk forums.

What you'll be doing

  • Partnering with project teams to discover and document security requirements early and embed them into key initiatives and business change.
  • Scoping the security services each project needs, including security architecture review, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, supplier assurance and control review, and maintaining the schedule that delivers them.
  • Providing independent cybersecurity and technology risk oversight, assurance and reporting across projects and strategic programs.
  • Coordinating internal teams and external delivery partners, including vendor-delivered testing and supplier assurance activity.
  • Preparing reporting on assurance status, service demand, risk themes and remediation progress, including input to management and Board Risk Committee papers.
  • Supporting internal and external audits through evidence collation and interviews and providing line 2 oversight of finding closure.
  • Contributing to the maturity of nib’s Information Security Management System, security policies and control frameworks.

About you

You'll have at least three years' experience in cybersecurity or technology risk and, need to be comfortable reviewing other people's work, forming an independent view, and explaining it clearly to the people who built it.

You're organised. A large part of this role is knowing what assurance work is in flight, what it depends on, who's delivering it and when it lands, then making that visible to everyone from delivery teams through to the Board.

You'll have a strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, including security-by-design, control effectiveness, vulnerability management, access management, data protection and cloud security, and you enjoy partnering with project teams to deliver practical, secure outcomes without creating unnecessary friction.

You’ll bring:

  • Excellent written, visual and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain security requirements, assurance outcomes and risk decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience scoping, coordinating or overseeing cybersecurity services such as security architecture review, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, supplier assurance or control review.
  • Experience assessing technical risk using a formal framework such as ISO 31000 and reviewing solution designs and assurance outputs to identify security implications, control gaps and remediation expectations.
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments and shared responsibility models, particularly AWS and Azure, and the security considerations for SaaS, PaaS and AI-enabled services.
  • Familiarity with secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, and how security controls are applied through development and deployment pipelines.
  • Relevant experience and/or qualifications in cybersecurity, technology, risk or a related discipline. Industry certification achieved or in progress is well regarded (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, SC-200, AZ-500 or similar).
  • Experience working in a regulated or compliance-bound environment, including exposure to APRA expectations such as CPS 234 and CPS 230.

Don't tick every box? If this role excites you and you bring relevant experience, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who we are

nib is a leader in private health insurance, disability support and health services, reshaping the industry through bold innovation, strategic disruption and trusted partnerships. We deliver great value health insurance and support services to protect, connect and empower you to access healthcare when and where you need.


We have a mission and vision of people enjoying better health. Through our success, we aspire to more prosperous and sustainable communities, helping members and travellers make more informed healthcare decisions and generally live healthier lives.


Diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace a flexible working environment and welcome candidates who reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We're committed to an environment where everyone has the autonomy and freedom to be their authentic selves, every day. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people living with disability, veterans, LGBTQIA+ as well as culturally diverse community members to apply for open roles.


We’re committed to creating an accessible recruitment process and employment experience. If you require adjustments to our online application, recruitment, selection and/or assessment process, or would like this advertisement in an alternative format, please contact us at nibemployment @nib.com.au.


Working at nib

Our hybrid working model offers flexibility to work from home or our purpose-built office Hubs, designed for focus, connection, and collaboration. We’re committed to coming together with purpose.


Other benefits to support you at work (and play) include:

  • New starter benefit to help set up a functional home workspace
  • 50% discount on employee health insurance
  • Opportunity to give back with paid volunteering leave supported by the nib foundation
  • Access to our nib Well Program and corporate fitness discounts
  • Access to employee share plans, short-term incentive program and life and salary continuance insurance benefits
  • 18 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents regardless of carer status
  • 5 days paid cultural leave for First Nations peoples
  • 4 weeks paid gender affirmation leave for trans, gender diverse and intersex employees

The fine print

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check (including criminal history and bankruptcy check) prior to commencement of employment.


We acknowledge Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the Traditional Custodians of the lands where we live, learn and work.


Next steps: If successful, you will receive an email from Sapia.ai inviting you to complete an online, chat‑based assessment.

title: Process & Pack Implementation (PPI) Technologist
description:
Job Description:

The Process & Pack Implementation (PPI) Technologist provides frontline technical support for the deployment of innovation, sustainability, and productivity initiatives across Mars Petcare North America’s packaging portfolio. The Technologist, PPI plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, and advancing scalable, sustainable packaging solutions across the manufacturing network.


Success in this role requires connecting innovative workstreams with high-quality, consistent manufacturing outcomes to deliver packaging solutions that meet evolving pet parent needs. The Technologist PPI is responsible for supporting business-critical projects and site trials, ensuring alignment from concept through commercialization and handover.


This role provides technical support for continuous improvement, process efficiency, and process standardization at full-scale manufacturing sites. This role is responsible for driving process improvements and enhancing operational performance through the application of root-cause problem solving and statistical analysis, leveraging extensive knowledge of packaging materials, package design, manufacturing processes, and packaging equipment.


This role is based in Bolton with regular in-office collaboration expected. Flexibility is a key enabler—empowering associates to make choices that support both business outcomes and personal needs, including remote work.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor or Associate’s Mechanical, Chemical, Food Process Engineering, Packaging, or equivalent experience.
  • 2–3+ years of technical experience in packaging, food manufacturing, quality assurance, or process engineering.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting trials, new equipment/material qualifications, and root-cause analysis.
  • Strong understanding of machinery and scale up risks
  • Willingness to travel 15%

What will be your key responsibilities?


Deployment & Handover: Support the execution of packaging trials, start-ups, and technology rollouts, ensuring seamless handover documentation and site operational readiness.

Site R&D Liaison: Function as the primary site-based technical representative connecting Packaging R&D and manufacturing teams to support project execution, issue resolution, and informed decision-making.

Process Optimization & Standardization: Partner with central engineering and operations to establish, simplify, and standardize process parameters for commercial and pipeline packaging materials.

Operational Excellence: Identify, prioritize, and implement process improvement opportunities using RCA, and SPC tools to improve equipment performance, reduce waste, and standardize manufacturing processes.

Protocol Design & Testing: Collaborate with broader R&D teams to design and execute qualification protocols, testing specifications, and modeling/simulation tools with minimal operational disruption.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between the below range CAD 76,148.00 - CAD 99,944.00. Please note: This job posting is for an existing vacancy. AI is used as a supporting tool in our recruitment process.

title: SYSTEM TEST-DO NOT APPLY
description:
Posting Date

09/23/20263000 DIXWELL AVESTE 100, HAMDEN, Connecticut, 06518-3522, United States of America

DaVita is seeking a Patient Care Technician who is looking to give life in an outpatient dialysis center. You can make an exceptional difference in the lives of our patients and their families dealing with end-stage renal failure or chronic kidney disease. Do you desire to deliver care in an empathetic, compassionate way - the way you'd want your own care to be?

If you haven't considered Nephrology before, read on as we think that you should.

Joining DaVita as Patient Care Technician (PCT) is an exciting opportunity to jump start your career in the health care industry! With paid, extensive training, you will gain the skills needed to care for our patients and build a network of other health care professionals across the geography where you live. Once you have successfully completed training, you will join a holistic team of care professionals – including nurses, dietitian, social workers, and other experienced PCTs – to care for our patients. It's not a job, it's giving life and a career based on passion and purpose.

DaVita – which is Italian for "giving life" – is working to provide quality service to patients, partners, and teammates. Our mission is to be the Provider, Partner, and Employer of Choice.

Our PCTs also find DaVita professionally fulfilling. To help advance your career, we offer clear paths to higher levels of responsibility and compensation through our Clinical Ladders program. Through DaVita's Bridge to your Dreams program, teammates who have been in their role for six consecutive months and in good standing, are eligible to receive tuition assistance up front to pursue their dream of becoming a DaVita RN and getting their Associates Degree in Nursing. description:

Job Description Summary

#LI-Remote

In this role you will be required to travel up to 60% of time. You can be based either in Spain (Madrid or Barcelona) or Slovenia (Ljubljiana).

Novartis can offer relocation support for this role!

In this role you will lead, support and report independent GMP audits according to the Novartis Quality System and the current GMP regulations to assess compliance with applicable regulations, standards, and guidance documents. Review and approve corrective action plans in support of the audit observations. The audits performed include internal and external targets of manufacturing sites, development centers, quality systems, contract manufacturers, laboratories, warehouses, country organizations, and suppliers.

The Global GMP Senior Quality Auditor also ensures alignment with strategic direction of the company and assist in driving implementation of the applicable actions and provides consultation to Novartis business units through risk based assessments.


Job Description

Major accountabilities:

  • Support the strategic development of an effective global risk-based audit strategy and program. Collect, collate, and incorporate input into the audit strategy and plan.
  • Plan, lead, conduct, document, and follow-up of GMP audit according to the requirements specified in the respective Novartis Quality procedures as well as applicable regulations, standards, quality agreements, and guidance documents.
  • For this role, auditors will be given more complex and higher-risk audits, such as sterile API, aseptic DP, and combination products. The ability to assess risk of these operations is critical to success. Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and training on audit activities.
  • Provide regulatory guidance for timely remediation and recommendations regarding acceptability of the proposed filing.
  • Prepare audit reports according to NVS requirements and timelines. Identify and report best practices and lessons learned to support development/training of GMP auditors. Mentor junior GMP staff as required .Act as GMP compliance consultant for GMP trainings, task forces, continuous improvement projects as needed.
  • Ensure appropriate escalation to responsible management in case of critical findings and support immediate follow-up measures according to NVS requirements on Management Escalations and other relevant procedures. Ensure adequate definition and recording of mitigation plans when applicable.
  • Assess the adequacy of responses (CAPA plans) to audit findings in cooperation with the stakeholder QA representative and Auditee.
  • Review and advise on relevant policies and procedures. Maintain current knowledge of regulations, standards, and guidance documents.

Essential requirements:

  • 12+ years broad experience in Pharmaceutical or Medical Device Industry. 3 years auditing experience preferred, and excellent knowledge of regulatory requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, sound and practical judgement in the interpretation and application of regulations and standards.
  • Solid operational experience, that should include QA/QC management and manufacturing, development or other relevant experience e.g. working at a regulatory health authority.
  • Strong experience in Sterile and/or expertise in at least one of the following areas: DP Manufacturing, Laboratories activities, Medical Devices, API, Biologics, Microbiology, Computer System Validation, Quality Systems, Cell&Gene therapy, Radioligand therapy.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including diplomacy and persuasion, used in obtaining cooperation and consensus with Novartis colleagues, vendors and customers.
  • Ability to independently manage and objectively evaluate complex compliance issues with minimal supervision.

Bradley Hospital A Brown University Health Entity

As Rhode Island’s largest health system and private employer, Brown University Health is committed to clinical excellence and devoted to our mission of delivering health with care. Bradley Hospital is hiring a Behavioral Health Specialist I to support the therapeutic milieu and provide compassionate, structured care to children and adolescents within our inpatient and partial programs.

Responsibilities

  • Therapeutic Milieu Support — Maintain a safe, structured, and therapeutic environment; actively engage with assigned children throughout the shift.

  • Patient Observation — Maintain and document observation levels as ordered by the physician or Charge RN.

  • Daily Care & Routines — Supervise children in daily routines, assist with activities of daily living, and support basic hygiene needs.

  • Crisis Response — Intervene in disruptive or unsafe situations using safe, effective, least‑restrictive crisis‑management techniques.

  • Documentation — Complete shift notes, incident reports, and other required documentation accurately and promptly.

  • Family Support — Provide support and information to visiting parents as directed by the treatment team.

  • Collaboration — Participate in treatment team meetings, rounds, shift reports, and patient‑specific discussions.

  • Care Planning — Review and contribute to milieu care plans; communicate updates to the interdisciplinary team.

  • Group & Activity Support — Co‑lead community meetings, social skills groups, recreation activities, and program‑specific groups.

  • Behavioral Programs — Follow individualized behavioral plans and set consistent, supportive therapeutic limits.

  • Recreation & Skill‑Building — Organize and participate in physical, social, and developmental activities for children.

  • Professional Development — Maintain certifications (CPR, crisis management, OSHA, Safety), attend staff meetings, and participate in training.

  • Cross‑Program Support — May be asked to support comparable duties in other clinical settings as program needs arise.

  • Education — Bachelor’s degree in a Human Services field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • Experience — 6 months to 1 year of direct childcare experience with emotionally impaired youth.

  • Certifications — Current Bradley Hospital Safety‑Care Certification and BLS certification (or ability to obtain).

    • Demonstrated willingness to learn role‑related skills.

    • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

    • Physically hold patients using approved methods

  • Competitive salary with shift differentials

title: Data Analyst - CLS
description:
Aspire Software is looking for a Data Analyst to join our team in Lebanon.

Here is a little window into our company: Aspire Software operates and manages wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

About the job:

This is not a role where you spend your week pulling reports people may or may not look at.

We want someone who can get inside the business, understand how Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Payments, and Finance operate, and turn messy data and manual processes into scalable systems.

You will become one of the key owners of our revenue data and HubSpot environment, helping us understand what is happening across the customer lifecycle, improving how our teams operate, and building AI agents and automations that remove repetitive work.

You will have significant freedom to identify problems and build solutions.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will help us:

  • Establish reliable reporting and KPI infrastructure across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Payments
  • Improve the accuracy, structure, and usability of HubSpot across the organization
  • Create a clear view of the entire revenue funnel, from lead through acquisition, onboarding, retention, expansion, and payments adoption
  • Reduce manual reporting and administrative work through automation
  • Build AI agents and workflows that make our teams faster and more effective; with a focus on go to market and reporting
  • Improve forecasting, pipeline visibility, customer segmentation, and revenue analysis
  • Create trusted datasets and dashboards that leadership can use to make decisions quickly
  • Identify revenue opportunities and operational issues before someone has to ask

What You’ll Do

Revenue Operations & Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical models across the customer lifecycle
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Payments, and Finance to define and track meaningful KPIs
  • Analyze pipeline, conversion, retention, expansion, payments adoption, and customer behavior
  • Help improve forecasting accuracy and pipeline management
  • Identify trends, bottlenecks, anomalies, and opportunities hidden within our data
  • Develop customer segmentation and cohort analysis to support GTM decisions
  • Translate business questions into clear analysis and actionable recommendations
  • Create scalable reporting rather than relying on manual spreadsheets and one-off analysis

HubSpot Ownership & RevOps

  • Help own and continuously improve our HubSpot environment
  • Build and maintain workflows, properties, lifecycle stages, pipelines, reporting, and automation
  • Improve CRM data quality, governance, and consistency
  • Design processes that make HubSpot easier for Sales and Customer Success teams to use correctly
  • Connect HubSpot data with other business systems and datasets
  • Automate lead routing, customer workflows, lifecycle management, alerts, and internal processes
  • Help establish scalable RevOps processes as the company grows

AI Agents & Automation

  • Identify repetitive or manual workflows that can be automated
  • Build AI agents that can analyze information, perform tasks, and support business processes
  • Create workflows that combine AI models, internal data, APIs, and business applications
  • Experiment rapidly with new AI capabilities and turn useful prototypes into repeatable internal tools
  • Build agents for use cases such as research, account intelligence, reporting, data enrichment, customer insights, and internal operations
  • Measure whether automation actually saves time, improves accuracy, or drives better business outcomes
  • Help teams understand where AI is useful and where traditional automation or analytics is the better solution

Data Quality & Infrastructure

  • Combine data from HubSpot and other business systems into consistent reporting
  • Help define our source-of-truth metrics and business definitions
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues
  • Work with Product and Engineering when deeper integrations or data infrastructure are required
  • Document key metrics, processes, workflows, and data definitions so systems can scale with the company

Requirements

    • 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a similar analytical role
    • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot
    • Experience working with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, or broader GTM organizations
    • Strong SQL and data analysis skills
    • Experience building dashboards and reporting using BI or visualization tools
    • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets capabilities
    • Comfortable working with imperfect datasets and figuring out how to make them useful
    • Experience designing workflows and automating business processes
    • Ability to translate analysis into clear business recommendations
    • Strong curiosity and willingness to dig into how the business actually works
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where not everything has already been built

AI & Automation Experience

  • We are specifically looking for someone who is excited about using AI as a practical business tool.
  • You should have experience experimenting with or building solutions using some combination of:
    • AI agents and agentic workflows
    • Large language models
    • APIs and webhooks
    • Workflow automation platforms
    • Python or JavaScript
    • Structured prompts and tool calling
    • Data enrichment and research automation
    • Connecting AI models to business applications and internal data
  • You do not need to be an AI engineer.
  • You do need to be someone who sees a repetitive process and immediately starts wondering whether there is a better way to do it.

You’ll Thrive Here If…

    • You like building things from scratch
    • You are naturally curious about how businesses make money
    • You would rather solve the underlying problem than keep producing the same report every Monday
    • You are comfortable moving between data analysis, systems, automation, and business conversations
    • You ask good questions and challenge assumptions
    • You care about clean data but understand that real-world data rarely starts clean
    • You can explain complicated analysis without making it complicated
    • You enjoy experimenting with new technology and figuring out where it creates real value
    • You want ownership rather than a narrowly defined list of tasks

What You’ll Get

  • A high-impact role with direct exposure to senior leadership
  • Significant ownership over analytics, RevOps, and automation projects
  • The opportunity to build systems and processes from the ground up
  • Exposure across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Payments, Product, Engineering, and Finance
  • The ability to experiment with and implement emerging AI technologies
  • A growing international software business with significant investment behind its next stage of growth
  • The opportunity to materially influence how Clubspeed and Resova operate as we scale

title: Bli med på laget i ferskvareavdelingen hos MENY Karmsundgata!
description:
I MENY elsker vi mat! For oss er god mat en lidenskap, og noe av det viktigste som finnes. Hos oss er alle MATarbeidere, uansett om du jobber i ferskvaredisken, kolonialen, i kassen eller på kontoret. Å være en MATarbeider i MENY betyr at du alltid gjør ditt beste for å veilede og inspirere kundene våre til matglede. Sammen skal vi hjelpe flere å spise bedre, og leve bedre.


Stillingsomfang: 24%
Arbeidstid: kveld og helg
Oppstart: snarest - eller etter avtale

Søknadsfrist: vi behandler søknader fortløpende

For å søke på denne stillingen må du være fylt 18 år, da du i denne stillingen håndterer maskiner med 18 års aldersgrense. Du må også kunne kommunisere godt med kunder og kolleger på norsk.

Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?
Som MATarbeider i vår ferskvareavdeling vil du ha en hektisk og spennende hverdag med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgavene. Du vil ekspedere kunder, skjære og tilberede ulike ferskvarer som kjøtt, fisk og ost, du vil fylle varer og naturlig nok ta oppvasken. Du vil også arbeide i bakeriavdelingen der oppgavene består i å steke brød, rydde, legge opp varer til neste dag og hjelpe kunder. For å trives må du være en som liker å prate med mennesker, takler utfordringer, tunge løft, hektisk tempo og ikke være redd for å smake på nye ting.


Våre kunder forventer at du har kunnskap om mat, men fortvil ikke selv om "Hellstrøm" ikke er ditt etternavn. Vi lærer deg alt vi kan om torsk, svinekjake, culotte og Kraftkar, men det er uten tvil en fordel om du har basiskunnskap og interesse for mat fra før av. Om du har relevant fagbrev er det selvfølgelig et pluss!


Hvordan er det å jobbe i MENY?
Hos oss vil du blant annet lære å ta ansvar, mestre stress, håndtere mennesker og ikke minst butikkdrift. Vi har en interaktiv kursplattform, ulike klasseromskurs som gir deg faglig påfyll og et traineeprogram med fokus på å gå fra ansatt til å bli leder, for å nevne noe. Satser du på MENY, satser MENY på deg!


Når det gjelder trivsel på jobb, vil vi trekke frem samholdet. Som en av våre matarbeidere blir du en del av et team som jobber mot felles mål, for din innsats vil påvirke butikken, kundene og kollegene dine. Vi verdsetter gjensidig omtanke og støtte, og det er rom for feil så lenge du lærer og utvikler deg – for er du trygg er du god.

Å søke jobb i MENY skal være enkelt

Du trenger ikke laste opp søknadsbrev. For at vi skal bli litt bedre kjent med deg, svarer du på spørsmålene om deg og din erfaring. Har du mye på hjertet må du gjerne skrive utfyllende, vi gleder oss til å lese! Og fordi vi synes det er spennende å se hvor du har vært tidligere, må du laste opp CV.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at alle søknader må sendes inn via søknadsskjema tilknyttet annonsen, dette er av hensyn til ditt personvern, samt at vi ønsker å være sikre på at vi klarer å følge opp alle kandidater på en god måte. Vi kan derfor ikke ta imot søknader på papir i butikken eller via e-post. Søknader behandles fortløpende.


Kontaktperson

Ole Lindanger

Butikksjef

52 80 45 00

ledigestillinger@meny.no

MENY er Norges største supermarkedkjede med nesten 200 butikker og en omsetning på over 20 milliarder kroner. Vi har 10 000 stolte matarbeidere som sørger for gode handleopplevelser hver eneste dag!

title: Interim Studio Coordinator - Costa Mesa
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a Studio Coordinator (SC), you live your power by supporting the world class CorePower Yoga studio experience including coordinating studio operations and holding the studio to the highest health and safety standards. In alignment with our Core Values, you work alongside the Studio Manager to deliver results and sustained growth towards all current company and studio-level goals. In the SC role, you will learn the business and develop the skillset to operate a studio.

Studio Presence and Guiding the Student Experience

  • Act as an ambassador of the CorePower Yoga Core Values at all times and consistently inspire these values in others
  • Support the Studio Manager in achieving company and studio level goals, including membership growth, retail sales, community outreach, teacher and SET recruitment, and programming enrollment
  • Commit to flexible schedule of 18-29 hours per week in studio in support of operations coordination and teaching (if certified), include health and safety protocol execution, front desk guidance, and team support
  • Must be flexible with schedule availability within the hourly commitment in service of the studio and team
  • Responsibly run the studio, including by acting as the point of contact for students and staff when Studio Manager is not present, up to 20 hours per week
  • Support maintaining an appropriate level of studio supply inventory so that all provisions and amenities are available for students at all times including cleanliness inventory, locker room amenities, towels, programming materials, etc.
  • Engage and know your studio community consistently; greet students by name, serve as an ambassador of yoga both inside and outside of the studio, and spend quality time at the front desk fostering community
  • Support our teachers learning experience of working the POS and other pre/post class duties

Coordinate and Execute Health, Safety and Cleanliness Protocol in the Studio​

  • Uphold high standards for the studio and when on duty, ensure that the physical studio space meets the high CPY standards of cleanliness and functionality including a safe environment, optimum heat and humidity, inspiring music, and clean and clutter-free surroundings in all areas of the studio
  • Support communication around Smart Health Protocol to students upon entry and throughout their visit at CPY ​
  • Act as an extension of the Studio Experience Team (SET) including cleaning the studio, stocking amenities, and ensuring the CPY cleanliness protocol is always followed while on duty in the studio
  • Support the SET team by interviewing SET applicants, hiring SET employees, scheduling SET employee's shifts, stepping in for no call/no shows, training, and disciplining/terminating SET employees who have violated CPY's policies and standards
  • Lead Orientation for new Studio Experience Team members and train them on cleanliness protocol and role expectations

Coordinate Studio Systems

  • Act as a liaison between the Studio Manager and the teaching and SET teams in training, communicating, and coordinating studio operational systems including but not limited to:
  • Point of Sales System (POS); understand and efficiently navigate POS to sign students in, sell packages and memberships, and explore and correct problems with student accounts when at the desk
  • Online Reservation System; support administrative follow up of late cancel fees, waitlist, student support, etc
  • Subbing Application; support training and usage for teaching team
  • HRIS Application; support training and usage for teaching and SET team
  • Help Desk; Submit facilities tickets when on duty ​and communicate follow up needs to Studio Manager

Teaching Schedule

  • Support the studio class schedule by teaching a minimum of 6 classes per week of branded CorePower Yoga classes and support the studio through subbing additional classes as needed

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must demonstrate CorePower Yoga Core Value
  • Excellent oral communication skills, professionalism and exceptional interpersonal skills are required
  • Experience in Customer Service required
  • Completion of a Yoga Alliance certified 200-hour program is preferred
  • Yoga Sculpt teacher training is preferred
  • Familiar and comfortable in studio systems such as the HRIS, intranet, point of sale systems, company scheduling and payroll systems, etc.
  • Ability to build relationships with individuals with diverse personalities and styles and at different levels of seniority
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize while working under multiple deadlines
  • Proven self-starter with ability to take on new projects with enthusiasm
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel
  • Excellent Time Management skills
  • Ability to take initiative and prioritize
  • College (BA/BS) preferred

THE FINE PRINT

  • Availability must match the needs of the business and leadership zig-zag schedules – morning, evening, weekend and some holiday availability and flexibility required
  • Must be able to move around the studio space, crouch, reach, and lift up to 25 lbs.
  • If certified to teach, must be able to step in to teach class with little to no notice while scheduled in the studio .

COMPENSATION

  • $24.50 per hour

THE PERKS

  • Free All Access Membership - use anytime, in studio or online

  • Free All Access Membership for a Plus One - bring someone along!

  • Retail Discounts

  • Continued Education Offerings

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 1.5x Holiday Pay: Earn time-and-a-half pay for hours worked on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

WHO WE ARE

At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.

As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, we reserve the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed. CorePower Yoga is an equal opportunity employer of all qualified individuals, including minorities, BIPOC, LGBTQ+, veterans & individuals with disabilities.

CorePower Yoga provides reasonable accommodation and/or modification to disabled individuals to assist in the application process. Any individual requiring accommodation/modification to complete this application should contact Human Resources at help.corepoweryoga.com.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Biller Workflows
description:
About the company

Our client is a high-growth healthcare technology company building AI-powered clinical and administrative software for care providers. Its platform supports more than 500,000 clinicians across hundreds of healthcare organizations, powers more than 100 million patient interactions, and processes more than $10 billion through its systems. The company is backed by leading venture investors, has raised more than $800 million, and was recently valued at $7 billion.

The role and why it matters

You will set the technical direction for the biller-workflow platform used across the company's practice-management and revenue-cycle products. This is a staff-level, full-stack role with an approximately 60/40 backend-to-frontend split. You will lead a generational rebuild of high-traffic workflows for claims, appointments, payments, posting, and other billing operations while keeping mature production systems reliable for enterprise customers.

What you'll do

• Define frontend and backend architecture, shared component conventions, API contracts, data-layer patterns, and observability practices across multiple engineering teams.

• Lead multi-month, multi-team platform rebuilds and migrations, shipping incremental improvements without breaking existing users.

• Build data-dense, high-performance interfaces for complex tables, virtualized rendering, keyboard-driven workflows, bulk actions, and activity timelines.

• A record of leading large, multi-team platform rebuilds or migrations and delivering them incrementally in production.

• Org-wide frontend architecture leadership, including adoption of a design system, shared component library, or common frontend platform across a large engineering organization.

Bonus points

Benefits

Compensation, location, and benefits

title: FMS-ACES Tier 2 Application Support Specialist (Appian Service Desk)
description:
This position supports the Foreign Military Sales – Army Case Execution System (FMS-ACES) Product Office. FMS-ACES is the first Defense Business System (DBS) program in the DoDI 5000.87 Software Acquisition Pathway, within Capability Program Executive (CPE) Enterprise Software and Services (CPE ES2), located in the PMO Acquisition, Training & Readiness (AT&R) portfolio.

FMS-ACES is a cloud-based Platform as a Service (PaaS) providing a user-centric journey design that will modernize the Army’s FMS case execution and management processes from end to end. By stream-lining business processes, data standardization, integrated through state-of-the-art interface management, FMS-ACES will provide accurate case management and business analytics enabling real-time, accurate and informed data-drive decisions for Senior Leaders. FMS-ACES is in development and once fielded subsumes capabilities of a 50-year-old legacy system and consolidates two disparate systems into a single source of Army FMS data. The new system will exchange information with 26 distinct financial and logistic systems of record partners for end-to-end process execution. FMS-ACES will support 2000 users, incorporating 6,200 active FMS cases and 88,000 active requisitions.

Key Features and Capabilities:

Developed using Agile methodologies, FMS-ACES provides a unified environment for managing the full lifecycle of an FMS case:

· Case Management: Streamlines everything from initial case implementation to closeout.

· Real-Time Data: Connects to over 20 government data source systems to provide case officers with accurate, real-time information.

· Enhanced Reporting: Includes advanced automated workflows, data visualization, and comprehensive reporting capabilities.

· Transparency and Collaboration: Allows better end-to-end transparency and coordination between stakeholders like the Department of State and other military departments.

Job Description:

Summary: The Tier 2 Application Support Specialist delivers advanced technical application support, incident resolution, and user enablement for the Foreign Military Sales – Army Case Execution System (FMS-ACES). Operating within the Army Enterprise Service Management Platform (AESMP / ServiceNow), the specialist diagnoses intermediate-to-advanced application, data, and platform issues on the Appian Cloud environment, coordinates Tier 3 engineering escalations, and champions user adoption across the Army FMS enterprise.

Core Duties & Responsibilities:

• Serve as the primary Tier 2 escalation point, diagnosing complex incidents across the Appian platform.
• Perform root-cause analysis to distinguish between user training gaps, platform configuration errors, and backend software defects.
• Execute SQL queries to inspect backend data structures, validate data integrity, and isolate transactional anomalies.
• Package diagnostic data, system logs, and reproducible steps to execute seamless handoffs to Tier 3 engineering and DevOps teams.

• Manage end-user lifecycle support: user account provisioning, role-based access control (RBAC), and authentication troubleshooting.
• Log, track, and manage tickets within the Army Enterprise Service Management Platform (AESMP/ServiceNow) adhering strictly to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Provide scheduled on-call support for mission-critical and severity-1 system incidents.

• Analyze recurring ticket trends to recommend system optimizations, workflow automation, or targeted training interventions.
• Author and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Knowledge Base (KB) articles, user manuals, and desk reference guides.
• Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) and Database Administrators (DBAs) to test bug fixes and validate performance.

• Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Retrospectives) to relay user feedback and defect reports directly to development squads.
• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment dry-runs, and user training sessions across the enterprise.

Requirements

Position Qualifications & Requirements:

Mandatory Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical discipline (or equivalent accredited technical training / 4+ years additional direct experience in lieu of degree).
• 4+ years of progressive IT service desk or application support experience.

• Hands-on experience troubleshooting enterprise low-code platforms (Appian Cloud environment preferred).
• Proficiency in writing and executing SQL queries for data validation and issue analysis.
• Working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and enterprise ticketing systems (AESMP / ServiceNow).

• CompTIA Security+ CE (or active DoD 8140/8570.01-M IAT Level II baseline certification) OR ITIL 4 Foundation certification (as specified by task order requirements).
• Familiarity with DoD 8500-series directives, NIST SP 800-37 / RMF concepts, and DISA STIG compliance standards.

• Active DoD Secret Clearance (U.S. Citizenship mandatory).

Preferred / Desired Qualifications

• 2+ years supporting enterprise implementations of Contract Writing Systems (CWS) or defense financial/case management systems.
• Direct operational knowledge of the Army Foreign Military Sales (FMS) enterprise.

• Working knowledge of Appian architecture, including in-memory engines (KDB), custom plug-ins, and REST/SOAP API integrations.
• Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

• Appian Certified Associate Developer or Appian Certified Analyst credential.

Place of Performance:

  • The contractor will follow a hybrid work environment for the Place of Performance:

o On-site performance of services by the Contractor at Government facilities shall be accomplished primarily in northern Virginia, when required. Quarterly workshops at New Cumberland or northern Virginia.
