title: Polyvalent Operator Filling V/L (Pilot Plant) (Tijdelijk Assignement 1,5j)
description:
Afdeling

De Small Scale Fill Finish (S2F2) afdeling maakt deel uit van de clinical supply afdeling en maakt de lancering van nieuwe, innovatieve geneesmiddelen en vaccins mogelijk door het ontwikkelen en implementeren van nieuwe productie processen, het produceren van klinische stalen en het verwerven van product en proces kennis.

Het volledige productie proces wordt van A tot Z verzorgd door het team van de pilot plant: reinigen en steriliseren van equipment en cleanrooms, afwegen en dooien van grondstoffen, formulatie van oplossingen en suspensies, steriele filtratie, steriel afvullen van vials/spuiten en het vriesdrogen van het afgevulde product, …

In de pilot plant wordt gebruik gemaakt van divers farmaceutische equipment en processen en wordt gewerkt volgens dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden als in een commerciële farmaceutische productie plant.

Verantwoordelijkheden en opportuniteiten

Binnen clinical supply/S2F2 zijn we op zoek naar een tijdelijke versterking voor ons team gedurende 1,5 jaar. Een ideale opportuniteit om te ontdekken of de clinical supply/S2F2 wereld iets voor jou is.

Je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling van diverse nieuwe geneesmiddelen en vaccins, die elk een specifiek formulatie proces en equipment vereisen. Hierdoor krijg je de kans om met een brede waaier van processen en equipment te werken.



Als Polyvalent Operator waarborg je de optimale conditie en werking van het equipment en de materialenflow. Je zorgt daarbij voor:

  • Cleaning en desinfectie van cleanrooms en equipment in grade C en grade B
  • Zelfstandig bedienen van equipment (vullijnen voeden, trayen, preparatie equipment bedienen zoals autoclaaf, VHP sas, Getinge, CIPSIP installatie)
  • Uitvoeren van administratieve taken
  • Sets assembleren
  • Oplossen van veel voorkomende technische problemen
  • Uitvoeren van controles (verificaties, in process testen, …)
  • Documentatie & ticket nazicht na beëindigen van het lot
  • Plaatsen & demonteren van wisselstukken op de lijn
  • Bevoorraden van de lijnen, materiaaltransfer van unclassified naar grade C en van grade C naar grade B
  • Je test de integriteit van lucht- en productfilters
  • Je assisteert bij andere teams (filling of andere afdeling) indien nodig
  • Zorgen voor orde en netheid

Functieprofiel

Must

  • Je werkt accuraat
  • Kwaliteit, orde en netheid zijn op je buik geschreven
  • Je volgt strikt procedures en documenteert nauwkeurig
  • Je werkt vlot in team
  • Goed proces en technisch inzicht
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken
  • Je communiceert goed en respectvol naar TL, shift PE, teamleden van zelfde en andere shift
  • Je kan goed tegen wisselende prioriteiten en planningswijzigingen (eigen aan clinical supply)
  • Bereid te werken in 2 ploegen

Nice to have

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie
  • Ervaring in een GMP omgeving
  • Ervaring in een aseptische werkomgeving



Work Location Assignment: On Premise

De Pfizer site in Puurs is één van de grootste productie- en verpakkingssites van Pfizer wereldwijd, gespecialiseerd in aseptische productie en verpakking. Jaarlijks worden in Puurs meer dan 400 miljoen doses injecteerbare vaccins en medicijnen geproduceerd. Deze zijn ter plaatse verpakt in ampullen, flacons, plastic flessen, spuiten en patronen voor pennen.

De medicijnen die in Puurs worden gemaakt, zijn bestemd voor patiënten in meer dan 170 landen wereldwijd. 30% van de productie uit Puurs is bestemd voor ontwikkelingslanden, in samenwerking met UNICEF, WHO, GAVI en ngo's.

Met het gebruik van twee windturbines, zonnepanelen en een warmtekrachtcentrale richten we ons op hernieuwbare energie.

Pfizer’s doel is om gelijke kansen te bieden in het wervingsproces door elke vorm van vooringenomenheid of mogelijke discriminatie te vermijden, ongeacht (maar niet beperkt tot) geslacht, leeftijd, ras, religie of overtuiging, seksuele geaardheid of handicap. We creëren een organisatie en bevorderen een cultuur die respect heeft voor ieders unieke karakter en levenservaringen en die de diversiteit van onze samenleving, klanten en markten weerspiegelt. Dit bereiken we door een omgeving te cultiveren en in stand te houden waarin elke collega zich gewaardeerd en ondersteund voelt.

Disability Inclusion:

Onze missie is om de kracht van al onze mensen te ontwikkelen en ruimte te geven. We zijn trots om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn, die aan alle kandidaten met een beperking gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen je aan om jezelf te zijn en dat met ons te delen, wetende dat wij ons best gaan doen om jouw sollicitatie en toekomstige carrière te ondersteunen. Jouw reis bij Pfizer begint hier!

description:
As a family company, we serve people and communities. When you work at Meijer, you’re provided with career and community opportunities centered around leadership, personal growth and development. Consider joining our family – take care of your career and your community!

Meijer Rewards

  • Weekly pay

  • Scheduling flexibility

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid education assistance

  • Team member discount

  • Development programs for advancement and career growth

Please review the job profile below and apply today!

The Area Leader is responsible for overall team member engagement for those in span of care. The leader will be responsible for driving recognition, feedback and coaching, performance management, training and development, and succession planning. The Area Leader will direct Leads and Team Leaders, while ultimately being accountable for area operations and financials (shrink, productivity, safety, scheduling & forecasting staffing needs, and team member and customer conflict resolution). The Area Leader will work to identify and implement process improvements as well as serve as a steward of the Meijer culture.


What You’ll be Doing:

  • Engages with team members in span of care to ensure they are receiving appropriate onboarding, training and development, and coaching and feedback to be successful in all they do.
  • Identifies talent and engages in career discussions to support overall store staffing and ensure a diversified talent pipeline strategy for team member as well as leadership roles.
  • Involvement in candid discussions with team members to ensure Meijer standards are upheld and team members have the ability to grow within the organization.
  • Accountability for area operations and financial results by overseeing the execution of corporate plans to ensure all services and products are effectively managed in order to maximize sales and productivity ultimately owning budget line items in the P&L.
  • Drives safety and compliance throughout the store in addition to overall condition management as well as responsibility for following all compliance procedures in the store.
  • Ensures the Team Leaders and Leads are providing guidance and assigning daily work assignments for team members as well as any training needs.
  • This job profile is not meant to be all inclusive of the responsibilities of this position; may perform other duties as assigned or required.

What You Bring with You (Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 4+ years of retail/grocery or customer service experience.
  • Progressive leadership experience preferred.
  • A passion to provide industry leading service.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with team members in a way that provides clear and precise direction.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial and statistical information and use that information to make informed decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead an organization that practices working safely at all times.
  • Demonstrates proactive/creative thinking and applies it to the business.
  • A thorough understanding of seasonal and diverse merchandising which leads to meeting the needs of our customers/community and gaining sales and market share.
  • A strong business acumen.
  • An innovative attitude to help Meijer set the industry standard.
  • A commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where all team members and vendors feel valued and supported.

title: Product Owner
description:
At Heathrow, we’re on a mission to transform the way millions of passengers experience travel. As an IT Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the digital products that keep the UK’s busiest airport running smoothly. This is your opportunity to influence technology that underpins critical airport operations, ensuring efficiency, safety, and exceptional service for our passengers and partners.

You’ll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team that thrives on innovation and continuous improvement. Success in this role means delivering products that meet business needs, enhance operational performance, and support Heathrow’s ambition to be a world-class, sustainable hub. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the airport, translating strategic objectives into actionable product roadmaps and ensuring value delivery at every stage.

  • Own and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring alignment with Heathrow’s strategic goals and operational requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, and UX teams to define clear product requirements and deliverables.
  • Lead the development and delivery of digital solutions that improve efficiency, resilience, and passenger experience.
  • Monitor product performance, using data and feedback to drive continuous improvement and maximise value.
  • Champion agile practices within the team, fostering a culture of transparency, adaptability, and collaboration.
  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within complex IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and product lifecycle management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to inform decisions and measure success.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent organisational skills and adaptability to changing priorities.

Ideally, you'll also have the following

  • Experience in aviation, transport, or other safety-critical industries.
  • Familiarity with enterprise IT systems and integration challenges.
  • Certification in Product Ownership or Agile frameworks (e.g., CSPO, SAFe PO/PM).

description:

Job Title: Crew Leader

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Job Summary:

The Crew Leader provides support and coaching to the crew to achieve production goals. This role identifies safety hazards and ensures compliance along with task allocation and prioritization of work on the job site as directed by their General Foreperson.


Essential Job Duties:

  • Adheres to and coaches employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods, and OSHA regulations. Assists with conducting necessary safety training, pre-job briefings, designating crew member assignments and coaching in accordance with company policies, procedures, and customer requirements.
  • Uses applicable herbicide equipment to treat stumps and brush. Maintain appropriate application records.
  • Obtains permission from property owners to trim or remove trees and apply herbicides. Works with customer or property owner to gain access to the job site, advises of potential interruption, and explains the work needing to be completed.
  • Works around hazardous equipment and in close proximity to energized power lines.
  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.
  • Conducts pre-inspection of work area to identify potential hazards.
  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.
  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.
  • Promotes and maintains good customer and public relations through effective completion of assigned work and the appropriate behavior of employees on the crew.
  • Maintains records, and reports related to the production of the crew, such as timesheets, work orders, units of work, manhours, distribution of crew assignments and controlling costs, to meet organizational goals.
  • Obtains and interprets maps from General Foreperson or utility showing work orders to be completed for tree trimming, removals and chemical application. Responsible for understanding drawings and symbols representing types of power lines, voltages, and line equipment per industry standard and assisting General Foreperson with assigning daily work orders.
  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.
  • Staging and clean-up of tools and equipment at the job site. Maintains a neat and orderly work area.
  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.
  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty and travel outside of regular work location for the duration of the disaster. Assists with contacting and coordinating the crew’s response to such work and responsible for determining proper steps necessary to eliminate hazards and trim/remove trees while onsite during emergency response.
  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.
  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

Supervisory Duties:


Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Possess excellent leadership skills and be able to handle stressful situations along with being able to multi-task.
  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).
  • Ability to adhere and educate on company and industry safety requirements.
  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.
  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.
  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.
  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.
  • Must be able to write, read, and comprehend written and verbal job instructions/information.
  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.
  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.
  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.
  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.
  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 3 years’ experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.
  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.
  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.
  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.
  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.
  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Possesses the ability to lift, move, and maneuver up to 50 pounds on an infrequent basis and up to 30 pounds on a frequent basis.
  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.
  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

Environmental Factors:

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to indoor and outdoor working conditions.
  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.
  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.
  • Routine exposure to noise, vibration, working hazards such as proximity to moving parts, mechanical equipment, moving vehicles, gasoline powered equipment, electrical current, heights, exposure to heat, exposure to chemicals, work in close quarters, narrow aisles or passageways, communicable diseases, bloodborne pathogens, cleaning chemicals, dust, odors, and a variety of pests.

Cargo: Crew Leader

Tipo de salario: No exento

Resumen del puesto:

El Crew Leader brinda apoyo y orientación al equipo de trabajo para alcanzar los objetivos de producción. La persona en este puesto identifica los posibles factores de riesgo a la seguridad y garantiza el cumplimiento de las normas, además de asignar tareas y priorizar el trabajo en el lugar de trabajo según las indicaciones de su General Foreperson.


Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Cumple con y orienta a los empleados sobre las políticas de la empresa, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de OSHA. Ayuda a impartir la capacitación en seguridad necesaria, realiza reuniones informativas previas al trabajo (job briefings), asigna tareas a los miembros del equipo de trabajo y brinda orientación conforme a las políticas, procedimientos y requisitos del cliente.
  • Utiliza equipos de aplicación de herbicidas según corresponda para tratar trocos y maleza (brush). Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.
  • Obtiene permisos de los propietarios para podar o eliminar árboles y aplicar herbicidas. Trabaja con el cliente o propietario para obtener acceso al lugar de trabajo, informa sobre posibles interrupciones y explica el trabajo que debe realizarse.
  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y en proximidad a líneas eléctricas energizadas.
  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.
  • Realiza inspecciones previas del área de trabajo para identificar posibles riesgos.
  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.
  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.
  • Promueve y mantiene buenas relaciones con clientes y público mediante la correcta realización del trabajo asignado y el comportamiento apropiado de los empleados del equipo de trabajo.
  • Mantiene registros e informes relacionados con la producción del equipo de trabajo, como hojas de horas, órdenes de trabajo, unidades de producción, horas-hombre, distribución de tareas y control de costos, con el fin de cumplir los objetivos organizacionales.
  • Recibe e interpreta los mapas del General Foreperson o de la empresa de servicios públicos que muestran las órdenes de trabajo que deben completarse para la poda y la eliminación de árboles o la aplicación química. Es responsable de comprender los planos y símbolos que representan los tipos de líneas eléctricas, tensiones y equipos de líneas eléctricas según los estándares del sector, y de asistir al General Foreperson en la asignación de las órdenes de trabajo diarias.
  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.
  • Se encarga de la preparación y limpieza de herramientas y equipos en el lugar de trabajo. Mantiene un área de trabajo limpia y ordenada.
  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.
  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento. Colabora en la comunicación y coordinación de la respuesta del equipo de trabajo ante dichas situaciones, y es responsable de determinar los pasos adecuados para eliminar peligros y podar o retirar árboles durante las labores de respuesta.
  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de propiedad de empleados de Wright.
  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.
  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:


Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo y capacidad para manejar situaciones de estrés, así como para realizar múltiples tareas simultáneamente.
  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con el público, los clientes y los empleados.
  • Conocimiento y comprensión de American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para Operaciones de Cuidado de Árboles - ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de American National Standards for Proper Pruning (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la Poda Adecuada - ANSI A300).

Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.
  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.

title: Renal/ Rare Territory Account Specialist- Atlanta, GA- North / East
description:
Band

Level 3


Job Description Summary

#LI-Remote

This is a field-based and remote opportunity supporting key accounts in an assigned geography.
Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible to you.

Company will not sponsor visas for this position.

As a Territory Account Specialist (TAS), you’ll lead with purpose – crafting personalized experiences that reflect the unique needs of each account and Health Care Provider (HCP). Acting as the primary point of contact, you’ll build meaningful connections, identify shared priorities, and navigate solutions that link customers to Novartis resources – all with the goal of improving patient outcomes. Success in this role comes from balancing demand generation with strategic account engagement. You’ll bring expertise in clinical and account-based selling, access navigation, collaborative problem-solving, team orchestration, and omni-channel engagement.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate and resolve challenges within accounts to ensure customer needs are met with effective, tailored solutions.
  • Build a strategic territory plan by aligning shared priorities and applying insights and tactics that drive product demand and support better patient outcomes.
  • Partner proactively with territory teammates, field teams, and home-office colleagues to address customer needs and deliver access support.
  • Apply deep knowledge of the market, competitive landscape, and cross-functional dynamics to anticipate opportunities and respond to challenges with agility.
  • Use territory data and market trends to uncover local insights, support pull-through efforts, and lead impactful customer engagements – virtually or in person.
  • Facilitate planning sessions with key stakeholders to solve complex challenges and collaborate across functions to meet customer needs with urgency.
  • Deliver real-time access support and work closely with Patient Specialty Services (PSS) to ensure seamless customer experience.
  • Harness digital tools and omni-channel strategies to personalize outreach and engage customers across both virtual and face-to-face settings.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required from 4-year college or university.
  • Experience (see leveling guidelines below) in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or similarly structured industries with large, geographically dispersed sales teams within the last 5 years. We also welcome candidates from other complex sales environments such as medical devices, diagnostics, life sciences services, insurance, consumer health, or B2B sectors, especially where strong field leadership and customer engagement are central to success. For Associate Level opportunities, applicants with limited prior sales experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Proven track-record of consistent high-performance, and well-versed in navigating and successfully selling to large accounts and key customers.
  • Self-starter with analytic abilities to seek out, prioritize, and apply relevant information to solve problems to meet the needs of key customers, while also demonstrating ethical leadership and ability to foster environment that promotes ethical behavior and compliance with company policies and laws.
  • Candidate must reside within territory, or within a reasonable daily commuting distance of 50 miles from the territory border. Ability to travel 60-80% over a broad geography is required, with the ability to drive and/or fly within the territory. Must have a valid driver’s license.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience across therapeutic groups, disease states, account management strategy, and new product launches.
  • Broad understanding in patient services, market access, buy and bill, specialty pharmacy, reimbursement and/or medical calling on HCPs with respect to a sophisticated product or reimbursement pathway.

Leveling Guidelines: The position will be filled at level commensurate with experience.

  • Associate Territory Account Specialist: Recently separated from the US Military with 4+ years of military service in a leadership capacity (Platoon Leader, Executive Officer, Company Commander, etc.), or applicants with limited prior sales experience.
    • Demonstrates strong ability to collaborate, work cross-functionally within a matrix environment, and communicate product information effectively.
    • Preferred experience in the 2-year Novartis Sales Internship Program; demonstrated proven leadership experience in student sports, fraternities, clubs, activities, and other extracurricular activities.
  • Territory Account Specialist: 2+ years’ experience in specialty pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, medical device, diagnostics, life sciences services, insurance, consumer health, B2B sectors or sales role of similar complexity within the last 5 years. Strong ability to collaborate, work cross-functionally within a matrix environment and can communicate clinical product information.
  • Senior Territory Account Specialist: 5+ years’ experience in specialty pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, medical device, diagnostics, life sciences services, insurance, consumer health, B2B sectors or sales role of similar complexity within the last 5 years. Strong ability to collaborate, work cross-functionally within a matrix environment and can communicate clinical product information.
  • Executive Territory Account Specialist: 10+ years’ experience in specialty pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, medical device, diagnostics, life sciences services, insurance, consumer health, B2B sectors or sales role of similar complexity within the last 5 years. Strong ability to collaborate, work cross-functionally within a matrix environment and can communicate clinical product information.

Driving is an Essential Function of this Role: Meaning it is fundamental to the purpose of this job and cannot be eliminated. Because driving is an essential function of the role, you must have a fully valid and unrestricted driver’s license to be qualified for this role. The company provides reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified individuals with medical restrictions if an accommodation can be provided without eliminating the essential function of driving.

COVID-19 Vaccine Policy (customer-facing roles only): While Novartis does not require vaccination for COVID-19 or proof of a recent negative test result for COVID-19 at this time, employees working in customer-facing roles must adhere to and comply with customers’ (such as hospitals, physician offices, etc.) credentialing guidelines, which may require vaccination. As required by applicable law, Novartis will consider requests for reasonable accommodation for those unable to be vaccinated. This requirement is subject to applicable state and local laws and may not be applicable to employees working in certain jurisdictions. Please send accommodation requests to Eh.occupationalhealth@novartis.com.

For Field Roles with a Dedicated Training Period: The individual hired for this role will be required to successfully complete certain initial training, including home study in eight (8) or fewer hours per day and forty (40) or fewer hours per week.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between:

  • Associate Territory Account Specialist: $81,200 and $150,800 per year
  • Territory Account Specialist: $114,100 and $211,900 per year
  • Senior Territory Account Specialist: $132,300 and $245,700 per year
  • Executive Territory Account Specialist: $145,600 and $270,400 per year

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

title: Staff Product Designer
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
About the company

Our client is a venture-backed AI software company rebuilding how go-to-market teams create customer-facing work. Its newly launched agent-first platform is growing at a double-digit weekly rate and is already used by major technology companies. With more than $71 million raised and a compact 20-person team, the company is at a rare point where strong traction meets a wide-open product and design language.

The role and why it matters

This is a founding design seat with direct access to product leadership, founders, and engineering. You will define how an AI-native product feels, how users direct and trust an agent, and what excellent generated work looks like across the customer journey.

What you'll do

• Own the core experience for requesting, shaping, reviewing, editing, and publishing agent-generated work.

• Invent new interaction models for an AI product rather than inheriting a mature design system.

• Set the visual and creative quality bar for both the interface and the agent's output.

• Partner closely with engineering to improve defaults, constraints, evaluations, brand adherence, and feedback loops.

• Shape product strategy with founders and product leadership, then prototype and refine ideas quickly.

• Move fluidly from product architecture and systems thinking to detailed interaction and visual decisions.

Requirements

What we're looking for

• At least 5 years of product design experience with a strong record of shipping products people use.

• A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional visual craft and novel zero-to-one work, not only assembled design-system screens.

• Experience in an early-stage or breakout startup, ideally in B2B SaaS, productivity software, or applied AI.

• Genuine enthusiasm for AI as a design medium and active use of modern AI tools in your work.

• High ownership, sound judgment, urgency, and comfort working directly with founders and engineers.

• Ability and willingness to work in the New York City office five days per week.

Bonus points

• Experience as a founding or sole designer at a venture-backed startup.

• A high-slope career path with rapid progression or recognition from a strong design fellowship.

• Experience designing creative tools, agent workflows, or AI-generated outputs.

Benefits

• $200K-$260K base salary.

• Competitive equity.

• Visa transfers may be considered for candidates who already hold valid U.S. work authorization. New visa sponsorship is not available.

• Full-time, on-site work in New York, NY. The team works together in the Flatiron area five days per week.

title: Electronic Security Designer
description:
Thornton Tomasetti applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.

Our Protective Design & Security team prioritizes the protection of life and assets by mitigating consequences of security risks in the built environment. With more than 75 years of experience, our risk-led and strategic solutions safeguard people, property, and operations from intentional harm, evolving and emerging threats.


Whether safeguarding a cultural landmark, securing a healthcare facility, or planning for crowd safety at a major event, our approach is grounded in intelligence, simulation, and human-centered design to deliver resilient solutions with demonstrable performance and lasting impact.


Within our practice, you’ll be develop knowledge on how risk-based design brings together security planning, physical security, and electronic security to develop layered protection strategies. You’ll support the development of performance-based solutions—from secure site planning to physical hardening, access control, surveillance, and detection—and how these measures integrate with security operations.


Your Role

As an Electronic Security Designer in our Protective Design & Security practice, you will support risk-based security strategy and electronic security design for buildings, campuses, and mixed-use environments across sectors. You will help develop and coordinate vendor-neutral systems—including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and supporting infrastructure—and connect them with architecture, physical security, infrastructure, and operations to support layered security. With support from your team, you will work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while developing technical, analytical, and project coordination skills.


What You'll Do

  • Support design and planning for access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, and related security systems.
  • Assist with technology selection and design, infrastructure coordination, as well as integration of the security measures into project designs.
  • Help prepare diagrams, technical narratives, presentations, and design documentation that communicate security measures clearly.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers and AV/IT specialists in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Participate in on-site assessments, field surveys, and construction-phase activities.
  • Develop foundational knowledge of cabling, power, and networks for security systems.
  • Build familiarity with TT’s culture, services, and interdisciplinary approach to security and resilience while growing your technical and professional skills.



What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, systems engineering, security engineering, architecture or a related field ; master's degree preferred.
  • Interest in electronic security, low-voltage systems, and security technology integration.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Familiarity with design, visualization, and documentation tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam,ARC GIS, Unreal Engine, or similar platforms is preferred.
  • Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

Compensation

The rate for this position generally is $78,000 - $88,000 annually. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by District of Columbia Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employee already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law. A potential new employee’s pay history will not be used in compensation decisions.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability and other voluntary benefits

  • Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Childcare

title: Abrysvo Maternal Market Access Director (US)
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Vaccines is the only place in Pfizer where you can contribute to patients in a way like no other – you can prevent sickness and disease. This is at the heart of what drives us every day. It is a remarkable time to be part of Pfizer’s US Vaccines business as it expands on its mission of preventing disease and improving public health.


RSV, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is a common respiratory virus that affects the lungs and airways and can be serious, especially for infants. The disease burden of RSV in young children is staggering with virtually all children getting an RSV infection by the time they are two years old. In the United States, up to 600,000 infants experience lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) due to RSV each year. For children younger than five years old in the U.S., approximately 2.1 million RSV outpatient visits and 58,000 RSV hospitalizations occur each year, and it is a leading cause of hospitalization in children less than one year of age.


ABRYSVO, ABRYSVO is Pfizer’s bivalent RSV vaccine, for the prevention of LRTD and severe LRTD caused by RSV in infants from birth up to six months of age by active immunization of pregnant individuals at 32 through 36 weeks gestational age. Following a highly successful first few seasons, the team continues strives to further drive vaccine uptake to help protect infants from RSV via maternal immunization during the new ACOG recommended season from Sept. 1 through March 1 (ACIP recommended season Sept. 1 thru Jan. 31).


ABRYSVO is the first and only maternal immunization to help protect newborns from RSV immediately at birth through six months. Given a highly competitive and rapidly evolving landscape, success will rely on accelerating vaccination uptake through communicating urgency to protect against RSV, the benefits of Maternal Immunization, robust clinical data, strong recommendations, and establishing Pfizer leadership.

The US ABRYSVO Maternal Access Director will play a key role, working in close collaboration with the Account Management team to protect more infants from RSV within large, organized customers by delivering solutions that help these customers prioritize RSV vaccines for pregnant individuals and members. This colleague must be able to apply a thorough understanding of health systems and payer segments in order to align business priorities that can help drive immunization rates.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITES

  • Drive overarching Abrysvo Maternal strategy for large systems / IDNs and Payers in a complex and evolving market
  • Oversee development of new messaging and resource development to support Account Management team to secure and advance operationalization of maternal immunization with Abrysvo
  • Serve as primary liaison to Account Mgmt organization, ensuring routine process to solicit insight, cross pollinate best practices and identify opportunities and challenges for the brand
  • Advance work to close the gap between Commercial and Medicaid vaccination uptake rates, with a focus on key stated
  • Ensure alignment of strategies and tactics across brand marketing, USMA, Field Medical, and other customer facing functions
  • Identify and address key product barriers to payer access and performance, applying advanced understanding of policy, contracting and pricing strategies, payer analytics, and payer market trends
  • Oversee evolution of opportunities to help address barriers to stocking, including key programs such as PAC/FAL, adhering to Pfizer policies and guidelines
  • Leverage deep customer insights, incorporating feedback from the Account organization and other internal and external stakeholders, to identify opportunities to advance brand strategies
  • Serve as point to develop routine communications and presentations to Account organization, to support, inform and influence key activities and strategies, aligned to HCP and consumer teams
  • Leverage analytics to identify opportunities and risks across the account business, bringing forward to leadership. Partnership with Payer & Channel Access, Account Management and Market Access teams to support evolution of contract offerings, monitor performance metrics related and develop contract pull-through resources
  • Oversee opportunities at the state level to increase Medicaid uptake, considering population and policy dynamics
  • Help develop learning plans to glean insights from key stakeholders in the payer space
  • Oversee agency and Payer/Access budget management

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to lead, influence and collaborate with peers and cross functional partners in a highly matrixed team, develop and coach others to achieve strategic outcomes and meaningful impact
  • Bachelor's Degree required
  • 8+ years of combined experience required within the U.S. pharmaceutical/healthcare market with primary focus within Customer/Account Management, Payer Brand/Customer Marketing, and/or Healthcare consulting
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strategy that links to executable tactics. Prior success delivering results and experience with collaborating across multiple stakeholders to drive results
  • Understanding of key business processes driving performance, and ability to align objectives and execute across multiple disciplines
  • Executive presence and ability to interact effectively across levels of the organization and with customers
  • GCMA and agency management experience preferred
  • Proven ability and strength as a collaborative partner communicator
  • Ability to work under pressure and take accountability for key deliverables
  • Represents Pfizer values across everyday work; Courage, Excellence, Equity and Joy


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

title: NPI Operator Filling (Tijdelijk Assignment 1,5j)
description:
NPI Operator Filling (tijdelijke assignment)

Afdeling

Variosys 1 maakt deel uit van de Clinical Supply afdeling en maakt de lancering van nieuwe, innovatieve geneesmiddelen en vaccins mogelijk door het ontwikkelen en implementeren van nieuwe productie processen, het produceren van klinische stalen en het verwerven van product en proces kennis.

Variosys 1 is een nieuwe, innovatieve afvullijn die recent werd gevalideerd voor de aseptische productie van vials. Momenteel wordt de lijn uitgebreid met een nieuwe module voor cartridges en spuiten.

Het project omvat de validatie en opstart van deze nieuwe technologie, met als doel de lijn binnen een ambitieuze tijdslijn over te dragen van engineering naar routineproductie.

Als operator krijg je de kans om actief mee te werken aan de ingebruikname van nieuw equipment en processen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de lijn.

Verantwoordelijkheden en opportuniteiten

Binnen clinical supply/VSYS1 zijn we op zoek naar een tijdelijke versterking voor ons team gedurende 1,5 jaar. Een ideale opportuniteit om te ontdekken of de clinical supply/VSYS1 wereld iets voor jou is.

Als New Product Introduction (NPI) filling operator werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe geneesmiddelen en vaccins. Deze diverse producten vereisen elk een specifiek afvulproces en specifiek afvulequipment, waardoor je de kans krijgt om met een brede waaier van processen en equipment te werken.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het afvullen van oplossingen, suspensies en RNA-suspensies.
  • Je zorgt voor de omstelling, set-up, bediening, monitoring en bijsturing van de vial/spuiten/cartridge lijn in een isolator (grade A) in de grade C.
  • Je leert werken met een modulaire isolator lijn (Variosys 1).
  • Je voert integriteitstesten uit van de filters en van handschoenen.
  • Je neemt in-proces stalen zoals vereist voor de vrijgave maar ook voor de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe geneesmiddel of vaccin.
  • Je assembleert productspecifieke vulpaden en zorgt voor de sterilisatie van dit equipment volgens gevalideerde procedures.
  • Je reinigt het filling equipment en volgt hierbij strikt de quarantaine regels die verbonden zijn aan de lopende cleaning validatie voor het nieuwe geneesmiddelen of vaccin. Je reinigt ook de afvullijn en de cleanrooms.
  • Je zorgt voor het periodieke onderhoud van het VSYS1 equipment en lokalen.
  • Je assisteert bij preventief onderhoud van het filling equipment.
  • Je assisteert bij andere clinical supply lijnen indien nodig (S2F2/Variosys2)

Functieprofiel

Must

  • Je werkt accuraat
  • Kwaliteit, orde en netheid zijn op je buik geschreven
  • Je volgt strikt procedures en documenteert nauwkeurig
  • Je werkt vlot in team
  • Goed proces en technisch inzicht
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken
  • Je communiceert goed en respectvol naar TL, shift PE, teamleden van zelfde en andere shift
  • Je kan goed tegen wisselende prioriteiten en planningswijzigingen (eigen aan clinical supply)
  • Je werkt in een tweeploegensysteem (vroege/late), met de flexibiliteit om tijdens projectactiviteiten in daguren te werken indien nodig

Nice to have

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie
  • Ervaring in een GMP omgeving
  • Ervaring in een aseptische werkomgeving

Work Location Assignment: On Premise

De Pfizer site in Puurs is één van de grootste productie- en verpakkingssites van Pfizer wereldwijd, gespecialiseerd in aseptische productie en verpakking. Jaarlijks worden in Puurs meer dan 400 miljoen doses injecteerbare vaccins en medicijnen geproduceerd. Deze zijn ter plaatse verpakt in ampullen, flacons, plastic flessen, spuiten en patronen voor pennen.

De medicijnen die in Puurs worden gemaakt, zijn bestemd voor patiënten in meer dan 170 landen wereldwijd. 30% van de productie uit Puurs is bestemd voor ontwikkelingslanden, in samenwerking met UNICEF, WHO, GAVI en ngo's.

Met het gebruik van twee windturbines, zonnepanelen en een warmtekrachtcentrale richten we ons op hernieuwbare energie.

Pfizer’s doel is om gelijke kansen te bieden in het wervingsproces door elke vorm van vooringenomenheid of mogelijke discriminatie te vermijden, ongeacht (maar niet beperkt tot) geslacht, leeftijd, ras, religie of overtuiging, seksuele geaardheid of handicap. We creëren een organisatie en bevorderen een cultuur die respect heeft voor ieders unieke karakter en levenservaringen en die de diversiteit van onze samenleving, klanten en markten weerspiegelt. Dit bereiken we door een omgeving te cultiveren en in stand te houden waarin elke collega zich gewaardeerd en ondersteund voelt.

Disability Inclusion:

Onze missie is om de kracht van al onze mensen te ontwikkelen en ruimte te geven. We zijn trots om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn, die aan alle kandidaten met een beperking gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen je aan om jezelf te zijn en dat met ons te delen, wetende dat wij ons best gaan doen om jouw sollicitatie en toekomstige carrière te ondersteunen. Jouw reis bij Pfizer begint hier!

description:
I MENY elsker vi mat! For oss er god mat en lidenskap, og noe av det viktigste som finnes. Hos oss er alle MATarbeidere, uansett om du jobber i ferskvaredisken, kolonialen, i kassen eller på kontoret. Å være en MATarbeider i MENY betyr at du alltid gjør ditt beste for å veilede og inspirere kundene våre til matglede. Sammen skal vi hjelpe flere å spise bedre, og leve bedre.


Stillingsomfang: 30%
Arbeidstid: dag, kveld og helg
Oppstart: snarest - eller etter avtale

Søknadsfrist: vi behandler søknader fortløpende


For å søke på denne stillingen må du være fylt 18 år, da du i denne stillingen håndterer maskiner med 18årsgrense. Du må også kunne kommunisere godt med kunder og kolleger på norsk.


Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?
Som MATarbeider i vår ferskvareavdeling vil du ha en hektisk og spennende hverdag med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgavene. Du vil ekspedere kunder, skjære og tilberede ulike ferskvarer som kjøtt, fisk og ost, du vil fylle varer og naturlig nok ta oppvasken. Du vil også arbeide i bakeriavdelingen der oppgavene består i å steke brød, rydde, legge opp varer til neste dag og hjelpe kunder. For å trives må du være en som liker å prate med mennesker, takler utfordringer, tunge løft, hektisk tempo og ikke være redd for å smake på nye ting.


Våre kunder forventer at du har kunnskap om mat, men fortvil ikke selv om "Hellstrøm" ikke er ditt etternavn. Vi lærer deg alt vi kan om torsk, svinekjake, culotte og Kraftkar, men det er uten tvil en fordel om du har basiskunnskap og interesse for mat fra før av. Om du har relevant fagbrev er det selvfølgelig et pluss!


Hvordan er det å jobbe i MENY?
Hos oss vil du blant annet lære å ta ansvar, mestre stress, håndtere mennesker og ikke minst butikkdrift. Vi har en interaktiv kursplattform, ulike klasseromskurs som gir deg faglig påfyll og et traineeprogram med fokus på å gå fra ansatt til å bli leder, for å nevne noe. Satser du på MENY, satser MENY på deg!


Når det gjelder trivsel på jobb, vil vi trekke frem samholdet. Som en av våre matarbeidere blir du en del av et team som jobber mot felles mål, for din innsats vil påvirke butikken, kundene og kollegene dine. Vi verdsetter gjensidig omtanke og støtte, og det er rom for feil så lenge du lærer og utvikler deg – for er du trygg er du god.

Å søke jobb i MENY skal være enkelt

Du trenger ikke laste opp søknadsbrev. For at vi skal bli litt bedre kjent med deg, svarer du på spørsmålene om deg og din erfaring. Har du mye på hjertet må du gjerne skrive utfyllende, vi gleder oss til å lese! Og fordi vi synes det er spennende å se hvor du har vært tidligere, må du laste opp CV.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at alle søknader må sendes inn via søknadsskjema tilknyttet annonsen, dette er av hensyn til ditt personvern, samt at vi ønsker å være sikre på at vi klarer å følge opp alle kandidater på en god måte. Vi kan derfor ikke ta imot søknader på papir i butikken eller via e-post. Søknader behandles fortløpende.

title: Art Director | New Games
description:
Craft:

Art

Job Description:

We’re looking for a hands-on Art Director to help shape the next generation of casual mobile games at King. You’ll join a small, newly formed, cross-functional team exploring new game ideas through rapid prototyping and player testing, then developing the titles that show promise.


The team is an on-site team (5 days a week) based in Stockholm.


This role combines creative leadership with making art. You’ll define the visual direction, create assets yourself, and work closely with the team to get appealing art into playable builds quickly. You will have a close collaboration with the creative director to define the visual world fantasy. Fluency in AI-assisted art creation is essential: you know how to guide, refine and combine AI outputs with your own 2D and 3D skills to achieve the visual result you want.


You’ll bring strong artistic judgment, curiosity and the confidence to put work in front of external players early. You understand what needs polish, what’s ready to test, and when a different direction will teach us more.


Your role within the Kingdom

  • Define and deliver the artistic vision. Explore distinctive, appealing visual directions for casual mobile games, working with both new and existing IP. Translate promising ideas into a coherent look that supports gameplay and connects with players.
  • Create art hands-on. Produce concepts, mock-ups and game-ready assets using 2D, 3D and AI-assisted workflows. Work closely with developers to get art into the game and evaluate it in context.
  • Make AI part of your creative practice. Choose the right tools for the task and take control of their outputs through clear direction, iteration and hands-on editing. Build practical, repeatable workflows that help the team move faster while maintaining a consistent style.
  • Prototype, test and adapt. Create good-looking art quickly and evolve the visuals based on player data. Be comfortable changing direction or letting go of work when a stronger opportunity emerges.
  • Lead and develop others. Give clear direction and actionable feedback to artists across game art, VFX, UI and animation. Coach and mentor the art team, lead external partners when needed, and balance leadership with your own creative contribution.
  • Collaborate across disciplines. Work closely with producers, designers, developers and marketing to connect visual decisions with gameplay, technical needs and the broader player experience.

Skills to create thrills

  • Senior art direction experience and a strong craft foundation
  • Practical fluency in AI-assisted art creation
  • Hands-on skills in both 2D and 3D
  • An excellent eye for casual game visuals
  • A fast, flexible approach to development
  • A player-focused mindset
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary art teams
  • Clear, collaborative communication
  • An understanding of in-game implementation

Bonus points

  • Experience in small teams, new game development or rapid prototyping.
  • Hands-on experience implementing art in Unity.
  • Experience with world building, video production or animation.
  • Experience developing new IP or adapting established IP for new game experiences.

Show us your work

Please include an online portfolio showing your artistic range, hands-on work and art direction experience, including examples of both 2D and 3D work.

We’d especially like to see how you move from an idea to visuals in a playable game, and how you use AI within that process. For collaborative projects, clearly describe your contribution. Process examples, iterations and work shaped by player feedback are welcome alongside finished work.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Structural Engineering New Grad | Los Angeles, CA
description:
Structural Engineering New Grad | Los Angeles, CA

100% Employee-Owned · Big-firm resources, local-team relationships, ONE IMEG culture

IMEG is hiring a Structural Engineering New Grad in Los Angeles, CA. This entry-level role offers hands-on design, analysis, and project execution experience, with mentorship, training, and opportunities to grow your expertise from day one. You will work closely with a team of experienced engineers and consultants to help provide engineering solutions and advice to clients.

In this role, you will assist with structural analysis, design, and development of documents for structural systems while supporting project budgets and cross-functional collaboration to meet project goals and client expectations. The team supports commercial and institutional work, with strong activity in education and healthcare, contributing to sustainable design goals including SE2050. This position has an anticipated start date of May or June 2027.

At a Glance

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Discipline: Structural

Markets: Commercial; Institutional

Ownership: 100% employee-owned (ESOP)

Travel: Up to 5%

Work Schedule: Full-time in office

Sponsorship: Not available

What You'll Do

  • Assist in analyzing and designing structural systems using a variety of building materials.
  • Use engineering software and tools to help develop detailed designs, specifications, and calculations according to code requirements and IMEG standards.
  • Interact with clients to gather project requirements, communicate technical information effectively, and build professional client relationships.
  • Support consulting project execution by assisting with project planning and scheduling to meet deadlines and objectives.
  • Help document design decisions and client instructions while monitoring project design progress and working within the project’s monetary budget.
  • Analyze low to medium complexity engineering tasks and collaborate with senior engineers and consultants to develop practical and efficient solutions.
  • Participate in IMEG quality control processes to help ensure engineering designs and solutions meet IMEG quality standards, industry standards, and client requirements.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in structural engineering, and contribute to research, development, and innovation efforts within IMEG.
  • Prioritize safety in all aspects of engineering work and conduct oneself in an ethical and professional manner.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and participate in the full project life cycle, including developing designs, construction documents, construction submittal review, and job site observations.

What You'll Bring

Required Education

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Civil, Structural, or Architectural Engineering, or equivalent, required

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Knowledge of design techniques, design standards including steel, concrete, wood, masonry, and concepts involved in structural systems of buildings and structures
  • Strong technical and analytical skills including knowledge of principles relating to structural mechanics and materials as it relates to structural design of buildings and other structures
  • Knowledge of industry standard engineering software and tools including structural analysis and design software
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and demonstrate effective team building skills
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt to new challenges
  • Basic knowledge in the use of BIM software.
  • Ability to clearly communicate in both oral and written communication to individuals or groups
  • Proficient with MS Office Suite including but not limited to Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Ability to travel up to 5% with occasional overnight stays

Preferred

  • Master’s Degree (MS) in Structural Engineering preferred
  • Prior internship experience in the building design consulting industry preferred
  • Engineering in Training (EIT) License preferred

About the Team

  • Los Angeles structural team is concentrated in Southern California education and healthcare work, especially school modernization and hospital upgrade efforts.
  • Active backlog features LAUSD and K-12 projects, hospital renovations and seismic/NPC work, civic facilities, and selected mixed-use or housing assignments.
  • Recent work includes LAUSD Jefferson CA & Closeout, Education, and Emanate Health Queen of the Valley Hospital NPC-4D L2 Compliance Upgrade, Healthcare.

Why IMEG

We put people at the center of who we are, creating positive outcomes for people, communities, and our planet. As a 100% employee-owned firm, every team member shares in that mission as an owner.

  • Consultancy 101: our structured development program that builds your consulting and technical foundation from day one
  • An assigned mentor to guide your growth from day one
  • IDEA Program: a firm-wide innovation accelerator where employees across every discipline develop and scale new tools, from VR and AI to carbon-reduction technology
  • MEG, our in-house AI platform, helps employees find information and build agents that streamline project workflows and calculations
  • Employee ownership (ESOP): 3% to 6% company contribution, plus year-end profit sharing
  • PE, SE, and other license exam prep, with a clear path from EIT to PE
  • Dress for Your Day flexibility (wear what fits your day)
  • Generous time off, including 6 paid holidays and 3 additional floating holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting day one, with preventive care at 100%, a $50/month wellness credit, and a Calm subscription

Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay will be based on several factors including experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant. Job Summary:

The Medical Services Coordinator is responsible for serving as a point of contact to coordinate medical care, providing support to patients and psychiatric clinicians, ensuring quality customer service to in- person and remote patients and clinicians.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficient in using Computer Software Applications (Microsoft Office & EMRs)
  • Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential Information (HIPAA)

Education and Experience:

  • High School or equivalent required, associates/bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 1+ years of experience in healthcare operations, customer service, or similar role or setting preferred.

  • Behave Ethically: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the company.
  • Build Relationships: Establish and maintain positive working relationships with others internally and externally to achieve the organization's goals. Work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals, resolve problems, and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness.
  • Growth Mindset: Actively look for ways to improve processes/performance. Assess problem situations to identify causes, gather and process relevant information, generate workable solutions, and make recommendations and/or resolve the problem.

About the Position

The Field Service Specialist serves as a senior technical resource and field operations partner, providing expert support for facility startups, operational disruptions, service capacity challenges, and workforce readiness initiatives across the MHE Solutions network. This role functions as the primary escalation point for complex equipment and system issues, while delivering field-based coaching, technical guidance, and onboarding support to service technicians. The Field Service Specialist collaborates with operational leadership to enhance service performance, drive continuous improvement, and ensure operational excellence, while serving as a subject matter expert on field service processes, technologies, and business systems. This individual represents the Kenco culture and reinforces our values through everyday actions.

Functions

  • Coordinate operational readiness activities for new site startups, including startup budget tracking, resource deployment planning, readiness assessments, and status reporting to operational leadership.
  • Monitor startup and deployment-related expenditures, ensuring compliance with approved budgets and providing reporting, analysis, and recommendations to operational leadership.
  • Facilitate technician onboarding and field-based training programs in partnership with Learning & Development and operational leadership, providing subject matter expertise, field validation, and coaching support.
  • Participate in technician interviews and provide technical assessments and hiring recommendations to management.
  • Evaluate technical proficiency during onboarding and provide developmental feedback and readiness assessments to operational leadership.
  • Provide recommendations to Operations Managers and Regional Service Managers regarding workforce readiness, technical capability gaps, process improvements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Provide on-site technical leadership for facility startups, operational disruptions, and critical staffing needs, ensuring equipment readiness, technician onboarding support, business continuity, and service performance.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex equipment, system, and operational issues, providing advanced troubleshooting expertise, maintenance support, and reliability guidance.
  • Deliver hands-on coaching, technical training, and developmental feedback to field technicians while serving as a subject matter expert on field service processes, technologies, business systems, and the Kenco Konnector program.
  • Partner with Operations Managers and Regional Service Managers to assess workforce readiness, prioritize field support deployments, and identify opportunities to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by providing expert technical support and representing Kenco's service, quality, and safety standards.
  • Support the Kenco Operating System (KOS) through continuous improvement initiatives, operational audits, investigations, and actions that enhance safety, inventory accuracy, equipment performance, and overall operational effectiveness.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer

Position Summary

The Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer is responsible for validating software used to control Axcelis ion implantation systems for semiconductor wafer processing. This role focuses on system-level software verification, test planning and execution, defect investigation, and ensuring software releases meet quality and customer requirements.

The ideal candidate has experience working with complex electro-mechanical systems, structured testing methodologies, and cross-functional engineering teams. This position requires strong analytical and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to operate ion implantation equipment in a laboratory and cleanroom environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with software, systems, and hardware engineering teams to review product requirements and ensure test coverage.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute test plans and test cases that validate software functionality, system performance and end-to-end customer scenarios.
  • Verify software and system requirements through structured testing and documented results.
  • Validate software installation procedures for internal use and customer releases.
  • Operate ion implantation equipment and simulation platforms to perform system-level software validation.
  • Investigate issues identified during testing, collect supporting data and logs, assist with root cause analysis, and verify corrective actions.
  • Document defects in the defect tracking system with clear problem descriptions, reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and expected results.
  • Maintain accurate records of test execution, results, risks, and quality metrics.
  • Participate in software release readiness reviews and quality assessments.
  • Work in a cleanroom environment while following all required cleanroom protocols and safety procedures.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly document test results and technical issues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret software requirements and translate them into effective test cases.
  • Experience with software testing methodologies, defect tracking systems, and test documentation.
  • Ability to identify, document, and communicate system-level hardware and software issues.
  • Experience working with complex electro-mechanical equipment or industrial systems.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with semiconductor manufacturing equipment, ion implantation systems, or other capital equipment used in semiconductor fabrication.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and industry practices.
  • Familiarity with factory automation standards such as SECS/GEM.
  • Experience with software validation, system integration testing, or customer workflow testing.
  • Understanding of hardware/software interactions in industrial control systems.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline.
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.

  • Beverly, MA
  • 100% Onsite

title: As Needed Director
description:
Who We Are


FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role


The Network Industries Strategies (“NIS”) group at FTI Consulting uses economic and financial analysis and network modeling to analyze complex issues involving pricing, valuation, and costs of service across the spectrum of network industries. Our rail and transportation team provides deep industry, market, and regulatory expertise to North America’s freight railroads and other transportation clients. We build sophisticated costing and pricing models, evaluate our clients’ key commercial and contractual relationships, assess competitive markets and asset values in support of transactions, and develop expert testimony before courts, arbitration panels, and regulatory bodies such as the Surface Transportation Board — helping carriers evaluate transactions, defend the reasonableness of their rates and services, negotiate contracts, quantify damages in disputes, and maximize the value of their network assets.


What You’ll Do


A Director is responsible for managing, processing, and analyzing information to develop solutions for clients. In addition, the candidate will assist team leaders by providing analytic support and drafting for advisory services across a wide range of industries. In addition, the position requires the development of written reports explaining the procedures employed. An individual that succeeds in the position will be able to work independently and to take initiative in solving problems that are faced on a day-to-day basis, continually striving to ensure quality output that can withstand the scrutiny of regulators and other stakeholders.


The ideal candidate will have:


  • Strong analytic and quantitative skills, including economic modeling, cost and pricing analysis, and/or transportation network modeling experience
  • Demonstrated ability to work with large and complex datasets, and to build reproducible, well-documented analysis
  • Ability to write memoranda to describe the procedures employed to complete tasks and to summarize the results of research or analysis
  • Solid communication skills (written and verbal) including the ability to concisely explain complicated concepts to clients and staff within and outside of the firm
  • Ability to support and direct communication with clients and staff members on engagements, while updating senior team members on progress and issues
  • Commitment to working in a team environment with an emphasis on collaboration and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients across functions
  • A positive, professional, and solutions-oriented attitude
  • Resilience and ability to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Outstanding problem-solving and analytic skills
  • Strong business acumen and entrepreneurial spirit, including the ability to identify and pursue new business opportunities

How You’ll Grow


We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.


As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.


What You Will Need to Succeed


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 5+ years of relevant full-time post-graduation professional work experience in economic consulting or business intelligence/analytical roles in the transportation, logistics, or manufacturing industries
  • Ability to travel to FTI offices and client(s)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to answer questions and develop informed viewpoints based on analysis of supporting data (including fluency in Excel and SQL)
  • Ability to create high-quality written and visual deliverables and communicate professionally and succinctly (including fluency in PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with core concepts in litigation consulting, including the role of expert evidence, discovery, and legal precedent
  • Ability to develop sound quantitative methodologies for solving complex problems
  • Computer skills working with large relational datasets, spatial/GIS data, and/or Python

Compensation
