title: Chaplain (Part-Time) - Altoona, PA
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.


Part-Time, Altoona, PA


Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.


Ministry

• Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.

• Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.

• May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.

• May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.

• May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.

• Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.

• May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.

• May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.

• Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.

• Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).

• Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.

• With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.


Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).


Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.


Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

title: Contrôleur(euse) principal | Senior Controller
description:
ABOUT US

We're a fast-growing group within Valsoft Corporation, working where payments meet AI. The group includes ValPay, TNRM, P&P and Sadie.

Sadie is the #1 voice AI reservation platform in the world, with customers in Australia, Europe, the United States and Canada.

ValPay is a payment facilitator (payfac). In plain terms, it lets other businesses accept and process payments through ValPay's own merchant infrastructure. That means they can start taking payments quickly, without setting up their own costly merchant account that can take a long time to get approved. ValPay is one of the fastest-growing companies in Canada.

Our growth has been recognized on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50, and we've reached a turning point. We've outgrown a traditional startup finance function, and we're building what comes next: a leaner, more technical, more automated finance team designed for how a modern payments and AI business really works. We don't want to copy how larger, slower companies do finance.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is a rare chance to help build a finance function where accounting and technology meet. Our finance setup dates from our startup days, and we're rebuilding it to match the pace and complexity of the business.

As Senior Controller, you'll own revenue recognition and technical accounting across multiple entities. Just as important, you'll have real, hands-on ownership of the automation and data work that more and more of our finance function runs on.

This role is ideal for a CPA who's ready to grow beyond traditional accounting and specialize in accounting and technology together. You don't need deep AI or automation experience. What matters most is a strong accounting foundation and the drive to build that expertise.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own revenue recognition and every judgmental or complex accounting entry across all entities, including usage-based and payfac revenue under IFRS
  • Review and approve accounting entries across the group
  • Set technical accounting policy for the group, and make sure it's applied consistently across entities in different jurisdictions
  • Own and keep improving the group's core processes and controls across multiple entities and currencies, and build scalable, well-documented processes as we grow
  • Lead the multi-entity close and consolidation
  • Take a hands-on role in building the automation and data infrastructure that connects usage, billing and payment-settlement data across the group. As the function matures, you'll have a real chance to build deep expertise in financial systems and data modeling.
  • Build your skills with AI tools in day-to-day work such as journal entry review, reconciliation and reporting, with the goal of making them central to how you work
  • Manage and review the work of the Controller and transactional support staff, bringing organization, structure and focus to a team we're building from the ground up
  • Be the main escalation point for technical accounting questions, taking over this role from the CFO
  • Work directly with our international tax specialist and external auditors on statutory filings, transfer pricing and audit requirements across our four entities

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • CPA designation (or equivalent international designation)
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of technical accounting
  • Solid understanding of IFRS
  • Experience closing and consolidating financials across multiple legal entities and/or jurisdictions
  • Experience reviewing and managing the work of other accounting staff, either as a people leader or through strong review and mentoring
  • Curiosity about data, systems and automation, and a drive to get fluent in them. Hands-on experience with AI tools or data modeling is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You'll work directly with the CFO, the auditors and, as the team grows, other finance staff.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment that calls for significant hands-on work

NICE TO HAVE

  • Exposure to finance automation, RPA or AI-assisted accounting tools
  • Experience in payments or payment facilitation
  • An audit background at a Big 4 or national fir
  • Experience in a multi-entity, PE-backed or acquisitive group
  • French proficiency (our team is based in Montreal)

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A clear growth path: you can specialize in accounting and technology as the function matures, working closely with the CFO along the way
  • Cross-border work: you'll work directly with an international tax specialist on cross-border and transfer pricing matters
  • A strong team: a close-knit finance team inside a high-growth company recognized on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50
  • Real impact: a high-ownership, in-office culture where your technical and automation work directly shapes how finance scales

    _____________________________________________________________________________________

À PROPOS DE NOUS

Nous sommes un groupe en forte croissance au sein de Valsoft Corporation, à la croisée des paiements et de l'intelligence artificielle. Le groupe comprend ValPay, TNRM, P&P et Sadie.

Sadie est la plateforme de réservation par IA vocale no 1 au monde, avec des clients en Australie, en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Canada.

ValPay est un facilitateur de paiement (payfac). Concrètement, ValPay permet à d'autres entreprises d'accepter et de traiter des paiements au moyen de sa propre infrastructure marchande. Ces entreprises peuvent ainsi commencer à accepter des paiements rapidement, sans avoir à ouvrir leur propre compte marchand, une démarche coûteuse et souvent longue à faire approuver. ValPay est l'une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada.

Notre croissance a été reconnue par le palmarès Technologie Fast 50 de Deloitte, et nous sommes arrivés à un point tournant. Notre fonction finance a dépassé le modèle traditionnel d'une jeune entreprise, et nous bâtissons la suite : une équipe finance plus agile, plus technique et plus automatisée, conçue pour le fonctionnement réel d'une entreprise moderne de paiements et d'IA. Nous ne voulons pas reproduire la façon de faire des grandes entreprises plus lentes.

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Ce poste est une occasion rare de contribuer à bâtir une fonction finance à la rencontre de la comptabilité et de la technologie. Notre structure financière date de nos débuts, et nous la repensons pour suivre le rythme et la complexité de l'entreprise.

À titre de contrôleur principal ou contrôleuse principale, vous serez responsable de la constatation des produits et de la comptabilité technique pour plusieurs entités. Tout aussi important, vous aurez une responsabilité concrète et directe sur les travaux d'automatisation et de données sur lesquels repose de plus en plus notre fonction finance.

Ce poste est idéal pour un ou une CPA prêt·e à aller au-delà de la comptabilité traditionnelle et à se spécialiser à la jonction de la comptabilité et de la technologie. Une expertise poussée en IA ou en automatisation n'est pas requise. Ce qui compte le plus, c'est une solide base en comptabilité et la volonté de développer cette expertise.

VOS RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Être responsable de la constatation des produits et de toutes les écritures comptables complexes ou exigeant du jugement pour l'ensemble des entités, y compris les produits fondés sur l'utilisation et ceux liés à la facilitation de paiement (payfac) selon les IFRS
  • Examiner et approuver les écritures comptables de l'ensemble du groupe
  • Établir les méthodes comptables du groupe et veiller à leur application uniforme dans les entités situées dans différents territoires
  • Prendre en charge et renforcer continuellement les processus et contrôles clés du groupe, pour plusieurs entités et devises, et mettre en place des processus évolutifs et bien documentés au fil de la croissance
  • Diriger la clôture et la consolidation des différentes entités
  • Participer activement à la mise en place de l'automatisation et de l'infrastructure de données reliant les données d'utilisation, de facturation et de règlement des paiements du groupe. À mesure que la fonction évoluera, vous aurez une réelle occasion de développer une expertise approfondie en systèmes financiers et en modélisation de données.
  • Développer vos compétences avec les outils d'IA dans votre travail quotidien, notamment pour l'examen des écritures de journal, les rapprochements et la production de rapports, dans le but d'en faire un élément central de votre façon de travailler
  • Gérer et examiner le travail du contrôleur ou de la contrôleuse et du personnel de soutien transactionnel, en apportant organisation, structure et priorités à une équipe que nous bâtissons de toutes pièces
  • Agir comme principale personne-ressource pour les questions de comptabilité technique, en prenant le relais du chef de la direction financière
  • Collaborer directement avec notre spécialiste en fiscalité internationale et les auditeurs externes sur les déclarations réglementaires, les prix de transfert et les exigences d'audit de nos quatre entités

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Titre de CPA (ou titre international équivalent)
  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience progressive en comptabilité, incluant la responsabilité de la comptabilité technique
  • Bonne connaissance des IFRS
  • Expérience de la clôture et de la consolidation des états financiers de plusieurs entités juridiques ou territoires
  • Expérience de l'examen et de la gestion du travail d'autres membres du personnel comptable, que ce soit comme gestionnaire ou par un solide rôle d'examen et de mentorat
  • Curiosité pour les données, les systèmes et l'automatisation, et désir de les maîtriser. Une expérience pratique des outils d'IA ou de la modélisation de données est un atout, mais n'est pas exigée.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale. Vous travaillerez directement avec le chef de la direction financière, les auditeurs et, à mesure que l'équipe grandira, d'autres membres de l'équipe finance.
  • Aisance dans un environnement de jeune entreprise au rythme rapide, qui demande beaucoup d'autonomie et un engagement pratique important

ATOUTS

  • Expérience de l'automatisation financière, de l'automatisation robotisée des processus (RPA) ou d'outils comptables assistés par l'IA
  • Expérience dans le secteur des paiements ou de la facilitation de paiement
  • Expérience en audit dans un cabinet des Big Four ou un cabinet national
  • Expérience au sein d'un groupe multi-entités, soutenu par du capital-investissement ou en croissance par acquisitions
  • Maîtrise du français (notre équipe est basée à Montréal)

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un vrai parcours de croissance : la possibilité de vous spécialiser à la jonction de la comptabilité et de la technologie à mesure que la fonction évolue, en travaillant étroitement avec le chef de la direction financière
  • Une exposition internationale : une collaboration directe avec un ou une spécialiste en fiscalité internationale sur les questions transfrontalières et de prix de transfert
  • Une équipe solide : une équipe finance tissée serrée au sein d'une entreprise en forte croissance, reconnue par le palmarès Technologie Fast 50 de Deloitte
  • Un impact réel : une culture de responsabilisation, en présentiel, où votre travail technique et d'automatisation façonne directement l'évolution de la fonction finance

title: R166481 Data Lead: Resiliency and AI Forecasting (Open)
description:

Data Lead (Resilience / AI Forecasting)

At Mars Petcare, our purpose is simple: A Better World for Pets. We are transforming how we use data to strengthen our global supply chain, protect revenue, and build greater resilience across our sourcing operations.

Preferred Experience

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (AWS)
description:
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Primary Point of Contact: Product Manager and Practice Leader

Location: Remote (LATAM Based)

About RevStar

At RevStar, we build cutting-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy infrastructure, and deploy production-grade cloud native and AI applications that drive real business value.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior AWS Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our AWS Practice. In this highly visible role, you will operate embedded directly at the intersection of enterprise cloud architecture, hands-on engineering, and client-facing delivery.

As an FDE, you are both a master cloud builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high-impact enterprise accounts—architecting resilient cloud-native environments, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and deploying state-of-the-art AWS Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Q, SageMaker) architectures. Simultaneously, you will drive AWS adoption and consumption growth by identifying new workloads, building POCs, and driving strategic technical alignment with client executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hands-On Cloud Architecture & Implementation: Design, build, and deploy secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and modern microservices/serverless patterns (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Enterprise Customer Delivery: Serve as the primary technical leader on strategic enterprise client engagements. Partner with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure/Engineering, and client development teams to translate complex business goals into high-performing AWS solutions.
  • Cloud Migration & Application Modernization: Lead large-scale migrations from on-premises data centers or legacy platforms to AWS (using AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, etc.) and re-architect legacy monolithic applications into modern serverless or containerized architectures.
  • AWS Generative AI & Machine Learning: Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations.
  • Drive Platform Adoption & Growth: Partner with RevStar account leadership to identify new, high-value cloud workloads within client accounts, driving AWS consumption expansion and clear ROI for client executive stakeholders.
  • Technical Mentorship & Practice Building: Coach and mentor Cloud Engineers and Solutions Architects. Drive internal RevStar accelerators, reusable Terraform modules, AWS Well-Architected Review frameworks, and cloud delivery best practices.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

Technical Expertise:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS.
  • 3+ years in a client-facing consulting, Solutions Architecture, or Forward Deployed Engineering role.
  • Deep AWS Core Expertise: Mastery across core AWS services (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Route 53).
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD: Expert-level proficiency in Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, along with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline).
  • AWS GenAI & Data Services: Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, or OpenSearch for building data platforms and AI solutions.
  • AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional required. Specialty certifications (Security, Machine Learning, Data Analytics) are a plus.

Client & Business Acumen:

  • Enterprise Track Record: Proven experience leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or mid-market enterprise clients (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, or SaaS).
  • Consulting & Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C-level executives.
  • Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint.

Benefits

Engagement Details & Terms

    • Contract Status: Independent Contractor (Form 1099-NEC).
    • Compensation: Hourly rate, commensurate with experience.

title: Plant Labelling Officer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Plant Labelling Officer to support the accurate identification, documentation, labelling, mapping, and interpretation of living plant collections within a Botanic Garden environment.

The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate plant labels, collection records, databases, mapping systems, and visitor-facing botanical information. The successful candidate will work closely with botanists, horticulturists, curators, and other technical specialists to ensure plant identities and collection information remain accurate, consistent, and up to date.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, install, inspect, update, and maintain plant labels across indoor and outdoor collections.
  • Ensure labels include accurate scientific names, common names, family information, geographic origin, accession details, and other relevant information.
  • Verify botanical nomenclature and taxonomy using recognised botanical references.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify missing, damaged, outdated, duplicated, or inaccurate labels.
  • Coordinate the correction and replacement of plant labels.
  • Work with botanists, horticulturists, curators, and other specialists to verify plant identification.
  • Maintain consistency between physical labels, accession records, databases, maps, and collection-management systems.
  • Manage and update plant-record databases and maintain accurate records of plant accessions, locations, provenance, movements, replacements, and losses.
  • Support plant accessioning and deaccessioning activities.
  • Maintain plant collection mapping systems and conduct field verification of plant locations.
  • Support the integration of plant records with GIS, digital mapping, and collection-management systems.
  • Develop and maintain botanical interpretation and visitor-facing information materials.
  • Translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear and accessible content.
  • Support digital plant-identification tools, QR-code systems, mobile applications, interactive maps, and digital collection platforms.
  • Conduct quality-control reviews of physical and digital plant information.
  • Support plant inventories and collection audits.
  • Maintain appropriate data-quality, backup, and version-control practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, Plant Taxonomy, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience in horticulture, botanical collections, plant identification, education, or technical capacity-building.
  • Strong knowledge of plant identification, taxonomy, nomenclature, and classification, with the ability to identify plants using morphological characteristics, botanical references, and taxonomic keys.
  • Proven experience in plant labelling, living-collection documentation, accessioning, provenance, and collection management.
  • Experience managing plant databases, electronic records, GIS, mapping systems, and digital collection-management platforms.
  • Strong research, information-verification, data-quality, and quality-control skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience developing and delivering horticulture training programmes, including practical, hands-on training.
  • Experience developing training materials, technical guides, manuals, presentations, and educational resources related to horticulture.
  • Experience assessing training needs, evaluating competency, and supporting internships, apprenticeships, vocational training, or work-based learning programmes.
  • Experience conducting horticulture workshops, demonstrations, or community-engagement programmes.
  • Ability to translate technical botanical and horticultural information into clear, engaging, visitor-facing content.
  • Experience working collaboratively with botanists, horticulturists, curators, researchers, educational institutions, and other technical specialists.
  • Familiarity with digital plant-identification tools, QR-code systems, mobile applications, and interactive mapping is advantageous.
  • Previous experience in a botanic garden, public garden, horticulture institution, nursery, educational institution, or comparable environment is preferred.
  • Strong written communication, technical documentation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Professional training or educational delivery experience in English and Arabic is preferred.

title: Data Analyst, ECP Insights
description:
ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. Used in more than 8,000 communities nationwide, our mission is to build world-class software that improves quality of life for seniors and drives clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers.

ECP Insights is our customer-facing reporting and analytics product. It gives senior living operators visibility across their portfolio and the reporting they need to run their business, from clinical care to occupancy to billing.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to build it. Some of what you build will be standard reporting that ships to every customer. Some will begin as a request from a single customer. In both cases you will build for reuse, so that work done for one operator can extend to others when it makes sense.

The work is primarily in Databricks, using SQL and Python or PySpark. Some reporting also requires querying our production databases directly.

You will work with customers directly, and the expectation is product discovery rather than intake. Understand the need behind the request, propose a better approach when there is one, and shape what we build instead of only executing what is asked.

Insights is a new product and this role carries real influence over its direction. You will join a small team and report to our VP of Data.

Responsibilities

  • Own client-facing analyses and dashboards end to end, from the initial conversation with the customer through delivery.
  • Run discovery with customers. Understand the underlying need, propose an approach, and define what will be built.
  • Use client input to prioritize what we build next across the reporting roadmap.
  • Design for reuse. Build standard reporting that serves all customers, and build client-specific work so it can extend to others when the need is shared.
  • Write SQL and Python or PySpark against large, multi-tenant datasets in Databricks.
  • Contribute dbt models alongside our data engineering team when the transformation belongs upstream.
  • Explain coverage, limitations, and methodology to customers.
  • Own the accuracy of what ships.
  • Work with product, data engineering, and customer-facing teams to turn recurring requests into product.
  • Handle protected health information in line with HIPAA and our security requirements.

What This Role Requires from You

  • You do discovery well. You find the need behind a request and propose a better approach when there is one.
  • You move quickly and design for reuse at the same time.
  • You get real leverage out of AI tooling and keep pushing on what it can take off your plate.
  • You are comfortable telling a customer that an approach will not work, and explaining why.
  • You ship in increments rather than waiting for a complete solution.
  • You verify your results before a customer sees them.
  • You want a role that is both technical and customer-facing.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree
  • You have independently built and shipped analyses or reporting against large, complex datasets using SQL and Python or PySpark.
  • You already use AI coding tools in your day to day work, for example Claude Code or Cursor. This is how we work and we expect the same here.
  • Strong SQL, including joins, window functions, and query performance on large tables.
  • Working knowledge of Databricks, or strong experience on a comparable platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Spark elsewhere.
  • Experience presenting your own work to people who did not build it, ideally external customers.
  • Experience working in version control on a shared codebase. We use Github.
  • A track record of owning work end to end.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with dbt
  • Building reporting that serves many customers on shared infrastructure, rather than for a single internal audience
  • Experience in healthcare, senior living, or another environment where the data is regulated
  • BI and dashboarding tools

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical and maintainable technical solutions.
  • Strong experience collaborating with business stakeholders, ITSM teams, architects, QA, and engineering teams.

title: Fuel Systems Technician Senior
description:
Our customers can find fresh food, healthy snack choices, and helpful employees. We strive to serve our local communities through kind and clean in-store service and community involvement. Enmarket is passionate about bringing healthy options to our customers and promoting healthy initiatives.

We have 128 locations across Georgia, North Carolina, and South Carolina and we are continuing to grow, which means new career opportunities!

Enmarket is looking for fresh and friendly faces to help us enrich life. If you are customer service oriented and highly motivated with a positive attitude, we hope you’ll consider joining our team.

Position Summary:

The Senior Fuel Systems Technician is responsible for the maintenance, repair, and compliance of fuel dispensing equipment, underground storage tanks (USTs), and related systems across multiple retail locations. This role serves as a technical lead, ensuring all fueling systems operate safely, efficiently, and in accordance with environmental and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform advanced diagnostics, repairs, and preventive maintenance on fuel dispensers, USTs, leak detection systems, and vapor recovery units.

  • Lead or assist in the installation and upgrade of fueling systems and associated technology.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and mentor to junior technicians.

  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations regarding fueling systems and hazardous materials.

  • Maintain accurate records of repairs, inspections, and compliance testing.

  • Coordinate with external vendors and regulatory agencies during site visits and audits.

  • Respond to emergency service calls and troubleshoot system issues in a timely manner.

  • Monitor fuel system performance and recommend proactive upgrades or replacements.

  • Provide support during site construction, tank testing, and permitting processes.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical certification or vocational training preferred.

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience working with fuel systems in a retail, convenience store, or commercial fueling environment.

  • In-depth knowledge of petroleum systems, including USTs, dispensers, sensors, and alarms.

  • Familiarity with Veeder-Root, Gilbarco, and Wayne systems a plus.

  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

  • Strong organizational and troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and travel between locations as needed.

  • OSHA and HAZMAT certification preferred.

Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds and work in varying weather conditions.

  • Frequent travel between store locations required.

  • On-call availability for emergency repairs or after-hours issues.

Benefits: Eligible team members may participate in medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) savings plan, paid time off, paid holidays, company-paid life insurance, disability benefits, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, and voluntary benefit offerings. Benefits eligibility and plan provisions are subject to program terms.


Enmarket is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Total Rewards Analyst
description:
This hybrid role offers the flexibility to work from either our Ogden or Salt Lake City office. Employees are expected to work onsite at their designated office location at least four days per week.

About Us

At Better Being Co. we empower and inspire individuals to feel better and live healthier lives by providing the most trustworthy, pure, and innovative natural wellness solutions. If you thrive in a challenging work environment, surrounded by incredible team members who will help you grow and do your best work, Better Being is the right place for you. Come build with us and be part of an award-winning company that’s helping create meaningful and lasting change in the healthcare industry.


Job Summary

At Better Being, we believe our people are our greatest competitive advantage. We're looking for a Total Rewards Analyst who is hands-on with data. Someone comfortable building pivot tables, writing Excel formulas, and putting together Power BI dashboards from HRIS data — to partner closely with the Director of Total Rewards and turn workforce and compensation data into clear, actionable recommendations. This highly visible role influences decisions across the organization by transforming data on pay, benefits, and workforce trends into insights leaders can act on.

This role focuses on analysis and reporting within our existing tools and platforms (Excel, Power BI, Workday). It is not a data engineering role, and it does not involve building data pipelines, warehouses, or custom software. If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems through data, and want to build your expertise in People Analytics and Total Rewards, we'd love to meet you.

Essential Functions

  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations in Power BI and Excel that give leadership visibility into compensation effectiveness, benefits program performance, and workforce trends.
  • Support compensation analysis, market pricing, pay equity reviews, and rewards program effectiveness using tools such as pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP, Power Query, and Power BI data modeling.
  • Analyze workforce trends including turnover, retention, hiring, promotions, and organizational effectiveness, and translate findings into recommendations for business leaders.
  • Partner with the Total Rewards team to analyze benefits utilization, enrollment trends, plan performance, and employee participation metrics.
  • Deliver timely, customized analyses that support business leaders and People Team initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve processes through technology and AI-enabled tools.
  • Assist with annual benefits planning, forecasting, and budget management by providing data analysis and reporting.
  • Support 401(k) plan administration and annual audit activities, including data collection, reconciliation, testing support, vendor coordination, and documentation.
  • Develop and maintain reporting related to healthcare costs, retirement plans, wellness initiatives, leave programs, and other benefit offerings.
  • Assist in creating and maintaining accurate HR and benefits records for audit, compliance, and reporting purposes.
  • Support data governance, confidentiality, and security protocols related to employee, compensation, and benefits information.
  • Support and participate in company, department, and safety policies, procedures, programs, and activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in a role that combined HR, compensation, or benefits data with hands-on analysis and reporting — for example, as a compensation analyst, HR/people analytics analyst, benefits analyst, or a quantitative/business analyst role with direct exposure to workforce data.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP, and Power Query.
  • Experience building (not just viewing) dashboards and reports in Power BI or a comparable BI tool.
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills for querying HRIS or reporting databases, or strong willingness/aptitude to learn.
  • Experience applying analytical methods such as trend analysis, variance analysis, pay equity analysis, or basic forecasting to workforce or compensation data.
  • Knowledge of HR metrics, practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate data into a clear narrative for non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy in data analysis.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive HR and compensation data appropriately.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AI tools and automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with HCM systems and databases; proficiency in Workday is a plus.
  • WorldatWork certification (CCP) or coursework in compensation analytics.

Physical Requirements

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear.
  • Employee must exert up to 30 lbs. of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 lbs. of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include near acuity, far acuity, depth perception, accommodation, color vision, and field of vision.

Our Benefits

Join our team and enjoy a comprehensive package of competitive benefits and perks designed to support your well-being and professional growth. Our offerings include:

  • Access to our Employee Health Clinic for your medical needs.
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance coverage.
  • Participation in our Family First Program, emphasizing work-life balance.
  • 401(K) plan with generous employer match to help you plan for the future.
  • Educational Reimbursement opportunities to support your continued learning and development.
  • Wellness Incentives to promote a healthy lifestyle.
  • Substantial product discounts, because we value our team members as customers too.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays, ensuring you have time to rest and recharge.

For more information, check out our website Better Being Careers and join us in experiencing a workplace where your well-being and success are our top priorities.

title: Global Business Workstream Lead – Price Risk Control Tower & PRIMES Price Forecasting
description:
Job Description:

Global Business Workstream Lead – Price Risk Control Tower & PRIMES Price Forecasting

Location: This role can be based in the UK, Poland, Germany or the US, with flexibility on specific site locations across these countries

The Global Business Workstream Lead is accountable for defining, delivering, and embedding strategic business capabilities within the Commercial Agility 2.0 transformation programme [CAT 2.0] [2]. The role is responsible for ensuring programme objectives are translated into fit for purpose associate utilization, sustainable business outcomes, operating model improvements, and measurable value delivery.

Acting as the primary business owner for assigned workstreams, this role will specifically focus on the deployment of the Price Risk Control Tower and capabilities supporting the PRIMES portfolio (Raw Materials, Packaging, and Co-Manufacturing). This lead will drive the business shift from static, retrospective financial reporting to proactive price forecasting automation and risk management analytics.

The role works in close partnership with digital, price risk management, data, analytics, finance, change manager, sourcing and regional Commercial teams while retaining accountability for business outcomes and organisational adoption.

What would be your key responsibilities?

Workstream Leadership

  • Lead global business workstreams throughout the programme lifecycle (Design > Creation > Execution > Continuous Improvement).

  • Partner with key stakeholders, including the Digital Technology Team, to define workstream objectives, scope, deliverables, roadmap, and success measures.

  • Establish and manage workstream plans, dependencies, risks, issues, and resource requirements.

  • Ensure alignment between workstream objectives and overall programme goals.

  • Report progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes through programme governance structures.

  • Drive accountability across all stakeholders contributing to workstream success.

  • Fit-for-purpose programme use-case with 100% user adoption success.

Business Capability Ownership

  • Define and own the business vision, objectives, and success measures for assigned workstreams.

  • Establish future-state business processes, governance, operating models, and ways of working to move the business from retrospective reporting to proactive margin management.

  • Define, prioritise, and validate business requirements for the Price Risk Control Tower, ensuring the platform effectively captures and visualizes key analytical dimensions:
    Portfolio Category Price Forecasting: Ability to forecast price through external benchmarks, historical actual price data, cost models, external insights.
    Commodity Volatility: Real-time and historical volatility across direct materials.
    Contract Coverage Positions: Clear tracking of fixed price coverage.
    Insights: Digitally enabled risks and opportunity insights to supplement forecasts.

  • Ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives, operational requirements, and strategic priorities.

  • Maintain ownership of business outcomes throughout the transformation lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Delivery Partnership

  • Partner with digital, regional delivery leads, data, price risk management, sourcing, analytics, change manager, and regional Commercial teams to support successful delivery of assigned workstreams.

  • Act as the bridge between commercial reality and technical execution, providing business context, commodity dynamics, and cost structures to the digital team who builds the quantitative models.

  • Align predictive price forecasting capabilities directly with the Annual Operating Plan (AEP) process, working alongside procurement finance to streamline forecasting cycles and reduce manual coordination.

  • Provide timely business decisions, priorities, requirements, and direction to enable effective solution delivery.

  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and delivery activities across all contributing teams.

  • Actively manage cross-functional dependencies and risks impacting achievement of business outcomes.

  • Support testing, deployment planning, readiness, and transition activities from a business perspective.

Stakeholder Engagement & Alignment

  • Build strong relationships with business leaders, regional commercial teams, regional delivery leads, functional stakeholders, digital program team, and programme leadership.

  • Partner closely with key executive stakeholders (such as Commodity Directors, Finance Leaders, and regional procurement heads) to drive alignment on a "single source of truth" for strategic inflation and financial exposure forecasting.

  • Drive alignment and commitment across stakeholder groups.

  • Facilitate business decision-making and resolution of challenges impacting delivery.

  • Champion programme objectives and future-state capabilities across the organisation.

Business Readiness & Adoption

  • Ensure new capabilities are successfully embedded into business operations.

  • Partner with Change Management and Regional Delivery Leads and regional commercial senior leaders to drive readiness and adoption activities.

  • Support buying teams in adopting the Price Risk Control Tower, ensuring they understand how to interpret and act upon predictive forecasting and risk-scenario outputs in their daily decision-making.

  • Support transition into business-as-usual operations.

  • Monitor adoption and identify barriers to successful and sustained implementation.

  • Drive ownership and accountability for new ways of working across impacted stakeholder groups.

Benefits Realisation

  • Ensure delivery of expected business outcomes, benefits, and value drivers as per business case.

  • Focus value tracking on portfolio coverage, plus improved forecasting accuracy, reduced PPV, and optimized commodity hedging execution.

  • Establish measures to assess adoption, utilization, and business impact.

  • Monitor achievement of targeted outcomes and benefits throughout delivery and implementation.

  • Identify opportunities to maximise value realization and continuous improvement.

  • Ensure capabilities deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

Key Outcomes

Success in the role will be demonstrated through:

  • Successful delivery of assigned workstream objectives.

  • Clear business ownership of future-state capabilities.

  • Strong alignment between business requirements and delivered outcomes.

  • Effective management of workstream risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Successful business readiness, 100% adoption, and embedding of new capabilities.

  • Achievement of targeted business outcomes, benefits, and value realisation.

  • Sustainable improvements in organisational capability, performance, and maturity.

What are we looking for?

Required

  • Experience leading business transformation, operational improvement, procurement excellence, or strategic initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional programmes, workstreams, or major business initiatives.

  • Broad understanding of commodity risk management, financial forecasting, pricing cycles, or strategic inflation planning.

  • Strong understanding of business process improvement, operating model design, and organisational change.

  • Experience working across business, digital, data, and technology-enabled environments.

  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and decision-making skills.

  • Experience driving adoption and implementation of business change within complex organisations.

Preferred

  • Experience within procurement, supply chain, shared services, or operational transformation environments.

  • Experience with data, analytics, automation, AI-enabled capabilities, or digital transformation initiatives from a business perspective.

  • Experience operating within large global and matrixed organisations.

  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide transformation programmes.

Functional Competencies

  • Transformation Delivery: Ability to lead complex business workstreams from concept through implementation, adoption and value realisation.

  • Techy Savvy: Experiments with existing and emerging technologies to enhance organizational outcomes, while encouraging others to learn and adopt new tools [2]. Partners effectively with digital, data, and analytics teams, keeping focus on business outcomes and value delivery.

  • Commercial & Operational Acumen: Ability to identify opportunities to improve organisational performance and deliver measurable business value.

  • Price Risk Management and Primes Forecasting: Forward-looking forecasts of raw material, packaging, and co-manufacturing costs by integrating market intelligence, coverage positions, financial drivers, and risk scenarios to guide planning and business decision-making.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.

  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.

  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.

  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

title: Outside Operator
description:
Departement FCC (Flexible Cartridge Center)

In onze productieafdelingen worden grondstoffen omgevormd tot afgevulde medicijnen. Het product doorloopt hierbij verschillende productiestappen (preparatie, vriesdrogen, vullen, cappen,...). Bij alle stappen streeft productie naar de hoogste graad van operationele uitmuntendheid. Verder in het productieproces zal het medicijn nog geïnspecteerd worden, van een label voorzien en verpakt worden om vervolgens via de distributieketen tot bij onze patiënt te geraken.

De functie outside operator situeert zich binnen de hoogtechnologische productie afdeling FCC. Dit is een volledig geïntegreerde farmaceutische productie afdeling waar inspuitbare geneesmiddelen worden afgevuld & gevriesdroogd. FCC is een afdeling waar een hoge graad van automatisatie aanwezig is.

'Als outside operator voer je zelfstandig taken uit in het washingcenter & preparatie, voer je diverse reinigingstaken uit en geef je ondersteuning bij filling taken'

We geloven sterk in team werk! Daarom zijn onderstaande taken wel typisch voor outside operator, maar staat het uiteindelijke resultaat van het team boven alles.

Takenpakket

  • Je voert zelfstandig taken uit in het washing- en preparatie center
  • Uitvoeren van reinigingstaken
  • Filling activiteiten ondersteunen
  • Stalen nemen en de kwaliteit van het eindproduct inspecteren
  • Je documenteert al deze activiteiten nauwkeurig

Functieprofiel

Must

  • Niveau secundair onderwijs of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
  • Je werkt georganiseerd en accuraat
  • Kwaliteit, orde en netheid zijn belangrijk voor jou
  • Functioneert vlot in teamverband

Nice to have

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie
  • Ervaring in een GMP omgeving

Aanbod:

  • Contract van onbepaalde duur met tal van extralegale voordelen
  • Een cultuur van ondernemerschap en innovatie
  • Grootste productie- en verpakkingssite van Europa binnen het Pfizer netwerk
  • Hoog investeringsritme
  • Hoogtechnologische omgeving

3-ploegenstelsel vroege/late/nacht


Work Location Assignment: On Premise

De Pfizer site in Puurs is één van de grootste productie- en verpakkingssites van Pfizer wereldwijd, gespecialiseerd in aseptische productie en verpakking. Jaarlijks worden in Puurs meer dan 400 miljoen doses injecteerbare vaccins en medicijnen geproduceerd. Deze zijn ter plaatse verpakt in ampullen, flacons, plastic flessen, spuiten en patronen voor pennen.

De medicijnen die in Puurs worden gemaakt, zijn bestemd voor patiënten in meer dan 170 landen wereldwijd. 30% van de productie uit Puurs is bestemd voor ontwikkelingslanden, in samenwerking met UNICEF, WHO, GAVI en ngo's.

Met het gebruik van twee windturbines, zonnepanelen en een warmtekrachtcentrale richten we ons op hernieuwbare energie.

Pfizer’s doel is om gelijke kansen te bieden in het wervingsproces door elke vorm van vooringenomenheid of mogelijke discriminatie te vermijden, ongeacht (maar niet beperkt tot) geslacht, leeftijd, ras, religie of overtuiging, seksuele geaardheid of handicap. We creëren een organisatie en bevorderen een cultuur die respect heeft voor ieders unieke karakter en levenservaringen en die de diversiteit van onze samenleving, klanten en markten weerspiegelt. Dit bereiken we door een omgeving te cultiveren en in stand te houden waarin elke collega zich gewaardeerd en ondersteund voelt.

Disability Inclusion:

Onze missie is om de kracht van al onze mensen te ontwikkelen en ruimte te geven. We zijn trots om een inclusieve werkgever te zijn, die aan alle kandidaten met een beperking gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen je aan om jezelf te zijn en dat met ons te delen, wetende dat wij ons best gaan doen om jouw sollicitatie en toekomstige carrière te ondersteunen. Jouw reis bij Pfizer begint hier!

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. Requests for any other reason will not be returned.

description:
At Lhoist North America, our core values of Respect, Courage, and Integrity are more than words. We respect people, encourage courageous innovation, and uphold integrity in everything we do. If these principles resonate with you, you may find your next great opportunity with us.

We believe our people make the difference. That’s why we invest in talent by offering meaningful opportunities to grow your skills, expand your knowledge, and pursue your interests. Our work environment prioritizes safety, fosters collaboration across teams, and embraces inclusion. Here, you’ll be challenged to grow, and you’ll be supported throughout your career journey. Join us and help shape the future of Lhoist North America.


POSITION SUMMARY:

The Utility Operator position is responsible for day-to-day maintenance throughout the plant, housekeeping in the plant, assist with loading of trucks and railcars, and the removal of lime/limestone waste from the plant to designated dump areas.


RESPONSIBILITIES & EXPECTATIONS:

  • Perform General Plant labor in all operational areas of the plant.
  • Demonstrate a working knowledge of kiln and kiln-related systems.
  • Clean bins, conveyers, spills, material from under conveyers and catwalks, and other cleaning duties as assigned.
  • Continuously observe, monitor, and report any condition that could lead to equipment failure or a safety hazard.
  • Ability to operate heavy equipment including vacuum truck, haul truck, bobcat, loader, man lift, forklift, shuttle wagon, and tractor in a safe manner.
  • Assist maintenance in preventative care and minor repairs of equipment used.
  • Assist in kiln outage work, as needed.
  • Learn various entry level positions and cross train in other areas of the plant as needed.
  • Responsible for completing equipment and work area inspections.
  • Perform all assigned work adhering to Company and governmental safety rules and regulation and follow company lock out tag out procedures.
  • Report any potential operational or safety problems to management.
  • Comply with all Safe Food Safe Feed Rules and Regulations
  • All other duties as assigned.

ATTRIBUTES:

  • Industrial background with good troubleshooting skills.
  • Knowledgeable of current environmental regulations and practices as they relate to the lime industry.
  • Previous experience operating heavy equipment is desired.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations is required.
  • Must be able to work shift work, seven days a week including holidays and be flexible to schedule changes, including overtime.
  • Must have a telephone and be open to callouts.
  • Tolerate working outside in severe weather conditions as well as exposure to industrial high temperature, noise and dust.
  • Effectively communicate and interact with supervisors, managers, and peers.
  • Knowledge of basic computer skills.
  • Knowledge of MS Office

PHYSICAL DEMANDS INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

  • Must be able to tolerate working outside in severe weather conditions as well as exposure to high temperature, noise, and dust.
  • Must be able to access all plant locations and perform the essential job duties of this position. This could include heights of 190 feet, confined spaces, climbing ladders or stairs, and accessing tunnels.
  • Previous experience operating heavy equipment is desired.
  • Ability to occasionally lift/carry 50 pounds.
  • Ability to read, write, and interpret documents such as work orders, mechanical drawings, safety rules, standard operating procedures, maintenance instructions, and procedural manuals.
  • Knowledgeable of current environmental regulations and practices as they relate to the lime industry.
  • Must perform all tasks in a timely and efficient manner.



REQUIRED EDUCATION: High School Diploma or GED

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: 1-2 years’ experience in industrial environment.

title: ESH Business & Technology Enablement Lead
description:
We have an opening for an ESH Business & Technology Enablement Lead. In this role, you will gather and translate ESH business and information technology requirements, serve as a liaison between LivIT and ESH business owners, and apply strong project management skills to transform business needs into actionable, sustainable IT solutions. You will support solution evaluation, design, testing, implementation, user adoption, and sustainment, helping ensure that new solutions are effectively understood and used across affected ESH programs and user groups. A strong background and demonstrated experience in ESH operations will be essential as you collaborate across ESH, LivIT, and partner organizations to support project execution and application implementation. This position is within the Operations Department of the Environment Safety & Health (ESH) Directorate.

This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.

You will:

  • Apply knowledge of ESH programs, operations, and compliance requirements to gather, analyze, and translate ESH business needs into clear, actionable, and testable IT requirements that support effective solution development and implementation.
  • Serve as a liaison between ESH business owners, LivIT, data specialists, and partner organizations to communicate requirements and support solution evaluation, design, testing, implementation, adoption, and sustainment.
  • Lead efforts to analyze current-state processes, identify gaps and root causes, and develop clear process maps and future-state improvements for the IT portfolio.
  • Utilize project management skills to lead highly complex ESH Application Management-related projects, including project definition, planning, scheduling, risk management, stakeholder engagement, execution, implementation, monitoring, and closeout.
  • Facilitate user acceptance, training, communications, and adoption activities to help ensure that implemented technology solutions are effectively understood and used across affected ESH programs and user groups.
  • Support the administration and execution of the ESH Software Review Board to ensure the effective evaluation, prioritization, and approval of proposed information technology-related business and functional requirements for software changes, workflows, dashboards, reports, and other technology-enabled solutions, in coordination with appropriate business and technical stakeholders.
  • Represent ESH in both institutional and departmental AI initiatives by coordinating business input, identifying practical use cases, and defining requirements, data needs, risks, and measures of success.
  • Work in conjunction with the Business Architect to facilitate working sessions and provide concise briefings to ESH leadership on requirements, project status, risks, technology needs, adoption, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physical science, or other ESH related field, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Substantial knowledge of, or experience with, ESH programs, operations, compliance functions, or related technical organizations, within a regulated, research and development, Department of Energy (DOE), National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), or national laboratory environment.
  • Substantial experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and translating business needs into clear, actionable, and testable information technology requirements including data, workflow, reporting, dashboard, and application requirements.
  • Experience partnering with IT organizations to evaluate, implement, improve, or sustain business applications and technology-enabled solutions.
  • Expertise analyzing highly advanced current-state processes, identifying gaps and root causes, developing process maps, and designing or implementing future-state improvements, including identifying functional interdependencies and reducing cross-silo redundancies.
  • Highly advanced experience leading or supporting projects through definition, planning, execution, monitoring, implementation, and closeout, including management of risks, schedules, stakeholders, and competing priorities that may require in-depth analysis.
  • Experience representing a technical or operational organization in emerging artificial intelligence initiatives, including contributing to AI maturity assessments, identifying implementation barriers, coordinating business input, and working with information technology partners to develop practical solutions.
  • Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building skills, coupled with independent judgment to ensure deliverables are achieved efficiently and effectively.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Possession or past completion of industry recognized project management certification(s).
  • Proven experience in identifying functional interdependencies and addressing cross-silo redundancies within an organization, with a focus on developing and implementing effective solutions.

Pay Range: $185,850- $235,692 Annually

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. title: NBA POD Business Process Lead (AI & Automation)
description:
Job Description:

Role Purpose

Mars Snacking’s vision is to create Better Snacks for Better Days, with a clear One Demand vision at the heart of it. At the service of the One Demand Vision, the Tech-Fueled Sales (TFS) ambition is to build a human-led, digitally-powered Sales Engine with the Associate at the center. This entails harnessing AI and data to help our associates sell smarter, serve customers better, and capture more value across every channel.

The NBA Business Process Lead is accountable for transforming Next Best Action/Perfect Store processes into scalable, AI-enabled ways of working that improve efficiency, effectiveness, and business performance. This role exists to fundamentally re-imagine the NBA commercial workflows, creating the lean, data-driven, and standardized process foundation required for AI and intelligent automation to succeed. He/she will dive deep into our end-to-end digital commerce processes to identify friction, root out inefficiency, and design the future-state workflows that will be powered by AI agents. By serving as the critical bridge between business reality and technical possibility, he/she will ensure our automation efforts are grounded in solid process engineering and deliver measurable efficiency and effectiveness gains for Mars Snacking.

  • Reporting to: Global NBA POD Lead
  • Location: Chicago
  • Travel: 10-15%
  • Direct reports: 0
  • This is a transformation role with an expected end date at the end of 2029.

Key Responsibilities
  • Process Mining & Re-engineering: Lead the deep-dive mapping and analysis of global, end-to-end NBA operational workflows. Apply formal methodologies (Lean, BPMN) to identify inefficiencies and design optimized, standardized future-state processes.
  • Data Foundation & Governance: Partner with business and data teams to define the data requirements for automated processes. Focus on improving the quality, standardization, and governance of critical process inputs to ensure data is reliable and fit-for-purpose for AI systems.
  • Automation & Agentic Workflow Design: Translate re-engineered processes into detailed functional requirements for AI agents and automation solutions. Design robust "Human-in-the-Loop" workflows to ensure proper validation, compliance, and oversight of AI-driven actions.
  • Solution Prototyping & Validation: Actively participate in the design, configuration, and testing of custom AI agents and workflow solutions. Ensure that technical builds accurately reflect the process design and will deliver the intended business value.
  • Impact Measurement & Continuous Improvement: Define, track, and report on key process performance indicators (e.g., process cycle time, task automation rates, error reduction). Establish a framework for ongoing process monitoring and continuous improvement.

Experience & Qualifications
  • Experience: 6+ years of dedicated experience in business process engineering, workflow automation, or systems analysis, with a strong background in Perfect Store (NBA), CPG, or sales operations.
  • Process Methodologies: Expert-level proficiency in process improvement and notation methodologies is required. Certifications such as Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), or extensive experience with BPMN, Value Stream Mapping, and Design Thinking are highly preferred.
  • Analytical Skills: A highly analytical and data-driven mindset. Proven ability to deconstruct complex systems, model multi-step global processes, and translate them into structured business and technical requirements.
  • Technical & AI Acumen: Strong familiarity with the concepts of Generative AI, APIs, and low-code/no-code automation tools. Critically, must have the ability to translate detailed process maps into logical requirements for developers.
  • Collaboration: Exceptional ability to work as a "translator" between non-technical commercial teams and expert AI engineers to deliver seamless, practical solutions.

Critical Skills & Leadership Capabilities
  • Manages Complexity: Can deconstruct highly complex, cross-functional business processes into clear, logical components and models.
  • Analytical Rigor: Sets clear hypotheses about process failures and uses data to diagnose root causes and validate solutions.
  • Strategic Mindset: Thinks beyond the "as-is" process to envision a simplified, automated future state that drives competitive advantage.
  • Nimble Learning: Quickly learns and understands new commercial domains and technical capabilities, applying that learning to process design.
  • Drives Results: Focuses on delivering tangible outcomes in process efficiency and effectiveness, not just creating process maps.

Measures of Success
  • Measurable reduction in process cycle time, manual effort, and error rates in targeted NBA workflows.
  • Successful translation of process designs into effective, adopted AI agents and automation solutions.
  • Creation and adoption of standardized, global processes for key NBA activities.
  • Positive feedback from both commercial stakeholders (on process simplification) and technical teams (on the clarity of requirements).

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Mars Statutory Transformation LATAM Lead
description:
Job Description:

The Mars Statutory Transformation LATAM Lead is responsible for leading statutory financial reporting, local regulatory compliance, and statutory reporting requirements across Latin America as part of a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role serves as the primary Finance and Controllership Subject Matter Expert for LATAM statutory reporting requirements, ensuring local GAAP, IFRS, financial statement, disclosure, and regulatory reporting obligations are incorporated into the SAP S/4HANA global template. The individual partners with the Finance, Tax, IT, Shared Services, and System Integrators to design, test, and deploy compliant statutory reporting processes and technologies (e.g. SAP DRC or other statutory compliance solutions).

What are we Looking For?

  • 8+ years of experience in statutory reporting, financial accounting, controllership, or external reporting.
  • Strong knowledge of statutory reporting requirements and local GAAP regulations across LATAM countries.
  • Deep understanding of IFRS and local statutory accounting requirements.
  • Experience supporting SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation programs.
  • Experience with statutory reporting technologies such as SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, Workiva, CCH Tagetik, BlackLine, or similar solutions.
  • Strong understanding of Record-to-Report (R2R), financial close, consolidation, and external reporting processes.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, multi-GAAP reporting, and financial reporting architecture.
  • Experience in Fixed Assets in SAP.
  • Proven experience defining business requirements and leading statutory reporting testing and deployment activities.
  • Experience supporting multi-country LATAM deployments within a global template framework.
  • Familiarity with complex regulatory environments across countries such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, and Peru.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Finance, Controllership, Tax, IT, Shared Services, auditors, and implementation partners.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
  • Preferred SAP S/4HANA Transformation Experience:
    • Led statutory reporting workstreams for LATAM SAP S/4HANA deployments.
    • Defined statutory reporting requirements across multiple LATAM countries.
    • Designed statutory reporting solutions leveraging SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, and financial statement versions.
    • Implemented SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, or similar compliance reporting technologies.
    • Defined requirements for local statutory financial statements, disclosures, trial balances, and regulatory reporting obligations.
    • Led statutory reporting UAT, defect management, cutover planning, deployment readiness, and hypercare support.
    • Collaborated with Regional Controllers, Global Process Owners, Tax, and System Integrators throughout the transformation lifecycle.
    • Supported audit readiness, financial compliance, and external audit requirements during deployment and steady-state operations.
    • Balanced global template adoption with country-specific statutory reporting requirements and compliance obligations.

What are the Key Responsibilities?

  • Lead the LATAM statutory reporting workstream for SAP S/4HANA design, build, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Serve as the primary SME for statutory financial reporting requirements across LATAM jurisdictions.
  • Define and validate local statutory reporting, financial statement, disclosure, and regulatory filing requirements.
  • Ensure LATAM statutory requirements are incorporated into the global S/4HANA template while balancing standardization and country compliance needs.
  • Partner with Finance, Controllership, R2R, Consolidation, Tax, and Shared Services teams to align statutory reporting requirements.
  • Define reporting requirements related to legal entities, charts of accounts, ledgers, account mappings, statutory adjustments, and financial statement structures.
  • Lead requirements and design reviews for SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, and other compliance reporting solutions.
  • Support finance design decisions involving parallel accounting, local GAAP adjustments, legal entity reporting, and reporting hierarchies.
  • Establish statutory reporting controls, governance standards, and compliance monitoring procedures.
  • Monitor changes in accounting standards and regulatory reporting requirements across LATAM countries and assess impacts to processes and systems.
  • Lead statutory reporting testing, defect management, business validation, and deployment sign-off activities.
  • Support deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and post-go-live stabilization activities.
  • Collaborate with local country finance teams to ensure regulatory and statutory obligations are appropriately addressed.

Key Deliverables

  • Approved LATAM statutory reporting requirements and solution design decisions.
  • Country statutory requirement inventories and localization assessments.
  • Local GAAP and IFRS reporting requirements documented and incorporated into SAP S/4HANA design.
  • SAP DRC, ONESOURCE Statutory Reporting, or equivalent compliance solution requirements and deployment sign-off.
  • Financial statement hierarchy, account mapping, and reporting structure requirements.
  • Statutory reporting process flows, governance documentation, and operating procedures.
  • Statutory controls framework and compliance monitoring processes.
  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, scripts, execution results, and defect resolution tracking.
  • Country-specific statutory reporting readiness assessments and deployment approvals.
  • Executive reporting on statutory compliance readiness, risks, key decisions, and deployment progress.
  • Go-live readiness plans, hypercare support procedures, and stabilization activities.
  • Knowledge transfer materials and operational support documentation.

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.
