title: Director D2, Private Sector Partnerships (Chief Fundraising Officer)
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

18 October 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 Central European Time (Rome)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT

The Partnerships and Innovation (PI) Department leads WFP's engagement with external partners to advance the organization's core mission and Strategic Plan. PI positions WFP, mobilizes and stewards partnerships and resources, and strengthens advocacy, and provides the strategy, analysis, and tools that enable WFP to be more agile, fast, and sophisticated in resource mobilization, working closely with regional offices and country offices to deepen partner relationships and deliver impact at scale. The Department is WFP's primary interface with governments, multilateral organizations, International Financial Institutions (IFIs), the private sector, foundations, academia, and strategic networks — combining global positioning with field-focused, operational support.


Within PI, the Private Sector Partnerships Division (PSP) leads WFP's global engagement with the private sector, mobilizing resources, expertise, innovation and advocacy in support of WFP's mission to achieve Zero Hunger. The Division plays a critical role in diversifying WFP's funding base, strengthening strategic partnerships and expanding private-sector contributions to humanitarian and development outcomes worldwide.


Working across WFP's Headquarters, Regional Offices, Country Offices and Friends Organizations, PSP develops and manages private-sector partnerships that generate financial and non-financial value, supports fundraising and business development across the organization, and advances innovative approaches that increase WFP's impact, reach and sustainability. The Division manages a global portfolio of strategic partnerships and fundraising activities and is central to WFP's ambition to increase private-sector income to US$1 billion annually by 2030.


The Director, PSP provides strategic leadership for WFP's global private-sector engagement function, driving partnership growth, resource mobilization and innovation across a diverse portfolio of fundraising and partnership channels. The Director is responsible for strengthening organizational capabilities, expanding WFP's private-sector ecosystem and positioning WFP as the partner of choice for private-sector stakeholders worldwide. Championing the power of private-sector partnerships to drive innovation and impact, the Director serves as WFP's lead strategist for engagement in major global forums — including the World Economic Forum (WEF), the UN General Assembly (UNGA) and COP — and co-represents the organization at these and other high-profile events.


JOB PURPOSE

To provide strategic leadership and direction for WFP's global private-sector engagement portfolio by driving partnership growth, resource mobilization, innovation and influence; strengthening WFP's private-sector ecosystem; and positioning the organization to secure greater impact, income and long-term value through partnerships with companies, foundations, philanthropists and individuals.


IMPACT OF RESULTS

The Director, PSP leads one of WFP's most strategically important functions, responsible for driving growth in private-sector engagement and resource mobilization worldwide. As WFP works towards annual private-sector income of US$1 billion by 2030, the incumbent's leadership, network, judgement and decision-making will be critical to expanding revenue streams, strengthening strategic relationships, enhancing WFP's reputation and positioning the organization for sustained long-term growth.


Decisions taken at this level have significant consequences for WFP's income generation, organizational effectiveness, partnership performance and global competitiveness. The incumbent is accountable for ensuring that WFP maximizes the value of private-sector engagement and secures the resources, capabilities and partnerships required to support the organization's strategic objectives and operations worldwide.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES (not all-inclusive)


Strategy and positioning

1. Lead the development and implementation of WFP's global private-sector partnerships strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and organizational objectives.

2. Provide strategic leadership and oversight of WFP's global private-sector engagement portfolio, delivering sustainable income growth, increased partner value and long-term diversification across corporate partnerships, foundations, philanthropy, individual giving, digital fundraising and emerging funding streams.

3. Monitor global philanthropic, fundraising and private-sector trends, assess market opportunities and risks, and provide strategic insight and recommendations to senior management to strengthen WFP's competitiveness, positioning and long-term growth.

4. Drive the expansion of existing markets and the development of new partnership opportunities, funding models and engagement approaches to diversify and strengthen WFP's resource base.

5. Shape and champion the business case for strategic investment in private-sector engagement, ensuring WFP allocates the people, capabilities, systems, technology and operating resources required to achieve income growth targets, strengthen organizational effectiveness and support long-term sustainability.

Partnership development and resource mobilization

6. Position WFP as a partner of choice for the private sector by building and maintaining relationships with senior executives, philanthropic leaders, investors and other influential stakeholders.

7. Identify, develop and advance high-value partnerships that generate financial resources, expertise, innovation, influence and other strategic value for WFP.

8. Champion integrated partnership strategies that bring together corporations, foundations, philanthropists, financial institutions and other ecosystem actors to unlock innovative solutions, mobilize additional resources and maximize collective impact.

9. Lead the exploration and adoption of innovative partnership approaches, blended finance solutions and emerging engagement models to expand WFP's reach, income and impact.

10. Provide executive oversight of WFP's most strategic private-sector partnerships, ensuring effective stewardship, governance, risk management and delivery of partnership commitments.

11. Provide strategic leadership for global fundraising, advocacy and engagement initiatives, in collaboration with relevant internal and external stakeholders, to strengthen WFP's visibility, supporter engagement and resource mobilization results.

Representation, influence and collaboration

12. Represent WFP in high-level external meetings, conferences, forums and strategic engagements to promote organizational priorities, strengthen partnerships and expand opportunities for collaboration.

13. Advise and support WFP's senior leadership team on private-sector engagement priorities, strategic partnerships and external positioning opportunities, and coordinate and leverage their engagement to advance priority partnerships and resource mobilization objectives.

14. Strengthen collaboration across Headquarters, Regional Offices, Country Offices and Friends Organizations to ensure a coordinated and effective approach to private-sector engagement worldwide, including the development of public-private partnerships where relevant.

15. Support the Assistant Executive Director in positioning the Department and, as a member of the senior management team, contribute to the achievement of its overall objectives.

Management and governance

16. Oversee divisional performance management — including income growth, financial performance, forecasting, pipeline management, KPI monitoring and business reporting — ensuring accountability, data-driven decision-making and timely corrective action.

17. Ensure effective governance, risk management, compliance and stewardship across the Division, safeguarding WFP's reputation and partnership assets, and lead the timely implementation of evaluation, audit and compliance recommendations.

18. Assume overall responsibility for divisional performance, organizational culture, staff engagement, talent development, succession planning, workforce planning and resource management, ensuring PSP has the capabilities, leadership and talent required to achieve its strategic objectives.

19. Foster a culture of innovation, performance and continuous improvement, ensuring PSP remains responsive to evolving market trends, donor expectations and partnership opportunities.

20. Promote an inclusive, diverse and respectful workplace consistent with WFP's values and leadership principles.

21. Perform other related duties as required.


QUALIFICATIONS AND KEY REQUIREMENTS

Education:

• Advanced University degree in Economics, International development, Social or Political sciences, Marketing Communications, or other relevant area, or first university degree with additional relevant experience and/or advanced training/courses.


Experience, Knowledge & Skills:

• Fifteen years or more (of which six international) of senior level experience in a relevant field of work.

• Proven success in managing complex global private-sector partnerships encompassing fundraising, brand building, capacity building and network management.

• Background and/or interest in international humanitarian development.

• Extensive experience leading large multicultural teams and improving performance.

• Excellent commercial acumen and financial management skills, with the ability to leverage external partnerships to optimize resources for WFP.

• A track record of dealing with and influencing at the highest levels within and beyond the organization.

• Ability to assimilate and analyse complex issues to develop strategies and policies.

• Detailed understanding of business principals and processes, and the ability to quickly assimilate UN/WFP specific processes and systems.


Language:

• Fluency (level C) in the English language

• Intermediate knowledge (level B) of a second official UN language: Arabic, Chinese, French, Spanish, Russian, and/or Portuguese (a WFP working language)


WFP LEADERSHIP FRAMEWORK

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

Click here to access WFP Leadership Framework

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

WFP is committed to supporting individuals with disabilities by providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact: global.inclusion@wfp.org

NO FEE DISCLAIMER

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION

  • All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.

  • We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.

  • If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is only for technical issues with an application - unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply.

  • At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.

  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. WFP is committed to providing an inclusive work environment free of sexual exploitation and abuse, all forms of discrimination, any kind of harassment, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. Therefore, all selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.


No appointment under any kind of contract will be offered to members of the UN Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (ACABQ), International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and other similar bodies within the United Nations system with oversight responsibilities over WFP, both during their service and within three years of ceasing that service.

A kiállítandó bútorokat összeszereled, szükség esetén pedig cseréled, javítod.
Figyelsz rá, hogy a termékkommunikációk és árak mindig ki legyenek helyezve.

Köszönjük, hogy érdeklődsz – várjuk, hogy megismerhessünk!

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
Together, we move what matters

We are at the start of something powerful. Heavy Haul Rail was created with a simple but transformative belief: the UK deserves a smarter, cleaner, more resilient freight future. And we have the opportunity to build it.

Every role in this business carries purpose. Whether you work in operational delivery, driving trains, engineering, or business support, the work you do contributes directly to reducing emissions, easing road congestion, strengthening supply chains and powering British industry. This is meaningful work, with real impact.

Who we are

Previously operating as Freightliner’s Heavy Haul business, we are now an independent company following CMA CGM Group’s acquisition of Freightliner UK’s Intermodal Logistics business in January 2026.

Heavy Haul Rail is the UK’s next-generation rail freight partner built for a sector ready to evolve. We believe it’s time to move differently. Congested roads, rising emissions, fragile supply chains. These aren’t just logistical challenges; they’re environmental and economic wake-up calls. We’re here to lead the modal shift, helping businesses transition from road to rail with confidence, clarity, and measurable impact.

We move 17 million tonnes of freight a year for customers in the industrial, energy and construction markets. The company operates 95 locomotives and over 1000 wagons. Heavy Haul Rail’s team of 950 supports customer deliveries to over 100 locations across the UK, running 250 trains per week.

Heavy Haul Rail also supports the renewal and maintenance of the rail infrastructure and supports passenger train operators and rolling stock companies, including the provision of drivers and route conducting services.

But none of this happens without us, its people.

Purpose of the Role:

Working within the IT Helpdesk team, the IT support analysts provide first & second line support to the business covering a wide range of products and hardware, requiring a varied skill set, covering infrastructure
etwork, applications, hardware, and mobile device support and provisioning.

Enabling the business to perform at full level, empowering others to succeed.

Main duties and responsibilities:

  • First point of contact for IT support within the organisation
  • Answering and resolving service requests
  • Escalate service requests to the appropriate levels and assuring completion
  • Installing, configuring, and maintaining applications, Operating Systems and hardware components of computer and network systems
  • Administration of Active Directory within scope
  • Daily checks and assessments of systems
  • Control and management of the backup processes
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation
  • Participate in project when required
  • Participate in the on-call rota
  • Improve the end user experience
  • Occasional travel to sites
  • Any other duties commensurate with skills, scope, and time available.
  • Implement and adhere to IT and general company policies

Key job requirements:

  • MS Office 365 installation and configuration
  • Network topologies and technologies
  • Windows PC Operating systems
  • PC hardware technologies
  • Active Directory
  • Mobile Technologies
  • Good communication skills
  • High levels of Customer Service
  • Attention to detail
  • Problem solving skills

Behavioural Competencies:

Friendly and approachable. Attacks goals and objectives with drive, energy and enthusiasm Diligent completion of task to a high level Proactive approach to work, using own initiative Embraces new challenges, is hands on operationally and gets things done Sets high standards of work for self and consistently achieves these High level of integrity and openness, combined with commitment to good governance Listens attentively to others’ perspectives and provides constructive feedback to enhance offerings

Why Join Us?

Here, you’re not one small part of a big machine. You’re a key contributor with national significance and real-world impact. We want our colleagues to feel proud of the work they do, connected to our mission and empowered to shape the future of this business. As part of Heavy Haul Rail, you can expect:

  • Purpose that matters. Your work contributes to a cleaner, more efficient freight industry.

  • Opportunity to shape what’s next. We’re new, agile and ready to do things differently, your ideas help build our future.

  • A team that moves forward together. Collaboration, respect and shared ambition define how we work.

  • A commitment to excellence. We deliver with pride, precision and professionalism.

  • Room to grow. Your development fuels our momentum.

Our perks and benefits

Our people are our most important asset. We strive to empower our employees, ensuring they are trained and competent, fit for work, always informed, and completely engaged in our culture that places safety and wellbeing firmly at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for the most committed and reliable individuals who possess the knowledge, skills and experience needed for their roles. In return we can offer considerable career progression, and a rewarding career in an award-winning team alongside:

  • Competitive pay

  • Fantastic final-salary pension scheme after an initial qualifying period

  • Enhanced maternity & paternity pay

  • Opportunities for ongoing training and development.

  • Access to the company's life assurance scheme

  • A range of benefits to make your own so you can get the most of your work and home life which will also help save you money and hassle. From reimbursement on health treatments, to savings on new cars.

Apply now

We know where we’re heading. We know why it matters. Now, it’s time to move, to make it real, together.

For queries contact careers@heavyhaulrail.co.uk

Shaping tomorrow. Starting today

The future we want to build won’t happen on its own, we have to move it forward, together. Heavy Haul Rail has the purpose, the ambition and the opportunity to reshape how Britain moves. Whatever our roles, we are collaborators, creators and custodians of a better future. This journey starts with what we choose to do today, tomorrow and every day after that.

Our values are:

  • Make Every Mile Matter: We act with intention and responsibility, knowing our work shapes a cleaner, stronger future for the UK.

  • Build Boldly: We use our entrepreneurial spirit to challenge legacy thinking and design better ways forward, for our customers, our industry and each other.

  • We move as one: We collaborate with trust, respect and shared momentum, because progress is a team sport.

  • Deliver with certainty: We stand behind our work. We’re reliable, precise and accountable in everything we do.

  • Fuelling The Future: We invest in our people and our potential, championing learning, curiosity and continuous improvement. with confidence, clarity, and measurable impact.

title: Sr Product Manager
location: Lake Buena Vista, Florida, United States of America
description:
Department Description

Disney isn't just another job; it's a career. We are a global leader in entertainment and experiences, committed to delivering exceptional Guest and Cast experiences through innovation, technology, and operational excellence. As a Senior Product Manager at Disney, you can combine your passion for technology and Guest experience to create compelling and delightful experiences for our valued Guests and Cast.


Team Description:

The Senior Product Manager – Point of Sale Platform is a senior individual contributor role on the Retail and Restaurant Technology team, responsible for owning and delivering large, multi-quarter product initiatives for Disney's Point of Sale (POS) platform across Retail and Food & Beverage businesses — including POS modernization, international deployments, and enterprise platform replacement programs. Working in close collaboration with key stakeholders and partners, this role develops an understanding of business and technical capabilities, identifies gaps, and executes product roadmaps for assigned initiative threads.


A successful candidate is highly collaborative, works effectively in a matrixed organization while wearing multiple hats, is comfortable working autonomously on complex programs, and is adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple products and applications. Serving as a product leader for assigned large programs, the Senior PM acts as a liaison to development, implementation, and support teams, and drives enhancements, backlog ownership, and the prioritization of features and capabilities. This role brings a working understanding of how POS systems connect to the broader technology ecosystem — including supply chain, mobile platforms, data warehousing, and payments — and ensures cross-system dependencies are surfaced, understood, and reflected in product decisions.


What You’ll Do:


Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Owns product direction and execution for assigned large POS initiatives, contributing to the development of product strategy and feature vision that enhances Guest and Cast experiences across Retail and Food & Beverage programs.
  • Develops and maintains a prioritized, outcomes-driven product roadmap for assigned initiative threads, prioritizing initiatives relative to business needs and aligning to strategic and tactical business objectives.
  • Works with the business to determine the real issue that needs to be solved or the opportunity to do things differently, translating ambiguous needs into clear, actionable product direction.
  • Supports business cases and business, technical, and financial feasibility assessments to ensure benefits align to enterprise priorities.
  • Identifies product improvement opportunities by staying involved in initiative delivery and stakeholder feedback, and recommends process and technology improvements that increase product effectiveness.
  • Provides advice and recommendations on emerging trends and technologies useful to both the business and Technology in the delivery of POS initiatives.

POS Domain Expertise & Industry Knowledge

  • Develops subject matter expertise in Point of Sale, with knowledge spanning hardware (terminals, handhelds, kiosks, peripherals), software, payment processing, menu/catalog management, reporting, and offline resilience across both retail and restaurant environments.
  • Understands the distinct requirements of retail POS (item lookup, inventory integration, returns, loyalty, associate-facing workflows) versus restaurant POS (order sequencing, kitchen display systems, modifier management, table management, and speed of service).
  • Applies operational knowledge of Food & Beverage and Merchandise environments — including Quick Service, Table Service, kiosk, grab-and-go, and specialty retail — to inform product decisions.
  • Stays current on the broader POS industry, including leading vendors (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Toast, Lightspeed, Square, Stripe) and emerging trends in unified commerce, mobile payment, and AI-enabled ordering, and applies relevant insights to Disney's platform direction.

Feature Definition & Product Lifecycle Execution

  • Owns and manages key phases of the product lifecycle — including requirements gathering, backlog grooming, and delivery tracking — from problem definition through feature delivery, adoption, and outcome measurement.
  • Leads the creation of technical specifications and user stories to enable system modification or development, refined to a sufficient level of detail to allow Architects and Software Engineers to design, develop, and implement appropriate solutions.
  • Defines and refines product features by synthesizing inputs from end users (e.g., surveys, analytics), business stakeholders (e.g., pricing, marketing), and industry trends.
  • Combines business requirements into a prioritized backlog grouped into project iterations, and manages the scope and traceability of requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Reviews and signs off on solution designs, ensuring business requirements are verified, validated, and delivered, and participates in functional design, construction, and testing.
  • Establishes performance metrics and KPIs to evaluate feature effectiveness, draws inferences, and drives iterative enhancements and prioritization decisions.
  • Drives Agile standups, backlog grooming, and planning, and ensures required outcomes are built, tested, communicated, and delivered on time and within budget.

Cross-System Dependencies & Platform Integrations

  • Maintains a working understanding of the systems the POS platform depends on and integrates with — including supply chain and inventory, loyalty and guest identity, mobile ordering and payments, kitchen display and production systems, and data warehousing and analytics.
  • Identifies and surfaces cross-system dependencies early in the product lifecycle, ensuring feature design accounts for integration complexity, data contracts, and downstream impacts before Engineering begins solution design.
  • Partners with product teams and architects across adjacent platforms to align on integration standards, API contracts, and shared data definitions.
  • Manages project interdependencies in support of business strategies, roadmaps, and financial commitments, and assists in identifying and managing risks, issues, and dependencies.

AI, Data & Workflow Enablement

  • Applies AI-enabled tools and data insights to improve product and operational team workflows, planning efficiency, and decision quality across POS capabilities.
  • Identifies opportunities to apply automation and analytics to reduce manual effort in Cast and operational workflows and improve speed to value.
  • Leads or supports proof-of-concepts (POCs) that align with the product vision to validate technical viability and business assumptions.
  • Partners with Technology and Data teams to ensure responsible, secure, and effective integration of AI capabilities into the POS platform and product development processes.

Collaboration, Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Collaborates with fellow Product Managers and cross-functional teams, contributing to team effectiveness by sharing product management best practices and lessons learned.
  • Develops and maintains relationships with business, vendor, and technology stakeholders, and manages engagement, expectations, scope, and budget discussions for large or complex initiatives.
  • Provides thought leadership and asserts influence by driving complex projects to completion effectively and efficiently, escalating issues and recommending appropriate solutions.
  • Communicates effectively through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates across various levels of the organization, providing updates to leadership as needed.
  • Supports go-to-market efforts in coordination with marketing, content, training, consumer insights, and operations, and participates in change control processes to ensure alignment with business and technology expectations.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • 5+ years (3+ years with a Master's degree) of product management or equivalent experience driving product strategy and execution, ideally in digital or technology roles within the retail or hospitality industry.
  • Strong technical product knowledge in the Point of Sale space, with functional understanding of retail and restaurant POS environments, payment processing, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, understand, and drive resolution of complex, critical issues, and to think strategically and drive ideas into action with a positive outlook and willingness to take personal initiative.
  • Understanding of Agile technical practices, DevOps, and testing concepts (CI/CD, TDD), and strong command of agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar).
  • Basic knowledge of public cloud technologies (e.g., AWS) and an understanding of the nuances of data pipeline issues and solutions.
  • Experience working in a collaborative, matrixed environment with cross-functional Technology teams and operational departments.
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex or diverse project data and information and articulate a compelling vision for complex and seemingly disparate concepts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience with Disney theme park or resort operations, or equivalent large-scale, multi-site hospitality or retail operations.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise POS platforms (e.g., Oracle MICROS, Toast, Lightspeed, NCR, or equivalent) in a retail or restaurant context.
  • Experience delivering enterprise POS platforms across multi-location environments with high transaction volume and complex operational requirements.
  • Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation to platform capabilities or operational workflows to improve Guest or Cast outcomes.
  • Familiarity with various funding models and driving products through the stages of the product funding lifecycle.

Required Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

The hiring range for this position in Lake Buena Vista, FL is $135,200 - $181,200 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

title: D1 Hockey Youth Mentor
description:
About the Role

Texas Sports Academy is a K-12 school designed for serious student-athletes who want both elite academics and high-level athletic development. Students learn twice as fast as traditional schools in just 2 hours a day, using the same 2-Hour Learning model as Alpha School. That frees up their entire afternoon for serious training, where they work alongside former pro and D1 athletes coaching them at the highest standard.

We are hiring D1 Hockey Youth Mentors to work with multiple student-athletes through one-on-one video sessions, splitting your time evenly between academic guidance and hockey mentorship. You will support your students through their academic hours, hold them accountable for focus and effort, and use your Division I hockey experience to guide how they approach training, competition, and life as a student-athlete.

What You'll Do

  • Guide Your Students Through Their Academic Day: Meet with your students one-on-one over video during their academic hours, keep them focused and on task, and help them maintain progress through their learning.
  • Mentor Young Hockey Players: Use your Division I hockey background to guide students on game preparation, handling mistakes, training habits, teamwork, and the college hockey recruiting process. Help them balance academic responsibilities with practices, games, tournaments, and travel.
  • Build Strong Mentoring Relationships: Be a consistent, trusted adult each student can turn to for guidance, accountability, and honest feedback across both school and hockey.
  • Support Their Learning: Help your students navigate the AI-powered learning platform, work through challenging material, and build study and time-management habits they can maintain throughout the hockey season.
  • Reinforce Standards: Set clear expectations for effort, focus, sportsmanship, and how students respond to feedback. Address concerns directly and recognize progress in both academics and hockey.
  • Communicate With Parents and Staff: Give parents and the academy clear updates on each student's academic progress, approach to hockey, and areas where they need additional support.

Requirements

  • Division I Hockey Background: You competed in NCAA Division I ice hockey and can use that experience to mentor young players. You understand the demands of balancing academics, training, competition, and travel.
  • Experience Working With Kids: You have worked with young people in a role where you were responsible for their focus, growth, or development. Coaching, tutoring, mentoring, camp counseling, teaching, or similar hands-on work.
  • Judgment With Young Athletes: You know how to earn a student's trust, set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and recognize when they need a different approach or additional support.
  • Strong Communication: You are clear and consistent on video, comfortable leading one-on-one sessions, and able to give parents and staff useful written updates.
  • Reliability and Organization: You show up on time, follow through, and keep track of what each of your students needs next.
  • AI-First Approach: You are comfortable using AI tools and AI-powered learning platforms to support your work. You check their outputs and use your own judgment when helping students.
  • Location and Setup: Remote (U.S.). Reliable internet and a quiet space for video sessions. U.S. work authorization required.

Bonus Points

  • Youth Hockey Coaching: You have coached youth hockey players, worked at hockey camps, or mentored athletes in a structured hockey program.
  • College Hockey Recruiting Experience: You have helped players and families understand recruiting, communicate with college coaches, or prepare for the transition to college hockey.
  • Teaching or Tutoring Background: You have taught, tutored, or led a classroom before.
  • Remote Student Support: You have supported students through video sessions, learning platforms, and messaging tools.

Benefits

Pay: $25/hour

title: Asistente de Programas - Infraestructura SSA5
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

29 September 2026-23:59-GMT-04:00 Venezuela Time (Caracas)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

ANTECEDENTES Y PROPÓSITO DEL CARGO


El Programa Mundial de Alimentos de las Naciones Unidas (WFP, por sus siglas en inglés) es la mayor agencia humanitaria del mundo que lucha contra el hambre a nivel global. La misión del WFP es ayudar a alcanzar el Hambre Cero en nuestra generación. Cada día, el WFP trabaja en todo el mundo para garantizar que ningún niño se acueste con hambre y que las personas más pobres y vulnerables, en particular mujeres y niños, puedan acceder a los alimentos nutritivos que necesitan.

El WFP en Venezuela se centra en apoyar la seguridad alimentaria de las personas que viven en condiciones vulnerables en el país, según lo establecido en el Plan Estratégico Interino para el País (iCSP) 2023-2026, en línea con el Marco de Cooperación para el Desarrollo Sostenible de las Naciones Unidas en Venezuela (2023-2026), el HRP y la Agenda 2030 para el Desarrollo Sostenible.

El WFP busca diversificar sus intervenciones en todas las áreas, procurando una respuesta integrada para el acceso a los alimentos, la mejora de la nutrición y los medios de vida de los grupos más vulnerables. El WFP lleva a cabo intervenciones centradas en alimentación escolar, asistencia alimentaria comunitaria y escolar para comunidades en mayor riesgo, capacitación en medios de vida y recuperación de activos combinada con asistencia alimentaria condicionada, así como preparación y respuesta ante emergencias, mientras fortalece la rendición de cuentas hacia las poblaciones afectadas, las capacidades escolares, la infraestructura de los sistemas alimentarios y las capacidades logísticas.

La Oficina del WFP en Venezuela cuenta actualmente con un portafolio de actividades diverso, orientadas a fortalecer la alimentación en las escuelas, en las comunidades, fortalecer la resiliencia y los medios de vida con un enfoque comunitario, y apoyar en el inmediato a personas afectadas por eventos climáticos u otros. Este puesto visa reforzar el equipo de infraestructuras y apoyar al seguimiento de las actividades bajo el programa de comidas escolares, con posible apoyo a las demás actividades.

La posición estará basada en Caracas, con posibles viajes a terreno para la capacitación y el apoyo a los equipos WFP en terreno y sus socios implementadores. El/La candidato/a reportará a la Ingeniera Asociada de Programas bajo el equipo de Asistencia Alimentaria y Resiliencia.


RESPONSABILIDADES:


El titular del cargo tendrá las siguientes responsabilidades:

• Realizar seguimiento operativo con oficinas de terreno de PMA y socios implementadores, incluyendo la revisión y actualización de cronogramas y actividades de infraestructura en terreno.

• Coordinar con los equipos de terreno y socios implementadores para dar seguimiento a la implementación de las actividades de infraestructura y al cumplimiento de los lineamientos establecidos. En caso requerido, apoyar a la oficina de terreno la socialización de estas actividades con CDCE y autoridades locales.

• Realizar visitas regulares a los espacios donde se implementen intervenciones de infraestructura, con el fin de verificar avances, levantar observaciones sobre la ejecución de las actividades y la entrega de materiales, equipamiento y herramientas. En caso de identificar desviaciones o incidencias, informar oportunamente y proponer acciones de mejora para su revisión por el equipo de Infraestructura.

• Supervisar y validar que las intervenciones de infraestructura que se realicen cumplan con lo establecido en los planes de trabajo desarrollados por el socio implementador, con los estándares de calidad establecidos por PMA y con la normativa de construcción establecida a nivel nacional.

• Revisar y validar soportes, facturas y documentación asociada a la legalización de gastos, asegurando coherencia y completitud de las intervenciones de infraestructura.

• Apoyar en la revisión técnica de propuestas, presupuestos y planes de

mantenimiento presentados por los socios implementadores para la implementación de actividades de infraestructura.

Banking Americas

Mizuho’s Banking Division provides corporate and investment banking coverage, sponsor coverage, advisory and solutions and loan capital markets/syndicate to Mizuho’s client base of leading international corporations, financial institutions and public sector entities in the US and Canada. Banking supports client business activities throughout the region with an extensive range of capital markets and lending capabilities and an integrated team of coverage, advisory and product bankers responsible for client relationship management and strategic transaction development to execute banking and securities mandates and originate idea generation for potential acquisitions, divestitures and investment opportunities.



About the Role:

Investment & Corporate Analysts are directly involved in the design, origination, structuring and execution of financial advisory, global capital markets, financial risk management, structured & syndicated finance, and other global products and services for existing and prospective clients. An Analyst is expected to understand the implications, identify key industry and product trends and provide input on pitch and deal material to enhance the ultimate deliverable.



Analysts are assigned to a variety of projects and are given a broad range of responsibilities, some of which include:

  • Conduct extensive quantitative economic, industry and company research and analysis
  • Conduct and model a broad range of corporate finance alternatives and due diligence for client transactions including M&A, strategic alternatives, capital structure development, acquisition finance and syndicated loan and capital market financing
  • Evaluate risk/return parameters of financing transactions
  • Financial modeling, valuation, comparable & relative value analyses and market-specific analysis
  • Facilitate and coordinate product group idea generation and solutions development across a broad platform of global capabilities
  • Draft client pitches and marketing materials including M&A, syndicated bank financing, public/private debt & equity capital markets, and other internal documentation by coordinating internal and external resources
  • Assist in financing structuring, underwriting transaction evaluation, preparation, due diligence and execution
  • Assist in the development and continued cultivation of client relationships


Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Finance or Economics and a minimum of 1 year corporate finance and capital markets experience with a top tier global bank
  • Knowledge of corporate finance, securities, financial markets and risk & pricing analysis
  • Aptitude to synthesize large amounts of information and develop innovative ideas and/or product solutions
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to work under pressure and adhere to tight deadlines
  • Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to convey ideas
  • Creativity and intellectual curiosity
  • Ability to work independently and must be able to work effectively in a team environment
  • Advanced proficiency with FactSet, CapitalIQ, Bloomberg, Microsoft Office

The expected base salary ranges from $110K - $130k. title: Scrum Master - Guidewire (Claims Center)
company: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan
description:
The Scrum Master serves a vital role and is in the unique position to help coach, guide and facilitate an energetic and knowledgeable team. As the Scrum Master you will serve as a critical liaison between the product delivery team, product manager and senior management providing critical direction, communication and assuring the quality delivery of products and services to our customers.

  • Leads one or more agile teams as the scrum master and team member.
  • Employs best practices for agile/scrum methodology, while operating within the department’s overall SDLC Framework.
  • Works collaboratively with the product managers and team members to give input and support to the strategic direction of the initiative.
  • Motivates and supports team members and ensures they have the tools and knowledge to do their jobs and that all blocking issues are resolved quickly.
  • Creates self-organizing agile teams and facilitates the delegation of tasks and responsibilities to appropriate team members.
  • Acts as moderator for sprint planning, daily standups, sprint demos, and refactoring/reflection sessions.
  • In partnership with the Product manager & Product Owner ensure a robust, prioritized backlog is available.
  • Supports Product Manager in understanding and communicating team effectiveness and performance.
  • Communicates team status to all internal stakeholders and continuously refines/improves metrics by working with the team.
  • Coordinates cross team dependencies with other Scrum master’s and participate in Agile Community of Practice (CoP).
  • Escalates issues that require executive attention.
  • Discovers opportunities to support organizational initiatives and develops strategies and programs to promote initiatives.
  • Participates in the development of programs as a strategic partner that supports the company plan as directed by leadership.
  • Provides planning, project coordination, and management for the development of organizational initiatives, while concurrently facilitating efficient operations to meet current and future business needs within the organization.
  • Responsible for balancing workload to optimize the effectiveness of project development and management.
  • Performs analysis to determine root cause of challenges and provides solutions for improved operational and process performance.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or a technical discipline (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering) required.
  • Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required.
  • Certification or progress toward certification (CSM, SSM) is highly preferred and encouraged.

EXPERIENCE

  • Seven years of progressive responsibility as a scrum master/agile project manager in an insurance environment.
  • Proven experience as a scrum master on several successful software development projects involving multiple developers is preferred.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Clear understanding of one of the agile frameworks and key best practices (Disciplined Agile, SAFe, Scrum, Kanban etc.).
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and planning skills.
  • Must demonstrate leadership ability to effectively interact with all levels of management.
  • Stakeholder Management, Negotiation and Communication skills.
  • Understanding of the fundamentals of iterative and incremental development.
  • Ability to help manage scrum team backlog and priorities using agile based tools (ServiceNow, Jira, Rally/Central Agile, Version1, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and mentoring skills.
  • Ability to effectively present budgetary and/or cost information and respond to questions as appropriate.
  • Demonstrable conflict resolution skills.
  • Demonstrable risk management and mitigation skills.
  • Knowledge of tools used to assist with scrum team planning (ServiceNow, Jira, Agile Manager, Version1, etc.).
  • Ability to be flexible as projects are often non-routine and require re-prioritizing of workload.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.

title: Demand Planner
description:
Job Description:

Are you a sharp, analytical planner who thrives on turning complex data into clear, actionable forecasts?


We are seeking a Demand Planner to join our Royal Canin ANZ team. This is a pivotal role where you will be the driving force behind our forecasting accuracy, ensuring that our beloved nutritional products are available for pets and their owners across Australia and New Zealand.


As a central figure in our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP+) cycle, you will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Category, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain leaders. Your insights will balance supply and demand, optimise our inventory, and directly contribute to our ambitious growth and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.


What will be your key responsibilities?

You will be the architect of our demand forecast, ensuring its accuracy and integrity through five key pillars:

  • S&OP+ Leadership & Collaboration: Facilitate the Demand Management Review (DMR) process, run forecast feeder consensus meetings with Sales, Category and Marketing to align on a single, unbiased forecast that reflects baselines, promotional activities, market trends, and new product launches and integrates strategic objectives.
  • Data-Driven Forecasting & Analysis: Leverage market intelligence and customer insights to develop and maintain a precise 18-month rolling forecast, continuously analyzing root causes to improve forecast accuracy and eliminate bias.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the central communication hub between Sales, Marketing, and Supply, ensuring that all business objectives, supply capabilities, and product lifecycle changes are seamlessly integrated into the demand plan.
  • Systems & Data Integrity: Take full ownership of the demand planning system (e.g. FuturMaster, OMP), ensuring all data—from new SKUs to seasonality parameters—is meticulously maintained to drive a reliable and automated forecast.
  • Continuous Improvement & Project Delivery: Proactively identify opportunities to enhance demand planning processes and tools, leading and supporting strategic supply chain projects that boost efficiency and drive best-in-class performance.

What are we looking for?

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 3 years in demand planning, forecasting, or a similar supply chain role, preferably within the FMCG or consumer goods industry.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel is essential. Experience with forecasting tools (like FuturMaster, OMP, or Blueshift) and data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau) is highly advantageous.
  • Analytical Acumen: Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to translate complex data sets into meaningful business insights.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and align with stakeholders across different functions in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

What You’ll Gain:

  • Purpose: A segment truly passionate about the health of pets, people and the planet with opportunities to support our community partners, including the RSPCA and Seeing Eye Dogs Australia and Blind & Low Vision Guide Dogs in New Zealand.
  • People: A culture that values your contributions, fosters leadership, and recognises the impact you make. Your work truly matters here.
  • Development: Shape your career with personalised development and real opportunities to grow from day one.
  • Enjoy a team and business environment that is invested in helping you manage and grow your energy for work and life.
  • Complimentary Royal Canin pet food for your cat or dog. Dogs are also welcome in our offices.

At Royal Canin, we believe that pets make our world better, and we’re committed to making a better world for pets. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re joining a mission.


About Royal Canin & Mars

At Royal Canin, we are obsessed with creating a better world for pets. For over 50 years, we have been a global leader in pet health nutrition, putting science and precise formulation at the heart of everything we do. As part of the Mars family, we are guided by our purpose: the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today.

As a Mars Associate, you are more than just an employee. You are a trusted partner, empowered with the freedom and responsibility to make a tangible impact. Here, collaboration is key, and our principle of Mutuality ensures that shared benefits create shared success—for our business, our partners, and our Associates.


What we stand for:

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.


Applications will only be accepted from candidates who have the appropriate approval to work in Australia and/or New Zealand.

title: Perfusionist
description:
The CLINICAL PERFUSIONIST is responsible for the set-up and operation of extra-corporeal circulation equipment during certain medical situations where it is necessary to support or temporarily replace the patient’s circulatory and/or respiratory function.

Provides safe and effective Cardio-Pulmonary Bypass (CPB).

  1. Circuit Preparation
    1. Uses sterile technique during set-up.
    2. Properly constructs circuit onto pump.
    3. Completely de-bubbles a primed circuit. Labels with date of priming.
    4. Understands the limitations of all devices used.
    5. Promptly communicates design or function problems.
  2. Heart-Lung Machine Preparation.
    1. Uses all provided machine safety devices.
    2. Uses all provided patient monitoring devices.
    3. Understands all aspects of the OR and pump Medical Gas systems.
    4. Understands all aspects of the OR and pump Electrical systems.
    5. Provides safe use of the Cooler/Heater machines for the patient.
  3. Patient (Data) Preparation.
    1. Reviews patient chart and gathers all relevant information.
    2. Makes plans and decisions with surgeon and/or Anesthesia.
    3. Selects proper cannula and other devices relevant to procedure.
    4. Maintains completeness of Perfusion Record.
    5. Provides safe and effective Cardio-Pulmonary Bypass (CPB).
    6. Is always present during “Time-Out” procedure.
  4. Case Conduct/Management.
    1. Provides safe transition to CPB
    2. Maintains blood pressure and responds appropriately to variances.
    3. Maintains blood flows/volumes and responds appropriately to variances.
    4. Maintains ABGs and ACTs, and responds appropriately to variances.
    5. Provides safe transition from CPB.
  5. Clinical Awareness and Responses.
    1. Maintains pre-, peri-, and post-CPB patient situational awareness.
    2. Promptly responds to patient situational variances.
    3. Promptly communicates situational variances to surgeon or other appropriate team members.
    4. Initiates “Incident Reports” in response to certain variances.
    5. Requests assistance from other team members or other Perfusionists as needed.
  6. Personal Safety.
    1. Always follows universal precautions.
    2. Creates a clutter-free, organized work space in the OR.
    3. Immediately cleans fluid spills in the OR work space.
    4. Disposes of waste with the safety of self and others in mind.
    5. Wipes-down equipment after use.

Provides safe and effective ancillary tasks.

  1. Intra-operative Autologous Blood Salvage (IABS)
    1. Determines Therapeutical Appropriateness of IABS (with surgeon)
    2. Conforms to departmental procedures and policies for IABS
    3. Maintains proficiency in Platelet-Rich Plasma production/Use
    4. Maintains proficiency in Platelet-Gel production/Use
    5. Performs periodic Quality-Control on the IABS blood products.
  2. Intra-Aortic Balloon Pumping (IABP)
    1. Properly constructs and primes pressure monitoring line.
    2. Selects appropriate size IAB catheter
    3. Correctly performs initial IABP machine set-up.
    4. Correctly establishes initial IABP therapy.
    5. Provides transport and trouble-shooting assistance as needed.
  3. Left-Heart Bypass or Veno-Veno Bypass
    1. Properly constructs and primes the circuit
    2. Properly conducts the bypass while allowing patient cardiac output.
    3. Communicates with anesthesia throughout the bypass
    4. Continuously monitors and maintains the patient blood pressure
    5. Understands the capabilities and limits of the bypass procedure
  4. Ventricular Assist Devices (VAD)
    1. Provides assistance to the scrub team in preparing the VAD
    2. Correctly establishes initial function of the VAD driver console
    3. Provides transport assistance and trouble-shooting as needed
  5. ECMO
    1. With the ECMO Specialist, participates in the initiation of ECMO by communicating with the team, helping to prime the circuit, helping to gather needed supplies, helping to establish bypass.
    2. Answers questions the ECMO Specialist might have.
    3. Provides trouble-shooting assistance to the ECMO Specialist.
    4. Assists in decisions about circuit modifications.
    5. Participates and/or instructs in the simulation lab
  6. AngioVac procedures
    1. With the company rep, assists in the operation of the pump/circuit
    2. Orders new supplies as needed.
  7. HIPEC procedure
    1. Properly sets up the machine
    2. Follows surgeon directives
    3. Wears protective gear when handling chemotherapeutic agents
    4. Properly disposes of circuit.
  8. Temporary Pacemaker
    1. Properly sets initial parameters
    2. Properly performs threshold testing as needed
    3. Performs routine battery changes/maintenance
  9. Other Ancillary Duties (Associated with CPB)
    1. Knowledgeable in the function and use of Ultra-Filtration
    2. Knowledgeable in the function and use of Retrograde cardioplegia
    3. Knowledgeable in the function and use of Retrograde cerebral perf
    4. Knowledgeable in the function and use of Antegrade cerebral perf
    5. Knowledgeable in the function and use of Circulatory arrest
    6. Knowledgeable in the function and use of direct coronary perfusion
    7. Knowledgeable in the function and use of vacuum-assisted venous return

Provides periodic ON-CALL service

  1. Responds to caller immediately after receiving a page or cell phone call.
  2. If requested, Reports to worksite within 30 - 45 minutes (ie. ASAP) of receiving page or cell phone call.
  3. Communicates appropriately with “second call” person
  4. At end of day, Notifies the OR Desk that Perfusion is leaving and “On-Call”
  5. Communicates call schedule changes to OR FRONT DESK

Maintains Adequate Perfusion Supplies

  1. Routinely checks for outdates and stocks the Cardiac Mini-Core
  2. Routinely checks for outdates and stocks the pump carts and pumproom
  3. Routinely checks for outdates and stocks the pharmacy/IV supplies
  4. Routinely checks for outdates and stocks the POCT supplies
  5. Monitors the supply levels in the main storeroom and informs director of needs

Provides continuous evaluations of devices and processes

  1. Immediately reports faulty equipment
    1. Follows Clin Eng “Tag-Out” procedure for electrical devices
    2. Retains faulty disposable products for manufacturer analysis
  2. Participates in new product evaluations
    1. provides constructive feedback
  3. Introduces new devices or techniques for evaluation
  4. Discusses problems or “issues” with others to seek improvements and to share information
  5. Strives for cost-containment
  6. Provides assistance to others as needed.
  7. Participates in or initiates and conducts team-oriented in-services
  8. Participates in or initiates and conducts patient data quality-review.

Maintains Education Requirements

title: SENIOR DENTAL AIDE, DENTAL
description:

title: Tehnolog proizvodnih procesov II (m/ž/d) / Process Expert II  (m/f/d)
description:

Band

Job Description Summary

Pridružite se naši ekipi kot Tehnolog proizvodnih procesov II za pogoje okolja (m/ž/d). V tej vlogi boste v ospredju pri obvladovanju in kontroli pogojev okolja v čistih prostorih. In this role, you will be at the forefront of controlling and maintaining environmental conditions in cleanroom environments. You will be responsible for planning and overseeing environmental monitoring and cleaning activities, trending and evaluating results, investigating deviations, and optimizing processes to ensure the safe and compliant manufacture of biological medicines.


Job Description

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:


· Zagotavljanje strokovne podpore na področju vzpostavitve, vzdrževanja in kontrole pogojev okolja v farmacevtski proizvodnji.

· Opravljanje vloge strokovnjaka na svojem področju (SME) za specifične tehnike, izdelke ali tehnološke procese (mikrobiološki in fizikalni pogoji okolja v proizvodnji, postopki vstopa in dezinfekcije, usposabljanje za vzorčenje in aseptične tehnike, planiranje, trendiranje rezultatov, čiščenje in validacije čistih prostorov, validacije avtoklaviranja).

· Usklajevanje in zagotavljanje pravočasnega dokončanja vseh proizvodnih postopkov v skladu z dokumentacijo in pravili dobre proizvodne prakse (GMP).

· Spremljanje rezultatov vzorčenj in ugotavljanje morebitnih trendov ter pravočasno ukrepanje ob opaženih negativnih trendih, priprava periodičnih poročil o izvedenih vzorčenjih.

· Vodenje raziskav odstopov in po potrebi sodelovanje s strokovnjaki relevantnih enot.

· Upravljanje validacij, revalidacij/kvalifikacij ter letnih pregledov procesov v dogovorjenih rokih in po veljavnih predpisih.

· Implementacija in vzdrževanje sistemov kakovosti na lokaciji v skladu s korporativnimi in regulatornimi smernicami ter uvajanje in implementacija novih standardov pri procesih.

· Zagotavljanje ocene tveganj/pomanjkljivosti in določanje učinkovitosti relevantnih korektivnih ukrepov.

· Zagotavljanje splošne pripravljenosti na inšpekcijske preglede ter interne presoje za svoje področje odgovornosti.


Vaš Doprinos k Delovnem Mestu:


· Univerzitetna stopnja izobrazbe iz mikrobiologije, biotehnologije, biologije, farmacije ali druge ustrezne znanstvene smeri.

· Aktivno znanje angleškega in slovenskega jezika.

· Poznavanje orodij MS Office.

· Odlične komunikacijske veščine, sposobnost samostojnega dela, odločanja ter postavljanja prioritet.

· Zanimanje za digitalizacijo, avtomatizacijo procesov in uporabo umetne inteligence pri izboljševanju delovnih procesov.

· Zaželeno poznavanje mikrobioloških osnov in poznavanje GMP.



Ponujamo začasno pogodbo za obdobje 12 mesecev.


Ugodnosti in nagrajevanje:

Konkurenčen plačni paket, letni bonus, fleksibilen način dela z možnostjo prilagajanja urnika in delom od doma, pokojninska shema, možnost vključitve v kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje, shema nagrajevanja in priznanja dosežkov, razširjeni

program promocije zdravja na področju fizičnega in duševnega dobrega počutja ter delovne obremenitve (Polni življenja), številne priložnosti za učenje in razvoj.


V Novartisu smo predani soustvarjanju medicine in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo.

22,050.00 - 40,950.00 EUR

Poleg osnovne plače ste lahko upravičeni tudi do kratkoročnega bonusa, ki je odvisen od določenih meril uspešnosti.

Zaposlenim nudimo nabor konkurenčnih ugodnosti, ki podpirajo strokovni in osebni razvoj, vključno s programi zavarovanj, pokojninsko shemo, aktivnostmi za dobro počutje ter programe za prepoznavanje dosežkov zaposlenih v skladu z internimi akti delodajalca. _____________________________

Key Responsibilities:

· Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for specific techniques, products, or technological processes, including microbiological and physical environmental conditions in manufacturing, gowning and disinfection procedures, training on sampling and aseptic techniques, planning and trending of environmental monitoring results, cleanroom cleaning and validation, and autoclave validation.

· Coordinate and ensure the timely completion of all manufacturing activities in accordance with approved documentation and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.

· Monitor environmental sampling results, identify potential trends, take timely action in response to adverse trends, and prepare periodic reports on environmental monitoring activities.

· Implement and maintain site quality systems in accordance with corporate and regulatory requirements, and support the introduction and implementation of new process standards.

Essential requirements:

· Proficiency in both English and Slovenian.

· Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools.

· Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work independently, make decisions, and effectively prioritize tasks.

· Interest in digitalization, process automation, and the application of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve work processes.

title: Customer Engagement Lead (Hampshire & Isle of Wight)
description:
Closing Date

12/10/2026

Job Title: Customer Engagement Lead (Hampshire & Isle of Wight)

Location: This role requires an on-site presence across the Hampshire and Isle of Wight areas, occasional travel to our Head Offices in Worthing and Falmer will also be required. This is a hybrid role, offering the opportunity to work from home as well.

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: 37 hours per week, Monday - Friday

Salary: From £35,000+ commensurate to skills and experience.

Are you passionate about building strong relationships with communities and helping major infrastructure projects land well with the people they affect?

There has never been a better time to join Southern Water as we invest in the future of our water and wastewater infrastructure, tackle climate change, minimise our environmental impact and reduce our carbon footprint.

Job Overview

We are looking for a tenacious, empathetic and confident Customer Engagement Lead to support both our Capital Projects and Major Projects programmes across Hampshire and the Isle of Wight.

You will plan, coordinate and deliver strategic customer and community engagement activities, acting as a visible and trusted link between our project teams, delivery partners and the communities affected by our work. Your focus will be on keeping people informed, anticipating concerns, resolving issues and protecting and enhancing Southern Water’s reputation through clear, timely and transparent communication.

This is a varied and autonomous role covering water and wastewater projects of different sizes and complexity. You will spend time out on site, build strong local knowledge and relationships, and help ensure our customers feel heard and supported throughout project delivery.

What you’ll be doing

  • Leading the development and delivery of project-specific customer and community engagement plans across both Capital Projects and Major Projects.
  • Acting as a named point of contact for customers and communities, providing clear, proactive and timely updates.
  • Visiting project sites regularly to understand the local impact of works, build trust and identify potential issues early.
  • Working with project teams and delivery partners to reduce complaints and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Listening to and addressing customer concerns, including managing sensitive or challenging conversations with empathy and confidence.
  • Advising project teams on the most appropriate communication channels and engagement approach for different audiences.
  • Creating clear and engaging communications, including customer letters, project updates and information for media or stakeholder teams.
  • Liaising with internal and external stakeholders, community groups, local organisations and other interested parties.
  • Ensuring engagement activity meets relevant regulatory reporting, branding and customer excellence standards.
  • Maintaining accurate records, reporting on engagement activity and handling commercially sensitive information with discretion.
  • Supporting engagement outside normal working hours where project or community needs require it.


What you’ll bring to the role:

You will be a self-starter and a genuine people person who is comfortable working independently across a broad geographical area. You will combine strong customer instincts with sound judgement, resilience and the confidence to handle difficult conversations while finding practical solutions.

You’ll bring:

  • Proven experience in customer management, community engagement, communications or another public-facing role (e.g teaching or coaching)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your approach to different audiences.
  • A strong understanding of different communication channels and how to use them effectively.
  • A customer-first attitude and the ability to build rapport quickly.
  • Strategic thinking, good organisation and the ability to drive your own workplan.
  • Confidence in handling complaints, sensitive issues and challenging situations.
  • Creativity, attention to detail and the ability to think practically when solving problems.
  • A flexible and collaborative approach, with the ability to work across functions and with delivery partners.
  • High integrity and discretion when handling commercially sensitive information.
  • A full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle, with the ability to travel regularly across Hampshire and the Isle of Wight and occasionally further afield.

Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. title: Quality Assurance and Operational Risk Specialist
description:

“Drive better customer outcomes. Strengthen controls. Make a real impact.”

The role and what you’ll lead and deliver:

Castle Trust Bank is looking for a detail-oriented and analytically minded Quality Assurance & Operational Risk Specialist to join our growing team.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role within the First Line of Defence, supporting the effective operation of Quality Assurance and Operational Risk frameworks across the business. You will help ensure that operational processes are delivered consistently, risks are identified early, and customer outcomes remain at the heart of everything we do.

Working closely with Operations, Risk and Compliance teams, you will use data, insight and robust oversight to identify control weaknesses, support remediation activity and drive continuous improvement across the Bank.

You will:

Quality Assurance

  • Conduct quality assurance reviews across operational processes using agreed methodologies.
  • Complete call, case and process assessments to evaluate customer outcomes, regulatory compliance and process adherence.
  • Participate in calibration activities to ensure consistency and accuracy of QA assessments.
  • Identify trends, themes and emerging risks through QA reviews.
  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to support performance improvement.
  • Maintain accurate records of QA findings in line with governance requirements.
  • Support the production of management information and reporting through accurate data capture and analysis.
  • Contribute to the continuous enhancement of QA frameworks, processes and templates.

Operational Risk

  • Support the day-to-day delivery of First Line Operational Risk activities.
  • Assist with: Incident and breach logging, Issue assessment and triage, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Remediation tracking, Evaluation of remediation effectiveness
  • Ensure incidents and issues are accurately recorded and escalated where appropriate.
  • Monitor remediation progress and highlight overdue or at-risk actions.
  • Identify recurring issues, emerging risks and control weaknesses across the business.
  • Support colleagues in understanding and managing operational risks.
  • Contribute to thematic reviews, analysis and reporting.

Governance & Stakeholder Support

  • Produce high-quality management information and reporting for governance forums.
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Risk and Compliance teams.
  • Provide meaningful data and insight to support decision-making.
  • Support internal audits, regulatory reviews and assurance activities where required.

What you’ll bring:

We are looking for someone who thrives in a governance-driven and regulated environment and has a strong customer and outcomes-focused mindset. You will be naturally curious and driven by data and insight and comfortable providing constructive challenge and seeing issues through to resolution.

In addition you will have the following experience:

  • Experience within Quality Assurance, Operational Risk, Risk & Control, Operational Oversight or similar functions in a regulated environment.
  • Experience of First Line risk in a FCA regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of operational processes, controls and risk management principles.
  • Experience identifying trends, root causes and process improvement opportunities.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience producing management information and reporting.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Why join Castle Trust Bank?

description:
Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago provides superior pediatric care in a setting that offers the latest benefits and innovations in medical technology, research and family-friendly design. As the largest pediatric provider in the region with a 140-year legacy of excellence, kids and their families are at the center of all we do. Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago is ranked in all 10 specialties by the U.S. News & World Report.

Day (United States of America)

Location
