Job Description

Performs routine and specialized tests in Genetics Laboratory, independently or with minimal supervision. Recognizes the clinical significance of each test performed and reports results within established time frames. The position actively supports the Hospital’s and the Department’s Continuous Quality Improvement and customer service goals through modeling of appropriate behavior and by providing a work environment conducive to attaining these goals.


Job Duties:

  • Performs clinical assays in the Cytogenetics Lab. Prepares specimens for analysis and/or storage and plans workload. Prepares laboratory reagents for the analyses, sets up appropriate controls, performs analyses and calculates final results. Recognizes abnormal results and notifies supervisor.
  • Ensures that laboratory specimens are correctly labeled, logged in to the Sunquest laboratory system and assigned laboratory ID numbers.
  • Sets up and/or maintains cell cultures for chromosome analysis, harvests cultures and makes slides. Does routine tissue culture of fibroblasts.
  • Screens chromosome slides to determine modal count and groups several metaphases to check morphology. Performs banding procedures and fluorescence in situ hybridization. Computer imaging. Karyotyping.
  • Quality control surveillance. Evaluates results of standard and control analyses and recognizes and reports “out-of range’ conditions. Documents results of these analyses. Participates in CAP survey.
  • Maintains record-keeping and results reporting. Verifies and monitors laboratory charges.
  • Orders and maintains lab supplies and equipment. Orders and maintains supplies of chemicals, glassware, and equipment.
  • Applies scientific method in problem-solving and assists in the evaluation of new methods and techniques. Assures that quality control criteria are met and adheres to established laboratory policies in handling hazardous substances.
  • Follows clinical laboratory testing procedures and policies in the performance of routine and specialized tests. Identifies source and nature of test problems and makes appropriate recommendation as to course of action.
  • Records necessary documentation to comply with various agency and Hospital regulations. Performs required instrument maintenance at the prescribed time and logs appropriately. Is able to perform minor trouble-shooting on instrumentation.
  • Handles shipping and related processes for samples which must be sent outside the institution.
  • Performs job functions adhering to service principles with customer service focus of innovation, service excellence and teamwork to provide the highest quality care and service to our patients, families, co-workers and others.
  • Completes competency testing and mandatory and continuing education requirements as defined by the position.
  • Other job functions as assigned, such as developing, coordinating, assessing, and documenting competency testing.

Minimum Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Biological Science, Genetics, or related field required
  • Meets all regulatory requirements for moderate or high complexity testing as appropriate.
  • Must be able to discern red/green color.
  • CG (ASCP) preferred.

roles and responsibilities

documentation, data, and operational practices.

to address identified issues and enhance quality assurance practices.

them to relevant stakeholders.

compliance with quality standards.

of audit findings.

culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Experience: 9+ yrs

Location: India

Job Type: Full-time

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer with 9+ years of experience in software quality engineering and a strong track record of building scalable automation frameworks rather than simply operating existing test suites.

The role requires deep expertise across UI automation, API testing, backend validation, CI/CD, performance engineering, event-driven systems, and cloud-native applications. You will play a key role in establishing robust quality engineering practices, improving test automation coverage, and embedding continuous testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on engineering capabilities with the ability to design maintainable automation architecture and drive quality improvements across complex software systems.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for complex software applications.
  • Develop robust UI automation using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or comparable frameworks.
  • Build automated API and integration tests using tools such as Rest Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies.
  • Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, API, data, and end-to-end testing.
  • Implement backend and database validation using SQL and other data-validation techniques.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and rapid quality feedback.
  • Work with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms to automate test execution and reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, reliability, execution speed, and maintainability.
  • Design reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and frameworks that can scale across products and teams.
  • Perform root-cause analysis of test failures and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve defects and quality issues.
  • Develop testing approaches for event-driven and distributed systems, including Kafka-based applications.
  • Contribute to performance engineering, including performance testing, bottleneck identification, and system behaviour analysis.
  • Validate cloud-native applications and services deployed across environments such as Azure and Kubernetes.
  • Establish quality gates and automated validation within software delivery pipelines.
  • Collaborate with developers and technical teams to shift testing earlier in the development lifecycle.
  • Maintain automation standards, technical documentation, test strategies, and engineering best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging testing tools and technologies to improve quality engineering effectiveness.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 9–12 years of experience in software quality engineering, QA automation, or a closely related engineering role.
  • Proven experience building automation frameworks from the ground up, not just executing or maintaining existing frameworks.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or comparable automation frameworks.
  • Strong experience with API automation, including Rest Assured, Postman, or similar tools.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience performing backend, database, and data validation.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and continuous testing practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent CI/CD technologies.
  • Experience with performance engineering and performance testing.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and Kafka/event-driven architectures.
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications, preferably within Azure and Kubernetes environments.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, automation architecture, test strategy, and quality engineering principles.
  • Excellent debugging, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong programming and scripting capabilities for developing maintainable automation solutions.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, DevOps engineers, product teams, and other technical stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive automation and quality initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical quality issues clearly.

title: Facilities Technician
description:
Job Description:


Job Description

Mars Wrigley – CLV Site

Cleveland, TN

Facilities Maintenance- Building and Grounds-

Monday through Thursday 5:00am - 3:30pm, overtime required based on business needs.


The Facilities Maintenance Technician for Building and Grounds is responsible for providing general maintenance and construction as assigned. Upon arrival at the assigned project, the Facilities Maintenance Technician must visually assess and troubleshoot the maintenance issue to correctly make the necessary repairs. The Facilities Maintenance Technician will determine what equipment is needed and the scope of the job as it relates to the following areas: electrical, plumbing, carpentry, masonry, landscaping, or drainage. After assessing what is necessary to repair the issue, the Facilities Maintenance Technician must order all parts, supplies, and equipment as necessary. Tools that will be used range from common hand and power tools, such as hammers, hoists, saws, drills, and wrenches, to precise measuring instruments and electrical and electronic testing devices. The Facilities Maintenance Technician will work collaboratively with contractors, and others within the company while also being able to work independently on each assigned task.


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Adhere to quality expectations and standards.
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others.
  • Support team to reach common goals.
  • Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other Associates, and communicate effectively, both verbally and written, with others using clear and professional language
  • Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance
  • Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders
  • Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping
  • Enter and locate work-related information using computers and communicate with others using computers and electronic devices
  • Perform other reasonable job duties as requested including but not limited to: floor repair, replacing tiles, vinyl flooring, repair / replace doors, door closers, maintenance on dock doors and dock locks, replacing ac filters, water filters, painting, replacing light bulbs, replacing ceiling tiles, repairing toilets / urinals, PM compactors / Bailers etc., assembly of office furniture, moving office furniture, and any other task assigned as the company requires

What skills are we looking for?

  • Capable of troubleshooting, repairing and overhauling equipment within close tolerances.
  • Support Operations in equipment setup, changeover, and training of operators in autonomous maintenance (AM) activities.
  • Document work orders (WO)/preventative maintenance (PM's) using computerized maintenance management system (SAP-PPM Plant Maintenance)
  • Effectively communicate with machine operators, peers, supervisors and all levels of management on a daily basis
  • Provide enthusiastic support where needed and complete other duties as assigned by Team Leader
  • Demonstrate engagement in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) Theory and Concepts through participation in Pillar Teams, training fellow Mechanics/Operators in autonomous (AM) activities and conducting Breakdown Analysis
  • Understand and adhere to Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) procedures, confined space procedures and all other plant safety/good manufacturing practices (GMP) requirements related to supporting machinery uptime
  • Possess essential personal tools needed to support mechanical ability
  • Willingness to develop required technical skills in welding, basic machinist, and fabrication/layout skill sets

Preferred skills:

  • Possess an advanced understanding of AC/DC electrical (up to 480-volt 3 phase), hydraulic and pneumatic schematics and mechanical drawings to solve problems in a timely manner
  • Technical/ Trade certification in welding, advanced machinist skills, fabrication, and blueprint interpretation
  • Possess PLC/ Instrumentation troubleshooting skills

Educational and Professional Requirements:


Minimum Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Technical Degree/Trade Certification OR 2+ years work experience related to industrial maintenance
  • Possess a fundamental understanding of Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic Schematics and/or Mechanical Drawings in order to solve problems with equipment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in a technical discipline, preferably in Industrial Maintenance/Technology
  • Technical/ Trade Certification in: Welding, Advanced Machinist Skills, fabrication, and blueprint interpretation

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Oracle ERP Business Systems Analyst
description:
We are currently hiring an Oracle ERP Business Systems Analyst for our Sunnyvale, CA location. This position is the first line support analyst responsible for monitoring Oracle EBS production environment and triage and resolve Oracle tickets. Oracle EBS production support team, the first line of support to business users.
As liaison between business and IT technical resources, we help the business on their issues and enhancements. Prioritize and participate system developments, coordinate user testing and production deployments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitors tickets to Oracle EBS production and performs first level troubleshooting
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting ERP system issues reported by end users
  • Developing documentation for ERP systems, including specifications, configurations, and business processes
  • Providing training and support to ERP system users
  • Participating in system upgrades and testing to ensure functionality and efficiency
  • Creating and delivering reports on ERP system

Qualifications & Skills:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or Business

Experience: 4+ years working as a Business Systems Analyst with hands-on Oracle EBS R12 experience. Good knowledge in Oracle EBS functional modules (OM, WSH, INV, AP, AR, GL). Production Support experiences in System Admin.

Analytical skills with ability to troubleshoot problems and identify root causes.

Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL/PL*SQL, understanding of relational database tables, and module-specific configurations. Knowledge of Oracle Cloud e-business Application is a plus.

Soft Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to adapt to changing situations, multi-tasking, prioritizations and deadlines. Work well independently and in a team environment.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $121,000-$148,000. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

Why Join Us:

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being.

Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000+ customers around the globe.

title: Aviation Architects
description:
Every journey begins and ends somewhere. At Grimshaw, we design the places where those journeys happen, and we are looking for architects to join the aviation team in our London studio in Clerkenwell.

Aviation has been part of our story for decades. From the Landside and Airside Centres at Zurich Airport to the terminal at Istanbul Airport, one of the largest in the world, our teams have shaped how millions of people arrive, depart and connect. Closer to home, we were selected as concept designers for the expansion of Heathrow Airport and have worked on Heathrow's Pier 4A. Across our global studios, we have led the design of a new terminal at Newark Liberty International Airport and the master plan for JFK International Airport.

The role

You will contribute to complex airport projects at every scale, from master planning and terminal design to the detail of how a passenger finds their way from kerb to gate. Aviation design rewards people who enjoy solving problems: balancing operational demands, passenger experience, sustainability and the character of the place that each airport serves. You will work closely with engineers, planners, airport operators and colleagues in our studios around the world.

Life in our studio

Our studios are friendly and democratic, and good ideas are welcomed from everyone, whatever their role or level of experience. With over 500 people and more than 50 nationalities across seven studios worldwide, you will be part of a genuinely global practice. We offer hybrid working, with core hours that give you flexibility over how you structure your day.

Is this you?

  • You hold ARB registration or an equivalent international professional qualification in architecture.
  • You have experience on aviation projects, or on other large and complex transport or infrastructure projects where your skills would transfer.
  • You work confidently in Autodesk Revit environments.
  • You care about design quality and pay close attention to detail.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working as part of medium and large project teams.
  • You are keen to contribute to studio life and to support junior colleagues.

If this role excites you but you don't meet every point above, we would still encourage you to apply.

What you can expect from us

  • Work on airport projects that shape how people travel and experience cities
  • Opportunities for mentoring, international collaboration and career development
  • The freedom to be creative, to challenge yourself and to grow
  • An inclusive, supportive culture, whatever your background or route into architecture

Our commitment to inclusion

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will be glad to help.

How to apply

Please submit your CV, portfolio and work samples in a standard format that can be read by applicant tracking systems. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Please note: any offer of employment is conditional upon your having the right to work in the UK.

title: Residence Director
description:
Reporting to the Associate Dean of Students for Residential Life, Residence directors (RDs) are responsible for the oversight of an undergraduate residential area of approximately 500 undergraduate students and supervision of student staff members. RDs are professional staff who are on-call and live in campus housing, interacting directly and intentionally with residents throughout the year to develop a safe, strong, and vibrant learning community.

This is a full-time, benefits eligible, salaried position with a hiring range of $50,778 - $60,125 per year.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate hiring, training, and supervision of student staff
  • Oversee and manage assigned undergraduate residential halls and area
  • Triage and provide support and referrals for students, including assisting with student case management needs
  • Respond, adjudicate and refer behavior and conduct issue
  • Assist with residential education development and programming
  • Demonstrate a commitment to ongoing professional growth and development in all areas of responsibility and explicitly equity and inclusion
  • Participate in year-round on-call rotation for Middlebury, VT campus-based programs, providing crisis intervention and serving as a resource or referral agent, including during College breaks

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Higher Education, College Student Personnel/Student Affairs, Counseling or a related field preferred OR two years of post undergraduate, directly related residential life experience
  • Knowledge of current theories, processes and practices related to student affairs, student development, and residential education
  • Demonstrated commitment to principles of inclusivity
  • Proficiency in responding to campus-based emergencies and crisis situations
  • Excellent interpersonal communications skills, including in the facilitation of difficult conversations and conflict mediation

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

Core responsibilities require mobility around campus and multiple buildings during days and evenings, this includes a combination of walking and climbing stairs. Regularly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery. Must be able to remain in a stationary position 75% of the time. Will need to regularly move about inside the office and will require regular cross-campus travel to access resources and personnel in other buildings. Requires presentation of content/materials in training sessions. May require limited and infrequent in-state and out-of-state trips for training, professional meetings, and professional development. Frequent late night, weekend, and on-call responsibilities required, and required to live on campus in a provided apartment.

Other:

An offer for this position is contingent upon successful completion of a criminal background check and references.

Benefits

As an employee of Middlebury College in Vermont, you will enjoy being part of a vibrant supportive community.

Middlebury offers its employees excellent compensation and competitive health, dental, life, disability, generous retirement matching, and vision benefits, and a generous time-away program - up to 34 days per year, increasing as the term of service lengthens. Employees are eligible for robust educational assistance programs. The result is a very high quality-of-life in a gorgeous setting. Middlebury Colleges offers its employees excellent compensation and other perks of employment including:

  • MiddCard Privileges: access to athletic facilities, discounts at the college store, library privileges, and cultural and sporting events. Spouses or domestic partners are eligible to receive a card with the same privileges.
  • Discounts on season passes at Middlebury College's Snow Bowl, the Ralph Myhre Golf Course and the Rikert Outdoor Center.
  • Access to our Partner Inclusion Program that provides comprehensive support services to the spouses and partners of Middlebury employees.
  • A full listing of our benefit offerings can be found on our website or click to see some of the other fun perks of working at Middlebury, whether in Middlebury, VT or Monterey, CA!

Middlebury College is an equal-opportunity employer where diversity, equity, and inclusion are core values. To this end, the College recruits talented and diverse faculty, staff, and students from across the United States and around the world. Middlebury College encourages applications from women, people of color, people with disabilities, and members of other protected classes and historically underrepresented communities. The College also invites applications from individuals who demonstrate an ongoing commitment to advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

title: Senior Fuel Technician
description:

Fuel Systems Technician (Entry & Senior Level)

$30-$34/hr Savannah, GA (31405)

Nouria Energy Corporation

Power the systems that keep our communities moving.

What You’ll Do

  • Diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining fuel dispensers, underground storage tanks (USTs), leak detection systems, and vapor recovery units

title: Tools Developer | Shared Tech
description:
Craft:

Technology & Development

Job Description:

King operates mobile games at a massive scale. With titles like Candy Crush, Candy Crush Soda Saga and Farm Heroes Saga, our code runs on hundreds of millions of devices across the world. We believe that the right tools in the right hands are key to our success as a company.


If you want to boost productivity for the teams creating entertainment for millions of players to enjoy on the go then this is the right job for you. As Tools Developer, you will drive innovation and take a lead in creating and maintaining tools and pipelines for our mobile casual games.


This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work as B2B organizations working across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engines themselves. The vision within Shared Tech is "We are the stage where King games love to perform”.


You will be working in Shared Tech’s Game Production organization, where we focus on game-changing tooling and infrastructure to enable our content creators to build features faster, easier and more reliably. This includes working across multiple teams to facilitate both architectural decisions and hands-on development to support smaller feature teams based on rolling needs.


You should have a broad range of knowledge and be able to context switch easily to provide active support across the whole team and beyond. The ability to see the project as a whole is crucial as you monitor the development in real- time to determine how we should support and assist the rest of the development team. You’ll also play a key role in improving our feedback loop, making it easier for teams to adopt tools and for our team to learn what’s working (or not). Strong communication and empathy for end users are essential.


King is a place where we build features in the open, collaboratively. We value diverse opinions and make sure every voice is heard. We offer you the freedom and opportunity to work on fulfilling tasks and to continue your journey as an expert tools developer. Your Role Within Our Kingdom You will enjoy a creative, challenging and collaborative environment where your ideas will be every bit as valued as your programming expertise.


Your role within the Kingdom

Some of your responsibilities include:

  • Improve, innovate and maintain current tooling infrastructure and in-house editing toolset
  • Design, architect, maintain, test and implement tools at scale
  • Collaborate with various current and future users of our tools, bridging various crafts within King with the intent to optimize, improve and discover workflows across games
  • Deliver high quality and well-structured code
  • Improve quality and performance inside our tools landscape
  • Share knowledge and best practices with peers and game teams
  • Drive and support tool adoption with stakeholders in the game teams across King
  • Coach and mentor more junior developers, helping them grow in technical areas such as architecture, development patterns or testing.

Skills to Create Thrills

You are a programmer who enjoys an array of challenges, and strives to deliver great products and technology. You are a self-starter, curious and a fast learner. You are excited to contribute to live games with a massive user base. You question the status quo and strive for effective innovations as much as you like maintaining and extending existing software. You enjoy being in contact with users of your tools and use their feedback to improve your work.

  • Excellent Python knowledge with experience implementing high-quality standalone and web applications, paired with strong C++ experience.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Highly experienced with testing, automation and continuous integration
  • Experienced with tools development and strong desire to work with tools
  • Experience with performance-critical software is a bonus
  • Ability to work closely with cross-discipline teams to understand their needs
  • High sense of code quality and polish and the desire to build and maintain a high-quality code base
  • Ability to develop on multiple platforms: Windows and OSX
  • Frontend skills (JS/TS, experience with web frontend frameworks)

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Cloud frameworks / technologies (GCP, Docker, k8s etc)
  • Experience with game editor extension systems (e.g., Unity Editor scripting, Unreal Editor tooling, or custom C++/Qt editor frameworks)
  • Familiarity with using observability tools, for example Sentry or Grafana
  • Experience facilitating workshops or leading technical presentations internally

What we offer

In Shared Tech, our team is focused on supporting multiple game teams with high quality tools. We take pride in the tools that we deliver, and the team that builds them. We are looking for a new voice in this context and want to find someone who has the technical skills we need while also contributing to the team as a whole. We have prioritized trust and open communication as the cornerstone of our team culture.


Finding the right mix of autonomy and support is another important aspect of work in this team. We enable this by making sure that information is shared effectively and prioritizing supporting each other when help is needed. We have chosen this approach since we believe in creating an environment that enables us to actively contribute to shaping the way we move forward. While also making sure that we, as a group, are aligned. This requires a sense of responsibility from us all, something which we are also proud of.


We believe that in order to remain competitive we need to grow in our roles, we support this by investing time and effort into personal development continuously throughout the year.


We also offer truly awesome benefits here at King in addition to a thriving social calendar of events for Kingsters to really get to know each other.


A Great Saga Needs All Sorts of Heroes

Making games is fun. Especially when you do it with people who share the same idea of what makes a good workplace great. We design games for everyone, no matter where they are or who they are, and we employ all sorts of people from all kinds of backgrounds to bring them to life. Truth is, we simply cannot expect diversity in our players and originality in our games without first nurturing it in our people. A great saga needs all sorts of heroes.


Making the World Playful

Making the World Playful is what inspires us to create new experiences and raise the bar. It’s what makes King a place where we can all dream bigger, continue to add innovation to our games, broadening the portfolio and exploring new territories in mid- core and casual. We take the art and science of gaming to the next level through our curiosity for the unexplored, passion for games, respect for each other and love for our players – and we’re not afraid to have fun along the way. In fact, together with our parent company Activision Blizzard and experts around the world, we believe having fun is good for you. There has never been a better time to join us. We're dreaming bigger and see a world of possibilities ahead. If you share our passion, our values, and our hunger to shape the future, join us in Making the World Playful!


Applications need to be in English.

Discover King at careers.king.com


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Platform Engineer to design, implement, secure, and operate scalable cloud-native platforms using Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes. The role focuses on building highly available, resilient, secure, and well-governed production environments while driving automation, observability, infrastructure-as-code, and platform engineering best practices.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise across Azure, AKS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, cloud governance, security, observability, and Disaster Recovery, along with the ability to provide technical leadership across complex platform environments.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and manage Microsoft Azure infrastructure and AKS/Kubernetes platforms.
  • Implement and maintain Disaster Recovery, backup, restore, and business continuity solutions.
  • Build infrastructure automation using Terraform, Helm, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Kubernetes networking, ingress, storage, namespaces, resource limits, security, and platform configurations.
  • Implement observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and related monitoring technologies.
  • Manage TLS certificates, secrets, access controls, RBAC, and platform security mechanisms.
  • Establish cloud and Kubernetes governance covering resource organisation, naming, tagging, security policies, and operational standards.
  • Define Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD governance, including reusable Terraform modules, state management, code reviews, approval gates, environment promotion, and artifact management.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design reviews for platforms, applications, integrations, and infrastructure changes.
  • Drive security and compliance readiness through vulnerability remediation, access reviews, security baselines, audit controls, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and monitor platform availability, SLIs, SLOs, capacity, performance, and operational health.
  • Lead incident and problem management, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and prevention of recurring issues.
  • Perform capacity planning, performance optimisation, and cloud cost optimisation / FinOps activities.
  • Own DR testing, RTO/RPO validation, backup and recovery standards, and periodic recovery exercises.
  • Plan and execute platform migrations, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging platform technologies, conduct POCs, and establish approved patterns for production adoption.
  • Maintain technical documentation including HLDs, LLDs, architecture diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and DR procedures.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing across platform engineering teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes, particularly AKS.
  • Strong experience with Docker, Helm, Terraform, and Azure DevOps / CI/CD.
  • Good understanding of Azure networking, including VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, and Azure Firewall.
  • Experience implementing observability using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or similar platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux, Bash scripting, Git, and GitOps practices.
  • Proven experience with Disaster Recovery, backup/restore, RTO/RPO planning, and recovery testing.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes security, governance, RBAC, policy enforcement, and Azure Policy.
  • Experience establishing reusable Infrastructure-as-Code patterns and platform engineering standards.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD governance, release controls, environment promotion, and source-control standards.
  • Experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, or Azure SQL.
  • Strong knowledge of incident management, problem management, RCA, capacity planning, performance optimisation, and cloud cost management.
  • Experience working in security-, compliance-, audit-, or governance-controlled environments.
  • Ability to create and maintain HLDs, LLDs, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, SOPs, and technical documentation.
  • Strong experience participating in architecture and technical design reviews.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong technical leadership, mentoring, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience in banking or other regulated industries would be an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, production operations, platform modernisation, and cloud transformation initiatives.

description:

This role provides clear direction and is accountable for the team’s overall performance and effectiveness. The Lead typically serves as the primary trainer and/or coordinates training efforts within the department and is responsible for the onboarding and integration of new associates.

title: Senior Director, Finance & Strategy
description:
Position Summary

About Us

Now part of Light & Wonder, Grover Gaming brings a legacy of innovation, integrity, and game design excellence to every aspect of our growing team. Known for award-winning gaming experiences and an energizing workplace culture, Grover has built a reputation as a top employer and a trusted name in charitable gaming. Together, we're expanding our reach and reshaping the future of the industry.

Position Overview

We are looking for a senior finance leader to serve as the right hand to the CFO and the financial center of gravity for the Grover Gaming business unit. This role owns financial planning and analysis end-to-end: the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, the long-range plan, month-end results, and the reporting that goes to executive leadership and the board. Just as important, this role partners directly with the CEO and the VP of Strategy to find, build, and implement the initiatives that expand margin and accelerate growth. You will also actively drive optimization initiatives across our markets, partnering with the Data Analytics and Strategy teams.


The person we need is a Swiss Army knife. Technically sound enough to build the model, not just review it. Credible enough to hold the room in front of executives. Curious enough to have a real point of view on content and hardware roadmaps, game mix, analytics, and commercial strategy. Success in this role looks like being the first call when a decision has a number attached to it, and the person who makes sure that we make the right decision and that decision actually gets implemented.



Role Objectives

  • Own the full planning cycle for the business unit: annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, long range plan, and monthly close reporting and analytics.
  • Serve as trusted advisor and decision partner to the CEO, the VP of Strategy, and the broader leadership team.
  • Translate operating drivers (units in market, hold per-unit per-day, location performance, game mix, denomination trends) into financial outcomes and forward-looking guidance.
  • Build and lead optimization initiatives that improve margin, capital efficiency, and process throughput, from idea through implementation and measured result.
  • Bring financial rigor to content and hardware roadmap decisions, new market entry, and capital deployment.
  • Develop the finance and analytics team, raising both technical depth and the standard of business partnership, consistent metric definitions, trusted data, automated reporting, and faster time to insight.
  • Represent the business-unit results and outlook to corporate finance and executive leadership.

Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own the annual budget, quarterly forecast cycles, and the multi-year long range plan, including scenario construction and clear bridges and variance insights between plan versions.
  • Lead month-end close review and variance analysis (full P&L and capital expenditure), explaining results in driver terms (volume, rate, mix, timing) rather than account-level noise.
  • Build and maintain the financial models that connect unit deployment, hold per-unit per-day, revenue share economics, and cost structure to P&L and cash outcomes.
  • Deliver board-level and executive reporting: QBR materials, monthly business reviews, earnings support, and rapid-turn analysis for the CEO and CFO.
  • Own capital planning and ROI governance for gaming equipment, including deployment, swap, and refresh decisions, plus post-implementation review of actual returns.
  • Partner with corporate FP&A and accounting on consolidation, purchase accounting impacts, and reporting alignment.

Strategy & Optimization

  • Partner with the VP of Strategy and the CEO to build the pipeline of optimization initiatives, size each opportunity, and pressure-test the assumptions behind it.
  • Move initiatives from analysis to execution by defining owners, milestones, and measurable targets, then tracking realized value against the original business case.
  • Lead the financial evaluation of new market entry and jurisdiction expansion, including regulatory constraints, revenue share structures, and ramp assumptions.
  • Build business cases for pricing, contract terms, and distributor and charity partner economics.
  • Identify structural cost and process improvement opportunities across the business and drive them to completion.

Commercial & Product Thought Leadership

  • Bring the financial and analytical lens to content roadmap decisions: performance by theme, math model, and price point, return on investments, and the right mix by market.
  • Support hardware and cabinet strategy with lifecycle cost, deployment economics, and churn and replacement analysis.
  • Partner with sales and operations on location and route level performance, underperformance diagnostics, and corrective action plans.
  • Turn market, competitor, and regulatory data into commercial insight that shapes pricing, incentives, and market prioritization.

Leadership & Controls

  • Lead, coach, and develop the finance team, building technical capability and succession depth.
  • Maintain internal controls, policies, and approval frameworks appropriate to a public company environment.
  • Foster an environment of trust, accuracy, integrity, and candor while delivering actionable, high-quality results.
  • Set the standard for how finance shows up: proactive, articulate, and focused on decisions backed by data rather than reports.

What You Bring

  • A deep technical FP&A foundation. You can build the model, stress the assumptions, and defend the output line-by-line.
  • Leadership presence. You can present to group of executives, tell the story, hold a position under pressure, and tell executives what you actually think and back it up.
  • Rigorous standards on data quality, accuracy, and a relentless pursuit of constant process improvements.
  • A track record of driving initiatives to completion across functions you do not control.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete data, paired with strong root cause instincts.
  • Real curiosity about the product, the player, and the customer, not just the P&L.
  • Hands-on analytical horsepower. You go to the data yourself rather than waiting on a report.
  • Experience supporting product, content, or capital deployment roadmap decisions.
  • The ability to build trust quickly with a diverse set of stakeholders (operators, engineers, sales leaders, and executives).

Required:

  • 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior-level FP&A leadership with direct reports.
  • Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, or similar. MBA and/or CPA preferred.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a complete planning cycle (budget, forecast, long range plan) for a business unit or larger.
  • Advanced financial modeling and data analysis skills, with working knowledge of GAAP and public company reporting requirements.
  • Experience implementing AI automations to streamline processes and improve business decision making.
  • Proven ability to influence and partner cross-functionally at the executive level.



Preferred:

  • Experience in gaming, lottery, charitable gaming, or another regulated, route-based, or recurring revenue business managing the full P&L.
  • Experience in a public company or private equity-backed environment, including post-acquisition integration.
  • Hands-on SQL, Tableau or Power BI, and large data set analysis.
  • Knowledge of ERP (Oracle) and enterprise planning tools.

From innovative electronic games to mission-driven partnerships, our work powers charitable gaming across the country, helping nonprofits fund the causes that matter most. We believe in doing what you love and doing it with purpose. Our team of innovators, creators, and problem-solvers is shaping the future of charitable gaming. Together, we are building more than games, we are #playingitforward by building community, impact, and opportunity.

title: Senior Applications Developer (ColdFusion/Oracle)
description:
ProSync is hiring a Senior Applications Developer to support a U.S. federal agency. The work is building and maintaining enterprise applications that run on Adobe ColdFusion with an Oracle database behind them.

This is a hands-on development role. You will write and support code on systems agency staff use every day, and you will own the quality controls around that code: automated test coverage, static analysis, and peer review. We are looking for someone who treats testing and code quality as part of the job rather than the first thing cut when a schedule tightens.

The position is fully remote within the continental United States.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and support enterprise applications using Adobe ColdFusion and CFML.
  • Design applications for testability, maintainability, reliability, and performance.
  • Implement automated testing, including unit, integration, functional, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites using Selenium or similar tools.
  • Use SonarQube or comparable tools to identify defects, vulnerabilities, code smells, duplication, and maintainability issues.
  • Establish and maintain automated testing and code quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Perform source control, peer code review, configuration management, defect resolution, and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and isolate defects across the database, application, integration, and user interface layers.
  • Support release readiness, regression testing, deployment validation, and production stabilization.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and sustainment.

If you have prior military service or government contracting experience, are proud to serve and support our nation, and want to help support ProSync's mission to "Define and Redefine the State of Possible,” please apply today!

  • Advanced hands-on experience developing enterprise applications in Adobe ColdFusion and CFML.
  • Advanced Oracle backend development, including SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, views, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, maintain, and troubleshoot integrated ColdFusion and Oracle applications.
  • Strong software testing background, including automated testing with Selenium or similar tools.
  • Experience with source control, configuration management, and defect resolution.
  • Ability to isolate a defect across multiple application layers and identify the underlying cause.
  • Applicants must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust background investigation. No security clearance is required for this role.

Preferred Requirements

title: Staff Engineer, Project

  • Manages the work effort (responsibilities and duties listed below) of Staff and Project Engineers assigned under the lead position.

  • Manages a portfolio of projects and provide key input into the 5-year CAPEX plan for the site.

  • Manage all phases of project development and execution with an emphasis on safety and performance specifications.

  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and execute technical activities for assigned plant projects. Monitor and control expenditures within limitations of project budget. Prepare interim and completion project reports.

  • Ability to lead a multi-discipline team of engineers, designers, and engineering and construction contractors assigned to projects.

  • Ensures the technical integrity of the project, including compliance with the project scope, specifications, sound engineering judgement and Cheniere basic engineering design documents. Assure as built and project close out documentation is completed and stored in document control systems.

  • Thoroughly understand and comply with the technical Management of Change (MOC) process and utilize it in support of capital projects and routine facility changes.

  • Deliver projects that ensure safe, reliable, and efficient LNG operations which are executed on time and on budget.

  • Comply with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies, and procedures following the highest ethical standards.

  • Participate in regulatory agency audits.

  • Reinforce safety and environmental awareness through frequent job observations and by interfacing with plant personnel.

  • Work with Engineering and Construction department to provide support and assure O & M interests are represented on major projects. Participates in equipment factory acceptance tests (FATs) and site acceptance tests (SATs).

  • Interact with and support Commercial Operations, Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, and other departments as required.

  • Complete site walk-downs to support project development requirements.

  • The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

Knowledge:

The individual should have a broad understanding of project development & management through a stage-gated approach to progress an opportunity from Project Feasibility to Design & Development to its Implementation & Commissioning. The individual shall also possess a very sound knowledge of the Management of Change (MOC) processes to identify and manage risks arising from the implementation of the proposed Projects (predominantly Brownfield Projects). Experience with Design and Engineering activities related to oil refining, petrochemical, specialty chemicals, hydrocarbon pipelines or LNG processing, storage, and transportation is required.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership and administrative abilities required.

    • An acute sensitivity to safety issues in a hazardous environment.

    • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

    • Ability to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization and with individuals and groups from different disciplines, industries, and governmental agencies.

    • Able to work with a culturally diverse group of technical individuals whose skills cover the range required to engineer, operate, and maintain the LNG terminal and Liquefaction production facilities.

    • Possess the personality and ability to relate to and to establish a mutually respectful relationship with 1) management, 2) peers and 3) the various facility level workers (Plant Manager, plant supervision and plant workers) whom are all responsible for ensuring good operations.

    • Organized, planning skills, able to manage multiple activities and programs in timely fashion and with a high degree of accuracy, able to meet work deadlines.

    • Exceptional problem solving and analytical skills.

    • Accomplished public speaker, able to create and deliver industry-specific presentations.

    • Computer knowledge including Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, Access, Project, and PowerPoint.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Education and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Civil, Structural, Electrical). A Professional Engineer’s (PE) license is preferred. Project & Financial (Budget) Management education such as PMP certification is desirable.

  • Experience: Ten (10) plus years’ experience as a Project Manager or Engineer out of which minimum of five (5) years’ experience shall be at an operating facility such as oil refining, petrochemical or specialty chemical plant, mid-steam storage or LNG facility. Recent experience with LNG is preferred, however, refining, petrochemical, NGL, cryogenic natural gas processing, or other hydrocarbon processing experience may be acceptable.

DIRECT REPORTS

Engineers as assigned.

FREEDOM TO ACT

The Staff Engineer, Projects requires minimal to no supervision on their daily assignments.

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Job is performed in an industrial plant environment.

  • Occasionally, work may be performed from home, after normal work hours or on weekends.

  • Limited travel required, as business conditions dictate.

  • Subject to drug and alcohol testing, per applicable federal regulations or as required by Cheniere.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is often required to stand, walk, sit, climb stairs, work at height above ground on stairs and catwalks, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk or hear, smell, type and write.

  • Must be able to board a ship via a gangway, climb to the top of a tank (200+ steps), scale vertical steel ladder up to forty feet or more in height and lift and move objects weighting up to 50 pounds.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee will work indoors and outdoors and will be exposed to year-around weather conditions, ocean environment, and noise. There are considerable outdoor activities involved.

  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

  • Required to obtain mandated certification by attending Company-sponsored training in basic first aid, CPR, and LNG firefighting.

  • Must maintain a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) card in good standing status.

ADA JOB REQUIREMENTS

Reasonable accommodations will be made to ensure that the essential functions of the job can be performed and not hinder the employee's performance due to physical, mental, or emotional disability.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Cheniere Energy is an equal-opportunity workplace. All employment decisions are made without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, marital or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected categories. This includes providing reasonable accommodation if requested for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices.

title: NorgesGruppen søker ny kommunikasjonssjef
description:
NorgesGruppen er en viktig handelsaktør i norsk matvarebransje, og det er stor offentlig interesse rundt virksomheten vår. Det stiller høye krav til hvordan vi kommuniserer - både når vi selv ønsker å sette saker på agendaen, når mediene ringer og når situasjoner krever raske og presise svar.

Vi søker nå en kommunikasjonssjef for eksternkommunikasjon. Dette er en sentral rolle i NorgesGruppens eksterne kommunikasjonsarbeid. Du vil jobbe tett på aktuelle saker, konsernledelsen og vil være en sentral kommunikasjonsfaglig rådgiver for ledere og fagmiljøer i hele virksomheten. I denne rollen får du ansvar for at NorgesGruppen kommuniserer tydelig, troverdig og godt, også når sakene er komplekse og tempoet høyt.

Stillingen rapporterer til konserndirektør for kommunikasjon og samfunnskontakt.

Om rollen:

Som kommunikasjonssjef for eksternkommunikasjon får du et særlig ansvar for NorgesGruppens kontakt med media og den løpende eksterne agendaen. Du håndterer mange av mediehenvendelsene, gir kommunikasjonsfaglige råd og bidrar til gode vurderinger av hvordan og når NorgesGruppen skal kommunisere. Du vil også være en av NorgesGruppens talspersoner i media og representere virksomheten i aktuelle saker.

En like viktig del av rollen er å arbeide proaktivt. Du skal identifisere saker vi bør løfte, finne gode innganger og bygge relasjoner med journalister, bransjeeksperter og andre sentrale interessenter. Kommunikasjonssjefen har i tillegg ansvar for NorgesGruppens egne eksterne kanaler på LinkedIn, Facebook og Instagram. Målet er både å bidra til at NorgesGruppens perspektiver blir forstått og å sikre et best mulig faktagrunnlag i saker som berører oss og bransjen vår. Som den største aktøren i vår bransje er vi avhengige av tillit i storsamfunnet, og eksternkommunikasjonen er svært viktig i dette arbeidet.

Du får en bred kontaktflate internt og samarbeider tett med ledere og fagmiljøer på tvers av konsernet. Rollen innebærer også prosjektledelse og deltakelse i større kommunikasjonsprosjekter, samt foredrag og presentasjoner internt og eksternt.

Når det virkelig gjelder

NorgesGruppen er en del av kritisk infrastruktur og har en viktig samfunnsrolle. God kommunikasjon er derfor avgjørende også når uforutsette situasjoner oppstår.

Kommunikasjonssjefen har en sentral rolle i konsernets krise- og beredskapsarbeid. I slike situasjoner må du raskt kunne sette deg inn i komplekse problemstillinger, skille det vesentlige fra det mindre vesentlige og bidra til presis og profesjonell kommunikasjon til medier og andre eksterne interessenter.

Rollen krever derfor tidvis tilgjengelighet også utenfor ordinær arbeidstid.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en erfaren kommunikasjonsrådgiver eller kommunikasjonsleder med solid forståelse for hvordan medier arbeider og hvordan kommunikasjon påvirker virksomhetens omdømme og handlingsrom.

Du har flere års erfaring fra kommunikasjonsarbeid i næringslivet eller større organisasjoner og kan vise til gode resultater fra mediehåndtering og strategisk kommunikasjonsarbeid. Du må være en svært god formidler, både skriftlig og muntlig, og trygg i rollen som talsperson. Du evner å formidle komplekse saker på en tydelig og troverdig måte, også når spørsmålene er kritiske og tiden er knapp.

Du trives med høyt tempo og med at arbeidsdagen ikke alltid blir slik den var planlagt. Når en krevende sak oppstår, klarer du å holde oversikt, gjøre gode vurderinger og kommunisere tydelig. Samtidig forstår du at de beste resultatene ofte skapes gjennom godt samarbeid og gode relasjoner over tid.

Vi ser gjerne at du har:

  • høyere relevant utdanning innen kommunikasjon, PR, journalistikk eller tilsvarende
  • flere års relevant erfaring fra strategisk og operativt kommunikasjonsarbeid
  • solid kompetanse innen mediehåndtering og medierådgivning
  • svært gode skriftlige og muntlige kommunikasjonsevner
  • erfaring med proaktivt pressearbeid og utvikling av saker
  • erfaring med kommunikasjonsarbeid i krevende eller komplekse situasjoner
  • gode relasjonelle ferdigheter

Hvorfor NorgesGruppen?

Hos oss får du jobbe med kommunikasjon i en virksomhet som berører svært mange mennesker hver eneste dag. Dagligvare er tett på både forbrukere, politikk, samfunnsutvikling og norsk næringsliv, og interessen for NorgesGruppen og bransjen vår er stor.

Det gir kommunikasjonsfaget en viktig plass i organisasjonen.

Du blir en del av et erfarent fagmiljø innen kommunikasjon og samfunnskontakt og får jobbe tett med ledere og fagmiljøer på tvers av NorgesGruppen. Rollen gir stor bredde, betydelig ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke hvordan en av Norges største virksomheter møter omverdenen.

Vi holder til i moderne lokaler på Skøyen, med god kantine og et hyggelig og aktivt arbeidsmiljø. Som medarbeider hos oss får du blant annet støtte til trening, tilbud om årlig helsekontroll, mulighet til å søke økonomisk støtte hos NorgesGruppens miljøfond for ansatte og vi har ulike sosiale aktiviteter, som bidrar til vårt gode arbeidsmiljø.

Søknadsfrist: 5. oktober 2026.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Stein Rømmerud (konserndirektør for kommunikasjon og samfunnskontakt): stein.rommerud@norgesgruppen.no / tlf.: 901 19 985 eller Ida Nordhagen (rekrutteringsrådgiver): ida.nordhagen@norgesgruppen.no / tlf.: 940 23 025.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Job Description

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll take ownership of designing, building, and deploying advanced LLM-based and agentic systems that extract and reason over medical records and application data. You’ll experiment, iterate, and ship quickly, working alongside a cross-functional team in a dynamic, fast-fail environment. You'll own the evals that prove your system works, and the guardrails that keep it working once real users depend on it. Your work will have a direct impact on our product and business as we push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

What you will be Doing

  • Build & Iterate Fast: Design, experiment, and deploy production LLM and agentic systems. Quickly test hypotheses, optimise, and iterate based on real-world feedback and eval results.

  • Own Evals: Build and maintain the evaluation harness that tells us whether a model or prompt change made things better or worse.

  • Design Agentic Workflows: Architect multi-step, tool-using pipelines with explicit state, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review where the stakes demand it.

  • Lead Innovation: Push the envelope with cutting-edge LLM and agentic techniques to solve hard problems in language understanding, extraction, and reasoning.

  • Shape the Product: Collaborate with Product, Design, and Underwriting SMEs to align ML capabilities with product goals and real domain constraints.

  • Scale & Optimise: Take systems from prototype to production, optimising for latency, cost per run, and reliability at scale.

What type of person fits the role:

  • Experience: 6+ years in ML/AI, with deep hands-on expertise in NLP, LLMs/SLMs, and agentic systems.

  • LLMs & Architectures: Hands-on experience building with OpenAI and Anthropic models/APIs; strong knowledge of LLMs and agent architectures.

  • Tooling: Practical experience with LiteLLM, vLLM, Langfuse (or equivalent LLM observability tooling). Experience with Claude Code/Codex and associated coding-agent workflows is a plus.

  • Evals: Proven ability to design, build, and own evaluation harnesses for LLM/agent outputs.

  • Prompt & Context Engineering: Proven ability to design and optimise prompts and context, including techniques like few-shot, chain-of-thought, and prompt tuning techniques, grounded in measurable evaluation rather than guesswork. Prior experience with DSPy, GEPA, or similar is a plus.

  • Backend & Infra Skills: Strong Python skills, with FastAPI for service development, Postgres (or similar) for data persistence, and comfort with event-driven, async architectures. Working knowledge of ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), containerisation with Docker and Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS preferred).

  • Think in Outcomes: You care about whether the system actually solves the underwriter's problem, not just whether the model scores well. You're comfortable challenging the spec, proposing a different approach, and owning your feature from idea through to production impact.

  • Mindset: Entrepreneurial, ownership-driven, and biased to action, with a "Build Fast, Fail Fast" approach, thriving in agile, iterative environments.

What we offer

Here at UnderwriteMe, you have the chance to work on solving complex problems that will change how lives are protected. This means working in an environment where you can really make a difference and where the opportunities for continuous learning and development are abound.

Unlike many other scale-up Tech companies, we have the financial backing of our successful parent company. This means we can offer a number of benefits and programmes to reward and recognise our employees’ contributions, which reflect the value we place on our employees. From competitive salaries and bonus schemes to wellness offerings and a hybrid working approach that facilitates a healthy work-life balance

We also take pride in giving back to the community and offer rewarding volunteering and social responsibility opportunities.

About UnderwriteMe

UnderwriteMe is an Insurtech software business and subsidiary of Pacific Life Re (PL Re), a global life and pensions reinsurance firm. We have a vision to help everyone purchase protection insurance by using data and disruptive technology to transform our partners and markets in order to make their underwriting processes as quick and efficient as possible.

Our core products are:
• Decision Platform - a B2B enterprise platform that provides a best-in-market Underwriting Rules Engine used by over 30 insurers to power their underwriting decisions. The product is sold across UK & Ireland, Asia-Pacific and North America. The platform combines our engine with technology to source and process third-party information supporting underwriting decisions for insurers. We are already working on capabilities, powered by AI, to make these decisions even more efficient.
• Protection Platform - a B2B2C marketplace used by over 15,000 advisors to power quoting and purchase of protection products in the UK. We currently deliver 16% of the UK markets protection policies and we are already working to increase our reach.

Working for UnderwriteMe

Joining UnderwriteMe means being part of a technology company that is committed to bringing a fresh and dynamic approach to insurance. You’d be working with a team of highly technical experts made up of people with backgrounds in software, fintech, and insurance.

Every person in our global team is valued for the unique qualities they bring to our business and we seek to build their expertise and support their individual ambitions at every step. Of course, we take our work seriously and we know our team can operate under great pressure. We work hard and thrive on achievement, but we also know how to have fun and relax too. We regularly host a range of team building days to strengthen our team's connection with each other and reflect on their successes.

Providing employees with a healthy work-life balance is very important to our culture. We have a wide range of employee benefits and we host regular social activities and wellbeing initiatives. We are also committed to supporting our employee's involvement in their communities, by actively fundraising, hosting charity events, and overseeing volunteering opportunities.

Benefits (Only for Permanent and Fixed Term Employees)

Leave

  • 25 days of annual leave with option to buy/sell more days

  • Adoption and fertility leave

  • Generous enhanced parental leave

Healthcare

  • Comprehensive private insurance coverage for employee and dependents

  • Group Life Insurance coverage of 9x basic annual salary and Group Income Protection up to 75% of basic annual salary

  • Optical benefits

Savings & Retirement

  • 15% combined employee/employer contributions

Wellness

  • Subsidized gym membership

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program

  • Cycle to Work and Electric Car Salary Sacrifice Scheme

  • Time off for volunteering

  • Charitable matching of employee donations

You Can Be Who You Are

We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential.

As part of our commitment to accessibility for all, UnderwriteMe will, upon the request of the applicant, provide accommodation during the recruitment process to ensure equal access to applicants with disabilities. Please contact us about your needs, and we will consult with you to ensure suitable accommodation is provided.

title: Director, PGS and Enterprise Solutions Data Management & Engineering
description:
ROLE SUMMARY
Pfizer Global Supply (PGS) is putting trusted, AI-ready data at the heart of how medicines are made, tested and delivered. PGS & Enterprise Solutions Data Products & Platforms is a newly formed team with a single mission: make our data self-service and accessible, available at the right latency, and contextualized so that its meaning can be interpreted by people and by machines. Spanning Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain, the team owns data strategy and standards, data contextualisation and semantics, data operations, and the converged data platform estate for PGS and Enterprise Solutions – working in deep partnership with PGS business data owners, solution teams and the site network.

The Director, Data Management & Engineering leads the function accountable for data quality and trust across PGS and Enterprise Solutions. The role owns the movement of data from source systems through to the point of consumption, and the assurance that what arrives is complete, accurate, traceable and fit to use.

Partnering closely with PGS Data, Analytics & AI Transformation organisation and Digital solution teams, this function turns trusted, contextualised data into operating reality at scale. This role builds and runs the pipeline estate that carries it, engineers the data quality controls that hold it to account, and certifies data products as trusted. It is the operational spine of an AI-ready data foundation.

The role leads a distributed team, supported by partner resources, and operates in a GxP-regulated environment where evidence of data integrity is a design requirement.


What You Will Achieve


Pipeline build and operations

  • Partnering closely with PGS Data, Analytics & AI Transformation organisation and Digital solution teams, set objectives for and lead the design, build and operation of the data pipeline and integration estate connecting source systems to enterprise consumption, including manufacturing, quality, supply chain and ERP sources.
  • Own ingestion and integration engineering from source through to MES, historian, and enterprise platforms, delivered to the architecture and integration standards set by Data Strategy & Architecture.
  • Establish and maintain DataOps practice across the estate: release management, environment control, change and version management, and automated deployment.
  • Own run-state performance, including monitoring, incident management, service levels and on-call arrangements, working with partner resources where the work is outsourced.

Data quality and certification

  • Lead data quality engineering across the estate: rule definition and enforcement, anomaly detection, remediation, and measurement.
  • Own the lineage and evidence chain from source to consumption, ensuring ALCOA+ principles are demonstrably met and that data products can withstand regulatory scrutiny.
  • Own the technical certification of data products into PGS Trusted Data, acting as an operational interface to the PGS Data, Analytics & AI Transformation organisation.
  • Establish observability across pipelines and data products so that failures, drift and degradation are detected before consumers are affected.

Regulatory and compliance

  • Ensure all pipelines and data products meet 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GAMP 5 and applicable data integrity requirements.
  • Maintain readiness for evolving regulatory expectations on AI, including demonstrable lineage from source to decision output.

Working across the function

  • Work with Data Platforms team on the boundary between the platform environment and the flow through it, ensuring that interface is explicit and understood by both teams.
  • Partner with Delivery & Operations Excellence on demand shaping and sequencing, and with Domain Data Solution Leads to define and meet the measures agreed with their business counterparts.
  • Set the direction for how the function aligns to enterprise-central capabilities — Enterprise Data Fabric (Loom), AI/ML platform, Cyber and OT Security — and represent PGS and Enterprise Solutions requirements into those forums.

Leadership

  • Build, lead and develop a distributed engineering team across multiple geographies, including recruitment, capability development and succession planning.
  • Manage partner and contractor capacity,including the balance between colleague and contracted delivery.
  • Represent the function with senior stakeholders across Digital, PGS and the Chief Data Officer organisation.

Basic Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience, including 3+ years leading technical teams (7+ years with an advanced degree).
  • Demonstrated experience owning data pipeline or integration estates at enterprise scale, including run-state accountability.
  • Strong grounding in data quality engineering, lineage and observability practice.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Experience managing partner or vendor delivery alongside internal teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical positions to senior non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in a GxP-regulated manufacturing environment, with working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, GAMP 5 and ALCOA+.
  • Exposure to data product thinking, data contracts, and certification or trust frameworks.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing and operational data sources: historians, MES, LIMS, SCADA, and ERP.
  • Experience with modern data platform tooling, including cloud data warehousing, streaming, and orchestration.
  • Understanding of ISA-95 and ISA-88 and their application to manufacturing data.
  • Experience standing up or materially reshaping a function rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • Global cultural awareness; comfort operating across time zones. Some travel expected.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.



Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

title: Sr. Med. Dir for Affordability
description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The Senior Medical Director for Affordability is a physician leader and the clinical lead for Horizon BCBSNJ’s medical cost optimization (MCO) efforts. This leader is accountable for identifying, investigating, and launching MCO programs in collaboration with the MCO strategy and execution teams. They provide support and expertise to proactively outreach to, and address inquiries from, providers, facilities, clients, medical societies, and others on MCO initiatives. They provide clinical support for all Horizon BCBSNJ teams related to MCO programs.

What You'll Do

Job Responsibilities:

  • Define a multi-year Medical Cost Optimization (MCO) strategy to drive affordability based on Horizon BCBSNJ experience, external data, competitive intelligence and implement this strategic vision, in collaboration with the MCO Strategy Lead.
  • Partner with leadership across Horizon BCBSNJ business units to identify MCO opportunities and drive progress toward operational process improvements to ensure continual, measurable improvement of the quality, compliance, and speed of execution of MCO initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with the Clinical Analytics, Medical Economics, Finance, and other teams to source and validate the sizing and clinical efficacy of MCO business cases.
  • Oversee tracking, analysis and reporting of data related to MCO to support the building of business cases, ROI analyses and measurement of progress toward MCO goals.
  • Direct MCO work to guide opportunity and solution evaluation and prioritization using the principles of the MCO Committee governing framework to ensure achievement of multi-year affordability, quality, and clinical outcome targets.
  • Facilitation of, and participation in, MCO Committee meetings.
  • Facilitate prioritization of MCO solutions in need of funding through the CPLT and DRIVE processes.
  • Partner with the Medical Cost Action Planning (MCAP), Finance and Actuary teams on tracking and reporting of enterprise MCO and MCAP performance.
  • Communicate MCO strategy, activity and results across HNS and the enterprise.
  • Communicate MCO efforts externally to network providers and their respective trade organizations.
  • Educate Horizon BCBSNJ staff on MCO tools, strategies, and programs.
  • Manage, develop and train staff; develop and monitor goals; conduct annual performance reviews, and administers salaries for the staff.
