Cargo: Crew Leader

Tipo de salario: No exento

Fecha de creación/Fecha de revisión: 04/24/2026


Resumen del puesto:

El Crew Leader brinda apoyo y orientación al equipo de trabajo para alcanzar los objetivos de producción. La persona en este puesto identifica los posibles factores de riesgo a la seguridad y garantiza el cumplimiento de las normas, además de asignar tareas y priorizar el trabajo en el lugar de trabajo según las indicaciones de su General Foreperson.


Funciones esenciales del puesto:

  • Cumple con y orienta a los empleados sobre las políticas de la empresa, las prácticas de seguridad en el trabajo, los métodos de trabajo aprobados y las normativas de OSHA. Ayuda a impartir la capacitación en seguridad necesaria, realiza reuniones informativas previas al trabajo (job briefings), asigna tareas a los miembros del equipo de trabajo y brinda orientación conforme a las políticas, procedimientos y requisitos del cliente.
  • Utiliza equipos de aplicación de herbicidas según corresponda para tratar trocos y maleza (brush). Mantiene los registros de aplicación correspondientes.
  • Obtiene permisos de los propietarios para podar o eliminar árboles y aplicar herbicidas. Trabaja con el cliente o propietario para obtener acceso al lugar de trabajo, informa sobre posibles interrupciones y explica el trabajo que debe realizarse.
  • Trabaja cerca de equipos peligrosos y en proximidad a líneas eléctricas energizadas.
  • Poda, retira o tala árboles usando equipos de trepa, como camión con elevador aéreo (canasta), arnés de seguridad, cuerda de trepa y escalera. También trabaja en el suelo utilizando sierras manuales, sierras de suelo, podadoras u otras herramientas aplicables.
  • Realiza inspecciones previas del área de trabajo para identificar posibles riesgos.
  • Carga vehículos y equipos con ramas y troncos de tamaño fácil de manipular que no sean aptos para astillar.
  • Repara daños menores a la propiedad que ocurran en el lugar de trabajo. Informa al General Foreperson de las situaciones que requieran atención, de forma oportuna.
  • Promueve y mantiene buenas relaciones con clientes y público mediante la correcta realización del trabajo asignado y el comportamiento apropiado de los empleados del equipo de trabajo.
  • Mantiene registros e informes relacionados con la producción del equipo de trabajo, como hojas de horas, órdenes de trabajo, unidades de producción, horas-hombre, distribución de tareas y control de costos, con el fin de cumplir los objetivos organizacionales.
  • Recibe e interpreta los mapas del General Foreperson o de la empresa de servicios públicos que muestran las órdenes de trabajo que deben completarse para la poda y la eliminación de árboles o la aplicación química. Es responsable de comprender los planos y símbolos que representan los tipos de líneas eléctricas, tensiones y equipos de líneas eléctricas según los estándares del sector, y de asistir al General Foreperson en la asignación de las órdenes de trabajo diarias.
  • Coloca señales de advertencia, barreras, banderas, transmite señales manuales, dirige el tráfico y utiliza otros dispositivos de control de tráfico según corresponda, para proteger a los empleados y al público de los peligros en y alrededor del área de trabajo. Coopera con los propietarios, clientes y personal de emergencia cuando sea necesario bloquear calles o entradas.
  • Se encarga de la preparación y limpieza de herramientas y equipos en el lugar de trabajo. Mantiene un área de trabajo limpia y ordenada.
  • Realiza inspecciones de vehículos y equipos para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento. Efectúa el mantenimiento rutinario de los vehículos, equipos y herramientas de la empresa. Informa al General Foreperson sobre las necesidades de mantenimiento especializado de los vehículos o equipos.
  • Durante emergencias o desastres naturales, puede ser necesario permanecer de servicio y desplazarse fuera del lugar habitual de trabajo durante la duración del evento. Colabora en la comunicación y coordinación de la respuesta del equipo de trabajo ante dichas situaciones, y es responsable de determinar los pasos adecuados para eliminar peligros y podar o retirar árboles durante las labores de respuesta.
  • Apoya, participa activamente y actúa de acuerdo con la cultura de seguridad y sentido de propiedad de empleados de Wright.
  • Cumple con las leyes, normas y reglamentos federales, estatales y locales aplicables; mantiene el conocimiento y cumplimiento de todas las políticas y procedimientos de la empresa.
  • Mantiene una asistencia regular y puntual al trabajo y a las reuniones.

Otras funciones:

  • Conduce y opera los vehículos y equipos asignados.

Funciones de supervisión:


Conocimientos, habilidades y aptitudes requeridas:

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo y capacidad para manejar situaciones de estrés, así como para realizar múltiples tareas simultáneamente.
  • Conocimiento de los árboles, incluyendo su identificación, hábitos de crecimiento y técnicas de arboricultura específicas para la poda, el mantenimiento, la reparación y la eliminación de árboles en proximidad a conductores energizados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atención al cliente y comunicación, centradas en la creación de relaciones, la escucha activa, la formulación de preguntas y la paciencia. Capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con el público, los clientes y los empleados.
  • Conocimiento y comprensión de American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para Operaciones de Cuidado de Árboles - ANSI Z133.1 – versión vigente) y de American National Standards for Proper Pruning (las Normas Nacionales Estadounidenses para la Poda Adecuada - ANSI A300).
  • Capacidad para cumplir y enseñar los requisitos de seguridad de la empresa y del sector.
  • Conocimientos sobre circuitos eléctricos y habilidad para leer e interpretar planos de circuitos.
  • Conocimiento de las normas de generación, transmisión y distribución de energía eléctrica de OSHA, incluido el artículo 1910.269 del Título 29 del Código de Reglamentaciones Federales (CFR). Capacidad para determinar el voltaje nominal, usar correctamente herramientas aisladas cerca de partes energizadas y distinguir las partes vivas expuestas de otras partes del equipo eléctrico.
  • Capacidad para aprender rápidamente y seguir instrucciones con precisión.
  • Capacidad para comunicarse con otras personas y representar a Wright Tree Service de manera profesional.
  • Capacidad para redactar, leer y comprender instrucciones o información laboral, tanto escritas como verbales.
  • Capacidad para reconocer plantas venenosas y adoptar las medidas preventivas adecuadas.
  • Debe ser capaz de llevar el equipo de protección personal (PPE) requerido.
  • Capacidad para trabajar jornadas prolongadas y realizar horas extras durante emergencias (incluidos feriados, fines de semana y trabajos por tormentas), estando sujeto a llamadas de emergencia.
  • Conocimiento y capacitación en rescate en árboles y con elevador aéreo (canasta).
  • Capacidad para operar y mantener todas las herramientas y equipos requeridos.
  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma independiente como en equipo.

Requisitos de formación, certificación y experiencia:

  • Contar con un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia trabajando en equipos de poda o despeje de árboles, o haber completado con éxito las evaluaciones de habilidades correspondientes.
  • Se prefiere diploma de educación secundaria o equivalente, aunque no es obligatorio.
  • Debe contar con credenciales vigentes de resucitación cardiopulmonar (CPR), o poder obtenerlas en un plazo de 90 días tras la contratación.

Otros requisitos preferidos:

  • Capacidad para obtener y mantener una licencia de conducir válida o una licencia comercial (según la división y los requisitos del cliente o contrato) y una tarjeta médica emitida por el Departamento de Transporte (Department of Transportation, DOT) conforme a las regulaciones de la FMCSA.
  • Conducir un vehículo con una astilladora u otra unidad remolcada acoplada hacia, desde o dentro del área de trabajo.
  • Mantener la certificación o equivalente en aplicación de herbicidas según lo requieran Wright Tree Service y las leyes locales, estatales y federales.
  • Mantenerse informado sobre nuevos equipos, especificaciones, normas, prácticas y procedimientos operativos.

Requisitos de idioma (leer, escribir, hablar):

title: Accelerator DT Technical Architect, Supply Chain
description:
Job Description:

Who are we


Accelerator is Mars Snacking's growth engine, focused on unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands. Within Accelerator, the Better For You portfolio includes KIND®, RXBAR®, Nutri-Grain®, Special K Bars®, and Pure Organic® and within Tasty & Wholesome, the portfolio includes Eggo, Rice Krispies Treats and Pop Tarts. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a growth business, we are driving innovation, accelerating performance, and transforming how we work through data, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

We’re looking for passionate collaborators to help us become the foremost leader in Mars Snacking and positively impact society along the way. If you’re looking to be a part of an inspiring, energetic and entrepreneurial environment, you’ve found the right place.


What you’ll do


Reporting to the Accelerator DT Manufacturing, Make, R&D and QFS Domain Sr. Manager, this role is part of the Digital Technologies organization supporting Accelerator, including KIND, Tru Fru, Nature's Bakery, and the newly acquired Kellanova brands. The role is responsible for shaping and governing technology solutions across the TLT portfolio, including Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics, and R&D/QFS, while defining technology roadmaps, evaluating solution options, establishing architecture standards, and identifying opportunities to leverage AI, Digital Twins, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies that support Accelerator's long-term digital strategy.

As Accelerator continues to evolve, this role will provide architecture leadership across multiple business priorities, serving as a trusted advisor who bridges business and technology to shape future-state capabilities, guide investment decisions, and drive scalable, integrated solutions across the enterprise. Working closely with business stakeholders, product teams, Enterprise Architecture, and delivery partners, this individual will combine architecture expertise with strong business analysis skills to assess opportunities, translate business requirements into solution recommendations, support vendor evaluations and RFPs, shape initiatives from concept through delivery, and provide hands-on problem solving across the TLT portfolio. The role balances strategic planning with day-to-day execution, helping ensure solutions are practical, standardized, and scalable while fostering innovation, reducing technical debt, and preventing one-off solutions that limit future growth.

Job Responsibilities


Architecture Strategy & Roadmap Development

  • Partner with TLT Domain Leads to understand business priorities and translate them into technology roadmaps.
  • Define future-state architecture strategies that support Accelerator's long-term business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, Digital Twins, analytics, and emerging technologies to create business value.
  • Support business case development and technology investment decisions.

Solution Assessment & Early Project Shaping

  • Lead solution assessments for new business initiatives and technology opportunities.
  • Evaluate technology options, platforms, and vendor capabilities against business requirements and architecture standards.
  • Support RFPs, vendor selections, proof-of-concepts, and technology due diligence activities.
  • Provide architecture guidance during project intake, discovery, and design phases.

Architecture Governance & Standards

  • Establish and maintain architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures across the TLT portfolio.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, data, and integration standards.
  • Review solution designs and help prevent siloed or plant-specific implementations that do not scale across Accelerator.
  • Drive reuse, standardization, and simplification across business capabilities and technology platforms.

Cross-Functional Delivery Support

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Delivery Teams, and Solution Architects to ensure successful execution of initiatives.
  • Provide architecture leadership across Manufacturing, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, R&D and digital transformation programs.
  • Support integration strategies across ERP, Planning, Manufacturing, Data & Analytics, AI, and operational technology ecosystems.
  • Balance strategic architecture direction with practical hands-on support when required.

Innovation & Emerging Technology

  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities including Microsoft Copilot, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation.
  • Assess and guide opportunities related to Digital Twins, smart manufacturing, connected operations, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architecture and innovation teams to evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends.

Qualifications


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Business Architecture, or related technology consulting roles.
  • Experience supporting supply chain, planning, manufacturing, quality or operational business domains.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions and roadmaps.
  • Experience facilitating business and technical workshops with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of systems integration, cloud platforms, data architecture, and enterprise applications.
  • Experience evaluating technology solutions, supporting vendor selections, and contributing to RFP processes.
  • Ability to operate as both a strategic advisor and a hands-on contributor.
  • Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Manufacturing technologies including SAP PP, MES, OT/IT integration, or Industry 4.0 initiatives.
  • Experience supporting Planning capabilities such as Demand Planning, Supply Planning, IBP, APO, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, or equivalent platforms.
  • Knowledge of Digital Twin technologies and connected operations architectures.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot, GenAI, automation, or AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Experience in Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain industries.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and modern integration platforms.
  • TOGAF, Azure, SAP, or related architecture certifications.

    What can you expect from Mars

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment.

The pay range shown is applicable to all US locations listed within the job posting:USD 108,160.00 - USD 148,720.00

title: Senior Systems Engineer | Shared Tech
description:
Craft:

Job Description:

At King, we’re on a mission to make the world playful. The tools, platforms and infrastructure behind our games help teams turn great ideas into experiences enjoyed by millions of players.

Engineering System & Support (ESS) builds the shared foundations that make game development smoother: reliable CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, repository services, build tooling and developer workflows. We help teams spend less time waiting on systems and more time creating great games.

Your role within the Kingdom

As a Senior Systems Engineer (Developer Experience & Infrastructure), you’ll improve the platforms developers rely on every day—making them faster, more reliable and easier to use.

What You’ll Do:

  • Elevate Developer Experience: Design, build, and support self-service platform tools and automated workflows that speed up developer feedback loops.

  • Scale Infrastructure: Maintain and modernize our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and containerized build systems across multi-OS and cloud environments.

  • System Design & Reliability: Shape platform architecture, strengthen monitoring, and troubleshoot complex distributed services.

  • Collaborate & Mentor: Partner closely with game teams across multiple locations, write clear platform documentation, and share knowledge across the engineering community.

Skills to create thrills

We evaluate candidates based on core capabilities and engineering fundamentals rather than tool-by-tool memorization.

  • Production Linux Expertise: Solid experience managing and troubleshooting Linux systems (e.g., Debian/Ubuntu) in production or high-availability settings.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience automating infrastructure provisioning using tools like Terraform, Puppet, or similar frameworks.

  • Cloud & Container Orchestration: Practical experience working with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Bash, Python, Groovy, or PowerShell) to eliminate toil and automate pipelines.

  • Version Control Fundamentals: Solid understanding of Git workflows and modern developer ecosystems.

  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong communication skills, structured task prioritization, and a passion for supporting fellow developers.

  • Managed services operations? Own t and , artifactory, perforce, builbuddy, buildkite, “product ownership”?

Bonus Points (Nice to Have, Not Required!)

  • Experience maintaining complex CI/CD pipelines across multi-OS environments (Linux, macOS, Windows).

  • Familiarity with build optimization or repository management tools (e.g., Artifactory, SonarQube, Incredibuild, or Veertu Anka).

  • Exposure to cloud-native monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Splunk).

  • Security awareness: An understanding of platform security and software supply-chain practices.

Bring your craft, curiosity and care for fellow developers. Together, we’ll build the foundations that help King teams create more moments of magic for players.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Self-Sufficiency Specialist I
description:
If you are looking for an opportunity to make a difference in the lives of children, families, seniors and people with disabilities and want to work in a positive, strength-based, and flexible environment, consider a career in human services with Shenandoah County Social Services. We strive every day to engage with families and assist them in obtaining the tools they need to make positive and sustainable changes. We are dedicated to advocating for the people we serve and collaborating with them to strengthen their natural support system. We are committed to ensuring that our team of professionals have the tools and resources they need to provide exemplary service to the citizens of our community. Employee wellness is essential to our mission. If you are interested in starting the next chapter of your professional development in the most rewarding field, we invite you to apply with our team.

Shenandoah County Social Services is located in beautiful Woodstock, Virginia approximately 30 miles south of Winchester and 30 miles north of Harrisonburg. Known for its majestic mountain views, the winding seven bends of the Shenandoah River and its small town charm, Shenandoah County is the perfect place to live and work.

Employees’ responsibilities are related to the determination and re-determination of eligibility of individuals and families for financial assistance, food stamps, medical assistance, and for other social services’ benefit programs. The work is performed within established policies, procedures and guidelines, but certain aspects of eligibility determination require independent judgment, especially as related to evaluation of social factors influencing eligibility. Employees seek supervisory help for difficult or unusual situations only.

Titles Description- Self-Sufficiency Specialist I represents the entry level in the Self-Sufficiency Specialist occupational group for employees working under close supervision while being trained in determining eligibility for a variety of social services government assistance programs and assessing employability of clients to aid in their effort to achieve self sufficiency. Upon recommendation by the supervisor, approval by the director, and successful completion of the training program, the employee shall be redefined to a full-performance Self-Sufficiency Specialist II and becomes eligible for a salary increase if/as indicated by the local department’s compensation plan. Employees are dedicated wholly to Employment Services or to a combination of Benefits and Employment Services. This level is distinguished from the Self-Sufficiency Specialist II by the latter’s performing all the assigned eligibility and employment service duties independently and making judgments following agency practices and procedures and mandated federal, state, or local laws and policies.

General Work Tasks (Illustrative Only) – Explains the employment services program Makes assessments of customer needs and develops employment plans, utilizing job search, work experience, education and training. Establishes and monitors self-sufficiency goals through information and assessment of customer background. Monitors case reports/records in accordance with regulations. Explains the child care program and makes assessments of customer needs. Interviews persons for assistance, obtains necessary information; Explains nature of temporary assistance benefit programs and determines reasons and need for assistance; Processes applications for financial assistance and diversion; Determines eligibility for assistance and benefit levels using automated systems and manual methods; Evaluates employability status of clients and explores potential sources of income; Explains client responsibilities, rights and program availability; Refers clients to service worker as the result of overall assessment of situation; Prepares reports and maintains client records;

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Knowledge- Some knowledge of: basic human behavior; mathematics to calculate percentages, formulas and averages to solve mathematical problems; and interviewing techniques such as data collection and investigation

Skills- Skill in operating a personal computer and the associated office and agency software.

Abilities- Demonstrated ability to: communicate effectively both orally and in writing; interview, gather information, and evaluate situations; analyze information; apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written or oral form; exercise sound judgment, discretion, tact and resourcefulness in solving problems and drawing logical conclusions; use various types of automated technology to establish and maintain case records, access and retrieve data, create reports and manipulate data; maintain professional ethics related to confidentiality; and establish and maintain effective working relationships with others in a positive and tactful manner under sometimes stressful situations.

Education and Experience- High school diploma supplemented with additional training and related work experience OR any equivalent combination of training and experience which provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

Preferred:

Bi-lingual

description:

Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid
Lokacija / Location: Ljubljana

Interni naziv pozicije / Internal job title: DDIT OPS strokovnjak za robotiko / DDIT OPS Robotics Expert ITOT

Ta vloga je odgovorna za oblikovanje in izvajanje strategije, portfelja ter razvojnega načrta robotike na lokaciji. Vključuje vodenje ocenjevanja, uvajanja in širjenja robotskih rešitev v proizvodnji, laboratorijih, skladiščih in podpornih funkcijah. Nosilec vloge hkrati vodi več pobud, usklajuje prioritete lokacije z globalnimi cilji in standardi na področju robotike ter prek tesnega medfunkcijskega sodelovanja vpliva na tehnološke, investicijske in implementacijske odločitve. Čeprav vloga ne vključuje neposrednega vodenja sodelavcev, zahteva usklajevanje internih strokovnjakov in zunanjih partnerjev za zagotavljanje standardiziranih, skladnih, razširljivih in trajnostnih robotskih rešitev, ki prinašajo merljivo poslovno vrednost.
_____________

This role is responsible for defining and driving the site robotics strategy, portfolio, and roadmap, leading the evaluation, deployment, and scaling of robotics solutions across manufacturing, laboratories, warehouses, and support operations. The position manages multiple initiatives simultaneously, aligns site priorities with enterprise robotics goals and standards, and influences technology, investment, and deployment decisions through cross-functional collaboration. Working without direct reports, the role coordinates internal experts and external partners to deliver standardized, compliant, scalable, and sustainable robotics solutions that generate measurable business value.

This role is based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.


Job Description

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:

  • Upravljanje strategije in razvojnega načrta robotike. Oblikovanje, vodenje in vzdrževanje prioritetnega razvojnega načrta robotike na lokaciji, usklajenega s poslovnimi potrebami, globalnimi standardi, tehnološko zrelostjo in razvojem trga.
  • Vzpostavljanje nabora primerov uporabe. Prepoznavanje, ocenjevanje in prioritetno razvrščanje priložnosti za uporabo robotike v proizvodnji, laboratorijih, skladiščih in podpornih funkcijah.
  • Vodenje implementacije in širjenja rešitev. Usmerjanje robotskih pobud od koncepta, študije izvedljivosti in pilotnega projekta do validirane implementacije, predaje v uporabo, podpore skozi življenjski cikel ter ponovne uporabe na drugih lokacijah. Koordinacija deležnikov iz proizvodnje, inženiringa, kakovosti, operativne odličnosti, nabave, digitalnih funkcij ter zunanjih dobaviteljev in sistemskih integratorjev.
  • Opredeljevanje zahtev in standardov. Priprava in usklajevanje uporabniških specifikacij zahtev (URS), referenčnih arhitektur, tehničnih standardov, okvirov za implementacijo in kataloga robotskih rešitev.
  • Ocenjevanje tehnologij in dobaviteljev. Presoja robotskih rešitev, AMR/AGV sistemov, kolaborativnih robotov (cobotov), strojnega vida, avtomatizirane inšpekcije, avtonomnih sistemov in fizične umetne inteligence z vidika tehnične ustreznosti, skladnosti, razširljivosti, vzdrževanja, stroškov in poslovne vrednosti.
  • Vloga strokovnjaka za robotiko. Svetovanje ekipam IT/OT in vodstvu lokacije glede arhitekture rešitev, integracije sistemov, izbire tehnologij, tveganj implementacije in investicijskih prioritet.
  • Zagotavljanje skladnosti in upravljanja. Usklajevanje rešitev z zahtevami GxP, validacije, integritete podatkov, kakovosti, varnosti, OT kibernetske varnosti ter drugimi veljavnimi regulatornimi zahtevami.
  • Priprava poslovnih primerov in spremljanje ustvarjene vrednosti. Kvantificiranje koristi, podpora investicijskim odločitvam, upravljanje projektnega portfelja in proračuna ter poročanje o izvedbi, sprejetosti rešitev, tveganjih in doseženi vrednosti. Spodbujanje uporabe odobrenih platform, ponovno uporabnih rešitev, prenosa naučenih lekcij ter enotnih načinov dela med lokacijami.

Vaš doprinos k delovnem mestu:

  • Univerzitetna stopnja izobrazbe s področja informacijske tehnologije, tehničnih ved (robotika, mehatronika, avtomatizacija) ali druge ustrezne smeri.
  • Najmanj 5 let izkušenj v mednarodnem okolju na IT področju, področju industrijske robotike, avtomatizacije, proizvodnega inženiringa, naprednih proizvodnih tehnologij ali IT/OT okolij.
  • Dokazane izkušnje z uvajanjem robotskih ali naprednih avtomatizacijskih rešitev od zasnove do implementacije v proizvodnem okolju.
  • Izkušnje z opredeljevanjem uporabniških zahtev (URS), tehničnih standardov, arhitekturnih rešitev in meril za ocenjevanje dobaviteljev. Dobro poznavanje robotske strojne opreme, industrijskih krmilnih sistemov, sistemske integracije, strojnega vida, avtonomnih sistemov in avtomatizacijskih arhitektur.
  • Izkušnje v reguliranem proizvodnem okolju, vključno z zahtevami GxP, validacije, integritete podatkov, kakovosti, varnosti in kibernetske varnosti operativnih tehnologij (OT). Dokazana sposobnost vodenja medfunkcijskih deležnikov, dobaviteljev in sistemskih integratorjev v globalnem okolju.
  • Izkušnje pri pripravi poslovnih utemeljitev ter upravljanju projektnih portfeljev, proračunov, tveganj in koristi.
  • Praktične izkušnje z avtonomnimi mobilnimi roboti (AMR), avtomatsko vodenimi vozili (AGV), kolaborativnimi roboti (coboti), robotskim rokovanjem z materiali, strojnim vidom, avtomatiziranimi sistemi za kontrolo kakovosti, laboratorijsko avtomatizacijo ali robotiko, podprto z umetno inteligenco.
  • Izkušnje z uvajanjem in širitvijo standardiziranih rešitev na več lokacijah ali platformah ter aktivno poslovno znanje angleškega jezika.

Zaželene izkušnje:

  • Izkušnje iz farmacevtske, biotehnološke industrije, celičnih in genskih terapij ali drugih področij life sciences predstavljajo prednost
  • Poznavanje konceptov Industrije 4.0, pametne proizvodnje, digitalne proizvodnje in avtonomne proizvodnje.

Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev. Prijavo oddajte z življenjepisom v slovenskem in angleškem jeziku.

Nagrajevanje:

V Novartisu smo zavezani k soustvarjanju prihodnosti medicine ter priznavanju in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo.

Pričakovani letni osnovni razpon plače za delovno mesto:

• Slovenija: 32.060 – 59.540 €

Osnovna plača se določa na podlagi vnaprej opredeljenih in transparentnih kriterijev, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje, ne glede na spol, ter v skladu z Novartisovo politiko določanja plač. Po zaposlitvi v Novartisu se plača periodično pregleda v skladu z internimi akti in postopki.

Plačna enakost je temeljno načelo naše kadrovske politike in odraža našo zavezo k ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava dostojanstveno in spoštljivo, kot je opredeljeno v našem Kodeksu etike.

Poleg osnovne letne bruto plače so zaposleni upravičeni tudi do spodaj navedenih ugodnosti:

  • Letni bonus, ki pripada vsakemu zaposlenemu: 12% letne plače.
  • Regres za dopust: Leta 2025 je znašal 2.496 € (neto). Za leto 2026 znaša 2.678,28 € (neto).
  • Nagrada za poslovno uspešnost: Leta 2025 je znašala 2.538,64 € (bruto), skupaj z zimskim regresom.
  • Prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje: Novartis v Sloveniji zagotavlja prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje (5,844 % bruto izplačila, letno omejeno na 3.224,18 €).
  • Zavarovanje:
  • undefined
  • undefined
  • Care Connect: Program, ki ponuja zaupno, osebno podporo za vaše duševno zdravje in dobro počutje s pomočjo terapij, svetovanj, orodij in še mnogo več.
  • Ostale ugodnosti v skladu z zakonom in kolektivno pogodbo: Prevoz, prehrana ter ostali dodatki.

Preberite brošuro in izvedite več o našem sistemu nagrajevanja:

Opomba: Ugodnosti se lahko razlikujejo glede na državo ter so skladni z lokalno zakonodajo, vključno z določili kolektivnih pogodb. Celovit pregled vašega paketa prejemkov, vključno z morebitnimi relevantnimi določbami kolektivne pogodbe, ki veljajo za vašo delovno mesto glede na lokacijo zaposlitve in delodajalca Novartis, vam bo posredovan v okviru nadaljnjih korakov zaposlitvenega postopka.

Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.

Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. Ste pripravljeni ustvariti svetlejšo prihodnost skupaj z nami?


________________________

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the robotics strategy and roadmap. Maintain a prioritized site roadmap aligned with business needs, enterprise standards, technology maturity, and market developments.
  • Build the use-case pipeline. Identify, assess, and prioritize robotics opportunities across manufacturing, laboratories, warehouses, and support functions.
  • Lead delivery and scaling. Drive robotics initiatives from concept, feasibility study, and pilot through validated deployment, operational handover, lifecycle support, and reuse across sites. Coordinate Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Operational Excellence, Procurement, Digital, vendors, and system integrators
  • Define requirements and standards. Own and harmonize User Requirement Specifications, reference architectures, technical standards, deployment frameworks, and the robotics catalog.
  • Evaluate technology and vendors. Assess robotics, AMR/AGV, cobots, machine vision, automated inspection, autonomous systems, and physical AI for technical fit, compliance, scalability, maintainability, cost, and business value.
  • Act as robotics subject matter expert. Advise ITOT and site leadership on solution architecture, integration, technology selection, implementation risks, and investment priorities.
  • Ensure compliance and governance. Align solutions with GxP, validation, data integrity, quality, safety, OT cybersecurity, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Build business cases and track value. Quantify benefits, support investment decisions, manage the project portfolio and budget, and report delivery, adoption, risks, and realized value. Promote approved platforms, reusable solutions, lessons learned, and consistent ways of working across locations.

Essential Requirements:

  • University education in IT, Technical Sciences (robotics, mechatronics, automation, engineering) or other related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in industrial robotics, automation, manufacturing engineering, advanced manufacturing technology, or IT/OT.
  • Proven delivery of robotics or advanced automation solutions from concept through production deployment.
  • Experience defining URSs, technical standards, solution architectures, and vendor evaluation criteria. Strong knowledge of robotics hardware, industrial controls, system integration, machine vision, autonomous systems, and automation architectures.
  • Experience in regulated manufacturing, including GxP, validation, data integrity, quality, safety, and OT cybersecurity requirements. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and system integrators in a global environment.
  • Experience developing business cases and managing project portfolios, budgets, risks, and benefits.
  • Hands-on experience with AMRs, AGVs, cobots, robotic material handling, machine vision, automated inspection, laboratory automation, or AI-enabled robotics.
  • Experience scaling standardized solutions across multiple sites or platforms, Business fluency in English.


Desirable Requirements:

  • Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cell and gene therapy, or other life sciences manufacturing experience.
  • Familiarity with Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, digital manufacturing, and autonomous manufacturing concepts.

title: Senior Well Operations & Reservoir Engineer
description:
Why Choose Us:

We are R360 Canada, an integrated services company that offers a variety of services to clients in the energy, environmental and industrial sectors. We are equipped to process, recover, recycle and dispose of waste and other materials safely and cost-effectively for our customers. The R360 team is aligned through the vision of reinventing the standard in waste solutions by serving our customers and employees, while staying true to our values. We’re proud to be a different kind of company with a different kind of culture one where self-directed, empowered employees have our trust and full support to realize their potential as they strive to make a bigger and better impact on their communities and careers every day.


General Description:

We are seeking a Well Operations Engineer to join our Well Operations & Reservoir Team. This role is responsible for the technical stewardship, performance optimization, integrity management, regulatory compliance, and development of the company's disposal well assets and associated reservoirs.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Geology, Facilities, Regulatory, EH&S, Finance, and external stakeholders to optimize well performance, manage risk, support capital projects, and ensure regulatory compliance. This position combines reservoir engineering, well drilling and operations, well integrity, and project management responsibilities, requiring both strong technical expertise and collaborative problem-solving skills.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys owning assets throughout their lifecycle, from reservoir evaluation and regulatory approvals to drilling, well intervention, optimization, integrity management, and abandonment.

As a Senior Well Operations & Reservoir Engineer with us, the minimum responsibilities are:

  • Monitor well performance, injection trends, reservoir pressure behavior, and operational effectiveness
  • Prepare, manage, and execute drilling, completions, workovers, stimulations, and abandonment (ARO) programs
  • Conduct pressure and volumetric analyses, capacity assessments, and performance evaluations to support operational and development decisions
  • Lead well integrity assessments, containment reviews, and risk evaluations
  • Prepare and support regulatory applications, engineering submissions, compliance reporting, and documentation to ensure regulatory compliance
  • Develop project scopes, cost estimates, AFEs, forecasts, and technical proposals
  • Collaborate with Operations, Geology, Facilities, EH&S, Finance, Business Development, and Land teams to optimize asset performance and support strategic planning

What We Need From You:

  • C.E.T. or Professional Engineering (P.Eng.) designation
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in well operations, reservoir engineering, production engineering, or disposal well operations
  • Experience with pressure analysis, reservoir evaluation, and well performance optimization
  • Working knowledge of drilling, completions, workovers, stimulations, and abandonment operations
  • Understanding of well integrity management principles and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Strong project management and contractor management skills
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and technical writing abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with Wellview, PetroSight, and geoSCOUT
  • Experience with disposal wells, injection reservoirs, or cavern storage would be considered an asset
  • Must be able to pass all pre-employment requirements

What You’ll Get From Us:

  • Competitive Wages
  • Retirement Plan with company match; let us help you save for your future
  • Benefits; Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Perks, perks, perks! Employee Assistance Program, Scholarship Opportunities for kids, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Insurance: Life, Short Term/Long Term Disability

We thank all applicants for their interest but advise only those selected for an interview will be contacted. R360 Canada, a company of Waste Connections of Canada is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions (including but not limited to hiring) are made without regard to characteristics protected by federal, provincial, or local law, regulation, or ordinance.

title: Zeppelin Cat söker Fältmekaniker till Västerbotten!
description:
Vill du arbeta med ett av världens starkaste varumärken och samtidigt ha friheten att utgå från hemmet? Nu söker vi en fältmekaniker till vårt team i Västerbotten. Tjänsten passar dig som är bosatt i Skellefteå, Norsjö, Lycksele eller närliggande område och som vill kombinera teknik, problemlösning och kundkontakt i en varierande vardag.


Vi erbjuder

  • Ett utvecklande arbete med ett av världens starkaste varumärken.
  • Goda utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter inom företaget.
  • Kompetenta och hjälpsamma kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap.
  • En trygg och stabil arbetsgivare med långsiktigt fokus.
  • En säker arbetsmiljö där hälsa och säkerhet alltid kommer först.
  • Friskvårdsbidrag.
  • Möjlighet till förskottssemester.
  • Förmånliga försäkringar för dig och din familj.
  • Förmånscykel.

Som fältmekaniker hos oss arbetar du med service, felsökning och reparation av Caterpillars maskiner ute hos våra kunder. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat arbete med motorer, växellådor, hydraulik och annan avancerad maskinteknik.


Du utgår från din bostad och arbetar självständigt inom ditt geografiska område, samtidigt som du har nära stöd från kollegor och arbetsledning. För att kunna ge våra kunder bästa möjliga service ser vi gärna att du bor i Skellefteå, Norsjö, Lycksele eller närliggande område.


Rollen innebär stor frihet under ansvar och passar dig som trivs med varierande arbetsdagar där du får använda både din tekniska kompetens och din problemlösningsförmåga. Du blir en del av ett kunnigt team och får möjlighet att bidra till vår fortsatta satsning och utveckling i Västerbotten.


Vi söker dig som har:

  • Gymnasial eller eftergymnasial utbildning inom fordon, teknik eller motsvarande.
  • Erfarenhet som mekaniker, servicetekniker eller liknande teknisk roll.
  • God datorvana.
  • B-körkort.
  • BE-körkort är meriterande.

Erfarenhet av entreprenadmaskiner, anläggningsmaskiner, jordbruksmaskiner, skogsmaskiner eller tunga fordon är meriterande.


Vi tror att det viktigaste är att du har ett genuint intresse för teknik, maskiner och problemlösning. Du är självgående, ansvarstagande och trivs med att planera och strukturera ditt arbete på egen hand.


Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra men känner dig också bekväm med att arbeta självständigt ute hos kund. För dig är hög kvalitet, säkerhet och god service en självklarhet. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, och drivs av att fortsätta utvecklas inom ditt yrkesområde.


För ytterligare information om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Emilia Ekström, ansvarig rekryterare, via e-post på emilia.ekstrom@zeppelin.com eller telefon 070-508 39 45.

Tjänsten kan tillsättas omgående eller enligt överenskommelse. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller.

Vi värnar om en säker arbetsmiljö och genomför därför alkohol- och drogtest vid nyanställning

title: Field Operations Technician
description:
Ledcor Technical Services has been building and servicing communication networks for customers across North America since 1979. Utilizing our broad expertise and experience, we customize solutions to best meet our client's needs. We act as a key partner for our clients by delivering exceptional quality, reliability, and safety in all that we do.

As a skilled Field Operations Technician, you will utilize your technical background to work on restoration activities, preventative maintenance, and installation. Your emphasis on building trust with clients and providing a best-in-class approach to customer service will be the foundation for success. You will perform installation, repair, configuration and testing of moves, additions, changes and disconnects (MACD) on various Nokia, Infinera, and Ciena equipment. Additionally, you will work with similar products to support customer optical, electrical, voice and data services. Lastly, you will test circuits using optical time domain reflectometers (OTDR).

Apply today to join the Ledcor Technical Services team!

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Deliver a high‑quality, customer‑focused service experience to every client

  • Resolve customer issues calmly and professionally using effective de‑escalation techniques

  • Perform on‑site installation and repair of internet services, copper and fiber cabling, demarc extensions, and rack‑mounted networking equipment

  • Diagnose technical problems and implement solutions, including running new cable, replacing hardware components, and installing data circuits for internet connectivity

  • Follow Ledcor’s safety standards and ensure proper use of vehicles, tools, and equipment at all times

Qualifications:

  • 5 or more years of experience in telecommunications, business installation and service for electronics, appliances, security, and/or cabling

  • A positive, “can-do” attitude and customer focused approach that will enable you to deal with challenging situations with integrity, empathy, and sincerity

  • Degree or diploma from a technical college would be preferred

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office suite

  • Experience working in the field independently and thriving in a dynamic environment

  • Clear and efficient verbal and written communication skills

Work Conditions:

  • Will be expected to travel with a company provided vehicle

  • Able to meet the physical requirements of the position which involves sitting, standing, bending, climbing, lifting (up to 50 pounds), working at heights and in confined spaces such as attics and crawl spaces, as well as in all types of weather conditions (that are deemed safe)

Compensation

$52,800.00 - $72,600.00

This is the expected base pay range for this role. Individual base pay will be determined based on a variety of factors including experience, knowledge, skills, education and location.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial well-being. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

Additional Information

Ledcor Technical Services (LTS) designs, builds, and maintains wireline or wireless networks that span North America and beyond. We are a proven leader and innovator in telecommunications network construction, maintenance, and service installation and repair.

Ledcor has been recognized as a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Employment Equity

At Ledcor we believe diversity, equity, and inclusion should be part of everything we do. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other identifying characteristic are encouraged to apply.

Our True Blue team consists of individuals from all backgrounds who contribute diverse perspectives and experiences to Ledcor. For more information about Ledcor’s Inclusion and Diversity initiatives, please visit our I&D page. Adjustments will be provided in all parts of our hiring process. title: Post Doctoral Fellow (Dr. De Plaen Lab)
description:
Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago provides superior pediatric care in a setting that offers the latest benefits and innovations in medical technology, research and family-friendly design. As the largest pediatric provider in the region with a 140-year legacy of excellence, kids and their families are at the center of all we do. Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago is ranked in all 10 specialties by the U.S. News & World Report.

Location

Simpson Querrey Biomedical Research Center

Job Description

A postdoctoral research position is immediately available to study blood vessels and lymphatics development in the neonatal intestine during necrotising enterocolitis in the laboratory of Isabelle De Plaen at the Simpson Querrey Research Center at Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago/ Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine in Chicago.


This position offers an outstanding opportunity for highly motivated scientists interested in advancing our understanding of the mechanisms causing necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), and helping develop innovative preventative/therapeutic approaches to prevent or limit the progression of the disease.


The De Plaen Laboratory investigates the pathogenesis of NEC, a devastating and life-threatening disease of the intestine affecting premature infants. The research program focuses on how embryonic macrophages promote blood and lymphatic microvasculature development during the perinatal period.

Furthermore, it investigates how this process is impaired during NEC development to identify preventative/therapeutic approaches for NEC. To do so, they are using established mouse models, high-resolution three-dimensional imaging, and single-cell and spatial transcriptomic approaches.


The successful candidate will join a collaborative and intellectually stimulating research environment with access to state-of-the-art facilities, outstanding scientific resources, and extensive opportunities for professional development.


Job Duties:

title: DCom POD Business Process Lead (AI & Automation)
description:
Job Description:

Role Purpose

Mars Snacking’s vision is to create Better Snacks for Better Days, with a clear One Demand vision at the heart of it. At the service of the One Demand Vision, the Tech-Fueled Sales (TFS) ambition is to build a human-led, digitally-powered Sales Engine with the Associate at the center. This entails harnessing AI and data to help our associates sell smarter, serve customers better, and capture more value across every channel.

The DCom Business Process Lead is accountable for transforming Digital Commerce processes into scalable, AI-enabled ways of working that improve efficiency, effectiveness, and business performance. This role exists to fundamentally re-imagine the Dcom commercial workflows, creating the lean, data-driven, and standardized process foundation required for AI and intelligent automation to succeed. He/she will dive deep into our end-to-end digital commerce processes to identify friction, root out inefficiency, and design the future-state workflows that will be powered by AI agents. By serving as the critical bridge between business reality and technical possibility, he/she will ensure our automation efforts are grounded in solid process engineering and deliver measurable efficiency and effectiveness gains for Mars Snacking.

  • Reporting to: Global DCom POD Lead
  • Location: Chicago
  • Travel: 10-15%
  • Direct reports: 0
  • This is a transformation role with an expected end date at the end of 2029.


Key Responsibilities

  • Process Mining & Re-engineering: Lead the deep-dive mapping and analysis of global, end-to-end DCom operational workflows (e.g., content syndication, availability monitoring, retail media execution). Apply formal methodologies (Lean, BPMN) to identify inefficiencies and design optimized, standardized future-state processes.
  • Data Foundation & Governance: Partner with business and data teams to define the data requirements for automated processes. Focus on improving the quality, standardization, and governance of critical process inputs to ensure data is reliable and fit-for-purpose for AI systems.
  • Automation & Agentic Workflow Design: Translate re-engineered processes into detailed functional requirements for AI agents and automation solutions. Design robust "Human-in-the-Loop" workflows to ensure proper validation, compliance, and oversight of AI-driven actions.
  • Solution Prototyping & Validation: Actively participate in the design, configuration, and testing of custom AI agents and workflow solutions. Ensure that technical builds accurately reflect the process design and will deliver the intended business value.
  • Impact Measurement & Continuous Improvement: Define, track, and report on key process performance indicators (e.g., process cycle time, task automation rates, error reduction). Establish a framework for ongoing process monitoring and continuous improvement.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 6+ years of dedicated experience in business process engineering, workflow automation, or systems analysis, with a strong background in Digital Commerce (DCom), CPG, or sales operations.
  • Process Methodologies: Expert-level proficiency in process improvement and notation methodologies is required. Certifications such as Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), or extensive experience with BPMN, Value Stream Mapping, and Design Thinking are highly preferred.
  • Analytical Skills: A highly analytical and data-driven mindset. Proven ability to deconstruct complex systems, model multi-step global processes, and translate them into structured business and technical requirements.
  • Technical & AI Acumen: Strong familiarity with the concepts of Generative AI, APIs, and low-code/no-code automation tools. Critically, must have the ability to translate detailed process maps into logical requirements for developers.
  • Collaboration: Exceptional ability to work as a "translator" between non-technical commercial teams and expert AI engineers to deliver seamless, practical solutions.

Critical Skills & Leadership Capabilities

  • Manages Complexity: Can deconstruct highly complex, cross-functional business processes into clear, logical components and models.
  • Analytical Rigor: Sets clear hypotheses about process failures and uses data to diagnose root causes and validate solutions.
  • Strategic Mindset: Thinks beyond the "as-is" process to envision a simplified, automated future state that drives competitive advantage.
  • Nimble Learning: Quickly learns and understands new commercial domains and technical capabilities, applying that learning to process design.
  • Drives Results: Focuses on delivering tangible outcomes in process efficiency and effectiveness, not just creating process maps.

Measures of Success

  • Measurable reduction in process cycle time, manual effort, and error rates in targeted DCom workflows.
  • Successful translation of process designs into effective, adopted AI agents and automation solutions.
  • Creation and adoption of standardized, global processes for key DCom activities.
  • Positive feedback from both commercial stakeholders (on process simplification) and technical teams (on the clarity of requirements).

What can you expect from Mars?

  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.

title: CNC Technician
description:
Job Description


Boyd Thermal by Eaton is seeking a CNC Technician in our Allenton, WI location.

This position is for 1st shift (7am-3pm or 6a-2p).

Base salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Essential Functions:

  • Develops CNC programs and software (G-Code, CAM) as required.

title: Werkstudent Tax
description:
Keen to become part of a truly global, collaborative team of professionals? Your journey begins here.

Waar ga je werken?
Hogan Lovells behoort tot de grootste internationale advocatenkantoren en heeft meer dan 35 kantoren in Afrika, Azië, Europa, Latijns Amerika, het Midden Oosten en de Verenigde Staten. Wereldwijd werken meer dan 2800 juristen bij Hogan Lovells waarvan circa 70 advocaten, (kandidaat-) notarissen, fiscalisten en paralegals in Amsterdam.


Hierdoor biedt Hogan Lovells Amsterdam “the best of both worlds”; het combineert een high quality global omgeving met de voordelen van een kantoor met een informele sfeer en korte lijnen. Wij voorzien onze cliënten van helder, praktisch en hoogwaardig advies door middel van een gezamenlijke aanpak. Wij ontwikkelen snel uitvoerbare en haalbare oplossingen voor de complexe uitdagingen waarmee onze cliënten worden geconfronteerd.


Innovation & Inclusion en Responsible Business zijn belangrijke prioriteiten voor ons kantoor. Hogan Lovells behoort tot de top 5 van meest innovatieve advocatenkantoren in Noord-Amerika en Europa. Bij Hogan Lovells krijg je de kans om zowel jouw eigen toekomst als die van onze cliënten vorm te geven. Het doen van pro bono- en vrijwilligerswerk zit in het DNA van onze mensen. Op deze manier nemen we onze verantwoordelijkheid om iets terug te geven aan de maatschappij.


Onze mensen zijn de sleutel tot succes en daarom proberen wij in alle regio’s van onze wereldwijde praktijk de meest getalenteerde mensen aan te trekken en te behouden.


Wat kun je verwachten?
Als werkstudent ben je gedurende drie maanden circa twee dagen in de week onderdeel van onze Tax unit. De unit houdt zich bezig met zowel de advisering en begeleiding van transacties als algemene fiscale advisering van vaste relaties, waarbij zowel zelfstandig gewerkt wordt als in multidisciplinair verband, samen met andere business units. Het team begeleidt het nationale en internationale bedrijfsleven en heeft diepgaande kennis en ervaring op het gebied van o.a. internationale (her)structurering, M&A, securitisatie, financieringen en derivaten, het opzetten van beleggingsfondsen en werknemersparticipatievormen.

Je taken zijn breed en divers en bestaan onder andere uit het analyseren van fiscale vraagstukken, het opstellen van memo’s en concept adviezen, het assisteren bij fiscale compliance werkzaamheden, het voorbereiden van presentaties en aanverwante zaken. Daarnaast ben je uiteraard welkom bij al onze sociale activiteiten. Hierdoor komt alles aan bod tijdens je werkstudentschap waardoor je een goed beeld krijgt van hoe het is om onderdeel te zijn van Hogan Lovells.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent een intelligente en gemotiveerde student in de laatste fase van je studie fiscaal recht of fiscale economie (WO);
  • Je neemt initiatief en beschikt over goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden;
  • Je hebt een sterk relativeringsvermogen en oog voor detail;
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.

Geïnteresseerd?
Indien je wilt solliciteren klik je op de ‘apply’ button. Nadat je een account hebt aangemaakt kan je je gegevens invullen en je stukken uploaden. We ontvangen graag je CV, motivatiebrief, cijferlijsten en eventuele (stage)beoordelingen. Vergeet niet in je motivatiebrief te vermelden per wanneer je beschikbaar bent.


Voor vragen kan je contact opnemen met Ariëlle Hulst (Campus Recruiter) via telefoonnummer 020-5533660 of per mail: amsterdam.recruitment@hoganlovells.com.

title: Associate Mathematician
description:
Gaming:

Welcome to the world of land-based gaming. At Light & Wonder, it’s all about the games, and our Gaming team builds cutting-edge technology, products, and content for the most iconic casinos and operators across the globe.

Position Summary

Our Reno team at Light & Wonder develops games for the specialty markets. We design and develop custom content for our Central Determination, Class II, Historical Horse Racing, and Class III markets. These markets are located across the United States and Canada. It is an exciting environment where game designers, mathematicians, engineers, artists, sound designers, and testers work together to produce some of the best content for the market.


We are looking for a creative and passionate mathematician to design and proof math models for our gaming products and to work closely with game designers, producers, engineers, and graphic and sound artists. The primary responsibility of this position is to deliver high quality and timely math models. It will also require the coding, testing, and debugging of game simulations in an existing framework. This position must demonstrate a high degree of initiative and is accountable for the thorough implementation of all tasks assigned.


Essential Job Functions:

· Work with game designers and mathematicians to develop proof of concept and feasible math models.

· Develop and generate math models that demonstrate gaming probabilities and mathematical return of games via theoretical calculation and/or simulation.

· Participate and contribute in the game design and invention process.

· Work with engineers to ensure correct implementation of math models.

· Deliver high quality work as scheduled in accordance with the game design and product requirements.

· Provide computer simulation and analysis of existing and new math models.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics/Statistics or Computer Science preferred. Bachelor’s degree in EE or Physics or other scientific fields with a strong mathematical background considered.


Experience:

· 1-2 years of working knowledge in the areas of applied mathematics, probability, or combinatorics.

· 1-2 years of experience with C++, C#, Python or similar object-oriented programming language.

· Experience in Microsoft Excel and Visual Studio a plus.


Knowledge Skills and Abilities:

· Expert knowledge of probability.

· Must enjoy working in a creative environment.

· Knowledge of programming languages, software development, design patterns and object-oriented programming.

· Ability to create spreadsheets and software simulations to verify math models.

· Ability to identify, research, and solve gaming related problems.

· Ability to interface and communicate with other members of the game development staff.

· Ability to bring projects to completion with minimal supervision.

· Good written and verbal communication skills and a high level of interpersonal skills.

· Must be a self-motivated team player with the ability to work in a customer-oriented, very fast-paced, demanding, and deadline-driven environment.


Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, bend, use hands, operate a computer, and have specific vision abilities to include close and distance vision, and ability to adjust focus working with computer and business equipment.


Work Conditions

Light & Wonder, Inc. and its affiliates (collectively, “L&W”) are engaged in the highly regulated gaming business. As a result, L&W employees may, among other things, be required to obtain a gaming or other license(s), undergo background investigations or security checks, and/or meet certain standards dictated by law, regulation or contracts. To ensure L&W complies with its regulatory and contractual commitments, as a condition to hiring and continuing to employ its employees, L&W requires all of its employees to meet those requirements necessary to fulfill their individual roles. As a prerequisite to employment with L&W (to the extent permitted by law), you shall be asked to consent to L&W conducting due diligence and a background investigation on you.

This job description should not be interpreted as all-inclusive; it is intended to identify major responsibilities and requirements of the job. The employee in this position may be requested to perform other job-related tasks and responsibilities than those stated above.

title: Family Services Specialist I- (Adult Protective Services)
description:
Title Description- Family Services Specialist I represents the entry level employees working under close supervision while being trained in program areas such as, Adult/Adult Protective Services, Child Protective Services, Foster Care/’Adoption, Child Care, and Employment Services. Employees perform routine- to journey-level casework activities and the casework usually is reviewed by the supervisor prior to implementing a case action. Upon completion of the training program and attainment of necessary approvals, the employee shall be redefined to a full-performance Family Services Specialist II and becomes eligible for a pay increase as defined by the local agency compensation plan. The Family Services Specialist I is distinguished from the Family Services Specialist II by the latter’s functioning more independently as a full performance Family Services Specialist.

General Work Tasks (Illustrative Only) –
  • Interprets laws, policies and regulations as applied to specific area of responsibility;
  • Monitors, coordinates and administers specific programs as assigned;
  • Coordinates services within specific area of responsibility;
  • Interviews and assesses customer needs and other relevant factors – such as education/skill levels, abilities, interests, and support systems.
  • Informs clients of related service programs rules/regulations, and right to participate;
  • Presents cases to determine appropriate services and writes/implements service plans;
  • Provides case management services to monitor compliance;
  • Manages program waiting lists;
  • Tracks expenditures, prepares/submits budget estimates and ensures payment for services;
  • Completes necessary federal, state and local planning and reporting requirements;
  • Coordinates with other agencies and participates in multi-disciplinary and interagency teams providing services to customers;
  • Conducts overall monitoring of programs in specific area of responsibility;
  • Serves as resource to clients and the community in area of expertise; and
  • Provides after hours on-call coverage and responds to emergencies in child/adult protective services and/or foster care.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Knowledge- Some knowledge of: social work principles and practices; human behavior and motivational theory; and social, economic, and health problems.

Skills- Skill in operating a motor vehicle and personal computer with associated software.

Abilities- Demonstrated ability to: communicate effectively both orally and in writing; interview, assess needs, counsel and refer clients to other resources as needed; develop and implement service plans in order to insure the delivery of appropriate services to the client; make sound judgments within the framework of existing laws, policies, and regulations; respond to the client's emotions in order to accomplish services objectives; plan and manage own work activities including service delivery preparing reports, and correspondence, record keeping responsibilities and related activities; establish and maintain effective relationships; and stay abreast of current trends and developments in the social work field.

Education and Experience- Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in a Human Services field or minimum of a Bachelor's degree in any field with a minimum of two years of appropriate and related experience in a Human Services area as mandated in Section 22VAC40-670-20 of the Administrative Code of Virginia and implemented by the Virginia Board of Social Services. Possession of a BSW or MSW degree and a Commonwealth of Virginia Social Worker license are desirable.

title: Vil du drive din egen butikk og skape vekst med et av Norges sterkeste konsepter?

title: Extern 4-TPP-6004
description:
Position Title: Nurse Dev & Nurse TPP Position Code: TPP-XXXX

Department: Nursing /Education Safety Sensitive: ☒ Yes ☐ No

Reports to: Department Manager/Director Exempt Status: ☐ Yes ☒ No

Position Purpose:

All KHI employees are expected to perform their respective tasks and duties in such a way that supports KHI’s vision to be among the kindest, highest quality health systems in the country.

The primary purpose of the Nursing Transition to Practice Program (TPP) position is to allow the student to perform skilled clinical duties, as specified, and as defined by the Arizona State Board of Nursing.

Key Responsibilities

All Levels / All Students:

  • Performs patient assessments, collects basic clinical data, monitors patient status, and obtains specimens in accordance with nursing standards under the direct supervision of an RN.
  • Collaborates under the supervision of an RN to identify patient care needs, develop care plans, and implement appropriate interventions and patient education.
  • Provides direct patient care and assists with activities of daily living, restorative care, and therapeutic interventions to support patient recovery and well-being.
  • Monitors patient responses to treatment, promptly reports changes in condition to the supervising RN, and contributes to patient safety and quality outcomes.
  • Maintains accurate and timely documentation, follows organizational policies and infection prevention practices, ensures a safe care environment, and adheres to Arizona State Board of Nursing and KRMC requirements.
  • Performs other duties as assigned to support overall effectiveness of department and organization.

Level I: First Semester Students

  • Vital sign monitoring.
  • POC testing.
  • Hourly rounding.
  • Patient ADLS (activities of daily living), mobility assistance.
  • Documenting care in EHR and reporting findings to supervising RN.
  • Performs specific skills under the supervising RN and as validated by the hospital.
  • Active participation in professional development workshops as provided by program.
  • Employee duties as assigned and per training in ancillary support areas and nursing units.

Level II: Second Semester Students

  • Continued active participation in professional development workshops as provided by program.
  • All duties of Level I and other duties as assigned by nursing/clinical area.

title: Residential Building and Zoning Plans Examiner
description:
About Our Job


With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver.


What We Offer


The City and County of Denver offers competitive pay commensurate with education and experience. New hires are typically brought into the organization between $31.33 - $43.00/hour. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:


  • A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
  • 457B Retirement Plan
  • 140 hours of PTO earned within first year + 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 wellness day, and 1 volunteer day per year
  • Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location & Schedule


The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model. Employees work where needed, at a job site several days a week and off-site as needed. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their off-site days.


In this position you can expect to work three (3) days in office at the Webb Municipal Building (201 W. Colfax Ave., Denver, CO 80202).


Who We Are & What You’ll Do


BUILDING COMMUNITY: Denver Community Planning and Development is responsible for visionary city planning and ensuring safe, responsible, sustainable building. CPD regulates planning, zoning, development and maintenance of private property in Denver. We're working hard to make Denver a great place to live, work and play! Visit .


Our Community Planning and Development Team is currently seeking a Residential Building and/or Zoning Plans Examiner to join our team!. The work assigned to the Residential Building and/or Zoning Plans Review Examiner position may include performing building and/or zoning code plan review for a wide range of permit applications of varying complexity for one- and two-family residential structures, performing zone lot verification reviews, providing front line services to residential customers, and responding to code and process questions.


Specifically, as the Residential Building and/or Zoning Plans Examiner, you will:


  • Review a wide range of building and/or zoning permit applications for the construction of one- and two-family residential buildings and associated accessory structures.
  • Conduct zoning and building records research to verify zone lots, and existing permitted uses and structures.
  • Review, examine, and interpret a wide range of construction documents and permit application materials for compliance with applicable codes, policies, and standards which may include the Denver Building and Fire Code, International Residential Code, International Energy Conservation Code, The Denver Zoning Code, and Former Chapter 59 (the “old” Zoning Code).
  • Generate plan review notices (comment letters) that clearly outline deficiencies in the permit application submittal and the corrections that are required to demonstrate compliance; comments should reference an applicable code and code section.
  • Update the permitting system, Accela, according to department procedures and policies, including but not limited to creating and filling out permits, relating records, updating workflow, and invoicing fees.
  • Assist one- and two-family customers with inquiries at the residential permit counter, via pre-application meetings, and via the general residential phone number and email. This involves advising contractors, architects, engineers, builders, homeowners, and the public on the permitting process and code requirements.
  • Interpret and explain a wide range of code requirements, permit application procedures, policies, and standards to the public, professional design consultants, project managers, contractors, city managers, and elected officials.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring


We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.


Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:


  • Experience reviewing and examining construction documents for conformance with either building code or zoning code regulations
  • For applicants with a building code background:
    • Certification from the International Code Council as a Residential Plans Examiner or Building Plans Examiner
    • Experience in Architecture, Engineering, Building Construction, Inspections, or Construction Project Management
  • For applicants with a planning or zoning code background:
    • Experience in Planning, Architecture, or Engineering
  • Proficient with using Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook, Bluebeam, and Adobe Acrobat; experience using electronic permitting systems and programs, such as Accela.
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills; ability to communicate effectively – verbally and in writing.
  • Efficiently demonstrates excellent time/work management skills; self-motivated and motivated to help others.
  • Problem solver that can envision various outcomes and plan accordingly to mitigate risky outcomes.

Required Minimum Qualifications


  • Education requirements: Graduation from high school or the possession of a GED, HiSET or TASC Certificate.
  • Experience Requirement: Five (5) years of plans review experience reviewing blueprints and plans for zoning and/or construction projects with regard to the compliance of zoning and construction codes and regulations.
  • Education/Experience Equivalency: Additional appropriate education may be substituted for the minimum experience requirements.

To be considered for this position, you must include the following on your job application (upload the attachments to the Resume/CV section on the My Experience tab):


  • Resume
  • Cover Letter (preferred)

Application Deadline


This position is expected to stay open until Tuesday, October 6, 2026. Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 10/6/26 at 11:59 p.m. to ensure consideration.

description:

Land acknowledgement:

Oak Valley Health is honoured to provide care on the traditional and treaty territory of the Anishinaabeg, and acknowledge our closest Indigenous communities, the Chippewas of Georgina Island and the Mississaugas of Scugog Island. The land is encompassed within Treaty 13, Treaty 20, and the Williams Treaty.


Today, this area is home to many diverse Indigenous Peoples, and we acknowledge the health disparities and barriers Indigenous Peoples face in accessing care. To support true healing, we are committed to understanding these challenges, learning from Indigenous knowledge, and taking action together to improve safe and equitable health care for current and future generations.

Who you are:

Who you are:
